  have : (interior D).EqOn (deriv f) f' := deriv_eqOn isOpen_interior hf'
  refine concaveOn_of_deriv2_nonpos hD hf (fun x hx ↦ (hf' _ hx).differentiableWithinAt) ?_ ?_
  · rw [differentiableOn_congr this]
    exact fun x hx ↦ (hf'' _ hx).differentiableWithinAt
  · rintro x hx
    convert hf''₀ _ hx
    dsimp
    rw [deriv_eqOn isOpen_interior (fun y hy ↦ ?_) hx]
    exact (hf'' _ hy).congr this <| by rw [this hy]

    BddBelow (slope f x '' {y ∈ s | x < y})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hyx, hys⟩ : ∃ y, y < x ∧ y ∈ s :=
    Eventually.exists_lt (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp hxs)
  refine bddBelow_iff_subset_Ici.mpr ⟨slope f x y, fun y' ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  simp_rw [mem_Ici, ← hz']
  refine hfc.slope_mono (interior_subset hxs) ?_ ?_ (hyx.trans hz.2).le
  · simp [hys, hyx.ne]
  · simp [hz.2.ne', hz.1]

proof:

  refine bddAbove_iff_subset_Iic.mpr ⟨slope f x y, fun y' ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  simp_rw [mem_Iic, ← hz']
  refine hfc.slope_mono (interior_subset hxs) ?_ ?_ (hz.2.trans hyx).le
  · simp [hz.2.ne, hz.1]

name: hasDerivWithinAt_sInf_slope_of_mem_interior
statement:
lemma hasDerivWithinAt_sInf_slope_of_mem_interior (hfc : ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hxs : x ∈ interior S) :
    HasDerivWithinAt f (sInf (slope f x '' {y ∈ S | x < y})) (Ioi x) x
proof:
:= by
  have hxs' := hxs
  rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds, mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset] at hxs'
  obtain ⟨a, b, hxab, habs⟩ := hxs'
  simp_rw [hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope]
  simp only [mem_Ioi, lt_self_iff_false, not_false_eq_true, sdiff_singleton_eq_self]
  have h : Ioo x b ⊆ {y | y ∈ S ∧ x < y} := fun z hz ↦ ⟨habs ⟨hxab.1.trans hz.1, hz.2⟩, hz.1⟩
  have h_Ioo : Tendsto (slope f x) (𝓝[>] x) (𝓝 (sInf (slope f x '' Ioo x b))) :=
    ((monotoneOn_slope_gt hfc (habs hxab)).mono h).tendsto_nhdsWithin_Ioo_right
      (by simpa using hxab.2) ((bddBelow_slope_lt_of_mem_interior hfc hxs).mono (image_mono h))
  suffices sInf (slope f x '' Ioo x b) = sInf (slope f x '' {y ∈ S | x < y}) by rwa [← this]
  apply (monotoneOn_slope_gt hfc (habs hxab)).csInf_eq_of_subset_of_forall_exists_le
    (bddBelow_slope_lt_of_mem_interior hfc hxs) h ?_
  rintro y ⟨hyS, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hxz, hzy⟩ := exists_between (lt_min hxab.2 hxy)
  exact ⟨z, ⟨hxz, hzy.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)⟩, hzy.le.trans (min_le_right _ _)⟩

name: hasDerivWithinAt_sSup_slope_of_mem_interior
statement:
lemma hasDerivWithinAt_sSup_slope_of_mem_interior (hfc : ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hxs : x ∈ interior S) :
    HasDerivWithinAt f (sSup (slope f x '' {y ∈ S | y < x})) (Iio x) x
proof:
:= by
  have hxs' := hxs
  rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds, mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset] at hxs'
  obtain ⟨a, b, hxab, habs⟩ := hxs'
  simp_rw [hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope]
  simp only [mem_Iio, lt_self_iff_false, not_false_eq_true, sdiff_singleton_eq_self]
  have h : Ioo a x ⊆ {y | y ∈ S ∧ y < x} := fun z hz ↦ ⟨habs ⟨hz.1, hz.2.trans hxab.2⟩, hz.2⟩
  have h_Ioo : Tendsto (slope f x) (𝓝[<] x) (𝓝 (sSup (slope f x '' Ioo a x))) :=
    ((monotoneOn_slope_lt hfc (habs hxab)).mono h).tendsto_nhdsWithin_Ioo_left
      (by simpa using hxab.1) ((bddAbove_slope_gt_of_mem_interior hfc hxs).mono (image_mono h))
  suffices sSup (slope f x '' Ioo a x) = sSup (slope f x '' {y ∈ S | y < x}) by rwa [← this]
  apply (monotoneOn_slope_lt hfc (habs hxab)).csSup_eq_of_subset_of_forall_exists_le
    (bddAbove_slope_gt_of_mem_interior hfc hxs) h ?_
  rintro y ⟨hyS, hyx⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hyz, hzx⟩ := exists_between (max_lt hxab.1 hyx)
  exact ⟨z, ⟨(le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hyz, hzx⟩, (le_max_right _ _).trans hyz.le⟩

name: monotoneOn_rightDeriv
statement:
lemma monotoneOn_rightDeriv (hfc : ConvexOn ℝ S f) :
    MonotoneOn (fun x ↦ derivWithin f (Ioi x) x) (interior S)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxs y hys hxy
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hxy with rfl | hxy; · rfl
  simp_rw [hfc.rightDeriv_eq_sInf_slope_of_mem_interior hxs,
    hfc.rightDeriv_eq_sInf_slope_of_mem_interior hys]
  refine csInf_le_of_le (b := slope f x y) (bddBelow_slope_lt_of_mem_interior hfc hxs)
    ⟨y, by simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, hxy, and_true]; exact interior_subset hys⟩
    (le_csInf ?_ ?_)
  · have hys' := hys
    rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds, mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset] at hys'
    obtain ⟨a, b, hxab, habs⟩ := hys'
    rw [image_nonempty]
    obtain ⟨z, hxz, hzb⟩ := exists_between hxab.2
    exact ⟨z, habs ⟨hxab.1.trans hxz, hzb⟩, hxz⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨z, ⟨hzs, hyz : y < z⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [slope_comm]
    exact slope_mono hfc (interior_subset hys) ⟨interior_subset hxs, hxy.ne⟩ ⟨hzs, hyz.ne'⟩
      (hxy.trans hyz).le

name: monotoneOn_leftDeriv
statement:
lemma monotoneOn_leftDeriv (hfc : ConvexOn ℝ S f) :
    MonotoneOn (fun x ↦ derivWithin f (Iio x) x) (interior S)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxs y hys hxy
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hxy with rfl | hxy; · rfl
  simp_rw [hfc.leftDeriv_eq_sSup_slope_of_mem_interior hxs,
    hfc.leftDeriv_eq_sSup_slope_of_mem_interior hys]
  refine le_csSup_of_le (b := slope f x y) (bddAbove_slope_gt_of_mem_interior hfc hys)
    ⟨x, by simp only [slope_comm, mem_ofPred_eq, hxy, and_true]; exact interior_subset hxs⟩
    (csSup_le ?_ ?_)
  · have hxs' := hxs
    rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds, mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset] at hxs'
    obtain ⟨a, b, hxab, habs⟩ := hxs'
    rw [image_nonempty]
    obtain ⟨z, hxz, hzb⟩ := exists_between hxab.1
    exact ⟨z, habs ⟨hxz, hzb.trans hxab.2⟩, hzb⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨z, ⟨hzs, hyz : z < x⟩, rfl⟩
    exact slope_mono hfc (interior_subset hxs) ⟨hzs, hyz.ne⟩ ⟨interior_subset hys, hxy.ne'⟩
      (hyz.trans hxy).le

name: leftDeriv_le_rightDeriv_of_mem_interior
statement:
lemma leftDeriv_le_rightDeriv_of_mem_interior (hfc : ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hxs : x ∈ interior S) :
    derivWithin f (Iio x) x ≤ derivWithin f (Ioi x) x
proof:
:= by
  have hxs' := hxs
  rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds, mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset] at hxs'
  obtain ⟨a, b, hxab, habs⟩ := hxs'
  rw [hfc.rightDeriv_eq_sInf_slope_of_mem_interior hxs,
    hfc.leftDeriv_eq_sSup_slope_of_mem_interior hxs]
  refine csSup_le ?_ ?_
  · rw [image_nonempty]
    obtain ⟨z, haz, hzx⟩ := exists_between hxab.1
    exact ⟨z, habs ⟨haz, hzx.trans hxab.2⟩, hzx⟩
  rintro _ ⟨z, ⟨hzs, hzx⟩, rfl⟩
  refine le_csInf ?_ ?_
  · rw [image_nonempty]
    obtain ⟨z, hxz, hzb⟩ := exists_between hxab.2
    exact ⟨z, habs ⟨hxab.1.trans hxz, hzb⟩, hxz⟩
  rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hys, hxy⟩, rfl⟩
  exact slope_mono hfc (interior_subset hxs) ⟨hzs, hzx.ne⟩ ⟨hys, hxy.ne'⟩ (hzx.trans hxy).le

name: le_slope_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Ioi
statement:
lemma le_slope_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Ioi (hfc : ConvexOn ℝ S f)
    (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) (hxy : x < y) (hf' : HasDerivWithinAt f f' (Ioi x) x) :
    f' ≤ slope f x y
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_tendsto <| (hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope' self_notMem_Ioi).mp hf'
  simp_rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff, slope_def_field]
  filter_upwards [eventually_lt_nhds hxy] with t ht (ht' : x < t)
  refine hfc.secant_mono hx (?_ : t ∈ S) hy ht'.ne' hxy.ne' ht.le
  exact hfc.1.ordConnected.out hx hy ⟨ht'.le, ht.le⟩

name: rightDeriv_le_slope
statement:
lemma rightDeriv_le_slope (hfc : ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) (hxy : x < y)

    derivWithin f (Ioi x) x ≤ slope f x y
proof:

  le_slope_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Ioi hfc hx hy hxy hfd.hasDerivWithinAt

name: slope_le_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Iio
statement:
lemma slope_le_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Iio (hfc : ConvexOn ℝ S f)
    (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) (hxy : x < y) (hf' : HasDerivWithinAt f f' (Iio y) y) :
    slope f x y ≤ f'
proof:
:= by
  apply ge_of_tendsto <| (hasDerivWithinAt_iff_tendsto_slope' self_notMem_Iio).mp hf'
  simp_rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff, slope_comm f x y, slope_def_field]
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_nhds hxy] with t ht (ht' : t < y)
  refine hfc.secant_mono hy hx (?_ : t ∈ S) hxy.ne ht'.ne ht.le
  exact hfc.1.ordConnected.out hx hy ⟨ht.le, ht'.le⟩

lemma monotoneOn_derivWithin (hfc : ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f S) :

proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hxy with rfl | hxy'
  · rfl
  exact (hfc.derivWithin_le_slope hx hy hxy' (hfd x hx)).trans
    (hfc.slope_le_derivWithin hx hy hxy' (hfd y hy))

name: monotoneOn_deriv
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_deriv (hfc : ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hfd : ∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) :

proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hxy with rfl | hxy'
  · rfl
  exact (hfc.deriv_le_slope hx hy hxy' (hfd x hx)).trans (hfc.slope_le_deriv hx hy hxy' (hfd y hy))

name: isMinOn_of_leftDeriv_nonpos_of_rightDeriv_nonneg
statement:
lemma isMinOn_of_leftDeriv_nonpos_of_rightDeriv_nonneg (hf : ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hx : x ∈ interior S)
    (hf_ld : derivWithin f (Iio x) x ≤ 0) (hf_rd : 0 ≤ derivWithin f (Ioi x) x) :
    IsMinOn f S x
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with hxy | h_eq | hyx
  · suffices 0 ≤ slope f x y by
      simp only [slope_def_field, div_nonneg_iff, sub_nonneg, tsub_le_iff_right, zero_add,
        not_le.mpr hxy, and_false, or_false] at this
      exact this.1
    exact hf_rd.trans <| rightDeriv_le_slope_of_mem_interior hf hx hy hxy
  · simp [h_eq]
  · suffices slope f x y ≤ 0 by
      simp only [slope_def_field, div_nonpos_iff, sub_nonneg, tsub_le_iff_right, zero_add,
        not_le.mpr hyx, and_false, or_false] at this
      exact this.1
    rw [slope_comm]
    exact (slope_le_leftDeriv_of_mem_interior hf hy hx hyx).trans hf_ld

name: isMinOn_of_rightDeriv_eq_zero
statement:
lemma isMinOn_of_rightDeriv_eq_zero (hf : ConvexOn ℝ S f) (hx : x ∈ interior S)
    (hf_rd : derivWithin f (Ioi x) x = 0) :
    IsMinOn f S x
proof:
:= by
  refine hf.isMinOn_of_leftDeriv_nonpos_of_rightDeriv_nonneg hx ?_ hf_rd.symm.le
  exact (hf.leftDeriv_le_rightDeriv_of_mem_interior hx).trans_eq hf_rd

name: isMinOn_of_leftDeriv_eq_zero
statement:

    IsMinOn f S x
proof:
:= by
  refine hf.isMinOn_of_leftDeriv_nonpos_of_rightDeriv_nonneg hx hf_ld.le ?_
  exact hf_ld.symm.le.trans (hf.leftDeriv_le_rightDeriv_of_mem_interior hx)

name: lt_slope_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Ioi
statement:
lemma lt_slope_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Ioi (hfc : StrictConvexOn ℝ S f)
    (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) (hxy : x < y) (hf' : HasDerivWithinAt f f' (Ioi x) x) :
    f' < slope f x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hxu, huy⟩ := exists_between hxy
  have hu : u ∈ S := hfc.1.ordConnected.out hx hy ⟨hxu.le, huy.le⟩
  have := hfc.secant_strict_mono hx hu hy hxu.ne' hxy.ne' huy
  simp only [← slope_def_field] at this
  exact (hfc.convexOn.le_slope_of_hasDerivWithinAt_Ioi hx hu hxu hf').trans_lt this

name: Finset.centerMass_empty
statement: theorem Finset.centerMass_empty : (∅ : Finset ι).centerMass w z = 0

name: Finset.centerMass_pair
statement:
theorem Finset.centerMass_pair [DecidableEq ι] (hne : i ≠ j) :
    ({i, j} : Finset ι).centerMass w z = (w i / (w i + w j)) • z i + (w j / (w i + w j)) • z j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [centerMass, sum_pair hne]
  module

name: Finset.centerMass_insert
statement:
theorem Finset.centerMass_insert [DecidableEq ι] (ha : i ∉ t) (hw : ∑ j ∈ t, w j ≠ 0) :
    (insert i t).centerMass w z =
      (w i / (w i + ∑ j ∈ t, w j)) • z i +
        ((∑ j ∈ t, w j) / (w i + ∑ j ∈ t, w j)) • t.centerMass w z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [centerMass, sum_insert ha, smul_add, (mul_smul _ _ _).symm, ← div_eq_inv_mul]
  congr 2
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_inv_cancel₀ hw, one_div]

name: Finset.centerMass_singleton
statement: theorem Finset.centerMass_singleton (hw : w i ≠ 0) : ({i} : Finset ι).centerMass w z = z i
proof:
:= by
  rw [centerMass, sum_singleton, sum_singleton]
  match_scalars
  field

name: Finset.centerMass_neg_left
statement: @[simp] lemma Finset.centerMass_neg_left : t.centerMass (-w) z = t.centerMass w z

name: Finset.centerMass_smul_left
statement:
lemma Finset.centerMass_smul_left {c : R'} [Module R' R] [Module R' E] [SMulCommClass R' R R]
    [IsScalarTower R' R R] [SMulCommClass R R' E] [IsScalarTower R' R E] (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    t.centerMass (c • w) z = t.centerMass w z
proof:
:= by
  simp [centerMass, -smul_assoc, smul_assoc c, ← smul_sum, smul_inv₀, smul_smul_smul_comm, hc]

name: Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1
statement:
theorem Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 (hw : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) :
    t.centerMass w z = ∑ i ∈ t, w i • z i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.centerMass, hw, inv_one, one_smul]

name: Finset.centerMass_smul
statement: theorem Finset.centerMass_smul : (t.centerMass w fun i => c • z i) = c • t.centerMass w z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.centerMass, Finset.smul_sum, (mul_smul _ _ _).symm, mul_comm c, mul_assoc]

name: Finset.centerMass_segment'
statement:
theorem Finset.centerMass_segment' (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset ι') (ws : ι → R) (zs : ι → E)
    (wt : ι' → R) (zt : ι' → E) (hws : ∑ i ∈ s, ws i = 1) (hwt : ∑ i ∈ t, wt i = 1) (a b : R)
    (hab : a + b = 1) : a • s.centerMass ws zs + b • t.centerMass wt zt = (s.disjSum t).centerMass
    (Sum.elim (fun i => a * ws i) fun j => b * wt j) (Sum.elim zs zt)
proof:
:= by
  rw [s.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ hws, t.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ hwt, smul_sum, smul_sum, ←
    Finset.sum_sumElim, Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1]
  · congr with ⟨⟩ <;> simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, mul_smul]
  · rw [sum_sumElim, ← mul_sum, ← mul_sum, hws, hwt, mul_one, mul_one, hab]

name: Finset.centerMass_segment
statement:
theorem Finset.centerMass_segment (s : Finset ι) (w₁ w₂ : ι → R) (z : ι → E)
    (hw₁ : ∑ i ∈ s, w₁ i = 1) (hw₂ : ∑ i ∈ s, w₂ i = 1) (a b : R) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a • s.centerMass w₁ z + b • s.centerMass w₂ z =
    s.centerMass (fun i => a * w₁ i + b * w₂ i) z
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (∑ i ∈ s, (a * w₁ i + b * w₂ i)) = 1 := by
    simp only [← mul_sum, sum_add_distrib, mul_one, *]
  simp only [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1, smul_sum, sum_add_distrib, add_smul, mul_smul, *]

name: Finset.centerMass_ite_eq
statement:
theorem Finset.centerMass_ite_eq [DecidableEq ι] (hi : i ∈ t) :
    t.centerMass (fun j => if i = j then (1 : R) else 0) z = z i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1]
  · trans ∑ j ∈ t, if i = j then z i else 0
    · congr with i
      split_ifs with h
      exacts [h ▸ one_smul _ _, zero_smul _ _]
    · rw [sum_ite_eq, ite_eq_left hi]
  · rw [sum_ite_eq, ite_eq_left hi]

name: Finset.centerMass_subset
statement:
theorem Finset.centerMass_subset {t' : Finset ι} (ht : t ⊆ t') (h : ∀ i ∈ t', i ∉ t → w i = 0) :
    t.centerMass w z = t'.centerMass w z
proof:
:= by
  rw [centerMass, sum_subset ht h, smul_sum, centerMass, smul_sum]
  apply sum_subset ht
  intro i hit' hit
  rw [h i hit' hit, zero_smul, smul_zero]

name: Finset.centerMass_filter_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Finset.centerMass_filter_ne_zero [∀ i, Decidable (w i ≠ 0)] :
    {i ∈ t | w i ≠ 0}.centerMass w z = t.centerMass w z
proof:
:=
  Finset.centerMass_subset z (filter_subset _ _) fun i hit hit' => by
    simpa only [hit, mem_filter, true_and, Ne, Classical.not_not] using hit'

name: centerMass_le_sup
statement:
theorem centerMass_le_sup {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} {w : ι → R} (hw₀ : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw₁ : 0 < ∑ i ∈ s, w i) :
    s.centerMass w f ≤ s.sup' (nonempty_of_ne_empty <| by rintro rfl; simp at hw₁) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [centerMass, inv_smul_le_iff_of_pos hw₁, sum_smul]
  exact sum_le_sum fun i hi => smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (le_sup' _ hi) <| hw₀ i hi

name: inf_le_centerMass
statement:
theorem inf_le_centerMass {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} {w : ι → R} (hw₀ : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i)

name: Finset.centerMass_congr
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← centerMass_filter_ne_zero, centerMass, ← centerMass_filter_ne_zero, centerMass]
  congr 1
  · congr 1
    exact sum_congr (by grind) (by grind)
  · exact sum_congr (by grind) (by grind)

name: Finset.centerMass_of_sum_add_sum_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  simp [centerMass, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hw, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hz]

name: Convex.centerMass_mem
statement:
theorem Convex.centerMass_mem (hs : Convex R s) :
    (∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) → (0 < ∑ i ∈ t, w i) → (∀ i ∈ t, z i ∈ s) → t.centerMass w z ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i t hi ht =>
    intro h₀ hpos hmem
    have zi : z i ∈ s := hmem _ (mem_insert_self _ _)
    have hs₀ : ∀ j ∈ t, 0 ≤ w j := fun j hj => h₀ j <| mem_insert_of_mem hj
    rw [sum_insert hi] at hpos
    by_cases hsum_t : ∑ j ∈ t, w j = 0
    · have ws : ∀ j ∈ t, w j = 0 := (sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hs₀).1 hsum_t
      have wz : ∑ j ∈ t, w j • z j = 0 := sum_eq_zero fun i hi => by simp [ws i hi]
      simp only [centerMass, sum_insert hi, wz, hsum_t, add_zero]
      simp only [hsum_t, add_zero] at hpos
      rw [← mul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hpos), one_smul]
      exact zi
    · rw [Finset.centerMass_insert _ _ _ hi hsum_t]
      refine convex_iff_div.1 hs zi (ht hs₀ ?_ ?_) ?_ (sum_nonneg hs₀) hpos
      · exact lt_of_le_of_ne (sum_nonneg hs₀) (Ne.symm hsum_t)
      · intro j hj
        exact hmem j (mem_insert_of_mem hj)
      · exact h₀ _ (mem_insert_self _ _)

name: Convex.sum_mem
statement:
theorem Convex.sum_mem (hs : Convex R s) (h₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) (h₁ : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1)
    (hz : ∀ i ∈ t, z i ∈ s) : (∑ i ∈ t, w i • z i) ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [h₁, centerMass, inv_one, one_smul] using
    hs.centerMass_mem h₀ (h₁.symm ▸ zero_lt_one) hz

name: Convex.finsum_mem
statement:
theorem Convex.finsum_mem {ι : Sort*} {w : ι → R} {z : ι → E} {s : Set E} (hs : Convex R s)
    (h₀ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (h₁ : ∑ᶠ i, w i = 1) (hz : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 → z i ∈ s) :
    (∑ᶠ i, w i • z i) ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  have hfin_w : HasFiniteSupport (w ∘ PLift.down) := by
    by_contra H
    rw [finsum, dite_eq_right H] at h₁
    exact zero_ne_one h₁
  have hsub : support ((fun i => w i • z i) ∘ PLift.down) ⊆ hfin_w.toFinset :=
    (support_smul_subset_left _ _).trans hfin_w.coe_toFinset.ge
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_plift_of_support_subset hsub]
  refine hs.sum_mem (fun _ _ => h₀ _) ?_ fun i hi => hz _ ?_
  · rwa [finsum, dite_eq_left hfin_w] at h₁
  · rwa [hfin_w.mem_toFinset] at hi

name: convex_iff_sum_mem
statement:
theorem convex_iff_sum_mem : Convex R s ↔ ∀ (t : Finset E) (w : E → R),
    (∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) → ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1 → (∀ x ∈ t, x ∈ s) → (∑ x ∈ t, w x • x) ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun hs t w hw₀ hw₁ hts => hs.sum_mem hw₀ hw₁ hts, ?_⟩
  intro h x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  by_cases h_cases : x = y
  · rw [h_cases, ← add_smul, hab, one_smul]
    exact hy
  · convert! h { x, y } (fun z => if z = y then b else a) _ _ _
    · simp only [sum_pair h_cases, ite_eq_right h_cases, ite_eq_left trivial]
    · grind
    · simp only [sum_pair h_cases, ite_eq_right h_cases, ite_eq_left trivial, hab]
    · intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.mem_insert] at hi
      cases hi <;> subst i <;> assumption

name: Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull
statement:
theorem Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull (t : Finset ι) {w : ι → R} (hw₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hws : 0 < ∑ i ∈ t, w i) {z : ι → E} (hz : ∀ i ∈ t, z i ∈ s) :
    t.centerMass w z ∈ convexHull R s
proof:
:=
  (convex_convexHull R s).centerMass_mem hw₀ hws fun i hi => subset_convexHull R s <| hz i hi

name: Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull_of_nonpos
statement:
lemma Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull_of_nonpos (t : Finset ι) (hw₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, w i ≤ 0)
    (hws : ∑ i ∈ t, w i < 0) (hz : ∀ i ∈ t, z i ∈ s) : t.centerMass w z ∈ convexHull R s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← centerMass_neg_left]
  exact Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull _ (fun _i hi ↦ neg_nonneg.2 <| hw₀ _ hi) (by simpa) hz

name: Finset.centerMass_id_mem_convexHull
statement:
theorem Finset.centerMass_id_mem_convexHull (t : Finset E) {w : E → R} (hw₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hws : 0 < ∑ i ∈ t, w i) : t.centerMass w id ∈ convexHull R (t : Set E)

name: Finset.centerMass_id_mem_convexHull_of_nonpos
affineCombination_eq_centerMass
statement:
theorem affineCombination_eq_centerMass {ι : Type*} {t : Finset ι} {p : ι → E} {w : ι → R}
    (hw₂ : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) : t.affineCombination R p w = centerMass t w p
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineCombination_eq_weightedVSubOfPoint_vadd_of_sum_eq_one _ w _ hw₂ (0 : E),
    Finset.weightedVSubOfPoint_apply, vadd_eq_add, add_zero, t.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ hw₂]
  simp_rw [vsub_eq_sub, sub_zero]

name: affineCombination_mem_convexHull
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineCombination_eq_centerMass hw₁]
  apply s.centerMass_mem_convexHull hw₀
  · simp [hw₁]
  · simp

name: Finset.centroid_eq_centerMass
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Finset.centroid_eq_centerMass (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (p : ι → E) :
    s.centroid R p = s.centerMass (s.centroidWeights R) p

name: Finset.centroid_mem_convexHull
statement:
theorem Finset.centroid_mem_convexHull (s : Finset E) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    s.centroid R id ∈ convexHull R (s : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [s.centroid_eq_centerMass hs]
  apply s.centerMass_id_mem_convexHull
  · simp only [inv_nonneg, imp_true_iff, Nat.cast_nonneg, Finset.centroidWeights_apply]
  · have hs_card : (#s : R) ≠ 0 := by simp [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp hs]
    simp only [hs_card, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀, Ne, not_false_iff,
      Finset.centroidWeights_apply, zero_lt_one]

name: convexHull_range_eq_exists_affineCombination
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Subset.antisymm (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) ?_
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_range.mp hx
    exact ⟨{i}, Function.const ι (1 : R), by simp, by simp, by simp [hi]⟩
  · rintro x ⟨s, w, hw₀, hw₁, rfl⟩ y ⟨s', w', hw₀', hw₁', rfl⟩ a b ha hb hab
    let W : ι → R := fun i => (if i ∈ s then a * w i else 0) + if i ∈ s' then b * w' i else 0
    have hW₁ : (s ∪ s').sum W = 1 := by
      rw [sum_add_distrib, ← sum_subset subset_union_left,
        ← sum_subset subset_union_right, sum_ite_of_true,
        sum_ite_of_true, ← mul_sum, ← mul_sum, hw₁, hw₁', ← add_mul, hab,
        mul_one] <;> intros <;> simp_all
    refine ⟨s ∪ s', W, ?_, hW₁, ?_⟩
    · rintro i -
      by_cases hi : i ∈ s <;> by_cases hi' : i ∈ s' <;>
        simp [W, hi, hi', add_nonneg, mul_nonneg ha (hw₀ i _), mul_nonneg hb (hw₀' i _)]
    · simp_rw [W, affineCombination_eq_linear_combination (s ∪ s') v _ hW₁,
        affineCombination_eq_linear_combination s v w hw₁,
        affineCombination_eq_linear_combination s' v w' hw₁', add_smul, sum_add_distrib]
      rw [← sum_subset subset_union_left, ← sum_subset subset_union_right]
      · simp only [ite_smul, sum_ite_of_true fun _ hi => hi, mul_smul, ← smul_sum]
      · intro i _ hi'
        simp [hi']
      · intro i _ hi'
        simp [hi']
  · rintro x ⟨s, w, hw₀, hw₁, rfl⟩
    exact affineCombination_mem_convexHull hw₀ hw₁

name: convexHull_eq
proof:
:= by
  refine Subset.antisymm (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) ?_
  · intro x hx
    use PUnit, {PUnit.unit}, fun _ => 1, fun _ => x, fun _ _ => zero_le_one, sum_singleton _ _,
      fun _ _ => hx
    simp only [Finset.centerMass, Finset.sum_singleton, inv_one, one_smul]
  · rintro x ⟨ι, sx, wx, zx, hwx₀, hwx₁, hzx, rfl⟩ y ⟨ι', sy, wy, zy, hwy₀, hwy₁, hzy, rfl⟩ a b ha
      hb hab
    rw [Finset.centerMass_segment' _ _ _ _ _ _ hwx₁ hwy₁ _ _ hab]
    refine ⟨_, _, _, _, ?_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rintro i hi
      rw [Finset.mem_disjSum] at hi
      rcases hi with (⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩) <;> simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] <;>
        apply_rules [mul_nonneg, hwx₀, hwy₀]
    · simp [← mul_sum, *]
    · intro i hi
      rw [Finset.mem_disjSum] at hi
      rcases hi with (⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩) <;> apply_rules [hzx, hzy]
  · rintro _ ⟨ι, t, w, z, hw₀, hw₁, hz, rfl⟩
    exact t.centerMass_mem_convexHull hw₀ (hw₁.symm ▸ zero_lt_one) hz

name: mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype
statement:
lemma mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype {s : Set E} {x : E} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → R) (z : ι → E)
    (hw₀ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hw₁ : ∑ i, w i = 1) (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ s) (hx : ∑ i, w i • z i = x) :
    x ∈ convexHull R s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hx, ← centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hw₁]
  exact centerMass_mem_convexHull _ (by simpa using hw₀) (by simp [hw₁]) (by simpa using hz)

name: mem_convexHull_iff_exists_fintype
statement:
lemma mem_convexHull_iff_exists_fintype {s : Set E} {x : E} :
    x ∈ convexHull R s ↔ ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (w : ι → R) (z : ι → E), (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) ∧
      ∑ i, w i = 1 ∧ (∀ i, z i ∈ s) ∧ ∑ i, w i • z i = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [convexHull_eq, mem_ofPred_eq]
    rintro ⟨ι, t, w, z, h⟩
    refine ⟨t, inferInstance, w ∘ (↑), z ∘ (↑), ?_⟩
    simpa [← sum_attach t, centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ h.2.1] using h
  · rintro ⟨ι, _, w, z, hw₀, hw₁, hz, hx⟩
    exact mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype w z hw₀ hw₁ hz hx

name: Finset.convexHull_eq
statement:
theorem Finset.convexHull_eq (s : Finset E) : convexHull R ↑s =
    { x : E | ∃ w : E → R, (∀ y ∈ s, 0 ≤ w y) ∧ ∑ y ∈ s, w y = 1 ∧ s.centerMass w id = x }
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (convexHull_min ?_ ?_) ?_
  · intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_coe] at hx
    refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, Finset.centerMass_ite_eq _ _ _ hx⟩
    · intros
      split_ifs
      exacts [zero_le_one, le_refl 0]
    · rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, ite_eq_left hx]
  · rintro x ⟨wx, hwx₀, hwx₁, rfl⟩ y ⟨wy, hwy₀, hwy₁, rfl⟩ a b ha hb hab
    rw [Finset.centerMass_segment _ _ _ _ hwx₁ hwy₁ _ _ hab]
    refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rintro i hi
      apply_rules [add_nonneg, mul_nonneg, hwx₀, hwy₀]
    · simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, mul_one, *]
  · rintro _ ⟨w, hw₀, hw₁, rfl⟩
    exact
      s.centerMass_mem_convexHull (fun x hx => hw₀ _ hx) (hw₁.symm ▸ zero_lt_one) fun x hx => hx

name: Finset.mem_convexHull
statement:
theorem Finset.mem_convexHull {s : Finset E} {x : E} : x ∈ convexHull R (s : Set E) ↔
    ∃ w : E → R, (∀ y ∈ s, 0 ≤ w y) ∧ ∑ y ∈ s, w y = 1 ∧ s.centerMass w id = x

name: Finset.mem_convexHull'
statement:
lemma Finset.mem_convexHull' {s : Finset E} {x : E} :
    x ∈ convexHull R (s : Set E) ↔
      ∃ w : E → R, (∀ y ∈ s, 0 ≤ w y) ∧ ∑ y ∈ s, w y = 1 ∧ ∑ y ∈ s, w y • y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_convexHull]
  refine exists_congr fun w ↦ and_congr_right' <| and_congr_right fun hw ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hw, id_eq]

name: Set.Finite.convexHull_eq
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, exists_prop] using
    hs.toFinset.convexHull_eq

name: convexHull_eq_union_convexHull_finite_subsets
statement:
theorem convexHull_eq_union_convexHull_finite_subsets (s : Set E) :
    convexHull R s = ⋃ (t : Finset E) (_ : ↑t ⊆ s), convexHull R ↑t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [_root_.convexHull_eq]
    rintro x ⟨ι, t, w, z, hw₀, hw₁, hz, rfl⟩
    simp only [mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨t.image z, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [coe_image, Set.image_subset_iff]
      exact hz
    · apply t.centerMass_mem_convexHull hw₀
      · simp only [hw₁, zero_lt_one]
      · exact fun i hi => Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
  · exact iUnion_subset fun i => iUnion_subset convexHull_mono

name: vectorSpan_segment
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_segment {p₁ p₂ : E} :
    vectorSpan R (segment R p₁ p₂) = R ∙ (p₂ -ᵥ p₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← convexHull_pair, ← direction_affineSpan, affineSpan_convexHull,
      direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vsub_eq_sub]

name: mk_mem_convexHull_prod
statement:
theorem mk_mem_convexHull_prod {t : Set F} {x : E} {y : F} (hx : x ∈ convexHull R s)
    (hy : y ∈ convexHull R t) : (x, y) ∈ convexHull R (s ×ˢ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_convexHull_iff_exists_fintype] at hx hy ⊢
  obtain ⟨ι, _, w, f, hw₀, hw₁, hfs, hf⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨κ, _, v, g, hv₀, hv₁, hgt, hg⟩ := hy
  have h_sum : ∑ i : ι × κ, w i.1 * v i.2 = 1 := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, ← sum_mul_sum, hw₁, hv₁, mul_one]
  refine ⟨ι × κ, inferInstance, fun p => w p.1 * v p.2, fun p ↦ (f p.1, g p.2),
    fun p ↦ mul_nonneg (hw₀ _) (hv₀ _), h_sum, fun p ↦ ⟨hfs _, hgt _⟩, ?_⟩
  ext
  · simp_rw [Prod.fst_sum, Prod.smul_mk, Fintype.sum_prod_type, mul_comm (w _), mul_smul,
      sum_comm (γ := ι), ← Fintype.sum_smul_sum, hv₁, one_smul, hf]
  · simp_rw [Prod.snd_sum, Prod.smul_mk, Fintype.sum_prod_type, mul_smul, ← Fintype.sum_smul_sum,
      hw₁, one_smul, hg]

name: convexHull_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem convexHull_prod (s : Set E) (t : Set F) :
    convexHull R (s ×ˢ t) = convexHull R s ×ˢ convexHull R t
proof:
:=
  Subset.antisymm
      (convexHull_min (prod_mono (subset_convexHull _ _) <| subset_convexHull _ _) <|
        (convex_convexHull _ _).prod <| convex_convexHull _ _) <|
    prod_subset_iff.2 fun _ hx _ => mk_mem_convexHull_prod hx

name: convexHull_add
statement: theorem convexHull_add (s t : Set E) : convexHull R (s + t) = convexHull R s + convexHull R t

name: convexHull_sub
statement: theorem convexHull_sub (s t : Set E) : convexHull R (s - t) = convexHull R s - convexHull R t

name: convexHull_list_sum
statement: theorem convexHull_list_sum (l : List (Set E)) : convexHull R l.sum = (l.map <| convexHull R).sum

name: convexHull_multiset_sum
statement:
theorem convexHull_multiset_sum (s : Multiset (Set E)) :
    convexHull R s.sum = (s.map <| convexHull R).sum

name: convexHull_sum
statement:
theorem convexHull_sum {ι} (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → Set E) :
    convexHull R (∑ i ∈ s, t i) = ∑ i ∈ s, convexHull R (t i)

name: AffineBasis.convexHull_eq_nonneg_coord
statement:
theorem AffineBasis.convexHull_eq_nonneg_coord {ι : Type*} (b : AffineBasis ι R E) :
    convexHull R (range b) = { x | ∀ i, 0 ≤ b.coord i x }
proof:
:= by
  rw [convexHull_range_eq_exists_affineCombination]
  ext x
  refine ⟨?_, fun hx => ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, w, hw₀, hw₁, rfl⟩ i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · rw [b.coord_apply_combination_of_mem hi hw₁]
      exact hw₀ i hi
    · rw [b.coord_apply_combination_of_notMem hi hw₁]
  · have hx' : x ∈ affineSpan R (range b) := by
      rw [b.tot]
      exact AffineSubspace.mem_top R E x
    obtain ⟨s, w, hw₁, rfl⟩ := (mem_affineSpan_iff_eq_affineCombination R E).mp hx'
    refine ⟨s, w, ?_, hw₁, rfl⟩
    intro i hi
    specialize hx i
    rw [b.coord_apply_combination_of_mem hi hw₁] at hx
    exact hx

name: AffineIndependent.convexHull_inter
statement:
lemma AffineIndependent.convexHull_inter (hs : AffineIndependent R ((↑) : s → E))
    (ht₁ : t₁ ⊆ s) (ht₂ : t₂ ⊆ s) :
    convexHull R (t₁ ∩ t₂ : Set E) = convexHull R t₁ ∩ convexHull R t₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (Set.subset_inter (convexHull_mono inf_le_left) <|
    convexHull_mono inf_le_right).antisymm ?_
  simp_rw [Set.subset_def, mem_inter_iff, Set.inf_eq_inter, ← coe_inter, mem_convexHull']
  rintro x ⟨⟨w₁, h₁w₁, h₂w₁, h₃w₁⟩, w₂, -, h₂w₂, h₃w₂⟩
  let w (x : E) : R := (if x ∈ t₁ then w₁ x else 0) - if x ∈ t₂ then w₂ x else 0
  have h₁w : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 0 := by simp [w, Finset.inter_eq_right.2, *]
  replace hs := hs.eq_zero_of_sum_eq_zero_subtype h₁w <| by
    simp only [w, sub_smul, zero_smul, ite_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_filter, h₃w₁,
      Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.inter_eq_right.2 ht₁, Finset.inter_eq_right.2 ht₂, h₃w₂,
      sub_self]
  have ht (x) (hx₁ : x ∈ t₁) (hx₂ : x ∉ t₂) : w₁ x = 0 := by
    simpa [w, hx₁, hx₂] using hs _ (ht₁ hx₁)
  refine ⟨w₁, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [and_imp, Finset.mem_inter]
    exact fun y hy₁ _ ↦ h₁w₁ y hy₁
  all_goals
  · rwa [sum_subset inter_subset_left]
    rintro x
    simp_intro hx₁ hx₂
    simp [ht x hx₁ hx₂]

name: AffineIndependent.convexHull_inter'
statement:
lemma AffineIndependent.convexHull_inter' [DecidableEq E]
    (hs : AffineIndependent R ((↑) : ↑(t₁ ∪ t₂) → E)) :
    convexHull R (t₁ ∩ t₂ : Set E) = convexHull R t₁ ∩ convexHull R t₂

name: mem_convexHull_pi
statement: lemma mem_convexHull_pi (h : ∀ i ∈ s, x i ∈ convexHull 𝕜 (t i)) : x ∈ convexHull 𝕜 (s.pi t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  wlog hs : s = Set.univ generalizing s t
  · rw [← pi_univ_ite]
    refine this (fun i _ ↦ ?_) rfl
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact h i hi
    · simp
  subst hs
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, mem_convexHull_iff_exists_fintype, true_implies] at h
  choose κ _ w f hw₀ hw₁ hft hf using h
  refine mem_convexHull_of_exists_fintype (fun k : Π i, κ i ↦ ∏ i, w i (k i)) (fun g i ↦ f _ (g i))
    (fun g ↦ prod_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ hw₀ _ _) ?_ (fun _ _ _ ↦ hft _ _) ?_
  · rw [← Fintype.prod_sum]
    exact prod_eq_one fun _ _ ↦ hw₁ _
  ext i
  calc
    _ = ∑ g : ∀ i, κ i, (∏ i, w i (g i)) • f i (g i) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
    _ = ∑ j : κ i, ∑ g : {g : ∀ k, κ k // g i = j},
          (∏ k, w k (g.1 k)) • f i ((g : ∀ i, κ i) i) := by
      rw [← Fintype.sum_fiberwise fun g : ∀ k, κ k ↦ g i]
    _ = ∑ j : κ i, (∑ g : {g : ∀ k, κ k // g i = j}, ∏ k, w k (g.1 k)) • f i j := by
      simp_rw [sum_smul]
      congr! with j _ g _
      exact g.2
    _ = ∑ j : κ i, w i j • f i j := ?_
    _ = x i := hf _
  congr! with j _
  calc
    ∑ g : {g : ∀ k, κ k // g i = j}, ∏ k, w k (g.1 k)
      = ∑ g ∈ piFinset fun k ↦ if hk : k = i then hk ▸ {j} else univ, ∏ k, w k (g k) :=
      Finset.sum_bij' (fun g _ ↦ g) (fun g hg ↦ ⟨g, by simpa using mem_piFinset.1 hg i⟩)
        (by aesop) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
    _ = w i j := by
      rw [← prod_univ_sum, ← prod_mul_prod_compl, Finset.prod_singleton, Finset.sum_eq_single,
        Finset.prod_eq_one, mul_one] <;> simp +contextual [hw₁]

name: convexHull_pi
statement:
@[simp] lemma convexHull_pi (s : Set ι) (t : Π i, Set (E i)) :
    convexHull 𝕜 (s.pi t) = s.pi (fun i ↦ convexHull 𝕜 (t i))
proof:
:=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (convexHull_min (Set.pi_mono fun _ _ ↦ subset_convexHull _ _) <| convex_pi <|
    fun _ _ ↦ convex_convexHull _ _) fun _ ↦ mem_convexHull_pi

name: convexHull_eq_closedInterior
statement:
@[simp] theorem convexHull_eq_closedInterior {𝕜 V : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜]
    [IsOrderedRing 𝕜] [AddCommGroup V] [Module 𝕜 V] {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex 𝕜 V n) :
    convexHull 𝕜 (Set.range s.points) = s.closedInterior
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [convexHull_range_eq_exists_affineCombination, Set.mem_ofPred]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · obtain ⟨u, w, hw, hw1, rfl⟩ := h
    have hw' : ∀ i ∈ u, w i ≤ 1 := by
      intro i hi
      rw [← hw1]
      apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun j hj ↦ hw j hj) hi
    have hw1' : ∑ i, (u : Set (Fin (n + 1))).indicator w i = 1 := by
      simpa [Finset.sum_indicator_subset _ u.subset_univ] using hw1
    rw [Finset.affineCombination_indicator_subset _ _ u.subset_univ,
      affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_iff hw1']
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ (u : Set (Fin (n + 1))) <;> aesop
  · obtain ⟨w, hw1, rfl⟩ := eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_of_fintype <|
      Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset h s.closedInterior_subset_affineSpan
    rw [affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_iff hw1] at h
    exact ⟨Finset.univ, w, fun i _ ↦ (h i).1, hw1, rfl⟩

name: strictConvex_preimage
statement:
@[simp]
lemma strictConvex_preimage {s : Set F} (e : E ≃L[𝕜] F) :
    StrictConvex 𝕜 (e ⁻¹' s) ↔ StrictConvex 𝕜 s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ Function.LeftInverse.preimage_preimage e.right_inv s ▸
    h.linear_preimage e.symm.toLinearMap e.symm.continuous e.symm.injective,
    fun h ↦ h.linear_preimage e.toLinearMap e.continuous e.injective⟩

name: strictConvex_image
statement:
@[simp]
lemma strictConvex_image {s : Set E} (e : E ≃L[𝕜] F) :
    StrictConvex 𝕜 (e '' s) ↔ StrictConvex 𝕜 s

name: gauge_def
statement: theorem gauge_def : gauge s x = sInf ({ r ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) | x ∈ r • s })

name: gauge_def'
statement: theorem gauge_def' : gauge s x = sInf {r ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) | r⁻¹ • x ∈ s}

name: bddBelow_gauge_set
statement: private theorem bddBelow_gauge_set : BddBelow { r : ℝ | 0 < r ∧ x ∈ r • s }

name: Absorbent.gauge_set_nonempty
statement:
theorem Absorbent.gauge_set_nonempty (absorbs : Absorbent ℝ s) :
    { r : ℝ | 0 < r ∧ x ∈ r • s }.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  let ⟨r, hr₁, hr₂⟩ := (absorbs x).exists_pos
  ⟨r, hr₁, hr₂ r (Real.norm_of_nonneg hr₁.le).ge rfl⟩

name: gauge_mono
statement: theorem gauge_mono (hs : Absorbent ℝ s) (h : s ⊆ t) : gauge t ≤ gauge s
proof:
:= fun _ => by
  unfold gauge
  gcongr; exacts [bddBelow_gauge_set, hs.gauge_set_nonempty]

name: exists_lt_of_gauge_lt
statement:
theorem exists_lt_of_gauge_lt (absorbs : Absorbent ℝ s) (h : gauge s x < a) :
    ∃ b, 0 < b ∧ b < a ∧ x ∈ b • s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, ⟨hb, hx⟩, hba⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt absorbs.gauge_set_nonempty h
  exact ⟨b, hb, hba, hx⟩

name: gauge_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gauge_zero : gauge s 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gauge_def']
  by_cases h : (0 : E) ∈ s
  · simp only [smul_zero, sep_true, h, csInf_Ioi]
  · simp only [smul_zero, sep_false, h, Real.sInf_empty]

name: gauge_zero'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gauge_zero' : gauge (0 : Set E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [gauge_def']
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0
  · simp only [csInf_Ioi, mem_zero, Pi.zero_apply, sep_true, smul_zero]
  · simp only [mem_zero, Pi.zero_apply, inv_eq_zero, smul_eq_zero]
    convert! Real.sInf_empty
    exact eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun r hr => hr.2.elim (ne_of_gt hr.1) hx

name: gauge_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gauge_empty : gauge (∅ : Set E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [gauge_def', Real.sInf_empty, mem_empty_iff_false, Pi.zero_apply, sep_false]

name: gauge_of_subset_zero
statement: theorem gauge_of_subset_zero (h : s ⊆ 0) : gauge s = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | rfl := subset_singleton_iff_eq.1 h
  exacts [gauge_empty, gauge_zero']

name: gauge_nonneg
statement: theorem gauge_nonneg (x : E) : 0 ≤ gauge s x

name: gauge_neg
statement: theorem gauge_neg (symmetric : ∀ x ∈ s, -x ∈ s) (x : E) : gauge s (-x) = gauge s x
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ x, -x ∈ s ↔ x ∈ s := fun x => ⟨fun h => by simpa using symmetric _ h, symmetric x⟩
  simp_rw [gauge_def', smul_neg, this]

name: gauge_neg_set_neg
statement: theorem gauge_neg_set_neg (x : E) : gauge (-s) (-x) = gauge s x

name: gauge_neg_set_eq_gauge_neg
statement: theorem gauge_neg_set_eq_gauge_neg (x : E) : gauge (-s) x = gauge s (-x)

name: gauge_le_of_mem
statement: theorem gauge_le_of_mem (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hx : x ∈ a • s) : gauge s x ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha' := ha.eq_or_lt
  · rw [mem_singleton_iff.1 (zero_smul_set_subset _ hx), gauge_zero]
  · exact csInf_le bddBelow_gauge_set ⟨ha', hx⟩

name: setOfPred_gauge_le_eq
statement:
theorem setOfPred_gauge_le_eq (hs₁ : Convex ℝ s) (hs₀ : (0 : E) ∈ s) (hs₂ : Absorbent ℝ s)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) : { x | gauge s x ≤ a } = ⋂ (r : ℝ) (_ : a < r), r • s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp_rw [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  refine ⟨fun h r hr => ?_, fun h => le_of_forall_pos_lt_add fun ε hε => ?_⟩
  · have hr' := ha.trans_lt hr
    rw [mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hr'.ne']
    obtain ⟨δ, δ_pos, hδr, hδ⟩ := exists_lt_of_gauge_lt hs₂ (h.trans_lt hr)
    suffices (r⁻¹ * δ) • δ⁻¹ • x ∈ s by rwa [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ δ_pos.ne'] at this
    rw [mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ δ_pos.ne'] at hδ
    refine hs₁.smul_mem_of_zero_mem hs₀ hδ ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hr', mul_one]
    exact hδr.le
  · linarith [gauge_le_of_mem (by linarith) <| h (a + ε / 2) (by linarith)]

name: setOfPred_gauge_lt_eq'
statement:
theorem setOfPred_gauge_lt_eq' (absorbs : Absorbent ℝ s) (a : ℝ) :
    { x | gauge s x < a } = ⋃ (r : ℝ) (_ : 0 < r) (_ : r < a), r • s
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp_rw [mem_ofPred, mem_iUnion, exists_prop]
  exact
    ⟨exists_lt_of_gauge_lt absorbs, fun ⟨r, hr₀, hr₁, hx⟩ =>
      (gauge_le_of_mem hr₀.le hx).trans_lt hr₁⟩

name: setOfPred_gauge_lt_eq
statement:
theorem setOfPred_gauge_lt_eq (absorbs : Absorbent ℝ s) (a : ℝ) :
    { x | gauge s x < a } = ⋃ r ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (a : ℝ), r • s
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp_rw [mem_ofPred, mem_iUnion, exists_prop, mem_Ioo, and_assoc]
  exact
    ⟨exists_lt_of_gauge_lt absorbs, fun ⟨r, hr₀, hr₁, hx⟩ =>
      (gauge_le_of_mem hr₀.le hx).trans_lt hr₁⟩

name: mem_openSegment_of_gauge_lt_one
statement:
theorem mem_openSegment_of_gauge_lt_one (absorbs : Absorbent ℝ s) (hgauge : gauge s x < 1) :
    ∃ y ∈ s, x ∈ openSegment ℝ 0 y
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_lt_of_gauge_lt absorbs hgauge with ⟨r, hr₀, hr₁, y, hy, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨y, hy, 1 - r, r, ?_⟩
  simp [*]

name: setOfPred_gauge_lt_one_subset_self
statement:
theorem setOfPred_gauge_lt_one_subset_self (hs : Convex ℝ s) (h₀ : (0 : E) ∈ s)
    (absorbs : Absorbent ℝ s) : { x | gauge s x < 1 } ⊆ s
proof:
:= fun _x hx ↦
  let ⟨_y, hys, hx⟩ := mem_openSegment_of_gauge_lt_one absorbs hx
  hs.openSegment_subset h₀ hys hx

name: gauge_le_one_of_mem
statement: theorem gauge_le_one_of_mem {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s) : gauge s x ≤ 1

name: gauge_add_le
statement:
theorem gauge_add_le (hs : Convex ℝ s) (absorbs : Absorbent ℝ s) (x y : E) :
    gauge s (x + y) ≤ gauge s x + gauge s y
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_forall_pos_lt_add fun ε hε => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha', x, hx, rfl⟩ :=
    exists_lt_of_gauge_lt absorbs (lt_add_of_pos_right (gauge s x) (half_pos hε))
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hb', y, hy, rfl⟩ :=
    exists_lt_of_gauge_lt absorbs (lt_add_of_pos_right (gauge s y) (half_pos hε))
  calc
    gauge s (a • x + b • y) ≤ a + b := gauge_le_of_mem (by positivity) <| by
      rw [hs.add_smul ha.le hb.le]
      exact add_mem_add (smul_mem_smul_set hx) (smul_mem_smul_set hy)
    _ < gauge s (a • x) + gauge s (b • y) + ε := by linarith

name: gauge_sum_le
statement:
theorem gauge_sum_le {ι : Type*} (hs : Convex ℝ s) (absorbs : Absorbent ℝ s) (t : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → E) : gauge s (∑ i ∈ t, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, gauge s (f i)

name: self_subset_setOfPred_gauge_le_one
statement: theorem self_subset_setOfPred_gauge_le_one : s ⊆ { x | gauge s x ≤ 1 }

name: Convex.setOfPred_gauge_le
statement:
theorem Convex.setOfPred_gauge_le (hs : Convex ℝ s) (h₀ : (0 : E) ∈ s) (absorbs : Absorbent ℝ s)
    (a : ℝ) : Convex ℝ { x | gauge s x ≤ a }
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : 0 ≤ a
  · rw [setOfPred_gauge_le_eq hs h₀ absorbs ha]
    exact convex_iInter fun i => convex_iInter fun _ => hs.smul _
  · convert! convex_empty (𝕜 := ℝ)
    exact eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun x hx => ha <| (gauge_nonneg _).trans hx

name: le_gauge_of_notMem
statement:
theorem le_gauge_of_notMem (hs₀ : StarConvex ℝ 0 s) (hs₂ : Absorbs ℝ s {x}) (hx : x ∉ a • s) :
    a ≤ gauge s x
proof:
:= by
  rw [starConvex_zero_iff] at hs₀
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := hs₂.exists_pos
  refine le_csInf ⟨r, hr, singleton_subset_iff.1 <| h _ (Real.norm_of_nonneg hr.le).ge⟩ ?_
  rintro b ⟨hb, x, hx', rfl⟩
  refine not_lt.1 fun hba => hx ?_
  have ha := hb.trans hba
  refine ⟨(a⁻¹ * b) • x, hs₀ hx' (by positivity) ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← div_eq_inv_mul]
    exact div_le_one_of_le₀ hba.le ha.le
  · dsimp only
    rw [← mul_smul, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ ha.ne']

name: one_le_gauge_of_notMem
statement:
theorem one_le_gauge_of_notMem (hs₁ : StarConvex ℝ 0 s) (hs₂ : Absorbs ℝ s {x}) (hx : x ∉ s) :
    1 ≤ gauge s x

name: gauge_smul_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem gauge_smul_of_nonneg [MulActionWithZero α E] [IsScalarTower α ℝ (Set E)] {s : Set E} {a : α}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (x : E) : gauge s (a • x) = a • gauge s x
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha' := ha.eq_or_lt
  · rw [zero_smul, gauge_zero, zero_smul]
  rw [gauge_def', gauge_def', ← Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg ha]
  congr 1
  ext r
  simp_rw [Set.mem_smul_set, Set.mem_sep_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hr, hx⟩
    simp_rw [mem_Ioi] at hr ⊢
    rw [← mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hr.ne'] at hx
    have := smul_pos (inv_pos.2 ha') hr
    refine ⟨a⁻¹ • r, ⟨this, ?_⟩, smul_inv_smul₀ ha'.ne' _⟩
    rwa [← mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ this.ne', smul_assoc,
      mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ (inv_ne_zero ha'.ne'), inv_inv]
  · rintro ⟨r, ⟨hr, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_Ioi] at hr ⊢
    rw [← mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hr.ne'] at hx
    have := smul_pos ha' hr
    refine ⟨this, ?_⟩
    rw [← mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ this.ne', smul_assoc]
    exact smul_mem_smul_set hx

name: gauge_smul_left_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem gauge_smul_left_of_nonneg [MulActionWithZero α E] [SMulCommClass α ℝ ℝ]
    [IsScalarTower α ℝ ℝ] [IsScalarTower α ℝ E] {s : Set E} {a : α} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    gauge (a • s) = a⁻¹ • gauge s
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha' := ha.eq_or_lt
  · rw [inv_zero, zero_smul, gauge_of_subset_zero (zero_smul_set_subset _)]
  ext x
  rw [gauge_def', Pi.smul_apply, gauge_def', ← Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 ha)]
  congr 1
  ext r
  simp_rw [Set.mem_smul_set, Set.mem_sep_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hr, y, hy, h⟩
    simp_rw [mem_Ioi] at hr ⊢
    refine ⟨a • r, ⟨smul_pos ha' hr, ?_⟩, inv_smul_smul₀ ha'.ne' _⟩
    rwa [smul_inv₀, smul_assoc, ← h, inv_smul_smul₀ ha'.ne']
  · rintro ⟨r, ⟨hr, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_Ioi] at hr ⊢
    refine ⟨smul_pos (inv_pos.2 ha') hr, r⁻¹ • x, hx, ?_⟩
    rw [smul_inv₀, smul_assoc, inv_inv]

name: gauge_smul_left
statement:
theorem gauge_smul_left [Module α E] [SMulCommClass α ℝ ℝ] [IsScalarTower α ℝ ℝ]
    [IsScalarTower α ℝ E] {s : Set E} (symmetric : ∀ x ∈ s, -x ∈ s) (a : α) :
    gauge (a • s) = |a|⁻¹ • gauge s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gauge_smul_left_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg a)]
  obtain h | h := abs_choice a
  · rw [h]
  · rw [h, Set.neg_smul_set, ← Set.smul_set_neg]
    congr
    ext y
    refine ⟨symmetric _, fun hy => ?_⟩
    rw [← neg_neg y]
    exact symmetric _ hy

name: gauge_norm_smul
statement:
theorem gauge_norm_smul (hs : Balanced 𝕜 s) (r : 𝕜) (x : E) :
    gauge s (‖r‖ • x) = gauge s (r • x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gauge
  congr with θ
  rw [@RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul 𝕜]
  refine and_congr_right fun hθ => (hs.smul _).smul_mem_iff ?_
  rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_norm]

name: gauge_smul
statement: theorem gauge_smul (hs : Balanced 𝕜 s) (r : 𝕜) (x : E) : gauge s (r • x) = ‖r‖ * gauge s x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← gauge_smul_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg r), gauge_norm_smul hs]

name: comap_gauge_nhds_zero_le
statement:
theorem comap_gauge_nhds_zero_le (ha : Absorbent ℝ s) (hb : Bornology.IsVonNBounded ℝ s) :
    comap (gauge s) (𝓝 0) ≤ 𝓝 0
proof:
:= fun u hu ↦ by
  rcases (hb hu).exists_pos with ⟨r, hr₀, hr⟩
  filter_upwards [preimage_mem_comap (gt_mem_nhds (inv_pos.2 hr₀))] with x (hx : gauge s x < r⁻¹)
  rcases exists_lt_of_gauge_lt ha hx with ⟨c, hc₀, hcr, y, hy, rfl⟩
  have hrc := (lt_inv_comm₀ hr₀ hc₀).2 hcr
  rcases hr c⁻¹ (hrc.le.trans (le_abs_self _)) hy with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  simpa only [smul_inv_smul₀ hc₀.ne']

name: gauge_eq_zero
statement:
theorem gauge_eq_zero (hs : Absorbent ℝ s) (hb : Bornology.IsVonNBounded ℝ s) :
    gauge s x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h₀ ↦ by_contra fun (hne : x ≠ 0) ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.symm ▸ gauge_zero⟩
  have : {x}ᶜ ∈ comap (gauge s) (𝓝 0) :=
    comap_gauge_nhds_zero_le hs hb (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hne.symm)
  rcases ((nhds_basis_zero_abs_lt _).comap _).mem_iff.1 this with ⟨r, hr₀, hr⟩
  exact hr (by simpa [h₀]) rfl

name: gauge_pos
statement:
theorem gauge_pos (hs : Absorbent ℝ s) (hb : Bornology.IsVonNBounded ℝ s) :
    0 < gauge s x ↔ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [(gauge_nonneg _).lt_iff_ne', Ne, gauge_eq_zero hs hb]

name: interior_subset_gauge_lt_one
statement: theorem interior_subset_gauge_lt_one (s : Set E) : interior s ⊆ { x | gauge s x < 1 }
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have H₁ : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ r⁻¹ • x) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 ((1 : ℝ)⁻¹ • x)) :=
    ((tendsto_id.inv₀ one_ne_zero).smul tendsto_const_nhds).mono_left inf_le_left
  rw [inv_one, one_smul] at H₁
  have H₂ : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[<] (1 : ℝ), x ∈ r • s ∧ 0 < r ∧ r < 1 := by
    filter_upwards [H₁ (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.1 hx), Ioo_mem_nhdsLT one_pos] with r h₁ h₂
    exact ⟨(mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ h₂.1.ne' _ _).2 h₁, h₂⟩
  rcases H₂.exists with ⟨r, hxr, hr₀, hr₁⟩
  exact (gauge_le_of_mem hr₀.le hxr).trans_lt hr₁

name: setOfPred_gauge_lt_one_eq_self_of_isOpen
statement:
theorem setOfPred_gauge_lt_one_eq_self_of_isOpen (hs₁ : Convex ℝ s) (hs₀ : (0 : E) ∈ s)
    (hs₂ : IsOpen s) : { x | gauge s x < 1 } = s
proof:
:= by
  refine (setOfPred_gauge_lt_one_subset_self hs₁ ‹_› <| absorbent_nhds_zero <|
    hs₂.mem_nhds hs₀).antisymm ?_
  convert! interior_subset_gauge_lt_one s
  exact hs₂.interior_eq.symm

name: gauge_lt_one_of_mem_of_isOpen
statement:
theorem gauge_lt_one_of_mem_of_isOpen (hs₂ : IsOpen s) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s) :
    gauge s x < 1

name: gauge_lt_of_mem_smul
statement:
theorem gauge_lt_of_mem_smul (x : E) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hs₂ : IsOpen s) (hx : x ∈ ε • s) :
    gauge s x < ε
proof:
:= by
  have : ε⁻¹ • x ∈ s := by rwa [← mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ hε.ne']
  have h_gauge_lt := gauge_lt_one_of_mem_of_isOpen hs₂ this
  rwa [gauge_smul_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hε.le), smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_lt_iff₀ hε, mul_one]
    at h_gauge_lt

name: mem_closure_of_gauge_le_one
statement:
theorem mem_closure_of_gauge_le_one (hc : Convex ℝ s) (hs₀ : 0 ∈ s) (ha : Absorbent ℝ s)
    (h : gauge s x ≤ 1) : x ∈ closure s
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[<] 1, r • x ∈ s := by
    filter_upwards [Ico_mem_nhdsLT one_pos] with r ⟨hr₀, hr₁⟩
    apply setOfPred_gauge_lt_one_subset_self hc hs₀ ha
    rw [mem_ofPred_eq, gauge_smul_of_nonneg hr₀]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_right hr₀ h).trans_lt hr₁
  refine mem_closure_of_tendsto ?_ this
  exact Filter.Tendsto.mono_left (Continuous.tendsto' (by fun_prop) _ _ (one_smul _ _))
    inf_le_left

name: mem_frontier_of_gauge_eq_one
statement:
theorem mem_frontier_of_gauge_eq_one (hc : Convex ℝ s) (hs₀ : 0 ∈ s) (ha : Absorbent ℝ s)
    (h : gauge s x = 1) : x ∈ frontier s
proof:
:=
  ⟨mem_closure_of_gauge_le_one hc hs₀ ha h.le, fun h' ↦
    (interior_subset_gauge_lt_one s h').out.ne h⟩

name: tendsto_gauge_nhds_zero_nhdsGE
statement: theorem tendsto_gauge_nhds_zero_nhdsGE (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 0) : Tendsto (gauge s) (𝓝 0) (𝓝[≥] 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine nhdsGE_basis_Icc.tendsto_right_iff.2 fun ε hε ↦ ?_
  rw [← set_smul_mem_nhds_zero_iff hε.ne'] at hs
  filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
  exact ⟨gauge_nonneg _, gauge_le_of_mem hε.le hx⟩

name: tendsto_gauge_nhds_zero
statement: theorem tendsto_gauge_nhds_zero (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 0) : Tendsto (gauge s) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)

name: continuousAt_gauge_zero
statement: theorem continuousAt_gauge_zero (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 0) : ContinuousAt (gauge s) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ContinuousAt, gauge_zero]
  exact tendsto_gauge_nhds_zero hs

name: comap_gauge_nhds_zero
statement:
theorem comap_gauge_nhds_zero (hb : Bornology.IsVonNBounded ℝ s) (h₀ : s ∈ 𝓝 0) :
    comap (gauge s) (𝓝 0) = 𝓝 0

name: continuousAt_gauge
statement: theorem continuousAt_gauge (hc : Convex ℝ s) (hs₀ : s ∈ 𝓝 0) : ContinuousAt (gauge s) x
proof:
:= by
  have ha : Absorbent ℝ s := absorbent_nhds_zero hs₀
  refine (nhds_basis_Icc_pos _).tendsto_right_iff.2 fun ε hε₀ ↦ ?_
  rw [← map_add_left_nhds_zero, eventually_map]
  have : ε • s ∩ -(ε • s) ∈ 𝓝 0 :=
    inter_mem ((set_smul_mem_nhds_zero_iff hε₀.ne').2 hs₀)
      (neg_mem_nhds_zero _ ((set_smul_mem_nhds_zero_iff hε₀.ne').2 hs₀))
  filter_upwards [this] with y hy
  constructor
  · rw [sub_le_iff_le_add]
    calc
      gauge s x = gauge s (x + y + (-y)) := by simp
      _ ≤ gauge s (x + y) + gauge s (-y) := gauge_add_le hc ha _ _
      _ ≤ gauge s (x + y) + ε := by grw [gauge_le_of_mem hε₀.le (mem_neg.1 hy.2)]
  · calc
      gauge s (x + y) ≤ gauge s x + gauge s y := gauge_add_le hc ha _ _
      _ ≤ gauge s x + ε := by grw [gauge_le_of_mem hε₀.le hy.1]

name: continuous_gauge
statement:
@[continuity, fun_prop]
theorem continuous_gauge (hc : Convex ℝ s) (hs₀ : s ∈ 𝓝 0) : Continuous (gauge s)

name: setOfPred_gauge_lt_one_eq_interior
statement:
theorem setOfPred_gauge_lt_one_eq_interior (hc : Convex ℝ s) (hs₀ : s ∈ 𝓝 0) :
    { x | gauge s x < 1 } = interior s
proof:
:= by
  refine Subset.antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (interior_subset_gauge_lt_one s)
  rcases mem_openSegment_of_gauge_lt_one (absorbent_nhds_zero hs₀) hx with ⟨y, hys, hxy⟩
  exact hc.openSegment_interior_self_subset_interior (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hs₀) hys hxy

name: gauge_lt_one_iff_mem_interior
statement:
theorem gauge_lt_one_iff_mem_interior (hc : Convex ℝ s) (hs₀ : s ∈ 𝓝 0) :
    gauge s x < 1 ↔ x ∈ interior s

name: gauge_le_one_iff_mem_closure
statement:
theorem gauge_le_one_iff_mem_closure (hc : Convex ℝ s) (hs₀ : s ∈ 𝓝 0) :
    gauge s x ≤ 1 ↔ x ∈ closure s
proof:
:=
  ⟨mem_closure_of_gauge_le_one hc (mem_of_mem_nhds hs₀) (absorbent_nhds_zero hs₀), fun h ↦
    le_on_closure (fun _ ↦ gauge_le_one_of_mem) (continuous_gauge hc hs₀).continuousOn
      continuousOn_const h⟩

name: gauge_eq_one_iff_mem_frontier
statement:
theorem gauge_eq_one_iff_mem_frontier (hc : Convex ℝ s) (hs₀ : s ∈ 𝓝 0) :
    gauge s x = 1 ↔ x ∈ frontier s
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_iff_le_not_lt, gauge_le_one_iff_mem_closure hc hs₀, gauge_lt_one_iff_mem_interior hc hs₀]
  rfl

name: gaugeSeminorm_lt_one_of_isOpen
statement:
theorem gaugeSeminorm_lt_one_of_isOpen (hs : IsOpen s) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ s) :
    gaugeSeminorm hs₀ hs₁ hs₂ x < 1

name: gaugeSeminorm_ball_one
statement: theorem gaugeSeminorm_ball_one (hs : IsOpen s) : (gaugeSeminorm hs₀ hs₁ hs₂).ball 0 1 = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Seminorm.ball_zero_eq]
  exact setOfPred_gauge_lt_one_eq_self_of_isOpen hs₁ hs₂.zero_mem hs

name: Seminorm.gauge_ball
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem Seminorm.gauge_ball (p : Seminorm ℝ E) : gauge (p.ball 0 1) = p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain hp | hp := { r : ℝ | 0 < r ∧ x ∈ r • p.ball 0 1 }.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · rw [gauge, hp, Real.sInf_empty]
    by_contra h
    have hpx : 0 < p x := (apply_nonneg _ _).lt_of_ne h
    have hpx₂ : 0 < 2 * p x := mul_pos zero_lt_two hpx
    refine hp.subset ⟨hpx₂, (2 * p x)⁻¹ • x, ?_, smul_inv_smul₀ hpx₂.ne' _⟩
    rw [p.mem_ball_zero, map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hpx₂),
      inv_mul_lt_iff₀ hpx₂, mul_one]
    exact lt_mul_of_one_lt_left hpx one_lt_two
  refine IsGLB.csInf_eq ⟨fun r => ?_, fun r hr => le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε => ?_⟩ hp
  · rintro ⟨hr, y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [p.mem_ball_zero] at hy
    rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hr.le hy.le
  · have hpε : 0 < p x + ε := by positivity
    refine hr ⟨hpε, (p x + ε)⁻¹ • x, ?_, smul_inv_smul₀ hpε.ne' _⟩
    rw [p.mem_ball_zero, map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hpε),
      inv_mul_lt_iff₀ hpε, mul_one]
    exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ hε

name: Seminorm.gaugeSeminorm_ball
statement:
theorem Seminorm.gaugeSeminorm_ball (p : Seminorm ℝ E) :
    gaugeSeminorm (p.balanced_ball_zero 1) (p.convex_ball 0 1) (p.absorbent_ball_zero zero_lt_one) =
      p

name: gauge_unit_ball
statement: theorem gauge_unit_ball (x : E) : gauge (ball (0 : E) 1) x = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ball_normSeminorm ℝ, Seminorm.gauge_ball, coe_normSeminorm]

name: gauge_ball
statement: theorem gauge_ball (hr : 0 ≤ r) (x : E) : gauge (ball (0 : E) r) x = ‖x‖ / r
proof:
:= by
  rcases hr.eq_or_lt with rfl | hr
  · simp
  · rw [← smul_unitBall_of_pos hr, gauge_smul_left, Pi.smul_apply, gauge_unit_ball, smul_eq_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg hr.le, div_eq_inv_mul]
    simp_rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_neg]
    exact fun _ => id

name: gauge_closure_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gauge_closure_zero : gauge (closure (0 : Set E)) = 0
proof:
:= funext fun x ↦ by
  simp only [← singleton_zero, gauge_def', mem_closure_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, mul_eq_zero,
    norm_eq_zero, inv_eq_zero]
  rcases (norm_nonneg x).eq_or_lt' with hx | hx
  · convert! csInf_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))
    exact Set.ext fun r ↦ and_iff_left (.inr hx)
  · convert! Real.sInf_empty
    exact eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun r ⟨hr₀, hr⟩ ↦ hx.ne' <| hr.resolve_left hr₀.out.ne'

name: gauge_closedBall
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gauge_closedBall (hr : 0 ≤ r) (x : E) : gauge (closedBall (0 : E) r) x = ‖x‖ / r
proof:
:= by
  rcases hr.eq_or_lt with rfl | hr'
  · rw [div_zero, closedBall_zero', singleton_zero, gauge_closure_zero]; rfl
  · apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← gauge_ball hr]
      exact gauge_mono (absorbent_ball_zero hr') ball_subset_closedBall x
    · suffices ∀ᶠ R in 𝓝[>] r, ‖x‖ / R ≤ gauge (closedBall 0 r) x by
        refine le_of_tendsto ?_ this
        exact tendsto_const_nhds.div inf_le_left hr'.ne'
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with R hR
      rw [← gauge_ball (hr.trans hR.out.le)]
      refine gauge_mono ?_ (closedBall_subset_ball hR) _
      exact (absorbent_ball_zero hr').mono ball_subset_closedBall

name: mul_gauge_le_norm
statement: theorem mul_gauge_le_norm (hs : Metric.ball (0 : E) r ⊆ s) : r * gauge s x ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain hr | hr := le_or_gt r 0
  · exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hr <| gauge_nonneg _).trans (norm_nonneg _)
  rw [mul_comm, ← le_div_iff₀ hr, ← gauge_ball hr.le]
  exact gauge_mono (absorbent_ball_zero hr) hs x

name: Convex.lipschitzWith_gauge
statement:
theorem Convex.lipschitzWith_gauge {r : ℝ≥0} (hc : Convex ℝ s) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hs : Metric.ball (0 : E) r ⊆ s) : LipschitzWith r⁻¹ (gauge s)
proof:
:=
  have : Absorbent ℝ (Metric.ball (0 : E) r) := absorbent_ball_zero hr
  LipschitzWith.of_le_add_mul _ fun x y =>
    calc
      gauge s x = gauge s (y + (x - y)) := by simp
      _ ≤ gauge s y + gauge s (x - y) := gauge_add_le hc (this.mono hs) _ _
      _ ≤ gauge s y + ‖x - y‖ / r := by grw [gauge_mono this hs (x - y), gauge_ball]; positivity
      _ = gauge s y + r⁻¹ * dist x y := by rw [dist_eq_norm, div_eq_inv_mul, NNReal.coe_inv]

name: Convex.lipschitz_gauge
statement:
theorem Convex.lipschitz_gauge (hc : Convex ℝ s) (h₀ : s ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E)) :
    ∃ K, LipschitzWith K (gauge s)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨r, hr₀, hr⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 h₀
  ⟨(⟨r, hr₀.le⟩ : ℝ≥0)⁻¹, hc.lipschitzWith_gauge hr₀ hr⟩

name: Convex.uniformContinuous_gauge
statement:
theorem Convex.uniformContinuous_gauge (hc : Convex ℝ s) (h₀ : s ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E)) :
    UniformContinuous (gauge s)

name: le_gauge_of_subset_closedBall
statement:
theorem le_gauge_of_subset_closedBall (hs : Absorbent ℝ s) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hsr : s ⊆ closedBall 0 r) :
    ‖x‖ / r ≤ gauge s x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gauge_closedBall hr]
  exact gauge_mono hs hsr _

name: IsExtreme.refl
statement:
@[refl]
protected theorem IsExtreme.refl (A : Set E) : IsExtreme 𝕜 A A

name: IsExtreme.rfl
statement: protected theorem IsExtreme.rfl : IsExtreme 𝕜 A A

name: IsExtreme.right_mem_of_mem_openSegment
statement:
theorem IsExtreme.right_mem_of_mem_openSegment (h : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) {y z : E} (hx : x ∈ A)
    (hy : y ∈ A) (hz : z ∈ B) (hzxy : z ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y) : y ∈ B
proof:
:=
  h.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment hy hx hz <| by rwa [openSegment_symm]

name: IsExtreme.trans
statement:
@[trans]
protected theorem IsExtreme.trans (hAB : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) (hBC : IsExtreme 𝕜 B C) :
    IsExtreme 𝕜 A C
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hBC.subset.trans hAB.subset, fun x₁ hx₁A x₂ hx₂A x hxC hx ↦ ?_⟩
  exact hBC.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment
    (hAB.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment hx₁A hx₂A (hBC.subset hxC) hx)
    (hAB.right_mem_of_mem_openSegment hx₁A hx₂A (hBC.subset hxC) hx) hxC hx

name: IsExtreme.antisymm
statement: protected theorem IsExtreme.antisymm : Std.Antisymm (IsExtreme 𝕜 : Set E → Set E → Prop)

name: IsExtreme.inter
statement:
theorem IsExtreme.inter (hAB : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) (hAC : IsExtreme 𝕜 A C) :
    IsExtreme 𝕜 A (B ∩ C)
proof:
:= by
  use Subset.trans inter_subset_left hAB.1
  rintro x₁ hx₁A x₂ hx₂A x ⟨hxB, hxC⟩ hx
  exact ⟨hAB.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment hx₁A hx₂A hxB hx,
    hAC.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment hx₁A hx₂A hxC hx⟩

name: IsExtreme.mono
statement:
protected theorem IsExtreme.mono (hAC : IsExtreme 𝕜 A C) (hBA : B ⊆ A) (hCB : C ⊆ B) :
    IsExtreme 𝕜 B C
proof:
:=
  ⟨hCB, fun _ hx₁B _ hx₂B _ hxC hx ↦ hAC.2 (hBA hx₁B) (hBA hx₂B) hxC hx⟩

name: isExtreme_iInter
statement:
theorem isExtreme_iInter {ι : Sort*} [Nonempty ι] {F : ι → Set E}
    (hAF : ∀ i : ι, IsExtreme 𝕜 A (F i)) : IsExtreme 𝕜 A (⋂ i : ι, F i)
proof:
:= by
  inhabit ι
  refine ⟨iInter_subset_of_subset default (hAF default).1, fun x₁ hx₁A x₂ hx₂A x hxF hx ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [mem_iInter] at hxF ⊢
  exact fun i ↦ (hAF i).2 hx₁A hx₂A (hxF i) hx

name: isExtreme_biInter
statement:
theorem isExtreme_biInter {F : Set (Set E)} (hF : F.Nonempty) (hA : ∀ B ∈ F, IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) :
    IsExtreme 𝕜 A (⋂ B ∈ F, B)
proof:
:= by
  have := hF.to_subtype
  simpa only [iInter_subtype] using isExtreme_iInter fun i : F ↦ hA _ i.2

name: isExtreme_sInter
statement:
theorem isExtreme_sInter {F : Set (Set E)} (hF : F.Nonempty) (hAF : ∀ B ∈ F, IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) :
    IsExtreme 𝕜 A (⋂₀ F)
proof: := by simpa [sInter_eq_biInter] using isExtreme_biInter hF hAF

name: mem_extremePoints
statement:
theorem mem_extremePoints : x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ↔
    x ∈ A ∧ ∀ᵉ (x₁ ∈ A) (x₂ ∈ A), x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ → x₁ = x ∧ x₂ = x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, fun x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx ↦ ⟨h.2 hx₁ hx₂ hx, ?_⟩⟩,
    fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, fun x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx ↦ (h.2 x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx).1⟩⟩
  apply h.2 hx₂ hx₁
  rwa [openSegment_symm]

name: mem_extremePoints_iff_left
statement:
theorem mem_extremePoints_iff_left : x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ↔
    x ∈ A ∧ ∀ x₁ ∈ A, ∀ x₂ ∈ A, x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ → x₁ = x

name: isExtreme_singleton
statement: @[simp] lemma isExtreme_singleton : IsExtreme 𝕜 A {x} ↔ x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜

name: extremePoints_subset
statement: theorem extremePoints_subset : A.extremePoints 𝕜 ⊆ A

name: extremePoints_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extremePoints_empty : (∅ : Set E).extremePoints 𝕜 = ∅

name: extremePoints_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extremePoints_singleton : ({x} : Set E).extremePoints 𝕜 = {x}
proof:
:=
  extremePoints_subset.antisymm <| singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨mem_singleton x, fun _ hx₁ _ _ _ ↦ hx₁⟩

name: inter_extremePoints_subset_extremePoints_of_subset
statement:
theorem inter_extremePoints_subset_extremePoints_of_subset (hBA : B ⊆ A) :
    B ∩ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ⊆ B.extremePoints 𝕜
proof:
:=
  fun _ ⟨hxB, hxA⟩ ↦ ⟨hxB, fun _ hx₁ _ hx₂ hx ↦ hxA.2 (hBA hx₁) (hBA hx₂) hx⟩

name: IsExtreme.extremePoints_subset_extremePoints
statement:
theorem IsExtreme.extremePoints_subset_extremePoints (hAB : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) :
    B.extremePoints 𝕜 ⊆ A.extremePoints 𝕜
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ by simpa only [← isExtreme_singleton] using hAB.trans

name: IsExtreme.extremePoints_eq
statement:
theorem IsExtreme.extremePoints_eq (hAB : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) :
    B.extremePoints 𝕜 = B ∩ A.extremePoints 𝕜

name: Set.extremePoints_eq_self
statement:
@[nontriviality]
lemma Set.extremePoints_eq_self [Subsingleton E] (A : Set E) : Set.extremePoints 𝕜 A = A
proof:
:=
  subset_antisymm extremePoints_subset fun _ h ↦ ⟨h, fun _ _ _ _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim ..⟩

name: IsExtreme.convex_sdiff
statement:
theorem IsExtreme.convex_sdiff [IsOrderedRing 𝕜] (hA : Convex 𝕜 A) (hAB : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) :
    Convex 𝕜 (A \ B)
proof:
:=
  convex_iff_openSegment_subset.2 fun _ ⟨hx₁A, hx₁B⟩ _ ⟨hx₂A, _⟩ _ hx ↦
    ⟨hA.openSegment_subset hx₁A hx₂A hx, fun hxB ↦ hx₁B (hAB.2 hx₁A hx₂A hxB hx)⟩

name: extremePoints_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extremePoints_prod (s : Set E) (t : Set F) :
    (s ×ˢ t).extremePoints 𝕜 = s.extremePoints 𝕜 ×ˢ t.extremePoints 𝕜
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  refine (and_congr_right fun hx ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩).trans and_and_and_comm
  · rintro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hx'⟩
    ext
    · exact h.1 hx₁.1 hx₂.1 ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congrArg Prod.fst hx'⟩
    · exact h.2 hx₁.2 hx₂.2 ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congrArg Prod.snd hx'⟩
  · rintro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx_fst
    refine congrArg Prod.fst (h (mk_mem_prod hx₁ hx.2) (mk_mem_prod hx₂ hx.2) ?_)
    rw [← Prod.image_mk_openSegment_left]
    exact mem_image_of_mem _ hx_fst
  · rintro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx_snd
    refine congrArg Prod.snd (h (mk_mem_prod hx.1 hx₁) (mk_mem_prod hx.1 hx₂) ?_)
    rw [← Prod.image_mk_openSegment_right]
    exact mem_image_of_mem _ hx_snd

name: extremePoints_pi
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extremePoints_pi (s : ∀ i, Set (M i)) :
    (univ.pi s).extremePoints 𝕜 = univ.pi fun i ↦ (s i).extremePoints 𝕜
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  simp only [mem_extremePoints_iff_left, mem_univ_pi, @forall_and ι]
  refine and_congr_right fun hx ↦ ⟨fun h i ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hi
    rw [← update_self i x₁ x, h (update x i x₁) _ (update x i x₂)]
    · rintro j
      obtain rfl | hji := eq_or_ne j i <;> simp [*]
    · rw [← Pi.image_update_openSegment]
      exact ⟨_, hi, update_eq_self _ _⟩
    · rintro j
      obtain rfl | hji := eq_or_ne j i <;> simp [*]
  · rintro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
    ext i
    exact h _ _ (hx₁ _) _ (hx₂ _) ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩

name: image_extremePoints
statement:
lemma image_extremePoints (f : L) (s : Set E) :
    f '' extremePoints 𝕜 s = extremePoints 𝕜 (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := EquivLike.surjective f b
  have : ∀ x y, f '' openSegment 𝕜 x y = openSegment 𝕜 (f x) (f y) :=
    image_openSegment _ (LinearMap.ofClass f).toAffineMap
  simp only [mem_extremePoints, (EquivLike.surjective f).forall,
    (EquivLike.injective f).mem_set_image, (EquivLike.injective f).eq_iff, ← this]

name: mem_extremePoints_iff_forall_segment
statement:
theorem mem_extremePoints_iff_forall_segment : x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ↔
    x ∈ A ∧ ∀ᵉ (x₁ ∈ A) (x₂ ∈ A), x ∈ segment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ → x₁ = x ∨ x₂ = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_extremePoints]
  refine and_congr_right fun hxA ↦ forall₄_congr fun x₁ h₁ x₂ h₂ ↦ ?_
  constructor
  · rw [← insert_endpoints_openSegment]
    rintro H (rfl | rfl | hx)
    exacts [Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl, Or.inl <| (H hx).1]
  · intro H hx
    rcases H (openSegment_subset_segment _ _ _ hx) with (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [⟨rfl, (left_mem_openSegment_iff.1 hx).symm⟩, ⟨right_mem_openSegment_iff.1 hx, rfl⟩]

name: Convex.mem_extremePoints_iff_convex_sdiff
statement:
theorem Convex.mem_extremePoints_iff_convex_sdiff (hA : Convex 𝕜 A) :
    x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ↔ x ∈ A ∧ Convex 𝕜 (A \ {x})
proof:
:= by
  use fun hx ↦ ⟨hx.1, (isExtreme_singleton.2 hx).convex_sdiff hA⟩
  rintro ⟨hxA, hAx⟩
  refine mem_extremePoints_iff_forall_segment.2 ⟨hxA, fun x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [convex_iff_segment_subset] at hAx
  by_contra! h
  exact (hAx ⟨hx₁, fun hx₁ ↦ h.1 (mem_singleton_iff.2 hx₁)⟩
      ⟨hx₂, fun hx₂ ↦ h.2 (mem_singleton_iff.2 hx₂)⟩ hx).2 rfl

name: Convex.mem_extremePoints_iff_mem_sdiff_convexHull_sdiff
statement:
theorem Convex.mem_extremePoints_iff_mem_sdiff_convexHull_sdiff (hA : Convex 𝕜 A) :
    x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ↔ x ∈ A \ convexHull 𝕜 (A \ {x})

name: extremePoints_convexHull_subset
statement: theorem extremePoints_convexHull_subset : (convexHull 𝕜 A).extremePoints 𝕜 ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  rintro x hx
  rw [(convex_convexHull 𝕜 _).mem_extremePoints_iff_convex_sdiff] at hx
  by_contra h
  exact (convexHull_min (subset_sdiff.2 ⟨subset_convexHull 𝕜 _, disjoint_singleton_right.2 h⟩) hx.2
    hx.1).2 rfl

name: star_segment
statement: @[simp] lemma star_segment (x y : E) : star (segment 𝕜 x y) = segment 𝕜 (star x) (star y)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x y : E, segment 𝕜 x y ⊆ star (segment 𝕜 (star x) (star y)) from
    le_antisymm (by simpa [star_subset] using this x y) (by simpa using this (star x) (star y))
  exact fun x y a ⟨b, c, hb, hc, hbc, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨star b, star c, by grind [star_one]⟩

name: star_openSegment
statement:
@[simp] lemma star_openSegment (x y : E) :
    star (openSegment 𝕜 x y) = openSegment 𝕜 (star x) (star y)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x y : E, openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ star (openSegment 𝕜 (star x) (star y)) from
    le_antisymm (by simpa [star_subset] using this x y) (by simpa using this (star x) (star y))
  exact fun x y a ⟨b, c, hb, hc, hbc, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨star b, star c, by grind [star_one]⟩

name: star_extremePoints
statement:
@[simp] lemma star_extremePoints (s : Set E) :
    star (extremePoints 𝕜 s) = extremePoints 𝕜 (star s)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [mem_star, mem_extremePoints_iff_left]
  conv_lhs => simp +singlePass only [star_involutive.surjective.forall]
  simp [← star_openSegment]

name: segment_eq_image
proof:
:= by
  simp only [segment, image, Prod.exists, mem_ofPred_eq, and_assoc]

name: openSegment_eq_image
proof:
:= by
  simp only [openSegment, image, Prod.exists, mem_ofPred_eq, and_assoc]

name: segment_symm
statement: theorem segment_symm (x y : E) : [x -[𝕜] y] = [y -[𝕜] x]
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun _ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, H⟩ => ⟨b, a, hb, ha, (add_comm _ _).trans hab, (add_comm _ _).trans H⟩,
      fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, H⟩ =>
      ⟨b, a, hb, ha, (add_comm _ _).trans hab, (add_comm _ _).trans H⟩⟩

name: openSegment_symm
statement: theorem openSegment_symm (x y : E) : openSegment 𝕜 x y = openSegment 𝕜 y x
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun _ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, H⟩ => ⟨b, a, hb, ha, (add_comm _ _).trans hab, (add_comm _ _).trans H⟩,
      fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, H⟩ =>
      ⟨b, a, hb, ha, (add_comm _ _).trans hab, (add_comm _ _).trans H⟩⟩

name: openSegment_subset_segment
statement: theorem openSegment_subset_segment (x y : E) : openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ [x -[𝕜] y]
proof:
:=
  fun _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ => ⟨a, b, ha.le, hb.le, hab, hz⟩

name: segment_subset_iff
statement:
theorem segment_subset_iff :
    [x -[𝕜] y] ⊆ s ↔ ∀ a b : 𝕜, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → a • x + b • y ∈ s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H a b ha hb hab => H ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩, fun H _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ =>
    hz ▸ H a b ha hb hab⟩

name: openSegment_subset_iff
statement:
theorem openSegment_subset_iff :
    openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ s ↔ ∀ a b : 𝕜, 0 < a → 0 < b → a + b = 1 → a • x + b • y ∈ s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H a b ha hb hab => H ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩, fun H _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ =>
    hz ▸ H a b ha hb hab⟩

name: left_mem_segment
statement: theorem left_mem_segment (x y : E) : x ∈ [x -[𝕜] y]
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, 0, zero_le_one, le_refl 0, add_zero 1, by rw [zero_smul, one_smul, add_zero]⟩

name: right_mem_segment
statement: theorem right_mem_segment (x y : E) : y ∈ [x -[𝕜] y]
proof:
:=
  segment_symm 𝕜 y x ▸ left_mem_segment 𝕜 y x

name: segment_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem segment_same (x : E) : [x -[𝕜] x] = {x}
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun z =>
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, hz⟩ => by
      simpa only [(add_smul _ _ _).symm, mem_singleton_iff, hab, one_smul, eq_comm] using hz,
      fun h => mem_singleton_iff.1 h ▸ left_mem_segment 𝕜 z z⟩

name: insert_endpoints_openSegment
statement:
theorem insert_endpoints_openSegment (x y : E) :
    insert x (insert y (openSegment 𝕜 x y)) = [x -[𝕜] y]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [subset_antisymm_iff, insert_subset_iff, left_mem_segment, right_mem_segment,
    openSegment_subset_segment, true_and]
  rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
  refine hb.eq_or_lt.imp ?_ fun hb' => ha.eq_or_lt.imp ?_ fun ha' => ?_
  · rintro rfl
    rw [← add_zero a, hab, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
  · rintro rfl
    rw [← zero_add b, hab, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add]
  · exact ⟨a, b, ha', hb', hab, rfl⟩

name: mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right
statement:
theorem mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right (hx : x ≠ z) (hy : y ≠ z) (hz : z ∈ [x -[𝕜] y]) :
    z ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← insert_endpoints_openSegment] at hz
  exact (hz.resolve_left hx.symm).resolve_left hy.symm

name: openSegment_subset_iff_segment_subset
statement:
theorem openSegment_subset_iff_segment_subset (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) :
    openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ s ↔ [x -[𝕜] y] ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← insert_endpoints_openSegment, insert_subset_iff, *, true_and]

name: segment.lift
statement: theorem segment.lift [SMulPosMono R 𝕜] (x y : E) : segment R x y ⊆ segment 𝕜 x y
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hxy⟩
  refine ⟨_, _, ?_, ?_, by simpa [add_smul] using congr($(hab) • (1 : 𝕜)), by simpa⟩
  all_goals exact zero_smul R (1 : 𝕜) ▸ smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right ‹_› zero_le_one

name: openSegment.lift
statement:
theorem openSegment.lift [Nontrivial 𝕜] [SMulPosStrictMono R 𝕜] (x y : E) :
    openSegment R x y ⊆ openSegment 𝕜 x y
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hxy⟩
  refine ⟨_, _, ?_, ?_, by simpa [add_smul] using congr($(hab) • (1 : 𝕜)), by simpa⟩
  all_goals exact zero_smul R (1 : 𝕜) ▸ smul_lt_smul_of_pos_right ‹_› zero_lt_one

name: openSegment_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem openSegment_same (x : E) : openSegment 𝕜 x x = {x}
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun z =>
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, hz⟩ => by
      simpa only [← add_smul, mem_singleton_iff, hab, one_smul, eq_comm] using hz,
    fun h : z = x => by
      obtain ⟨a, ha₀, ha₁⟩ := DenselyOrdered.dense (0 : 𝕜) 1 zero_lt_one
      refine ⟨a, 1 - a, ha₀, sub_pos_of_lt ha₁, add_sub_cancel _ _, ?_⟩
      rw [← add_smul, add_sub_cancel, one_smul, h]⟩

name: segment_eq_image
statement:
theorem segment_eq_image (x y : E) :
    [x -[𝕜] y] = (fun θ : 𝕜 => (1 - θ) • x + θ • y) '' Icc (0 : 𝕜) 1
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun _ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ =>
      ⟨b, ⟨hb, hab ▸ le_add_of_nonneg_left ha⟩, hab ▸ hz ▸ by simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]⟩,
      fun ⟨θ, ⟨hθ₀, hθ₁⟩, hz⟩ => ⟨1 - θ, θ, sub_nonneg.2 hθ₁, hθ₀, sub_add_cancel _ _, hz⟩⟩

name: openSegment_eq_image
statement:
theorem openSegment_eq_image (x y : E) :
    openSegment 𝕜 x y = (fun θ : 𝕜 => (1 - θ) • x + θ • y) '' Ioo (0 : 𝕜) 1
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun _ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ =>
      ⟨b, ⟨hb, hab ▸ lt_add_of_pos_left _ ha⟩, hab ▸ hz ▸ by simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]⟩,
      fun ⟨θ, ⟨hθ₀, hθ₁⟩, hz⟩ => ⟨1 - θ, θ, sub_pos.2 hθ₁, hθ₀, sub_add_cancel _ _, hz⟩⟩

name: segment_eq_image'
statement:
theorem segment_eq_image' (x y : E) :
    [x -[𝕜] y] = (fun θ : 𝕜 => x + θ • (y - x)) '' Icc (0 : 𝕜) 1
proof:
:= by
  convert! segment_eq_image 𝕜 x y using 2
  simp only [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
  abel

name: openSegment_eq_image'
statement:
theorem openSegment_eq_image' (x y : E) :
    openSegment 𝕜 x y = (fun θ : 𝕜 => x + θ • (y - x)) '' Ioo (0 : 𝕜) 1
proof:
:= by
  convert! openSegment_eq_image 𝕜 x y using 2
  simp only [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]
  abel

name: segment_eq_image_lineMap
statement:
theorem segment_eq_image_lineMap (x y : E) : [x -[𝕜] y] =
    AffineMap.lineMap x y '' Icc (0 : 𝕜) 1
proof:
:= by
  convert segment_eq_image 𝕜 x y
  exact AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module _ _ _

name: openSegment_eq_image_lineMap
statement:
theorem openSegment_eq_image_lineMap (x y : E) :
    openSegment 𝕜 x y = AffineMap.lineMap x y '' Ioo (0 : 𝕜) 1
proof:
:= by
  convert openSegment_eq_image 𝕜 x y
  exact AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module _ _ _

name: lineMap_mem_openSegment
statement:
theorem lineMap_mem_openSegment (a b : E) {t : 𝕜} (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 1) :
    AffineMap.lineMap a b t ∈ openSegment 𝕜 a b
proof:
:=
  openSegment_eq_image_lineMap 𝕜 a b ▸ mem_image_of_mem _ ht

name: lineMap_mem_segment
statement:
theorem lineMap_mem_segment (a b : E) {t : 𝕜} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    AffineMap.lineMap a b t ∈ [a -[𝕜] b]
proof:
:=
  segment_eq_image_lineMap 𝕜 a b ▸ mem_image_of_mem _ ht

name: image_segment
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_segment (f : E →ᵃ[𝕜] F) (a b : E) : f '' [a -[𝕜] b] = [f a -[𝕜] f b]
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x => by
    simp_rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap, mem_image, exists_exists_and_eq_and, AffineMap.apply_lineMap]

name: image_openSegment
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_openSegment (f : E →ᵃ[𝕜] F) (a b : E) :
    f '' openSegment 𝕜 a b = openSegment 𝕜 (f a) (f b)
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x => by
    simp_rw [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap, mem_image, exists_exists_and_eq_and,
      AffineMap.apply_lineMap]

name: vadd_segment
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vadd_segment [AddTorsor G E] [VAddCommClass G E E] (a : G) (b c : E) :
    a +ᵥ [b -[𝕜] c] = [a +ᵥ b -[𝕜] a +ᵥ c]
proof:
:=
  #adaptation_note /
  we didn't need this `let` statement. -/
  let : AddTorsor E E := AddGroup.instAddTorsor E
  image_segment 𝕜 ⟨_, LinearMap.id, fun _ _ => vadd_comm _ _ _⟩ b c

name: vadd_openSegment
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vadd_openSegment [AddTorsor G E] [VAddCommClass G E E] (a : G) (b c : E) :
    a +ᵥ openSegment 𝕜 b c = openSegment 𝕜 (a +ᵥ b) (a +ᵥ c)
proof:
:=
  #adaptation_note /
  we didn't need this `let` statement. -/
  let : AddTorsor E E := AddGroup.instAddTorsor E
  image_openSegment 𝕜 ⟨_, LinearMap.id, fun _ _ => vadd_comm _ _ _⟩ b c

name: mem_segment_translate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_segment_translate (a : E) {x b c} : a + x ∈ [a + b -[𝕜] a + c] ↔ x ∈ [b -[𝕜] c]

name: mem_openSegment_translate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_openSegment_translate (a : E) {x b c : E} :
    a + x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 (a + b) (a + c) ↔ x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 b c

name: segment_translate_preimage
statement:
theorem segment_translate_preimage (a b c : E) :
    (fun x => a + x) ⁻¹' [a + b -[𝕜] a + c] = [b -[𝕜] c]

name: openSegment_translate_preimage
statement:
theorem openSegment_translate_preimage (a b c : E) :
    (fun x => a + x) ⁻¹' openSegment 𝕜 (a + b) (a + c) = openSegment 𝕜 b c

name: segment_translate_image
statement: theorem segment_translate_image (a b c : E) : (fun x => a + x) '' [b -[𝕜] c] = [a + b -[𝕜] a + c]
proof:
:=
  segment_translate_preimage 𝕜 a b c ▸ image_preimage_eq _ <| add_left_surjective a

name: openSegment_translate_image
statement:
theorem openSegment_translate_image (a b c : E) :
    (fun x => a + x) '' openSegment 𝕜 b c = openSegment 𝕜 (a + b) (a + c)
proof:
:=
  openSegment_translate_preimage 𝕜 a b c ▸ image_preimage_eq _ <| add_left_surjective a

name: segment_inter_subset_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_sub
proof:
:= by
  intro z ⟨hzt, hzs⟩
  rw [segment_eq_image, mem_image] at hzt hzs
  rcases hzt with ⟨p, ⟨p0, p1⟩, rfl⟩
  rcases hzs with ⟨q, ⟨q0, q1⟩, H⟩
  have Hx : x = (x - c) + c := by abel
  have Hy : y = (y - c) + c := by abel
  rw [Hx, Hy, smul_add, smul_add] at H
  have : c + q • (y - c) = c + p • (x - c) := by
    convert! H using 1 <;> simp [sub_smul]
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ : p = 0 ∧ q = 0 := h.eq_zero_of_pair' ((add_right_inj c).1 this).symm
  simp

name: segment_inter_eq_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_sub
proof:
:= by
  refine (segment_inter_subset_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_sub 𝕜 h).antisymm ?_
  simp [singleton_subset_iff, left_mem_segment]

name: sameRay_of_mem_segment
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image'] at h
  rcases h with ⟨θ, ⟨hθ₀, hθ₁⟩, rfl⟩
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left, ← sub_sub, sub_smul, one_smul] using
    (SameRay.sameRay_nonneg_smul_left (z - y) hθ₀).nonneg_smul_right (sub_nonneg.2 hθ₁)

name: segment_inter_eq_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_of_ne
statement:
lemma segment_inter_eq_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_of_ne
    [CommRing 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [IsOrderedRing 𝕜] [IsDomain 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E]
    {x y : E} (h : LinearIndependent 𝕜 ![x, y]) {s t : 𝕜} (hs : s ≠ t) (c : E) :
    [c + x -[𝕜] c + t • y] ∩ [c + x -[𝕜] c + s • y] = {c + x}
proof:
:= by
  apply segment_inter_eq_endpoint_of_linearIndependent_sub
  simp only [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
  suffices H : LinearIndependent 𝕜 ![(-1 : 𝕜) • x + t • y, (-1 : 𝕜) • x + s • y] by
    convert! H using 1; simp only [neg_smul, one_smul]; abel_nf
  nontriviality 𝕜
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_add_smul_add_smul_iff]
  aesop

name: midpoint_mem_openSegment
statement:
theorem midpoint_mem_openSegment [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) :
    midpoint 𝕜 x y ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap]
  exact ⟨⅟2, ⟨invOf_pos.mpr two_pos, invOf_lt_one one_lt_two⟩, rfl⟩

name: midpoint_mem_segment
statement: theorem midpoint_mem_segment [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) : midpoint 𝕜 x y ∈ [x -[𝕜] y]

name: mem_openSegment_sub_add
statement:
theorem mem_openSegment_sub_add [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) :
    x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 (x - y) (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  convert! midpoint_mem_openSegment (𝕜 := 𝕜) (x - y) (x + y)
  rw [midpoint_sub_add]

name: mem_segment_sub_add
statement: theorem mem_segment_sub_add [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) : x ∈ [x - y -[𝕜] x + y]

name: mem_openSegment_add_sub
statement:
theorem mem_openSegment_add_sub [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) :
    x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 (x + y) (x - y)
proof:
:= by
  convert! midpoint_mem_openSegment (𝕜 := 𝕜) (x + y) (x - y)
  rw [midpoint_add_sub]

name: mem_segment_add_sub
statement: theorem mem_segment_add_sub [Invertible (2 : 𝕜)] (x y : E) : x ∈ [x + y -[𝕜] x - y]

name: left_mem_openSegment_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem left_mem_openSegment_iff [DenselyOrdered 𝕜] [IsTorsionFree 𝕜 E] :
    x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, _, hb, hab, hx⟩
    refine smul_right_injective _ hb.ne' ((add_right_inj (a • x)).1 ?_)
    rw [hx, ← add_smul, hab, one_smul]
  · rintro rfl
    rw [openSegment_same]
    exact mem_singleton _

name: right_mem_openSegment_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem right_mem_openSegment_iff [DenselyOrdered 𝕜] [IsTorsionFree 𝕜 E] :
    y ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y ↔ x = y

name: mem_segment_iff_div
statement:
theorem mem_segment_iff_div :
    x ∈ [y -[𝕜] z] ↔
