      ∃ a b : 𝕜, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ 0 < a + b ∧ (a / (a + b)) • y + (b / (a + b)) • z = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
    use a, b, ha, hb
    simp [*]
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a / (a + b), b / (a + b), by positivity, by positivity, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [← add_div, div_self hab.ne']

name: mem_openSegment_iff_div
statement:
theorem mem_openSegment_iff_div : x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 y z ↔
    ∃ a b : 𝕜, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ (a / (a + b)) • y + (b / (a + b)) • z = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
    use a, b, ha, hb
    rw [hab, div_one, div_one]
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl⟩
    have hab : 0 < a + b := add_pos' ha hb
    refine ⟨a / (a + b), b / (a + b), by positivity, by positivity, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [← add_div, div_self hab.ne']

name: mem_segment_iff_sameRay
statement: theorem mem_segment_iff_sameRay : x ∈ [y -[𝕜] z] ↔ SameRay 𝕜 (x - y) (z - x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨sameRay_of_mem_segment, fun h => ?_⟩
  rcases h.exists_eq_smul_add with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hxy, hzx⟩
  rw [add_comm, sub_add_sub_cancel] at hxy hzx
  rw [← mem_segment_translate _ (-x), neg_add_cancel]
  refine ⟨b, a, hb, ha, add_comm a b ▸ hab, ?_⟩
  rw [← sub_eq_neg_add, ← neg_sub, hxy, ← sub_eq_neg_add, hzx, smul_neg, smul_comm, neg_add_cancel]

name: openSegment_subset_union
statement:
theorem openSegment_subset_union (x y : E) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ range (lineMap x y : 𝕜 → E)) :
    openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ insert z (openSegment 𝕜 x z ∪ openSegment 𝕜 z y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hz with ⟨c, rfl⟩
  simp only [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap, ← mapsTo_iff_image_subset]
  rintro a ⟨h₀, h₁⟩
  rcases lt_trichotomy a c with (hac | rfl | hca)
  · right
    left
    have hc : 0 < c := h₀.trans hac
    refine ⟨a / c, ⟨div_pos h₀ hc, (div_lt_one hc).2 hac⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [← homothety_eq_lineMap, ← homothety_mul_apply, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc.ne']
  · left
    rfl
  · right
    right
    have hc : 0 < 1 - c := sub_pos.2 (hca.trans h₁)
    simp only [← lineMap_apply_one_sub y]
    refine
      ⟨(a - c) / (1 - c), ⟨div_pos (sub_pos.2 hca) hc, (div_lt_one hc).2 <| sub_lt_sub_right h₁ _⟩,
        ?_⟩
    simp only [← homothety_eq_lineMap, ← homothety_mul_apply, sub_mul, one_mul,
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc.ne', sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]

name: segment_subset_Icc
statement: theorem segment_subset_Icc (h : x ≤ y) : [x -[𝕜] y] ⊆ Icc x y
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · calc
      x = a • x + b • x := (Convex.combo_self hab _).symm
      _ ≤ a • x + b • y := by gcongr
  · calc
      a • x + b • y ≤ a • y + b • y := by gcongr
      _ = y := Convex.combo_self hab _

name: openSegment_subset_Ioo
statement: theorem openSegment_subset_Ioo (h : x < y) : openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ Ioo x y
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · calc
      x = a • x + b • x := (Convex.combo_self hab _).symm
      _ < a • x + b • y := by gcongr
  · calc
      a • x + b • y < a • y + b • y := by gcongr
      _ = y := Convex.combo_self hab _

name: segment_subset_uIcc
statement: theorem segment_subset_uIcc (x y : E) : [x -[𝕜] y] ⊆ uIcc x y
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total x y with h | h
  · rw [uIcc_of_le h]
    exact segment_subset_Icc h
  · rw [uIcc_of_ge h, segment_symm]
    exact segment_subset_Icc h

name: Convex.min_le_combo
statement:
theorem Convex.min_le_combo (x y : E) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    min x y ≤ a • x + b • y
proof:
:=
  (segment_subset_uIcc x y ⟨_, _, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩).1

name: Convex.combo_le_max
statement:
theorem Convex.combo_le_max (x y : E) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a • x + b • y ≤ max x y
proof:
:=
  (segment_subset_uIcc x y ⟨_, _, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩).2

name: Icc_subset_segment
statement: theorem Icc_subset_segment : Icc x y ⊆ [x -[𝕜] y]
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨hxz, hyz⟩
  obtain rfl | h := (hxz.trans hyz).eq_or_lt
  · rw [segment_same]
    exact hyz.antisymm hxz
  rw [← sub_nonneg] at hxz hyz
  rw [← sub_pos] at h
  refine ⟨(y - z) / (y - x), (z - x) / (y - x), div_nonneg hyz h.le, div_nonneg hxz h.le, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← add_div, sub_add_sub_cancel, div_self h.ne']
  · rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_div_right_comm, ← mul_div_right_comm, ← add_div,
      div_eq_iff h.ne', add_comm, sub_mul, sub_mul, mul_comm x, sub_add_sub_cancel, mul_sub]

name: segment_eq_Icc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem segment_eq_Icc (h : x ≤ y) : [x -[𝕜] y] = Icc x y

name: Ioo_subset_openSegment
statement: theorem Ioo_subset_openSegment : Ioo x y ⊆ openSegment 𝕜 x y
proof:
:= fun _ hz =>
  mem_openSegment_of_ne_left_right hz.1.ne hz.2.ne' <| Icc_subset_segment <| Ioo_subset_Icc_self hz

name: openSegment_eq_Ioo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem openSegment_eq_Ioo (h : x < y) : openSegment 𝕜 x y = Ioo x y

name: segment_eq_Icc'
statement: theorem segment_eq_Icc' (x y : 𝕜) : [x -[𝕜] y] = Icc (min x y) (max x y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total x y with h | h
  · rw [segment_eq_Icc h, max_eq_right h, min_eq_left h]
  · rw [segment_symm, segment_eq_Icc h, max_eq_left h, min_eq_right h]

name: openSegment_eq_Ioo'
statement: theorem openSegment_eq_Ioo' (hxy : x ≠ y) : openSegment 𝕜 x y = Ioo (min x y) (max x y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hxy.lt_or_gt with h | h
  · rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo h, max_eq_right h.le, min_eq_left h.le]
  · rw [openSegment_symm, openSegment_eq_Ioo h, max_eq_left h.le, min_eq_right h.le]

name: segment_eq_uIcc
statement: theorem segment_eq_uIcc (x y : 𝕜) : [x -[𝕜] y] = uIcc x y

name: Convex.mem_Icc
statement:
theorem Convex.mem_Icc (h : x ≤ y) :
    z ∈ Icc x y ↔ ∃ a b, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧ a * x + b * y = z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← segment_eq_Icc h, segment, mem_ofPred_eq, smul_eq_mul, exists_and_left]

name: Convex.mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem Convex.mem_Ioo (h : x < y) :
    z ∈ Ioo x y ↔ ∃ a b, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧ a * x + b * y = z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← openSegment_eq_Ioo h, openSegment, smul_eq_mul, exists_and_left, mem_ofPred_eq]

name: Convex.mem_Ioc
statement:
theorem Convex.mem_Ioc (h : x < y) :
    z ∈ Ioc x y ↔ ∃ a b, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧ a * x + b * y = z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hz => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩ := (Convex.mem_Icc h.le).1 (Ioc_subset_Icc_self hz)
    obtain rfl | hb' := hb.eq_or_lt
    · rw [add_zero] at hab
      rw [hab, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero] at hz
      exact (hz.1.ne rfl).elim
    · exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb', hab, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
    obtain rfl | ha' := ha.eq_or_lt
    · rw [zero_add] at hab
      rwa [hab, one_mul, zero_mul, zero_add, right_mem_Ioc]
    · exact Ioo_subset_Ioc_self ((Convex.mem_Ioo h).2 ⟨a, b, ha', hb, hab, rfl⟩)

name: Convex.mem_Ico
statement:
theorem Convex.mem_Ico (h : x < y) :
    z ∈ Ico x y ↔ ∃ a b, 0 < a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ a + b = 1 ∧ a * x + b * y = z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hz => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩ := (Convex.mem_Icc h.le).1 (Ico_subset_Icc_self hz)
    obtain rfl | ha' := ha.eq_or_lt
    · rw [zero_add] at hab
      rw [hab, one_mul, zero_mul, zero_add] at hz
      exact (hz.2.ne rfl).elim
    · exact ⟨a, b, ha', hb, hab, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
    obtain rfl | hb' := hb.eq_or_lt
    · rw [add_zero] at hab
      rwa [hab, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero, left_mem_Ico]
    · exact Ioo_subset_Ico_self ((Convex.mem_Ioo h).2 ⟨a, b, ha, hb', hab, rfl⟩)

name: Icc_subset_segment
statement:
protected lemma Icc_subset_segment {x y : Nonneg 𝕜} :
    Icc x y ⊆ segment (Nonneg 𝕜) x y
proof:
:= by
  intro a ⟨hxa, hay⟩
  rw [← Subtype.coe_le_coe] at hxa hay
  rcases Icc_subset_segment ⟨hxa, hay⟩ with ⟨t₁, t₂, t₁_nonneg, t₂_nonneg, t_add, hta⟩
  refine ⟨⟨t₁, t₁_nonneg⟩, ⟨t₂, t₂_nonneg⟩, zero_le, zero_le, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
  ext <;> simpa

name: segment_eq_Icc
statement:
protected lemma segment_eq_Icc {x y : Nonneg 𝕜} (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    segment (Nonneg 𝕜) x y = Icc x y

name: segment_eq_uIcc
statement:
protected lemma segment_eq_uIcc {x y : Nonneg 𝕜} :
    segment (Nonneg 𝕜) x y = uIcc x y
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total x y with h | h
  · simp [h, Nonneg.segment_eq_Icc]
  · simp [h, segment_symm _ x y, Nonneg.segment_eq_Icc]

name: segment_subset
statement: theorem segment_subset (x y : E × F) : segment 𝕜 x y ⊆ segment 𝕜 x.1 y.1 ×ˢ segment 𝕜 x.2 y.2
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩
  exact ⟨⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_arg Prod.fst hz⟩, a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_arg Prod.snd hz⟩

name: openSegment_subset
statement:
theorem openSegment_subset (x y : E × F) :
    openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ openSegment 𝕜 x.1 y.1 ×ˢ openSegment 𝕜 x.2 y.2
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩
  exact ⟨⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_arg Prod.fst hz⟩, a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_arg Prod.snd hz⟩

name: image_mk_segment_left
statement:
theorem image_mk_segment_left (x₁ x₂ : E) (y : F) :
    (fun x => (x, y)) '' [x₁ -[𝕜] x₂] = [(x₁, y) -[𝕜] (x₂, y)]
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image₂, segment_eq_image₂, image_image]
  refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
  simp [Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]

name: image_mk_segment_right
statement:
theorem image_mk_segment_right (x : E) (y₁ y₂ : F) :
    (fun y => (x, y)) '' [y₁ -[𝕜] y₂] = [(x, y₁) -[𝕜] (x, y₂)]
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image₂, segment_eq_image₂, image_image]
  refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
  simp [Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]

name: image_mk_openSegment_left
statement:
theorem image_mk_openSegment_left (x₁ x₂ : E) (y : F) :
    (fun x => (x, y)) '' openSegment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ = openSegment 𝕜 (x₁, y) (x₂, y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [openSegment_eq_image₂, openSegment_eq_image₂, image_image]
  refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
  simp [Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]

name: image_mk_openSegment_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_mk_openSegment_right (x : E) (y₁ y₂ : F) :
    (fun y => (x, y)) '' openSegment 𝕜 y₁ y₂ = openSegment 𝕜 (x, y₁) (x, y₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [openSegment_eq_image₂, openSegment_eq_image₂, image_image]
  refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
  simp [Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]

name: segment_subset
statement: theorem segment_subset (x y : ∀ i, M i) : segment 𝕜 x y ⊆ s.pi fun i => segment 𝕜 (x i) (y i)
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ i -
  exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_fun hz i⟩

name: openSegment_subset
statement:
theorem openSegment_subset (x y : ∀ i, M i) :
    openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ s.pi fun i => openSegment 𝕜 (x i) (y i)
proof:
:= by
  rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hz⟩ i -
  exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congr_fun hz i⟩

name: image_update_segment
statement:
theorem image_update_segment (i : ι) (x₁ x₂ : M i) (y : ∀ i, M i) :
    update y i '' [x₁ -[𝕜] x₂] = [update y i x₁ -[𝕜] update y i x₂]
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image₂, segment_eq_image₂, image_image]
  refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
  simp only [← update_smul, ← update_add, Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]

name: image_update_openSegment
statement:
theorem image_update_openSegment (i : ι) (x₁ x₂ : M i) (y : ∀ i, M i) :
    update y i '' openSegment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ = openSegment 𝕜 (update y i x₁) (update y i x₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [openSegment_eq_image₂, openSegment_eq_image₂, image_image]
  refine EqOn.image_eq fun a ha ↦ ?_
  simp only [← update_smul, ← update_add, Convex.combo_self ha.2.2]

name: closedBall_eq_segment
statement: lemma closedBall_eq_segment (hε : 0 ≤ ε) : closedBall r ε = segment ℝ (r - ε) (r + ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedBall_eq_Icc, segment_eq_Icc ((sub_le_self _ hε).trans <| le_add_of_nonneg_right hε)]

name: ball_eq_openSegment
statement: lemma ball_eq_openSegment (hε : 0 < ε) : ball r ε = openSegment ℝ (r - ε) (r + ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ball_eq_Ioo, openSegment_eq_Ioo ((sub_lt_self _ hε).trans <| lt_add_of_pos_right _ hε)]

name: convex_iff_isPreconnected
statement: theorem convex_iff_isPreconnected : Convex ℝ s ↔ IsPreconnected s

name: segment_subset_closure_openSegment
statement: theorem segment_subset_closure_openSegment : [x -[𝕜] y] ⊆ closure (openSegment 𝕜 x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image, openSegment_eq_image, ← closure_Ioo (zero_ne_one' 𝕜)]
  exact image_closure_subset_closure_image (by fun_prop)

name: closure_openSegment
statement:
@[simp]
theorem closure_openSegment (x y : E) : closure (openSegment 𝕜 x y) = [x -[𝕜] y]
proof:
:= by
  rw [segment_eq_image, openSegment_eq_image, ← closure_Ioo (zero_ne_one' 𝕜)]
  exact (image_closure_of_isCompact (isBounded_Ioo _ _).isCompact_closure <|
    Continuous.continuousOn <| by fun_prop).symm

name: Convex.combo_interior_closure_subset_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.combo_interior_closure_subset_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {a b : 𝕜}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) : a • interior s + b • closure s ⊆ interior s
proof:
:=
  interior_smul₀ ha.ne' s ▸
    calc
      interior (a • s) + b • closure s ⊆ interior (a • s) + closure (b • s) :=
        add_subset_add Subset.rfl (smul_closure_subset b s)
      _ = interior (a • s) + b • s := by rw [isOpen_interior.add_closure (b • s)]
      _ ⊆ interior (a • s + b • s) := subset_interior_add_left
      _ ⊆ interior s := interior_mono <| hs.set_combo_subset ha.le hb hab

name: Convex.combo_interior_self_subset_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.combo_interior_self_subset_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {a b : 𝕜}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) : a • interior s + b • s ⊆ interior s
proof:
:=
  calc
    a • interior s + b • s ⊆ a • interior s + b • closure s :=
      add_subset_add Subset.rfl <| image_mono subset_closure
    _ ⊆ interior s := hs.combo_interior_closure_subset_interior ha hb hab

name: Convex.combo_closure_interior_subset_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.combo_closure_interior_subset_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {a b : 𝕜}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1) : a • closure s + b • interior s ⊆ interior s
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  exact hs.combo_interior_closure_subset_interior hb ha (add_comm a b ▸ hab)

name: Convex.combo_self_interior_subset_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.combo_self_interior_subset_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {a b : 𝕜}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1) : a • s + b • interior s ⊆ interior s
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  exact hs.combo_interior_self_subset_interior hb ha (add_comm a b ▸ hab)

name: Convex.combo_interior_closure_mem_interior
proof:
:=
  hs.combo_interior_closure_subset_interior ha hb hab <|
    add_mem_add (smul_mem_smul_set hx) (smul_mem_smul_set hy)

name: Convex.combo_interior_self_mem_interior
proof:
:=
  hs.combo_interior_closure_mem_interior hx (subset_closure hy) ha hb hab

name: Convex.combo_closure_interior_mem_interior
proof:
:=
  hs.combo_closure_interior_subset_interior ha hb hab <|
    add_mem_add (smul_mem_smul_set hx) (smul_mem_smul_set hy)

name: Convex.combo_self_interior_mem_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.combo_self_interior_mem_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (hy : y ∈ interior s) {a b : 𝕜} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a • x + b • y ∈ interior s
proof:
:=
  hs.combo_closure_interior_mem_interior (subset_closure hx) hy ha hb hab

name: Convex.openSegment_interior_closure_subset_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.openSegment_interior_closure_subset_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {x y : E}
    (hx : x ∈ interior s) (hy : y ∈ closure s) : openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ interior s
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
  exact hs.combo_interior_closure_mem_interior hx hy ha hb.le hab

name: Convex.openSegment_interior_self_subset_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.openSegment_interior_self_subset_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {x y : E}
    (hx : x ∈ interior s) (hy : y ∈ s) : openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ interior s

name: Convex.openSegment_closure_interior_subset_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.openSegment_closure_interior_subset_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {x y : E}
    (hx : x ∈ closure s) (hy : y ∈ interior s) : openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ interior s
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
  exact hs.combo_closure_interior_mem_interior hx hy ha.le hb hab

name: Convex.openSegment_self_interior_subset_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.openSegment_self_interior_subset_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {x y : E}
    (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ interior s) : openSegment 𝕜 x y ⊆ interior s

name: Convex.add_smul_sub_mem_interior'
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_smul, smul_sub, one_smul, add_sub, add_comm] using
    hs.combo_interior_closure_mem_interior hy hx ht.1 (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2)
      (add_sub_cancel _ _)

name: Convex.add_smul_sub_mem_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.add_smul_sub_mem_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (hy : y ∈ interior s) {t : 𝕜} (ht : t ∈ Ioc (0 : 𝕜) 1) : x + t • (y - x) ∈ interior s

name: Convex.add_smul_mem_interior'
statement:
theorem Convex.add_smul_mem_interior' {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ closure s)
    (hy : x + y ∈ interior s) {t : 𝕜} (ht : t ∈ Ioc (0 : 𝕜) 1) : x + t • y ∈ interior s
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hs.add_smul_sub_mem_interior' hx hy ht

name: Convex.add_smul_mem_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.add_smul_mem_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (hy : x + y ∈ interior s) {t : 𝕜} (ht : t ∈ Ioc (0 : 𝕜) 1) : x + t • y ∈ interior s

name: Convex.interior
statement:
protected theorem Convex.interior [ZeroLEOneClass 𝕜] {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) :
    Convex 𝕜 (interior s)
proof:
:=
  convex_iff_openSegment_subset.mpr fun _ hx _ hy =>
    hs.openSegment_closure_interior_subset_interior (interior_subset_closure hx) hy

name: Convex.closure
statement: protected theorem Convex.closure {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) : Convex 𝕜 (closure s)
proof:
:=
  fun x hx y hy a b ha hb hab =>
  let f : E → E → E := fun x' y' => a • x' + b • y'
  have hf : Continuous (Function.uncurry f) :=
    (continuous_fst.const_smul _).add (continuous_snd.const_smul _)
  show f x y ∈ closure s from map_mem_closure₂ hf hx hy fun _ hx' _ hy' => hs hx' hy' ha hb hab

name: convexHull_interior_subset
statement:
lemma convexHull_interior_subset [ZeroLEOneClass 𝕜] (s : Set E) :
    convexHull 𝕜 (interior s) ⊆ interior (convexHull 𝕜 s)
proof:
:=
  convexHull_min (interior_mono <| subset_convexHull 𝕜 s) (convex_convexHull 𝕜 s).interior

name: IsOpen.convexHull
statement:
protected theorem IsOpen.convexHull [ZeroLEOneClass 𝕜] {s : Set E} (hs : IsOpen s) :
    IsOpen (convexHull 𝕜 s)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← subset_interior_iff_isOpen, hs.interior_eq] using convexHull_interior_subset s

name: Convex.strictConvex'
statement:
protected theorem Convex.strictConvex' {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s)
    (h : (s \ interior s).Pairwise fun x y => ∃ c : 𝕜, lineMap x y c ∈ interior s) :
    StrictConvex 𝕜 s
proof:
:= by
  refine strictConvex_iff_openSegment_subset.2 ?_
  intro x hx y hy hne
  by_cases hx' : x ∈ interior s
  · exact hs.openSegment_interior_self_subset_interior hx' hy
  by_cases hy' : y ∈ interior s
  · exact hs.openSegment_self_interior_subset_interior hx hy'
  rcases h ⟨hx, hx'⟩ ⟨hy, hy'⟩ hne with ⟨c, hc⟩
  refine (openSegment_subset_union x y ⟨c, rfl⟩).trans
    (insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hc, union_subset ?_ ?_⟩)
  exacts [hs.openSegment_self_interior_subset_interior hx hc,
    hs.openSegment_interior_self_subset_interior hc hy]

name: Convex.strictConvex
statement:
protected theorem Convex.strictConvex {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s)
    (h : (s \ interior s).Pairwise fun x y => ([x -[𝕜] y] \ frontier s).Nonempty) :
    StrictConvex 𝕜 s
proof:
:= by
  refine hs.strictConvex' <| h.imp_on fun x hx y hy _ => ?_
  simp only [segment_eq_image_lineMap, ← self_sdiff_frontier]
  rintro ⟨_, ⟨⟨c, hc, rfl⟩, hcs⟩⟩
  refine ⟨c, hs.segment_subset hx.1 hy.1 ?_, hcs⟩
  exact lineMap_mem_segment 𝕜 x y hc

name: Convex.closure_interior_eq_closure_of_nonempty_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.closure_interior_eq_closure_of_nonempty_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s)
    (hs' : (interior s).Nonempty) : closure (interior s) = closure s
proof:
:=
  subset_antisymm (closure_mono interior_subset)
    fun _ h ↦ closure_mono (hs.openSegment_interior_closure_subset_interior hs'.choose_spec h)
      (segment_subset_closure_openSegment (right_mem_segment ..))

name: Convex.interior_closure_eq_interior_of_nonempty_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.interior_closure_eq_interior_of_nonempty_interior {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s)
    (hs' : (interior s).Nonempty) : interior (closure s) = interior s
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ (interior_mono subset_closure)
  intro y hy
  rcases hs' with ⟨x, hx⟩
  have h := AffineMap.lineMap_apply_one (k := 𝕜) x y
  obtain ⟨t, ht1, ht⟩ := AffineMap.lineMap_continuous.tendsto' _ _ h |>.eventually_mem
    (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.1 hy) |>.exists_gt
  apply hs.openSegment_interior_closure_subset_interior hx ht
  nth_rw 1 [← AffineMap.lineMap_apply_zero (k := 𝕜) x y, ← image_openSegment]
  exact ⟨1, Ioo_subset_openSegment ⟨zero_lt_one, ht1⟩, h⟩

name: convex_closed_sInter
statement:
theorem convex_closed_sInter {S : Set (Set E)} (h : ∀ s ∈ S, Convex 𝕜 s ∧ IsClosed s) :
    Convex 𝕜 (⋂₀ S) ∧ IsClosed (⋂₀ S)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ hx => starConvex_sInter fun _ hs => (h _ hs).1 <| hx _ hs,
    isClosed_sInter fun _ hs => (h _ hs).2⟩

statement:
theorem convexHull_subset_closedConvexHull {s : Set E} :

name: closedConvexHull_closure_eq_closedConvexHull
statement:
@[simp]
theorem closedConvexHull_closure_eq_closedConvexHull {s : Set E} :
    closedConvexHull 𝕜 (closure s) = closedConvexHull 𝕜 s
proof:
:=
  subset_antisymm (by
    simpa using ((closedConvexHull 𝕜).monotone (closure_subset_closedConvexHull (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E))))
    ((closedConvexHull 𝕜).monotone subset_closure)

name: closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull
statement:
theorem closedConvexHull_eq_closure_convexHull {s : Set E} :
    closedConvexHull 𝕜 s = closure (convexHull 𝕜 s)
proof:
:= subset_antisymm
  (closedConvexHull_min (subset_trans (subset_convexHull 𝕜 s) subset_closure)
    (Convex.closure (convex_convexHull 𝕜 s)) isClosed_closure)
  (closure_minimal convexHull_subset_closedConvexHull isClosed_closedConvexHull)

name: Convex.closure_subset_image_homothety_interior_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem Convex.closure_subset_image_homothety_interior_of_one_lt {s : Set E} (hs : Convex ℝ s)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ interior s) (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 < t) :
    closure s ⊆ homothety x t '' interior s
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hne : t ≠ 0 := (one_pos.trans ht).ne'
  refine
    ⟨homothety x t⁻¹ y, hs.openSegment_interior_closure_subset_interior hx hy ?_,
      (AffineEquiv.homothetyUnitsMulHom x (Units.mk0 t hne)).apply_symm_apply y⟩
  rw [openSegment_eq_image_lineMap, ← inv_one, ← inv_Ioi₀ (zero_lt_one' ℝ), ← image_inv_eq_inv,
    image_image, homothety_eq_lineMap]
  exact mem_image_of_mem _ ht

name: Convex.closure_subset_interior_image_homothety_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem Convex.closure_subset_interior_image_homothety_of_one_lt {s : Set E} (hs : Convex ℝ s)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ interior s) (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 < t) :
    closure s ⊆ interior (homothety x t '' s)
proof:
:=
  (hs.closure_subset_image_homothety_interior_of_one_lt hx t ht).trans <|
    (homothety_isOpenMap x t (one_pos.trans ht).ne').image_interior_subset _

name: Convex.subset_interior_image_homothety_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem Convex.subset_interior_image_homothety_of_one_lt {s : Set E} (hs : Convex ℝ s) {x : E}

name: Convex.nontrivial_iff_nonempty_interior
statement:
theorem Convex.nontrivial_iff_nonempty_interior {s : Set 𝕜} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) :
    s.Nontrivial ↔ (interior s).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, y, hy, h⟩
    have hs' := Nonempty.mono <| interior_mono <| hs.segment_subset hx hy
    rw [segment_eq_Icc', interior_Icc, nonempty_Ioo, inf_lt_sup] at hs'
    exact hs' h
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    rcases eq_singleton_or_nontrivial (interior_subset hx) with rfl | h
    · rw [interior_singleton] at hx
      exact hx.elim
    · exact h

name: Convex.Ioo_subset_of_mem_closure
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial s with
  | inl hs_sub =>
    simp only [subsingleton_coe] at hs_sub
    simp [hs_sub.closure has hbs]
  | inr h' =>
    simp only [nontrivial_coe_sort] at h'
    calc Ioo a b
    _ = interior (Ioo a b) := interior_Ioo.symm
    _ ⊆ interior (openSegment 𝕜 a b) := interior_mono <| Ioo_subset_openSegment
    _ ⊆ interior (closure s) := interior_mono <| hs.closure.openSegment_subset has hbs
    _ = interior s := hs.interior_closure_eq_interior_of_nonempty_interior <|
      hs.nontrivial_iff_nonempty_interior.1 h'
    _ ⊆ s := interior_subset

name: Convex.nhdsWithin_inter_Iio_eq_nhdsLT
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hbs, hba⟩ := h'
  refine nhdsWithin_inter_of_mem (mem_nhdsLT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.2 ⟨b, hba, ?_⟩)
  exact hs.Ioo_subset_of_mem_closure (subset_closure hbs) has

name: Convex.nhdsWithin_inter_Ioi_eq_nhdsGT
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hbs, hba⟩ := h'
  refine nhdsWithin_inter_of_mem (mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.2 ⟨b, hba, ?_⟩)
  exact hs.Ioo_subset_of_mem_closure has (subset_closure hbs)

name: Convex.nhdsWithin_sdiff_eq_nhdsNE
proof:
:= by
  rw [sdiff_eq, ← Iio_union_Ioi, inter_union_distrib_left, nhdsWithin_union, nhdsWithin_union]
  simp [hs.nhdsWithin_inter_Ioi_eq_nhdsGT has h_Ioi, hs.nhdsWithin_inter_Iio_eq_nhdsLT has h_Iio]

name: Convex.nhdsWithin_sdiff_eq_nhdsLT
proof:
:= by
  rw [sdiff_eq, ← Iio_union_Ioi, inter_union_distrib_left, nhdsWithin_union]
  simp [h_Ioi, hs.nhdsWithin_inter_Iio_eq_nhdsLT has h_Iio]

name: Convex.nhdsWithin_sdiff_eq_nhdsGT
proof:
:= by
  rw [sdiff_eq, ← Iio_union_Ioi, inter_union_distrib_left, nhdsWithin_union]
  simp [h_Iio, hs.nhdsWithin_inter_Ioi_eq_nhdsGT has h_Ioi]

name: sdiff_singleton_eventually_mem_nhds_left
statement:
private lemma sdiff_singleton_eventually_mem_nhds_left {s : Set 𝕜} {a : 𝕜}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ closure s, Ioo x a ⊆ s) : ∀ᶠ (x : 𝕜) in 𝓝[s ∩ Iio a] a, s \ {a} ∈ 𝓝 x
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty (s ∩ Iio a) with hs' | ⟨b, hbs, hba⟩
  · simp [hs']
  have : Ioo b a ⊆ s := h b (subset_closure hbs)
  apply eventually_of_mem (U := Ioo b a) ?_ fun x hx ↦ ?_
  · exact mem_nhdsWithin.2 ⟨Ioi b, isOpen_Ioi, hba, fun _ ⟨h₁, _, h₂⟩ ↦ ⟨h₁, h₂⟩⟩
  · exact mem_nhds_iff.2 ⟨Ioo b a, subset_sdiff_singleton this right_notMem_Ioo, isOpen_Ioo, hx⟩

name: Convex.sdiff_singleton_eventually_mem_nhds
statement:
theorem Convex.sdiff_singleton_eventually_mem_nhds {s : Set 𝕜} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) (a : 𝕜) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[s \ {a}] a, s \ {a} ∈ 𝓝 x
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_neBot (𝓝[s \ {a}] a) with h | has
  · rw [h]
    exact eventually_bot
  replace has := closure_mono sdiff_subset (mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot.2 has)
  conv in 𝓝[s \ {a}] a => rw [sdiff_eq, ← Iio_union_Ioi, inter_union_distrib_left]
  rw [nhdsWithin_union, eventually_sup]
  exact ⟨sdiff_singleton_eventually_mem_nhds_left fun x hx ↦ hs.Ioo_subset_of_mem_closure hx has,
    sdiff_singleton_eventually_mem_nhds_left (𝕜 := 𝕜ᵒᵈ) fun x hx z hz ↦
      hs.Ioo_subset_of_mem_closure has hx hz.symm⟩

name: isCompact_closedInterior
statement: theorem isCompact_closedInterior {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex 𝕜 P n) : IsCompact s.closedInterior
proof:
:= by
  suffices IsCompact ((AffineEquiv.vaddConst 𝕜 (s.points 0)).symm.toAffineMap ''
      s.closedInterior) by
    apply (Homeomorph.vaddConst (s.points 0)).symm.isCompact_image.mp
    simpa
  rw [← s.closedInterior_map (AffineEquiv.injective _), ← convexHull_eq_closedInterior]
  exact (Set.finite_range _).isCompact_convexHull 𝕜

theorem isClosed_closedInterior [T2Space P] {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex 𝕜 P n) :
    IsClosed s.closedInterior

name: UniformConvexOn.strictConvexOn
statement:
lemma UniformConvexOn.strictConvexOn (hf : UniformConvexOn s φ f) (hφ : ∀ r, r ≠ 0 → 0 < φ r) :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ s f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hf.1, fun x hx y hy hxy a b ha hb hab ↦ (hf.2 hx hy ha.le hb.le hab).trans_lt <|
    sub_lt_self _ ?_⟩
  rw [← sub_ne_zero, ← norm_pos_iff] at hxy
  positivity [hφ _ hxy.ne']

:= by

:= by

  simpa [mul_add, add_add_add_comm, sub_add_sub_comm]

name: aux_sub
statement:
private lemma aux_sub (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a * (f x - m / (2 : ℝ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) + b * (f y - m / (2 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) +
      m / (2 : ℝ) * ‖a • x + b • y‖ ^ 2
      = a * f x + b * f y - m / (2 : ℝ) * a * b * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_add_sq_real, norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, real_inner_smul_left,
    inner_smul_right, norm_of_nonneg ha, norm_of_nonneg hb, mul_pow, mul_pow]
  obtain rfl := eq_sub_of_add_eq hab
  ring_nf

name: aux_add
statement:
private lemma aux_add (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    a * (f x + m / (2 : ℝ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) + b * (f y + m / (2 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) -
      m / (2 : ℝ) * ‖a • x + b • y‖ ^ 2
      = a * f x + b * f y + m / (2 : ℝ) * a * b * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [neg_div] using! aux_sub (E := E) (m := -m) ha hb hab

name: strongConvexOn_iff_convex
statement:
lemma strongConvexOn_iff_convex :
    StrongConvexOn s m f ↔ ConvexOn ℝ s fun x ↦ f x - m / (2 : ℝ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine and_congr_right fun _ ↦ forall₄_congr fun x _ y _ ↦ forall₅_congr fun a b ha hb hab ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [sub_le_iff_le_add, smul_eq_mul, aux_sub ha hb hab, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]

name: strongConcaveOn_iff_convex
statement:
lemma strongConcaveOn_iff_convex :
    StrongConcaveOn s m f ↔ ConcaveOn ℝ s fun x ↦ f x + m / (2 : ℝ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine and_congr_right fun _ ↦ forall₄_congr fun x _ y _ ↦ forall₅_congr fun a b ha hb hab ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [← sub_le_iff_le_add, smul_eq_mul, aux_add ha hb hab, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]

name: Subsingleton.convexIndependent
statement: theorem Subsingleton.convexIndependent [Subsingleton ι] (p : ι → E) : ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p
proof:
:= by
  intro s x hx
  have : (convexHull 𝕜 (p '' s)).Nonempty := ⟨p x, hx⟩
  rw [convexHull_nonempty_iff, Set.image_nonempty] at this
  rwa [Subsingleton.mem_iff_nonempty]

name: ConvexIndependent.injective
statement:
protected theorem ConvexIndependent.injective {p : ι → E} (hc : ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p) :
    Function.Injective p
proof:
:= by
  refine fun i j hij => hc {j} i ?_
  rw [hij, Set.image_singleton, convexHull_singleton]
  exact Set.mem_singleton _

name: ConvexIndependent.comp_embedding
statement:
theorem ConvexIndependent.comp_embedding {ι' : Type*} (f : ι' ↪ ι) {p : ι → E}
    (hc : ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p) : ConvexIndependent 𝕜 (p ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  intro s x hx
  rw [← f.injective.mem_set_image]
  exact hc _ _ (by rwa [Set.image_image])

statement:
protected theorem ConvexIndependent.subtype {p : ι → E} (hc : ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p) (s : Set ι) :

name: ConvexIndependent.range
statement:
protected theorem ConvexIndependent.range {p : ι → E} (hc : ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p) :
    ConvexIndependent 𝕜 ((↑) : Set.range p → E)
proof:
:= by
  let f : Set.range p → ι := fun x => x.property.choose
  have hf : ∀ x, p (f x) = x := fun x => x.property.choose_spec
  let fe : Set.range p ↪ ι := ⟨f, fun x₁ x₂ he => Subtype.ext (hf x₁ ▸ hf x₂ ▸ he ▸ rfl)⟩
  convert! hc.comp_embedding fe
  ext
  rw [Embedding.coeFn_mk, comp_apply, hf]

name: ConvexIndependent.mono
statement:
protected theorem ConvexIndependent.mono {s t : Set E} (hc : ConvexIndependent 𝕜 ((↑) : t → E))
    (hs : s ⊆ t) : ConvexIndependent 𝕜 ((↑) : s → E)

name: Function.Injective.convexIndependent_iff_set
statement:
theorem Function.Injective.convexIndependent_iff_set {p : ι → E} (hi : Function.Injective p) :
    ConvexIndependent 𝕜 ((↑) : Set.range p → E) ↔ ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hc =>
    hc.comp_embedding
      (⟨fun i => ⟨p i, Set.mem_range_self _⟩, fun _ _ h => hi (Subtype.mk_eq_mk.1 h)⟩ :
        ι ↪ Set.range p),
    ConvexIndependent.range⟩

name: ConvexIndependent.mem_convexHull_iff
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem ConvexIndependent.mem_convexHull_iff {p : ι → E} (hc : ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p)
    (s : Set ι) (i : ι) : p i ∈ convexHull 𝕜 (p '' s) ↔ i ∈ s
proof:
:=
  ⟨hc _ _, fun hi => subset_convexHull 𝕜 _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem p hi)⟩

name: convexIndependent_iff_notMem_convexHull_sdiff
statement:
theorem convexIndependent_iff_notMem_convexHull_sdiff {p : ι → E} :
    ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p ↔ ∀ i s, p i ∉ convexHull 𝕜 (p '' (s \ {i}))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hc i s h => ?_, fun h s i hi => ?_⟩
  · rw [hc.mem_convexHull_iff] at h
    exact h.2 (Set.mem_singleton _)
  · by_contra H
    refine h i s ?_
    rw [Set.sdiff_singleton_eq_self H]
    exact hi

name: convexIndependent_set_iff_inter_convexHull_subset
statement:
theorem convexIndependent_set_iff_inter_convexHull_subset {s : Set E} :
    ConvexIndependent 𝕜 ((↑) : s → E) ↔ ∀ t, t ⊆ s → s ∩ convexHull 𝕜 t ⊆ t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro hc t h x ⟨hxs, hxt⟩
    refine hc { x | ↑x ∈ t } ⟨x, hxs⟩ ?_
    rw [Subtype.coe_image_of_subset h]
    exact hxt
  · intro hc t x h
    rw [← Subtype.coe_injective.mem_set_image]
    exact hc (t.image ((↑) : s → E)) (Subtype.coe_image_subset s t) ⟨x.prop, h⟩

name: convexIndependent_set_iff_notMem_convexHull_sdiff
statement:
theorem convexIndependent_set_iff_notMem_convexHull_sdiff {s : Set E} :
    ConvexIndependent 𝕜 ((↑) : s → E) ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, x ∉ convexHull 𝕜 (s \ {x})
proof:
:= by
  rw [convexIndependent_set_iff_inter_convexHull_subset]
  constructor
  · rintro hs x hxs hx
    exact (hs _ Set.sdiff_subset ⟨hxs, hx⟩).2 (Set.mem_singleton _)
  · rintro hs t ht x ⟨hxs, hxt⟩
    by_contra h
    exact hs _ hxs (convexHull_mono (Set.subset_sdiff_singleton ht h) hxt)

name: convexIndependent_iff_finset
statement:
theorem convexIndependent_iff_finset {p : ι → E} :
    ConvexIndependent 𝕜 p ↔
      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (x : ι), p x ∈ convexHull 𝕜 (s.image p : Set E) → x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hc s x hx => hc s x ?_, fun h s x hx => ?_⟩
  · rwa [Finset.coe_image] at hx
  have hp : Injective p := by
    rintro a b hab
    rw [← mem_singleton]
    refine h {b} a ?_
    rw [hab, image_singleton, coe_singleton, convexHull_singleton]
    exact Set.mem_singleton _
  rw [convexHull_eq_union_convexHull_finite_subsets] at hx
  simp_rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hx⟩ := hx
  rw [← hp.mem_set_image]
  refine ht ?_
  suffices x ∈ t.preimage p hp.injOn by rwa [mem_preimage, ← mem_coe] at this
  refine h _ x ?_
  rwa [t.image_preimage p hp.injOn, filter_true_of_mem]
  exact fun y hy => s.image_subset_range p (ht <| mem_coe.2 hy)

name: Convex.convexIndependent_extremePoints
statement:
theorem Convex.convexIndependent_extremePoints (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) :
    ConvexIndependent 𝕜 ((↑) : s.extremePoints 𝕜 → E)
proof:
:=
  convexIndependent_set_iff_notMem_convexHull_sdiff.2 fun _ hx h =>
    (extremePoints_convexHull_subset
          (inter_extremePoints_subset_extremePoints_of_subset
            (convexHull_min (Set.sdiff_subset.trans extremePoints_subset) hs) ⟨h, hx⟩)).2
      (Set.mem_singleton _)

name: sbtw_iff_triplewise_and_ne_pair
statement:
lemma sbtw_iff_triplewise_and_ne_pair [IsOrderedRing R] {l : List P} :
    l.Sbtw R ↔ l.Triplewise (Sbtw R) ∧ ∀ a, l ≠ [a, a]
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.Sbtw]
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons head tail ih =>
    rw [wbtw_cons, triplewise_cons]
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_,
            fun ⟨⟨hp, ht⟩, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨hp.imp _root_.Sbtw.wbtw, ht.imp _root_.Sbtw.wbtw⟩, ?_⟩⟩
    · rcases h with ⟨⟨hp, ht⟩, hpne⟩
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · clear ih
        induction tail with
        | nil => simp
        | cons head2 tail ih' =>
          rw [pairwise_cons] at hp hpne hpne ⊢
          refine ⟨fun a ha ↦ ⟨hp.1 a ha, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
          · refine ⟨(hpne.1 head2 ?_).symm, hpne.2.1 a ha⟩
            simp
          · rw [wbtw_cons] at ht
            grind [List.pairwise_iff_forall_sublist]
      · rw [pairwise_cons] at hpne
        exact (ih.1 ⟨ht, hpne.2⟩).1
      · grind
    · have ht' : tail.Wbtw R := ht.imp _root_.Sbtw.wbtw
      simp only [ht', true_and, ht] at ih
      rw [pairwise_cons, ih]
      refine ⟨fun a ha' ↦ ?_, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
      · rintro rfl
        cases tail with
        | nil => simp at ha'
        | cons head2 tail =>
          rw [pairwise_cons] at hp
          rcases mem_cons.1 ha' with rfl | hat
          · cases tail with
            | nil => simp at ha
            | cons head3 tail => simpa using hp.1 head3
          · simpa using hp.1 head hat
      · rintro rfl
        simp at hp

name: sbtw_cons
statement:
lemma sbtw_cons [IsOrderedRing R] {p : P} {l : List P} :
    (p :: l).Sbtw R ↔ l.Pairwise (Sbtw R p) ∧ l.Sbtw R ∧ l ≠ [p]
proof:
:= by
  rw [sbtw_iff_triplewise_and_ne_pair, ← not_exists, triplewise_cons]
  simp only [cons.injEq, exists_eq_left', and_assoc, and_congr_right_iff, ne_eq, and_congr_left_iff]
  intro hp hne
  rw [sbtw_iff_triplewise_and_ne_pair, iff_self_and, ← not_exists]
  rintro hl ⟨a, rfl⟩
  simp at hp

name: exists_map_eq_of_sorted_nonempty_iff_wbtw
statement:
lemma exists_map_eq_of_sorted_nonempty_iff_wbtw {l : List P} (hl : l ≠ []) :
    (∃ l' : List R, l'.SortedLE ∧ l'.map (lineMap (l.head hl) (l.getLast hl)) = l) ↔
      l.Wbtw R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨l', hl's, hl'l⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← hl'l]
    exact Wbtw.map hl's.wbtw _
  · suffices ∃ l' : List R, (∀ a ∈ l', 0 ≤ a) ∧ l'.SortedLE ∧
        l'.map (lineMap (l.head hl) (l.getLast hl)) = l by
      rcases this with ⟨l', -, hl'⟩
      exact ⟨l', hl'⟩
    induction l with
    | nil => simp at hl
    | cons head tail ih =>
      by_cases ht : tail = []
      · refine ⟨[0], ?_⟩
        simp [ht, sortedLE_iff_pairwise]
      · rw [wbtw_cons] at h
        replace ih := ih ht h.2
        rcases ih with ⟨l'', hl''0, hl''s, hl''⟩
        simp only [head_cons, getLast_cons ht]
        cases tail with
        | nil => simp at ht
        | cons head2 tail =>
          by_cases ht2 : tail = []
          · exact ⟨[0, 1], by simp [ht2, sortedLE_iff_pairwise]⟩
          · simp only [head_cons, getLast_cons ht2] at hl'' ⊢
            rw [pairwise_cons] at h
            have hw := h.1.1 _ (getLast_mem ht2)
            rcases hw with ⟨r, ⟨hr0, hr1⟩, rfl⟩
            refine ⟨0 :: l''.map fun x ↦ r + (1 - r) * x, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
            · simp only [mem_cons, mem_map, forall_eq_or_imp, le_refl, forall_exists_index,
                and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂, true_and]
              intro a ha
              have := hl''0 a ha
              nlinarith
            · simp only [sortedLE_iff_pairwise, pairwise_cons, mem_map,
                forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
              refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
              · intro a ha
                have := hl''0 a ha
                nlinarith
              · refine hl''s.pairwise.map _ fun a b hab ↦ ?_
                gcongr
            · simp only [map_cons, lineMap_apply_zero, map_map, ← hl'', cons.injEq,
                map_inj_left, Function.comp_apply, lineMap_lineMap_left, lineMap_eq_lineMap_iff,
                true_and]
              ring_nf
              simp

name: exists_map_eq_of_sorted_iff_wbtw
statement:
lemma exists_map_eq_of_sorted_iff_wbtw {l : List P} :
    (∃ p₁ p₂ : P, ∃ l' : List R, l'.SortedLE ∧ l'.map (lineMap p₁ p₂) = l) ↔ l.Wbtw R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨p₁, p₂, l', hl's, hl'l⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · subst hl'l
    exact Wbtw.map hl's.wbtw _
  · by_cases hl : l = []
    · exact ⟨AddTorsor.nonempty.some, AddTorsor.nonempty.some, [], by
        simp [hl, sortedLE_iff_pairwise]⟩
    · exact ⟨l.head hl, l.getLast hl, (exists_map_eq_of_sorted_nonempty_iff_wbtw hl).2 h⟩

name: exists_map_eq_of_sorted_nonempty_iff_sbtw
statement:
lemma exists_map_eq_of_sorted_nonempty_iff_sbtw {l : List P} (hl : l ≠ []) :
    (∃ l' : List R, l'.SortedLT ∧ l'.map (lineMap (l.head hl) (l.getLast hl)) = l ∧
      (l.length = 1 ∨ l.head hl ≠ l.getLast hl)) ↔ l.Sbtw R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨l', hl's, hl'l, hla⟩ ↦
            ⟨(exists_map_eq_of_sorted_nonempty_iff_wbtw hl).1
            ⟨l', (hl's.pairwise.imp LT.lt.le).sortedLE, hl'l⟩, ?_⟩,
          fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← hl'l]
    rcases hla with hla | hla
    · grind [List.pairwise_iff_forall_sublist]
    · exact (hl's.pairwise.imp LT.lt.ne).map _ fun _ _ ↦ (lineMap_injective _ hla).ne
  · rw [List.Sbtw, ← exists_map_eq_of_sorted_nonempty_iff_wbtw hl] at h
    rcases h with ⟨⟨l', hl's, hl'l⟩, hp⟩
    refine ⟨l', ?_, hl'l, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hl'l] at hp
      have hp' : l'.Pairwise (· ≠ ·) := hp.of_map _ (by simp)
      exact ((pairwise_and_iff.2 ⟨hl's.pairwise, hp'⟩).imp lt_iff_le_and_ne.2).sortedLT
    · cases l with
      | nil => simp at hl
      | cons head tail =>
        simp only [length_cons, add_eq_right, length_eq_zero_iff, head_cons]
        cases tail with
        | nil => simp
        | cons head2 tail =>
          simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_or]
          rw [pairwise_cons] at hp
          refine hp.1 ((head :: head2 :: tail).getLast hl) ?_
          simp

name: exists_map_eq_of_sorted_iff_sbtw
statement:
lemma exists_map_eq_of_sorted_iff_sbtw [Nontrivial P] {l : List P} :
    (∃ p₁ p₂ : P, p₁ ≠ p₂ ∧ ∃ l' : List R, l'.SortedLT ∧ l'.map (lineMap p₁ p₂) = l) ↔
      l.Sbtw R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨p₁, p₂, hp₁p₂, l', hl's, hl'l⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · subst hl'l
    rw [(lineMap_injective _ hp₁p₂).list_sbtw_map_iff]
    exact hl's.sbtw
  · by_cases hl : l = []
    · rcases exists_pair_ne P with ⟨p₁, p₂, hp₁p₂⟩
      exact ⟨p₁, p₂, hp₁p₂, by simp [hl, sortedLT_iff_pairwise]⟩
    · by_cases hlen : l.length = 1
      · rw [length_eq_one_iff] at hlen
        rcases hlen with ⟨p₁, rfl⟩
        rcases exists_ne p₁ with ⟨p₂, hp₂p₁⟩
        exact ⟨p₁, p₂, hp₂p₁.symm, [0], by simp [sortedLT_iff_pairwise]⟩
      · refine ⟨l.head hl, l.getLast hl, ?_⟩
        rw [← exists_map_eq_of_sorted_nonempty_iff_sbtw hl] at h
        simp only [hlen, false_or] at h
        rcases h with ⟨l', hl's, hl'l, hl⟩
        exact ⟨hl, l', hl's, hl'l⟩

name: ConvexOn.smul'
statement:
lemma ConvexOn.smul' (hf : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) (hg : ConvexOn 𝕜 s g) (hf₀ : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → 0 ≤ f x)
    (hg₀ : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → 0 ≤ g x) (hfg : MonovaryOn f g s) : ConvexOn 𝕜 s (f • g)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hf.1, fun x hx y hy a b ha hb hab ↦ ?_⟩
  dsimp
  refine
    (smul_le_smul (hf.2 hx hy ha hb hab) (hg.2 hx hy ha hb hab) (hf₀ <| hf.1 hx hy ha hb hab) <|
      add_nonneg (smul_nonneg ha <| hg₀ hx) <| smul_nonneg hb <| hg₀ hy).trans ?_
  calc
      _ = (a * a) • (f x • g x) + (b * b) • (f y • g y) + (a * b) • (f x • g y + f y • g x) := ?_
    _ ≤ (a * a) • (f x • g x) + (b * b) • (f y • g y) + (a * b) • (f x • g x + f y • g y) := by
        gcongr _ + (a * b) • ?_; exact hfg.smul_add_smul_le_smul_add_smul hx hy
    _ = (a * (a + b)) • (f x • g x) + (b * (a + b)) • (f y • g y) := by
        simp only [mul_add, add_smul, smul_add, mul_comm _ a]; abel
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [hab, mul_one]
  simp only [add_smul, smul_add]
  rw [← smul_smul_smul_comm a, ← smul_smul_smul_comm b, ← smul_smul_smul_comm a b,
    ← smul_smul_smul_comm b b, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm b,
    add_comm _ ((b * b) • f y • g y), add_add_add_comm, add_comm ((a * b) • f y • g x)]

name: ConcaveOn.smul'
statement:
lemma ConcaveOn.smul' [IsOrderedModule 𝕜 E] (hf : ConcaveOn 𝕜 s f) (hg : ConcaveOn 𝕜 s g)
    (hf₀ : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → 0 ≤ f x) (hg₀ : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → 0 ≤ g x) (hfg : AntivaryOn f g s) :
    ConcaveOn 𝕜 s (f • g)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hf.1, fun x hx y hy a b ha hb hab ↦ ?_⟩
  dsimp
  refine (smul_le_smul (hf.2 hx hy ha hb hab) (hg.2 hx hy ha hb hab)
    (add_nonneg (smul_nonneg ha <| hf₀ hx) <| smul_nonneg hb <| hf₀ hy)
    (hg₀ <| hf.1 hx hy ha hb hab)).trans' ?_
  calc a • f x • g x + b • f y • g y
        = (a * (a + b)) • (f x • g x) + (b * (a + b)) • (f y • g y) := by simp_rw [hab, mul_one]
    _ = (a * a) • (f x • g x) + (b * b) • (f y • g y) + (a * b) • (f x • g x + f y • g y) := by
        simp only [mul_add, add_smul, smul_add, mul_comm _ a]; abel
    _ ≤ (a * a) • (f x • g x) + (b * b) • (f y • g y) + (a * b) • (f x • g y + f y • g x) := by
        gcongr _ + (a * b) • ?_; exact hfg.smul_add_smul_le_smul_add_smul hx hy
    _ = _ := ?_
  simp only [add_smul, smul_add]
  rw [← smul_smul_smul_comm a, ← smul_smul_smul_comm b, ← smul_smul_smul_comm a b,
    ← smul_smul_smul_comm b b, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm b a,
    add_comm ((a * b) • f x • g y), add_comm ((a * b) • f x • g y), add_add_add_comm]

name: ConvexOn.smul''
statement:
lemma ConvexOn.smul'' [IsOrderedModule 𝕜 E] (hf : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) (hg : ConvexOn 𝕜 s g)
    (hf₀ : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → f x ≤ 0) (hg₀ : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → g x ≤ 0) (hfg : AntivaryOn f g s) :

    hfg.neg

name: ConvexOn.smul_concaveOn'

lemma ConvexOn.pow (hf : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) (hf₀ : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → 0 ≤ f x) :
    ∀ n, ConvexOn 𝕜 s (f ^ n)
  | 0 => by simpa using! convexOn_const 1 hf.1
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [pow_succ']
    exact hf.mul (hf.pow hf₀ _) hf₀ (fun x hx ↦ pow_nonneg (hf₀ hx) _) <|
      (monovaryOn_self f s).pow_right₀ hf₀ n

/

name: convexOn_pow
statement: lemma convexOn_pow : ∀ n, ConvexOn 𝕜 (Ici 0) fun x : 𝕜 ↦ x ^ n

name: Even.convexOn_pow
statement: protected lemma Even.convexOn_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : Even n) : ConvexOn 𝕜 univ fun x : 𝕜 ↦ x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hn
  simp_rw [← two_mul, pow_mul]
  refine ConvexOn.pow ⟨convex_univ, fun x _ y _ a b ha hb hab ↦ sub_nonneg.1 ?_⟩
    (fun _ _ ↦ by positivity) _
  calc
    (0 : 𝕜) ≤ (a * b) * (x - y) ^ 2 := by positivity
    _ = _ := by obtain rfl := eq_sub_of_add_eq hab; simp only [smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: convexOn_zpow
statement:
lemma convexOn_zpow : ∀ n : ℤ, ConvexOn 𝕜 (Ioi 0) fun x : 𝕜 ↦ x ^ n
  | (n : ℕ) => by
    simp_rw [zpow_natCast]
    exact (convexOn_pow n).subset Ioi_subset_Ici_self (convex_Ioi _)
  | -[n+1] => by
    simp_rw [zpow_negSucc, ← inv_pow]
    refine (convexOn_iff_forall_pos.2 ⟨convex_Ioi _, ?_⟩).pow (fun x (hx : 0 < x) ↦ by positivity) _
    rintro x (hx : 0 < x) y (hy : 0 < y) a b ha hb hab
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    have H : 0 ≤ a * b * (x - y) ^ 2
proof:
:= by positivity
    linear_combination H - x * y * (a + b + 1) * hab

name: convexJoin_assoc_aux
statement:
theorem convexJoin_assoc_aux (s t u : Set E) :
    convexJoin 𝕜 (convexJoin 𝕜 s t) u ⊆ convexJoin 𝕜 s (convexJoin 𝕜 t u)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [subset_def, mem_convexJoin]
  rintro _ ⟨z, ⟨x, hx, y, hy, a₁, b₁, ha₁, hb₁, hab₁, rfl⟩, z, hz, a₂, b₂, ha₂, hb₂, hab₂, rfl⟩
  obtain rfl | hb₂ := hb₂.eq_or_lt
  · refine ⟨x, hx, y, ⟨y, hy, z, hz, left_mem_segment 𝕜 _ _⟩, a₁, b₁, ha₁, hb₁, hab₁, ?_⟩
    linear_combination (norm := module) -hab₂ • (a₁ • x + b₁ • y)
  refine
    ⟨x, hx, (a₂ * b₁ / (a₂ * b₁ + b₂)) • y + (b₂ / (a₂ * b₁ + b₂)) • z,
      ⟨y, hy, z, hz, _, _, by positivity, by positivity, by field, rfl⟩,
      a₂ * a₁, a₂ * b₁ + b₂, by positivity, by positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linear_combination a₂ * hab₁ + hab₂
  · match_scalars <;> field

statement:

    convexJoin 𝕜 (convexJoin 𝕜 s t) u = convexJoin 𝕜 s (convexJoin 𝕜 t u)
proof:
:= by
  refine (convexJoin_assoc_aux _ _ _).antisymm ?_
  simp_rw [convexJoin_comm s, convexJoin_comm _ u]
  exact convexJoin_assoc_aux _ _ _

name: Convex.convexJoin
statement:
protected theorem Convex.convexJoin (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) (ht : Convex 𝕜 t) :
    Convex 𝕜 (convexJoin 𝕜 s t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Convex, StarConvex, convexJoin, mem_iUnion]
  rintro _ ⟨x₁, hx₁, y₁, hy₁, a₁, b₁, ha₁, hb₁, hab₁, rfl⟩
    _ ⟨x₂, hx₂, y₂, hy₂, a₂, b₂, ha₂, hb₂, hab₂, rfl⟩ p q hp hq hpq
  rcases hs.exists_mem_add_smul_eq hx₁ hx₂ (mul_nonneg hp ha₁) (mul_nonneg hq ha₂) with ⟨x, hxs, hx⟩
  rcases ht.exists_mem_add_smul_eq hy₁ hy₂ (mul_nonneg hp hb₁) (mul_nonneg hq hb₂) with ⟨y, hyt, hy⟩
  refine ⟨_, hxs, _, hyt, p * a₁ + q * a₂, p * b₁ + q * b₂, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> try positivity
  · linear_combination p * hab₁ + q * hab₂ + hpq
  · rw [hx, hy]
    module

name: Convex.convexHull_union
statement:
protected theorem Convex.convexHull_union (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) (ht : Convex 𝕜 t) (hs₀ : s.Nonempty)
    (ht₀ : t.Nonempty) : convexHull 𝕜 (s ∪ t) = convexJoin 𝕜 s t
proof:
:=
  (convexHull_min (union_subset (subset_convexJoin_left ht₀) <| subset_convexJoin_right hs₀) <|
        hs.convexJoin ht).antisymm <|
    convexJoin_subset_convexHull _ _

proof:
:= by
  rw [← convexHull_convexHull_union_left, ← convexHull_convexHull_union_right]
  exact (convex_convexHull 𝕜 s).convexHull_union (convex_convexHull 𝕜 t) hs.convexHull ht.convexHull

statement:
theorem convex_iff_add_mem : Convex 𝕜 s ↔
    ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s → ∀ ⦃a b : 𝕜⦄, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → a • x + b • y ∈ s

statement:

    Convex 𝕜 s ↔ ∀ ⦃a b : 𝕜⦄, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → a • s + b • s ⊆ s
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (by
      rintro hA a b ha hb hab w ⟨au, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, bv, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact hA hu hv ha hb hab)
    fun h _ hx _ hy _ _ ha hb hab => (h ha hb hab) (Set.add_mem_add ⟨_, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨_, hy, rfl⟩)

statement:

proof:
:= by
  rintro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  rw [mem_iUnion] at hx hy ⊢
  obtain ⟨i, hx⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨j, hy⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨k, hik, hjk⟩ := hdir i j
  exact ⟨k, hc (hik hx) (hjk hy) ha hb hab⟩

      ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s → ∀ ⦃a b : 𝕜⦄, 0 < a → 0 < b → a + b = 1 → a • x + b • y ∈ s

name: convex_iff_pairwise_pos
statement:

    s.Pairwise fun x y => ∀ ⦃a b : 𝕜⦄, 0 < a → 0 < b → a + b = 1 → a • x + b • y ∈ s

:= by
  refine convex_iff_forall_pos.trans ⟨fun h x hx y hy _ => h hx hy, ?_⟩
  intro h x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  obtain rfl | hxy := eq_or_ne x y
  · rwa [Convex.combo_self hab]
  · exact h hx hy hxy ha hb hab

name: convex_segment
statement: theorem convex_segment [IsOrderedRing 𝕜] (x y : E) : Convex 𝕜 [x -[𝕜] y]
proof:
:= by
  rintro p ⟨ap, bp, hap, hbp, habp, rfl⟩ q ⟨aq, bq, haq, hbq, habq, rfl⟩ a b ha hb hab
  refine
    ⟨a * ap + b * aq, a * bp + b * bq, add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hap) (mul_nonneg hb haq),
      add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hbp) (mul_nonneg hb hbq), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [add_add_add_comm, ← mul_add, ← mul_add, habp, habq, mul_one, mul_one, hab]
  · match_scalars <;> noncomm_ring

name: Convex.linear_image
statement: theorem Convex.linear_image (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) (f : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) : Convex 𝕜 (f '' s)

:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ a b ha hb hab
  exact ⟨a • x + b • y, hs hx hy ha hb hab, by rw [f.map_add, f.map_smul, f.map_smul]⟩

theorem Convex.is_linear_image (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {f : E → F} (hf : IsLinearMap 𝕜 f) :

  fun x hx y hy a b ha hb hab => by
    rw [mem_preimage, f.map_add, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
    exact hs hx hy ha hb hab

theorem Convex.is_linear_preimage {s : Set F} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {f : E → F} (hf : IsLinearMap 𝕜 f) :

theorem Convex.translate_preimage_right (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) (z : E) :

proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  have h := hs hx hy ha hb hab
  rwa [smul_add, smul_add, add_add_add_comm, ← add_smul, hab, one_smul] at h

name: convex_Iic
statement: theorem convex_Iic (r : β) : Convex 𝕜 (Iic r)
proof:
:= fun x hx y hy a b ha hb hab =>
  calc
    a • x + b • y ≤ a • r + b • r :=
      add_le_add (smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hx ha) (smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hy hb)
    _ = r := Convex.combo_self hab _

name: convex_Iio
statement: theorem convex_Iio (r : β) : Convex 𝕜 (Iio r)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  obtain rfl | ha' := ha.eq_or_lt
  · rw [zero_add] at hab
    rwa [zero_smul, zero_add, hab, one_smul]
  rw [mem_Iio] at hx hy
  calc
    a • x + b • y < a • r + b • r := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le
        (smul_lt_smul_of_pos_left hx ha') (smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hy.le hb)
    _ = r := Convex.combo_self hab _

name: Convex.lift
statement: theorem Convex.lift [SMulPosMono R 𝕜] {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) : Convex R s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  suffices (a • (1 : 𝕜)) • x + (b • (1 : 𝕜)) • y ∈ s by simpa using this
  refine hs hx hy ?_ ?_ (by simpa [add_smul] using congr($(hab) • (1 : 𝕜)))
  all_goals exact zero_smul R (1 : 𝕜) ▸ smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right ‹_› zero_le_one

name: MonotoneOn.convex_le
statement:
theorem MonotoneOn.convex_le (hf : MonotoneOn f s) (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) (r : β) :
    Convex 𝕜 ({ x ∈ s | f x ≤ r })
proof:
:= fun x hx y hy _ _ ha hb hab =>
  ⟨hs hx.1 hy.1 ha hb hab,
    (hf (hs hx.1 hy.1 ha hb hab) (max_rec' (· ∈ s) hx.1 hy.1)
      (Convex.combo_le_max x y ha hb hab)).trans
      (max_rec' (f · ≤ r) hx.2 hy.2)⟩

theorem MonotoneOn.convex_lt (hf : MonotoneOn f s) (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) (r : β) :

proof:
:= fun x hx y hy _ _ ha hb hab =>
  ⟨hs hx.1 hy.1 ha hb hab,
    (hf (hs hx.1 hy.1 ha hb hab) (max_rec' (· ∈ s) hx.1 hy.1)
          (Convex.combo_le_max x y ha hb hab)).trans_lt
      (max_rec' (f · < r) hx.2 hy.2)⟩

name: convex_openSegment
statement: theorem convex_openSegment (a b : E) : Convex 𝕜 (openSegment 𝕜 a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [convex_iff_openSegment_subset]
  rintro p ⟨ap, bp, hap, hbp, habp, rfl⟩ q ⟨aq, bq, haq, hbq, habq, rfl⟩ z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨a * ap + b * aq, a * bp + b * bq, by positivity, by positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linear_combination (norm := noncomm_ring) a * habp + b * habq + hab
  · module

name: Convex.add_smul_mem
statement:
theorem Convex.add_smul_mem (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : x + y ∈ s) {t : 𝕜}
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : 𝕜) 1) : x + t • y ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  have h : x + t • y = (1 - t) • x + t • (x + y) := by match_scalars <;> noncomm_ring
  rw [h]
  exact hs hx hy (sub_nonneg_of_le ht.2) ht.1 (sub_add_cancel _ _)

proof:
:= by
  simpa using hs.add_smul_mem zero_mem (by simpa using hx) ht

proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  exact h.lineMap_mem hx hy ht

name: Convex.semilinear_image
statement:
theorem Convex.semilinear_image {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) (hσ : ∀ {s t}, σ s ≤ σ t ↔ s ≤ t)
    (f : E →ₛₗ[σ] F') : Convex 𝕜' (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r : 𝕜, σ r = a := RingHomSurjective.is_surjective ..
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t : 𝕜, σ t = b := RingHomSurjective.is_surjective ..
  refine ⟨r • x + t • y, hs hx hy (by simp_all [(@hσ 0 r).mp]) (by simp_all [(@hσ 0 t).mp])
    ?_, by simp⟩
  apply_fun σ using Function.Injective.of_eq_imp_le (hσ.mp ·.le)
  simpa

name: Convex_subadditive_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [convex_iff_segment_subset]
  rintro x hx y hy z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hs, rfl⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ a • (f x) + b • (f y) := le_trans (hf1 _ _) (add_le_add (hf2 x ha) (hf2 y hb))
    _ ≤ a • B + b • B := by gcongr <;> assumption
    _ ≤ B := by rw [← add_smul, hs, one_smul]

name: Convex.midpoint_mem
proof:
:=
  h.segment_subset hx hy <| midpoint_mem_segment x y

name: convex_iff_div
statement:
theorem convex_iff_div :
    Convex 𝕜 s ↔ ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s →
      ∀ ⦃a b : 𝕜⦄, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → 0 < a + b → (a / (a + b)) • x + (b / (a + b)) • y ∈ s

name: Convex.mem_smul_of_zero_mem
statement:
theorem Convex.mem_smul_of_zero_mem (h : Convex 𝕜 s) {x : E} (zero_mem : (0 : E) ∈ s) (hx : x ∈ s)
    {t : 𝕜} (ht : 1 ≤ t) : x ∈ t • s
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem₀ (zero_lt_one.trans_le ht).ne']
  exact h.smul_mem_of_zero_mem zero_mem hx
    ⟨inv_nonneg.2 (zero_le_one.trans ht), inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ ht⟩

name: Convex.exists_mem_add_smul_eq
statement:
theorem Convex.exists_mem_add_smul_eq (h : Convex 𝕜 s) {x y : E} {p q : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) : ∃ z ∈ s, (p + q) • z = p • x + q • y
proof:
:= by
  rcases _root_.em (p = 0 ∧ q = 0) with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | hpq)
  · use x, hx
    simp
  · replace hpq : 0 < p + q :=
      (add_nonneg hp hq).lt_of_ne' (mt (add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hp hq).1 hpq)
    refine ⟨_, convex_iff_div.1 h hx hy hp hq hpq, ?_⟩
    match_scalars <;> field

name: Convex.add_smul
statement:
protected theorem Convex.add_smul (h_conv : Convex 𝕜 s) {p q : 𝕜} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    (p + q) • s = p • s + q • s
proof:
:= (add_smul_subset _ _ _).antisymm <| by
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨v₁, h₁, rfl⟩, _, ⟨v₂, h₂, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact h_conv.exists_mem_add_smul_eq h₁ h₂ hp hq

name: Convex.add_half_self_eq_self
statement: theorem Convex.add_half_self_eq_self (h_conv : Convex 𝕜 s) : (2 : 𝕜)⁻¹ • s + (2 : 𝕜)⁻¹ • s = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h_conv.add_smul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  ring_nf
  rw [one_smul]

name: Set.OrdConnected.convex_of_chain
proof:
:= by
  refine convex_iff_segment_subset.mpr fun x hx y hy => ?_
  obtain hxy | hyx := h.total hx hy
  · exact (segment_subset_Icc hxy).trans (hs.out hx hy)
  · rw [segment_symm]
    exact (segment_subset_Icc hyx).trans (hs.out hy hx)

statement: protected theorem convex (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) : Convex 𝕜 (↑K : Set E)

  repeat' intro
  refine add_mem (smul_mem _ _ ?_) (smul_mem _ _ ?_) <;> assumption

name: Convex.semilinear_range
convex_of_nonneg_surjective_algebraMap
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Convex, StarConvex] at hs ⊢
  intro u hu v hv a b ha hb hab
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := halg ha
  obtain ⟨d, hd1, hd2⟩ := halg hb
  convert hs hu hv hc1 hd1 _
  · rw [← hc2, algebraMap_smul]
  · rw [← hd2, algebraMap_smul]
  rw [← hc2, ← hd2, ← algebraMap.coe_add] at hab
  exact (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_eq_one_iff R A).mp hab

name: ConvexOn.slope_mono_adjacent
statement:
theorem ConvexOn.slope_mono_adjacent (hf : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {x y z : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s) (hz : z ∈ s)
    (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z) : (f y - f x) / (y - x) ≤ (f z - f y) / (z - y)
proof:
:= by
  have hxz := hxy.trans hyz
  rw [← sub_pos] at hxy hxz hyz
  have ha : 0 ≤ (z - y) / (z - x) := by positivity
  have hb : 0 ≤ (y - x) / (z - x) := by positivity
  have key := hf.2 hx hz ha hb (by field)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at key
  ring_nf at key
  field_simp at key ⊢
  linarith

name: ConcaveOn.slope_anti_adjacent
statement:
theorem ConcaveOn.slope_anti_adjacent (hf : ConcaveOn 𝕜 s f) {x y z : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s) (hz : z ∈ s)
    (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z) : (f z - f y) / (z - y) ≤ (f y - f x) / (y - x)
proof:
:= by
  have := ConvexOn.slope_mono_adjacent hf.neg hx hz hxy hyz
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply] at this
  linear_combination this

name: StrictConvexOn.slope_strict_mono_adjacent
proof:
:= by
  have hxz := hxy.trans hyz
  have hxz' := hxz.ne
  rw [← sub_pos] at hxy hxz hyz
  have ha : 0 < (z - y) / (z - x) := by positivity
  have hb : 0 < (y - x) / (z - x) := by positivity
  have key := hf.2 hx hz hxz' ha hb (by field)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at key
  ring_nf at key
  field_simp at key ⊢
  linarith

name: StrictConcaveOn.slope_anti_adjacent
statement:
theorem StrictConcaveOn.slope_anti_adjacent (hf : StrictConcaveOn 𝕜 s f) {x y z : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (hz : z ∈ s) (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z) : (f z - f y) / (z - y) < (f y - f x) / (y - x)
proof:
:= by
  have := StrictConvexOn.slope_strict_mono_adjacent hf.neg hx hz hxy hyz
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply] at this
  linear_combination this

name: convexOn_of_slope_mono_adjacent
statement:
theorem convexOn_of_slope_mono_adjacent (hs : Convex 𝕜 s)
    (hf :
      ∀ {x y z : 𝕜},
        x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f y - f x) / (y - x) ≤ (f z - f y) / (z - y)) :
    ConvexOn 𝕜 s f
proof:
:=
  LinearOrder.convexOn_of_lt hs fun x hx z hz hxz a b ha hb hab => by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    have hxy : x < a * x + b * z := by linear_combination b * hxz - x * hab
    have hyz : a * x + b * z < z := by linear_combination a * hxz + z * hab
    have key := hf hx hz hxy hyz
    field_simp [sub_pos.2 hxy, sub_pos.2 hyz] at key
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (sub_pos.2 hxz)
    linear_combination key + (- f x * z + x * f z) * hab

name: concaveOn_of_slope_anti_adjacent
statement:
theorem concaveOn_of_slope_anti_adjacent (hs : Convex 𝕜 s)
    (hf :
      ∀ {x y z : 𝕜},
        x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f z - f y) / (z - y) ≤ (f y - f x) / (y - x)) :
    ConcaveOn 𝕜 s f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_convexOn_iff]
  refine convexOn_of_slope_mono_adjacent hs fun hx hz hxy hyz => ?_
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply]
  linear_combination hf hx hz hxy hyz

name: strictConvexOn_of_slope_strict_mono_adjacent
statement:
theorem strictConvexOn_of_slope_strict_mono_adjacent (hs : Convex 𝕜 s)
    (hf :
      ∀ {x y z : 𝕜},
        x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f y - f x) / (y - x) < (f z - f y) / (z - y)) :
    StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f
proof:
:=
  LinearOrder.strictConvexOn_of_lt hs fun x hx z hz hxz a b ha hb hab => by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    have hxy : x < a * x + b * z := by linear_combination b * hxz - x * hab
    have hyz : a * x + b * z < z := by linear_combination a * hxz + z * hab
    have key := hf hx hz hxy hyz
    field_simp [sub_pos.2 hxy, sub_pos.2 hyz] at key
    apply lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left ?_ (sub_pos.2 hxz).le
    linear_combination key + (- f x * z + x * f z) * hab

name: strictConcaveOn_of_slope_strict_anti_adjacent
statement:
theorem strictConcaveOn_of_slope_strict_anti_adjacent (hs : Convex 𝕜 s)
    (hf :
      ∀ {x y z : 𝕜},
        x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f z - f y) / (z - y) < (f y - f x) / (y - x)) :
    StrictConcaveOn 𝕜 s f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_strictConvexOn_iff]
  refine strictConvexOn_of_slope_strict_mono_adjacent hs fun hx hz hxy hyz => ?_
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply]
  linear_combination hf hx hz hxy hyz

name: convexOn_iff_slope_mono_adjacent
statement:
theorem convexOn_iff_slope_mono_adjacent :
    ConvexOn 𝕜 s f ↔
      Convex 𝕜 s ∧ ∀ ⦃x y z : 𝕜⦄,
          x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f y - f x) / (y - x) ≤ (f z - f y) / (z - y)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, fun _ _ _ => h.slope_mono_adjacent⟩, fun h =>
    convexOn_of_slope_mono_adjacent h.1 (@fun _ _ _ hx hy => h.2 hx hy)⟩

name: concaveOn_iff_slope_anti_adjacent
statement:
theorem concaveOn_iff_slope_anti_adjacent :
    ConcaveOn 𝕜 s f ↔
      Convex 𝕜 s ∧
        ∀ ⦃x y z : 𝕜⦄,
          x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f z - f y) / (z - y) ≤ (f y - f x) / (y - x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, fun _ _ _ => h.slope_anti_adjacent⟩, fun h =>
    concaveOn_of_slope_anti_adjacent h.1 (@fun _ _ _ hx hy => h.2 hx hy)⟩

name: strictConvexOn_iff_slope_strict_mono_adjacent
statement:
theorem strictConvexOn_iff_slope_strict_mono_adjacent :
    StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f ↔

        ∀ ⦃x y z : 𝕜⦄,

  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, fun _ _ _ => h.slope_strict_mono_adjacent⟩, fun h =>
    strictConvexOn_of_slope_strict_mono_adjacent h.1 (@fun _ _ _ hx hy => h.2 hx hy)⟩

name: strictConcaveOn_iff_slope_strict_anti_adjacent
statement:
theorem strictConcaveOn_iff_slope_strict_anti_adjacent :
    StrictConcaveOn 𝕜 s f ↔
      Convex 𝕜 s ∧
        ∀ ⦃x y z : 𝕜⦄,
          x ∈ s → z ∈ s → x < y → y < z → (f z - f y) / (z - y) < (f y - f x) / (y - x)

name: ConvexOn.secant_mono_aux1
statement:
theorem ConvexOn.secant_mono_aux1 (hf : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {x y z : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s) (hz : z ∈ s)
    (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z) : (z - x) * f y ≤ (z - y) * f x + (y - x) * f z
proof:
:= by
  have hxy' : 0 < y - x := by linarith
  have hyz' : 0 < z - y := by linarith
  have hxz' : 0 < z - x := by linarith
  have ha : 0 ≤ (z - y) / (z - x) := by positivity
  have hb : 0 ≤ (y - x) / (z - x) := by positivity
  have key := hf.2 hx hz ha hb ?_
  · simp only [smul_eq_mul] at key
    ring_nf at key
    field_simp at key
    linear_combination key
  · field

name: ConvexOn.secant_mono_aux2
statement:
theorem ConvexOn.secant_mono_aux2 (hf : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {x y z : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s) (hz : z ∈ s)
    (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z) : (f y - f x) / (y - x) ≤ (f z - f x) / (z - x)
proof:
:= by
  have hxy' : 0 < y - x := by linarith
  have hxz' : 0 < z - x := by linarith
  field_simp
  linarith only [hf.secant_mono_aux1 hx hz hxy hyz]

name: ConvexOn.secant_mono_aux3
statement:
theorem ConvexOn.secant_mono_aux3 (hf : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {x y z : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s) (hz : z ∈ s)
    (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z) : (f z - f x) / (z - x) ≤ (f z - f y) / (z - y)
proof:
:= by
  have hyz' : 0 < z - y := by linarith
  have hxz' : 0 < z - x := by linarith
  field_simp
  linarith only [hf.secant_mono_aux1 hx hz hxy hyz]

name: ConvexOn.secant_mono
statement:
theorem ConvexOn.secant_mono (hf : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {a x y : 𝕜} (ha : a ∈ s) (hx : x ∈ s)
    (hy : y ∈ s) (hxa : x ≠ a) (hya : y ≠ a) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    (f x - f a) / (x - a) ≤ (f y - f a) / (y - a)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hxy with (rfl | hxy)
  · simp
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hxa with hxa | hxa
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hya with hya | hya
    · convert! hf.secant_mono_aux3 hx ha hxy hya using 1 <;> rw [← neg_div_neg_eq] <;> simp
    · convert! hf.slope_mono_adjacent hx hy hxa hya using 1
      rw [← neg_div_neg_eq]; simp
  · exact hf.secant_mono_aux2 ha hy hxa hxy

name: StrictConvexOn.secant_strict_mono_aux1
statement:
theorem StrictConvexOn.secant_strict_mono_aux1 (hf : StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {x y z : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (hz : z ∈ s) (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z) : (z - x) * f y < (z - y) * f x + (y - x) * f z
proof:
:= by
  have hxy' : 0 < y - x := by linarith
  have hyz' : 0 < z - y := by linarith
  have hxz' : 0 < z - x := by linarith
  have ha : 0 < (z - y) / (z - x) := by positivity
  have hb : 0 < (y - x) / (z - x) := by positivity
  have key := hf.2 hx hz (by linarith) ha hb ?_
  · simp only [smul_eq_mul] at key
    ring_nf at key
    field_simp at key
    linear_combination key
  · field

name: StrictConvexOn.secant_strict_mono_aux2
statement:
theorem StrictConvexOn.secant_strict_mono_aux2 (hf : StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {x y z : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (hz : z ∈ s) (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z) : (f y - f x) / (y - x) < (f z - f x) / (z - x)
proof:
:= by
  have hxy' : 0 < y - x := by linarith
  have hxz' : 0 < z - x := by linarith
  field_simp
  linarith only [hf.secant_strict_mono_aux1 hx hz hxy hyz]

name: StrictConvexOn.secant_strict_mono_aux3
statement:
theorem StrictConvexOn.secant_strict_mono_aux3 (hf : StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {x y z : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s)
    (hz : z ∈ s) (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z) : (f z - f x) / (z - x) < (f z - f y) / (z - y)
proof:
:= by
  have hyz' : 0 < z - y := by linarith
  have hxz' : 0 < z - x := by linarith
  field_simp
  linarith only [hf.secant_strict_mono_aux1 hx hz hxy hyz]

name: StrictConvexOn.secant_strict_mono
statement:
theorem StrictConvexOn.secant_strict_mono (hf : StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {a x y : 𝕜} (ha : a ∈ s)
    (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) (hxa : x ≠ a) (hya : y ≠ a) (hxy : x < y) :
    (f x - f a) / (x - a) < (f y - f a) / (y - a)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hxa with hxa | hxa
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hya with hya | hya
    · convert! hf.secant_strict_mono_aux3 hx ha hxy hya using 1 <;> rw [← neg_div_neg_eq] <;>
        simp
    · convert! hf.slope_strict_mono_adjacent hx hy hxa hya using 1
      rw [← neg_div_neg_eq]; simp
  · exact hf.secant_strict_mono_aux2 ha hy hxa hxy

name: StrictConcaveOn.secant_strict_mono
statement:
theorem StrictConcaveOn.secant_strict_mono (hf : StrictConcaveOn 𝕜 s f) {a x y : 𝕜} (ha : a ∈ s)
    (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) (hxa : x ≠ a) (hya : y ≠ a) (hxy : x < y) :
    (f y - f a) / (y - a) < (f x - f a) / (x - a)
proof:
:= by
  have key := hf.neg.secant_strict_mono ha hx hy hxa hya hxy
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply] at key
  linear_combination key

name: ConvexOn.strictMonoOn
statement:
theorem ConvexOn.strictMonoOn (hf : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {x y : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s) (hxy : x < y)
    (hxy' : f x < f y) : StrictMonoOn f (s ∩ Set.Ici y)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu v hv huv
  have step1 : ∀ {z : 𝕜}, z ∈ s ∩ Set.Ioi y → f y < f z := by
    intro z hz
    refine hf.lt_right_of_left_lt hx hz.1 ?_ hxy'
    rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo (hxy.trans hz.2)]
    exact ⟨hxy, hz.2⟩
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hu.2 with (rfl | hu2)
  · exact step1 ⟨hv.1, huv⟩
  · refine hf.lt_right_of_left_lt ?_ hv.1 ?_ (step1 ⟨hu.1, hu2⟩)
    · apply hf.1.segment_subset hx hu.1
      rw [segment_eq_Icc (hxy.le.trans hu.2)]
      exact ⟨hxy.le, hu.2⟩
    · rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo (hu2.trans huv)]
      exact ⟨hu2, huv⟩

name: ConvexOn.strictAntiOn
statement:
theorem ConvexOn.strictAntiOn (hf : ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) {x y : 𝕜} (hy : y ∈ s) (hxy : x < y)
    (hxy' : f y < f x) : StrictAntiOn f (s ∩ .Iic x)
proof:
:= by
  have := hf.comp_affineMap (-.id ..) |>.strictMonoOn (by simpa) (neg_lt_neg hxy) (by simpa)
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using this.comp_strictAntiOn strictMonoOn_id.neg fun _ _ ↦ by simpa

name: ConcaveOn.strictMonoOn
statement:
theorem ConcaveOn.strictMonoOn (hf : ConcaveOn 𝕜 s f) {x y : 𝕜} (hy : y ∈ s) (hxy : x < y)
    (hxy' : f x < f y) : StrictMonoOn f (s ∩ .Iic x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (neg_convexOn_iff.mpr hf |>.strictAntiOn hy hxy <| neg_lt_neg hxy').neg

name: ConcaveOn.strictAntiOn
statement:
theorem ConcaveOn.strictAntiOn (hf : ConcaveOn 𝕜 s f) {x y : 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ s) (hxy : x < y)
    (hxy' : f y < f x) : StrictAntiOn f (s ∩ .Ici y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (neg_convexOn_iff.mpr hf |>.strictMonoOn hx hxy <| neg_lt_neg hxy').neg

name: ContinuousLinearMap.toExposed.isExposed
statement: theorem ContinuousLinearMap.toExposed.isExposed : IsExposed 𝕜 A (l.toExposed A)

name: isExposed_empty
statement: theorem isExposed_empty : IsExposed 𝕜 A ∅
proof:
:= fun ⟨_, hx⟩ => by
  exfalso
  exact hx

name: subset
statement: protected theorem subset (hAB : IsExposed 𝕜 A B) : B ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  rintro x hx
  obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := hAB ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact hx.1

name: refl
statement:
@[refl]
protected theorem refl (A : Set E) : IsExposed 𝕜 A A
proof:
:= fun ⟨_, _⟩ =>
  ⟨0, Subset.antisymm (fun _ hx => ⟨hx, fun _ _ => le_refl 0⟩) fun _ hx => hx.1⟩

name: antisymm
statement: protected theorem antisymm (hB : IsExposed 𝕜 A B) (hA : IsExposed 𝕜 B A) : A = B

name: mono
statement: protected theorem mono (hC : IsExposed 𝕜 A C) (hBA : B ⊆ A) (hCB : C ⊆ B) : IsExposed 𝕜 B C
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hC ⟨w, hw⟩
  exact ⟨l, Subset.antisymm (fun x hx => ⟨hCB hx, fun y hy => hx.2 y (hBA hy)⟩) fun x hx =>
    ⟨hBA hx.1, fun y hy => (hw.2 y hy).trans (hx.2 w (hCB hw))⟩⟩

name: eq_inter_halfSpace'
statement:
theorem eq_inter_halfSpace' {A B : Set E} (hAB : IsExposed 𝕜 A B) (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    ∃ l : StrongDual 𝕜 E, ∃ a, B = { x ∈ A | a ≤ l x }
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hAB hB
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hB
  exact ⟨l, l w, Subset.antisymm (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2 w hw.1⟩) fun x hx =>
    ⟨hx.1, fun y hy => (hw.2 y hy).trans hx.2⟩⟩

name: eq_inter_halfSpace
statement:
theorem eq_inter_halfSpace [IsOrderedRing 𝕜] [Nontrivial 𝕜] {A B : Set E} (hAB : IsExposed 𝕜 A B) :
    ∃ l : StrongDual 𝕜 E, ∃ a, B = { x ∈ A | a ≤ l x }
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hB := B.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · refine ⟨0, 1, ?_⟩
    rw [eq_comm, eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro x ⟨-, h⟩
    rw [zero_apply] at h
    have : ¬(1 : 𝕜) ≤ 0 := not_le_of_gt zero_lt_one
    contradiction
  exact hAB.eq_inter_halfSpace' hB

name: inter
statement:
protected theorem inter [IsOrderedRing 𝕜] [ContinuousAdd 𝕜] {A B C : Set E} (hB : IsExposed 𝕜 A B)
    (hC : IsExposed 𝕜 A C) : IsExposed 𝕜 A (B ∩ C)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨w, hwB, hwC⟩
  obtain ⟨l₁, rfl⟩ := hB ⟨w, hwB⟩
  obtain ⟨l₂, rfl⟩ := hC ⟨w, hwC⟩
  refine ⟨l₁ + l₂, Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rintro x ⟨⟨hxA, hxB⟩, ⟨-, hxC⟩⟩
    exact ⟨hxA, fun z hz => add_le_add (hxB z hz) (hxC z hz)⟩
  rintro x ⟨hxA, hx⟩
  refine ⟨⟨hxA, fun y hy => ?_⟩, hxA, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · exact
      (add_le_add_iff_right (l₂ x)).1 ((add_le_add (hwB.2 y hy) (hwC.2 x hxA)).trans (hx w hwB.1))
  · exact
      (add_le_add_iff_left (l₁ x)).1 (le_trans (add_le_add (hwB.2 x hxA) (hwC.2 y hy)) (hx w hwB.1))

name: sInter
statement:
theorem sInter [IsOrderedRing 𝕜] [ContinuousAdd 𝕜] {F : Finset (Set E)} (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hAF : ∀ B ∈ F, IsExposed 𝕜 A B) : IsExposed 𝕜 A (⋂₀ F)
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finset.induction with
  | empty => exfalso; exact Finset.not_nonempty_empty hF
  | insert C F _ hF' =>
    rw [Finset.coe_insert, sInter_insert]
    obtain rfl | hFnemp := F.eq_empty_or_nonempty
    · rw [Finset.coe_empty, sInter_empty, inter_univ]
      exact hAF C (Finset.mem_singleton_self C)
    · exact (hAF C (Finset.mem_insert_self C F)).inter
        (hF' hFnemp fun B hB => hAF B (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hB))

name: inter_left
statement: theorem inter_left (hC : IsExposed 𝕜 A C) (hCB : C ⊆ B) : IsExposed 𝕜 (A ∩ B) C
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hC ⟨w, hw⟩
  exact ⟨l, Subset.antisymm (fun x hx => ⟨⟨hx.1, hCB hx⟩, fun y hy => hx.2 y hy.1⟩)
    fun x ⟨⟨hxC, _⟩, hx⟩ => ⟨hxC, fun y hy => (hw.2 y hy).trans (hx w ⟨hC.subset hw, hCB hw⟩)⟩⟩

name: inter_right
statement: theorem inter_right (hC : IsExposed 𝕜 B C) (hCA : C ⊆ A) : IsExposed 𝕜 (A ∩ B) C

name: isClosed
statement:
protected theorem isClosed [OrderClosedTopology 𝕜] {A B : Set E} (hAB : IsExposed 𝕜 A B)
    (hA : IsClosed A) : IsClosed B
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hB := B.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · simp
  obtain ⟨l, a, rfl⟩ := hAB.eq_inter_halfSpace' hB
  exact hA.isClosed_le continuousOn_const l.continuous.continuousOn

name: isCompact
statement:
protected theorem isCompact [OrderClosedTopology 𝕜] [T2Space E] {A B : Set E}
    (hAB : IsExposed 𝕜 A B) (hA : IsCompact A) : IsCompact B

name: exposed_point_def
statement:
theorem exposed_point_def :
    x ∈ A.exposedPoints 𝕜 ↔ x ∈ A ∧ ∃ l :
    StrongDual 𝕜 E, ∀ y ∈ A, l y ≤ l x ∧ (l x ≤ l y → y = x)

name: exposedPoints_subset
statement: theorem exposedPoints_subset : A.exposedPoints 𝕜 ⊆ A

@[simp]
theorem exposedPoints_empty : (∅ : Set E).exposedPoints 𝕜 = ∅

name: mem_exposedPoints_iff_exposed_singleton
statement: theorem mem_exposedPoints_iff_exposed_singleton : x ∈ A.exposedPoints 𝕜 ↔ IsExposed 𝕜 A {x}
proof:
:= by
  use fun ⟨hxA, l, hl⟩ _ =>
    ⟨l,
      Eq.symm <|
        eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2
          ⟨⟨hxA, fun y hy => (hl y hy).1⟩, fun z hz => (hl z hz.1).2 (hz.2 x hxA)⟩⟩
  rintro h
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h ⟨x, mem_singleton _⟩
  rw [eq_comm, eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem] at hl
  exact
    ⟨hl.1.1, l, fun y hy =>
      ⟨hl.1.2 y hy, fun hxy => hl.2 y ⟨hy, fun z hz => (hl.1.2 z hz).trans hxy⟩⟩⟩

name: convex
statement: protected theorem convex (hAB : IsExposed 𝕜 A B) (hA : Convex 𝕜 A) : Convex 𝕜 B
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hB := B.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · exact convex_empty
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hAB hB
  exact fun x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ a b ha hb hab =>
    ⟨hA hx₁.1 hx₂.1 ha hb hab, fun y hy =>
      ((l.toLinearMap.concaveOn convex_univ).convex_ge _ ⟨mem_univ _, hx₁.2 y hy⟩
          ⟨mem_univ _, hx₂.2 y hy⟩ ha hb hab).2⟩

name: isExtreme
statement: protected theorem isExtreme (hAB : IsExposed 𝕜 A B) : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hAB.subset, fun x₁ hx₁A x₂ hx₂A x hxB hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hAB ⟨x, hxB⟩
  have hl : ConvexOn 𝕜 univ l := l.toLinearMap.convexOn convex_univ
  have hlx₁ := hxB.2 x₁ hx₁A
  have hlx₂ := hxB.2 x₂ hx₂A
  refine ⟨hx₁A, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  rw [hlx₁.antisymm (hl.le_left_of_right_le (mem_univ _) (mem_univ _) hx hlx₂)]
  exact hxB.2 y hy

name: Sbtw.dist_lt_max_dist
statement:
theorem Sbtw.dist_lt_max_dist (p : P) {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h : Sbtw ℝ p₁ p₂ p₃) :
    dist p₂ p < max (dist p₁ p) (dist p₃ p)
proof:
:= by
  have hp₁p₃ : p₁ -ᵥ p ≠ p₃ -ᵥ p := by simpa using h.left_ne_right
  rw [Sbtw, ← wbtw_vsub_const_iff p, Wbtw, affineSegment_eq_segment, ← insert_endpoints_openSegment,
    Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff] at h
  rcases h with ⟨h | h | h, hp₂p₁, hp₂p₃⟩
  · rw [vsub_left_cancel_iff] at h
    exact False.elim (hp₂p₁ h)
  · rw [vsub_left_cancel_iff] at h
    exact False.elim (hp₂p₃ h)
  · rw [openSegment_eq_image, Set.mem_image] at h
    rcases h with ⟨r, ⟨hr0, hr1⟩, hr⟩
    simp_rw [@dist_eq_norm_vsub V, ← hr]
    exact
      norm_combo_lt_of_ne (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _) hp₁p₃ (sub_pos.2 hr1) hr0 (by abel)

name: Wbtw.dist_le_max_dist
statement:
theorem Wbtw.dist_le_max_dist (p : P) {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h : Wbtw ℝ p₁ p₂ p₃) :
    dist p₂ p ≤ max (dist p₁ p) (dist p₃ p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp₁ : p₂ = p₁; · simp [hp₁]
  by_cases hp₃ : p₂ = p₃; · simp [hp₃]
  have hs : Sbtw ℝ p₁ p₂ p₃ := ⟨h, hp₁, hp₃⟩
  exact (hs.dist_lt_max_dist _).le

name: Collinear.wbtw_of_dist_eq_of_dist_le
proof:
:= by
  rcases h.wbtw_or_wbtw_or_wbtw with (hw | hw | hw)
  · exact hw
  · by_cases hp₃p₂ : p₃ = p₂
    · simp [hp₃p₂]
    have hs : Sbtw ℝ p₂ p₃ p₁ := ⟨hw, hp₃p₂, hp₁p₃.symm⟩
    have hs' := hs.dist_lt_max_dist p
    rw [hp₁, hp₃, lt_max_iff, lt_self_iff_false, or_false] at hs'
    exact False.elim (hp₂.not_gt hs')
  · by_cases hp₁p₂ : p₁ = p₂
    · simp [hp₁p₂]
    have hs : Sbtw ℝ p₃ p₁ p₂ := ⟨hw, hp₁p₃, hp₁p₂⟩
    have hs' := hs.dist_lt_max_dist p
    rw [hp₁, hp₃, lt_max_iff, lt_self_iff_false, false_or] at hs'
    exact False.elim (hp₂.not_gt hs')

name: Collinear.sbtw_of_dist_eq_of_dist_lt
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.wbtw_of_dist_eq_of_dist_le hp₁ hp₂.le hp₃ hp₁p₃, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro rfl
    exact hp₂.ne hp₁
  · rintro rfl
    exact hp₂.ne hp₃

name: dist_add_dist_eq_iff
statement: lemma dist_add_dist_eq_iff : dist a b + dist b c = dist a c ↔ Wbtw ℝ a b c
proof:
:= by
  have :
      dist (a -ᵥ a) (b -ᵥ a) + dist (b -ᵥ a) (c -ᵥ a) = dist (a -ᵥ a) (c -ᵥ a) ↔
        b -ᵥ a ∈ segment ℝ (a -ᵥ a) (c -ᵥ a) := by
    simp only [mem_segment_iff_sameRay, sameRay_iff_norm_add, dist_eq_norm', sub_add_sub_cancel',
      eq_comm]
  simp_rw [dist_vsub_cancel_right, ← affineSegment_eq_segment, ← affineSegment_vsub_const_image]
    at this
  rwa [(vsub_left_injective _).mem_set_image] at this

name: dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff
statement:
theorem dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff {a b c : P} :
    dist a c < dist a b + dist b c ↔ ¬ Wbtw ℝ a b c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ne_iff_lt_iff_le.mpr (dist_triangle _ _ _), not_iff_not, eq_comm, dist_add_dist_eq_iff]

name: eq_lineMap_of_dist_eq_mul_of_dist_eq_mul
statement:
lemma eq_lineMap_of_dist_eq_mul_of_dist_eq_mul (hxy : dist x y = r * dist x z)
    (hyz : dist y z = (1 - r) * dist x z) : y = AffineMap.lineMap x z r
proof:
:= by
  have : y -ᵥ x ∈ [(0 : E) -[ℝ] z -ᵥ x] := by
    rw [mem_segment_iff_wbtw, ← dist_add_dist_eq_iff, dist_zero, dist_vsub_cancel_right,
      ← dist_eq_norm_vsub', ← dist_eq_norm_vsub', hxy, hyz, ← add_mul, add_sub_cancel,
      one_mul]
  obtain rfl | hne := eq_or_ne x z
  · obtain rfl : y = x := by simpa
    simp
  · rw [← dist_ne_zero] at hne
    obtain ⟨a, b, _, hb, _, H⟩ := this
    rw [smul_zero, zero_add] at H
    have H' := congr_arg norm H
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub', ← dist_eq_norm_vsub', hxy,
      mul_left_inj' hne] at H'
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← H', H, vsub_vadd]

name: eq_midpoint_of_dist_eq_half
statement:
lemma eq_midpoint_of_dist_eq_half (hx : dist x y = dist x z / 2) (hy : dist y z = dist x z / 2) :
    y = midpoint ℝ x z
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_lineMap_of_dist_eq_mul_of_dist_eq_mul
  · rwa [invOf_eq_inv, ← div_eq_inv_mul]
  · rwa [invOf_eq_inv, ← one_div, sub_half, one_div, ← div_eq_inv_mul]
