name: isTheta_deriv_ofReal_cpow_const_atTop
statement:
theorem isTheta_deriv_ofReal_cpow_const_atTop {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    deriv (fun (x : ℝ) => (x : ℂ) ^ c) =Θ[atTop] fun x => x ^ (c.re - 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ =ᶠ[atTop] fun x : ℝ ↦ c * x ^ (c - 1) := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_ne_atTop 0] with x hx using by rw [deriv_ofReal_cpow_const hx hc]
    _ =Θ[atTop] fun x : ℝ ↦ ‖(x : ℂ) ^ (c - 1)‖ :=
      (Asymptotics.IsTheta.of_norm_eventuallyEq EventuallyEq.rfl).const_mul_left hc
    _ =ᶠ[atTop] fun x ↦ x ^ (c.re - 1) := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hx
      rw [norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos hx, sub_re, one_re]

  obtain rfl | hc := eq_or_ne c 0
  · simp_rw [cpow_zero, deriv_const', Asymptotics.isBigO_zero]
  · exact (isTheta_deriv_ofReal_cpow_const_atTop hc).1

name: hasStrictFDerivAt_rpow_of_pos
statement:
theorem hasStrictFDerivAt_rpow_of_pos (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : 0 < p.1) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (fun x : ℝ × ℝ => x.1 ^ x.2)
      ((p.2 * p.1 ^ (p.2 - 1)) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ +
        (p.1 ^ p.2 * log p.1) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) p
proof:
:= by
  have : (fun x : ℝ × ℝ => x.1 ^ x.2) =ᶠ[𝓝 p] fun x => exp (log x.1 * x.2) :=
    (continuousAt_fst.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hp)).mono fun p hp => rpow_def_of_pos hp _
  refine HasStrictFDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_ this.symm
  convert! ((hasStrictFDerivAt_fst.log hp.ne').fun_mul hasStrictFDerivAt_snd).exp using 1
  rw [rpow_sub_one hp.ne', ← rpow_def_of_pos hp, smul_add, smul_smul, mul_div_left_comm,
    div_eq_mul_inv, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_assoc, add_comm]

name: hasStrictFDerivAt_rpow_of_neg
statement:
theorem hasStrictFDerivAt_rpow_of_neg (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p.1 < 0) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (fun x : ℝ × ℝ => x.1 ^ x.2)
      ((p.2 * p.1 ^ (p.2 - 1)) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ +
        (p.1 ^ p.2 * log p.1 - exp (log p.1 * p.2) * sin (p.2 * π) * π) •
          ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) p
proof:
:= by
  have : (fun x : ℝ × ℝ => x.1 ^ x.2) =ᶠ[𝓝 p] fun x => exp (log x.1 * x.2) * cos (x.2 * π) :=
    (continuousAt_fst.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hp)).mono fun p hp => rpow_def_of_neg hp _
  refine HasStrictFDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_ this.symm
  convert!
    ((hasStrictFDerivAt_fst.log hp.ne).fun_mul hasStrictFDerivAt_snd).exp.fun_mul
      (hasStrictFDerivAt_snd.mul_const π).cos using 1
  simp_rw [rpow_sub_one hp.ne, smul_add, ← add_assoc, smul_smul, ← add_smul, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_comm (cos _), ← rpow_def_of_neg hp]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, add_comm]; congr 2 <;> ring

statement:

proof:
:= by
  rcases hp.lt_or_gt with hneg | hpos
  exacts
    [(((contDiffAt_fst.log hneg.ne).mul contDiffAt_snd).exp.mul
          (contDiffAt_snd.mul contDiffAt_const).cos).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      ((continuousAt_fst.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hneg)).mono fun p hp => rpow_def_of_neg hp _),
    ((contDiffAt_fst.log hpos.ne').mul contDiffAt_snd).exp.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      ((continuousAt_fst.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hpos)).mono fun p hp => rpow_def_of_pos hp _)]

statement:

statement:
theorem hasStrictDerivAt_rpow_const_of_ne {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (p : ℝ) :

proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.lt_or_gt with hx | hx
  · have := (hasStrictFDerivAt_rpow_of_neg (x, p) hx).comp_hasStrictDerivAt x
      ((hasStrictDerivAt_id x).prodMk (hasStrictDerivAt_const x p))

theorem not_differentiableAt_rpow_const_zero {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 1) (hr' : r ≠ 0) :
    ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x ↦ x ^ r) (0 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  set y := deriv (fun x ↦ x ^ r) (0 : ℝ)
  
  have h : Filter.Tendsto (fun t ↦ t ^ (r - 1)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 y) := by
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_congr _ h.hasDerivAt.tendsto_slope_zero_right
    intro x (hx : 0 < x)
    simp only [zero_add, ne_eq, hr', not_false_eq_true, Real.zero_rpow, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    nth_rw 1 [← add_sub_cancel 1 r, Real.rpow_add hx]
    simp
  exact not_tendsto_nhds_of_tendsto_atTop (tendsto_rpow_neg_nhdsGT_zero (by simp [hr])) y h

  replace h : 1 ≤ p := h.neg_resolve_left rfl

    (hasStrictDerivAt_rpow_const_of_ne hx p).hasDerivAt
  exacts [continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inr (zero_le_one.trans h)),
    continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inr (sub_nonneg.2 h)))]

statement: theorem deriv_rpow_const (x p : ℝ) : deriv (fun x ↦ x ^ p) x = p * x ^ (p - 1)

statement:
theorem contDiff_rpow_const_of_le {p : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (h : ↑n ≤ p) :
    ContDiff ℝ n fun x : ℝ => x ^ p
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing p with
  | zero => exact contDiff_zero.2 (continuous_id.rpow_const fun x => Or.inr <| by simpa using h)
  | succ n ihn =>
    have h1 : 1 ≤ p := le_trans (by simp) h
    rw [Nat.cast_add_one, ← le_sub_iff_add_le] at h
    rw [Nat.cast_add_one, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv, deriv_rpow_const' p]
    simp only [WithTop.natCast_ne_top, analyticOn_univ, IsEmpty.forall_iff, true_and]
    exact ⟨differentiable_rpow_const h1, contDiff_const.mul (ihn h)⟩

theorem deriv_norm_ofReal_cpow (c : ℂ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :

proof:
:= by
  calc deriv (fun (x : ℝ) ↦ x ^ p) = fun x => p * x ^ (p - 1) := Real.deriv_rpow_const' p
    _ =Θ[atTop] fun x ↦ x ^ (p - 1) :=

:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp
  case inl =>
    simp [zero_sub, Real.rpow_neg_one, Real.rpow_zero, deriv_const', Asymptotics.isBigO_zero]
  case inr =>
    exact (isTheta_deriv_rpow_const_atTop hp).1

  suffices IsOpen {x : ℂ × ℂ | x.1 = 0}ᶜ from
    mem_nhds_iff.mpr ⟨_, fun x hx ↦ by simp_all [cpow_def_of_ne_zero], this, hp_fst⟩

  exact isClosed_eq continuous_fst continuous_const

theorem rpow_eq_nhds_of_neg {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp_fst : p.fst < 0) :

  suffices ∀ᶠ x : ℝ × ℝ in 𝓝 p, x.1 < 0 from

    ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ p.2) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_iff_lt_or_gt] at hp
  cases hp with
  | inl hp =>
    rw [continuousAt_congr (rpow_eq_nhds_of_neg hp)]
    refine ContinuousAt.mul ?_ (by fun_prop)
    · refine continuous_exp.continuousAt.comp (ContinuousAt.mul ?_ continuous_snd.continuousAt)
      exact (continuousAt_log hp.ne).comp continuous_fst.continuousAt
  | inr hp =>
    rw [continuousAt_congr (rpow_eq_nhds_of_pos hp)]
    refine continuous_exp.continuousAt.comp (ContinuousAt.mul ?_ continuous_snd.continuousAt)
    refine (continuousAt_log ?_).comp continuous_fst.continuousAt
    exact hp.ne'

name: continuousAt_rpow_of_pos
statement:
theorem continuousAt_rpow_of_pos (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : 0 < p.2) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ p.2) p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y⟩ := p
  dsimp only at hp
  obtain hx | rfl := ne_or_eq x 0
  · exact continuousAt_rpow_of_ne (x, y) hx
  have A : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => exp (log p.1 * p.2)) (𝓝[≠] 0 ×ˢ 𝓝 y) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
      ((tendsto_log_nhdsNE_zero.comp tendsto_fst).atBot_mul_pos hp tendsto_snd)
  have B : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ p.2) (𝓝[≠] 0 ×ˢ 𝓝 y) (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero_norm (fun p => abs_rpow_le_exp_log_mul p.1 p.2) A
  have C : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ p.2) (𝓝[{0}] 0 ×ˢ 𝓝 y) (pure 0) := by
    rw [nhdsWithin_singleton, tendsto_pure, pure_prod, eventually_map]
    exact (lt_mem_nhds hp).mono fun y hy => zero_rpow hy.ne'
  simpa only [← sup_prod, ← nhdsWithin_union, compl_union_self, nhdsWithin_univ, nhds_prod_eq,
    ContinuousAt, zero_rpow hp.ne'] using B.sup (C.mono_right (pure_le_nhds _))

statement:
theorem Continuous.rpow (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) (h : ∀ x, f x ≠ 0 ∨ 0 < g x) :
    Continuous fun x => f x ^ g x
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => hf.continuousAt.rpow hg.continuousAt (h x)

name: ContinuousOn.rpow_const
statement:
theorem ContinuousOn.rpow_const (hf : ContinuousOn f s) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0 ∨ 0 ≤ p) :
    ContinuousOn (fun x => f x ^ p) s
proof: := fun x hx => (hf x hx).rpow_const (h x hx)

name: Continuous.rpow_const
statement:
theorem Continuous.rpow_const (hf : Continuous f) (h : ∀ x, f x ≠ 0 ∨ 0 ≤ p) :
    Continuous fun x => f x ^ p

name: continuousAt_cpow_zero_of_re_pos
statement:
theorem continuousAt_cpow_zero_of_re_pos {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    ContinuousAt (fun x : ℂ × ℂ => x.1 ^ x.2) (0, z)
proof:
:= by
  have hz₀ : z ≠ 0 := ne_of_apply_ne re hz.ne'
  rw [ContinuousAt, zero_cpow hz₀, tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
  refine squeeze_zero (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun _ => norm_cpow_le _ _) ?_
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg]
  refine Tendsto.zero_mul_isBoundedUnder_le ?_ ?_
  · convert!
    (continuous_fst.norm.tendsto ((0 : ℂ), z)).rpow ((continuous_re.comp continuous_snd).tendsto _)
      _ <;>
      simp [hz, Real.zero_rpow hz.ne']
  · simp only [Function.comp_def, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    rcases exists_gt |im z| with ⟨C, hC⟩
    refine ⟨Real.exp (π * C), eventually_map.2 ?_⟩
    refine
      (((continuous_im.comp continuous_snd).abs.tendsto (_, z)).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hC)).mono
        fun z hz => Real.exp_le_exp.2 <| (neg_le_abs _).trans ?_
    rw [_root_.abs_mul]
    exact
      mul_le_mul (abs_le.2 ⟨(neg_pi_lt_arg _).le, arg_le_pi _⟩) hz.le (_root_.abs_nonneg _)
        Real.pi_pos.le

name: continuousAt_cpow_of_re_pos
statement:
theorem continuousAt_cpow_of_re_pos {p : ℂ × ℂ} (h₁ : 0 ≤ p.1.re ∨ p.1.im ≠ 0) (h₂ : 0 < p.2.re) :
    ContinuousAt (fun x : ℂ × ℂ => x.1 ^ x.2) p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, w⟩ := p
  rw [← not_lt_zero_iff, lt_iff_le_and_ne, not_and_or, Ne, Classical.not_not,
    not_le_zero_iff] at h₁
  rcases h₁ with (h₁ | (rfl : z = 0))
  exacts [continuousAt_cpow h₁, continuousAt_cpow_zero_of_re_pos h₂]

name: continuousAt_cpow_const_of_re_pos
statement:
theorem continuousAt_cpow_const_of_re_pos {z w : ℂ} (hz : 0 ≤ re z ∨ im z ≠ 0) (hw : 0 < re w) :
    ContinuousAt (fun x => x ^ w) z

name: continuousAt_ofReal_cpow
statement:
theorem continuousAt_ofReal_cpow (x : ℝ) (y : ℂ) (h : 0 < y.re ∨ x ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p => (p.1 : ℂ) ^ p.2 : ℝ × ℂ → ℂ) (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (0 : ℝ) x with (hx | rfl | hx)
  · 
    have : ContinuousAt (fun p => ⟨↑p.1, p.2⟩ : ℝ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (x, y) := by fun_prop
    refine (continuousAt_cpow (Or.inl ?_)).comp this
    rwa [ofReal_re]
  · 
    have A : ContinuousAt (fun p => p.1 ^ p.2 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) ⟨↑(0 : ℝ), y⟩ := by
      rw [ofReal_zero]
      apply continuousAt_cpow_zero_of_re_pos
      tauto
    have B : ContinuousAt (fun p => ⟨↑p.1, p.2⟩ : ℝ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) ⟨0, y⟩ := by fun_prop
    exact A.comp_of_eq B rfl
  · 
    suffices ContinuousAt (fun p => (-(p.1 : ℂ)) ^ p.2 * exp (π * I * p.2) : ℝ × ℂ → ℂ) (x, y) by
      refine this.congr (eventually_of_mem (prod_mem_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hx) univ_mem) ?_)
      exact fun p hp => (ofReal_cpow_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hp.1) p.2).symm
    have A : ContinuousAt (fun p => ⟨-↑p.1, p.2⟩ : ℝ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (x, y) := by fun_prop
    apply ContinuousAt.mul
    · refine (continuousAt_cpow (Or.inl ?_)).comp A
      rwa [neg_re, ofReal_re, neg_pos]
    · fun_prop

name: continuousAt_ofReal_cpow_const
statement:
theorem continuousAt_ofReal_cpow_const (x : ℝ) (y : ℂ) (h : 0 < y.re ∨ x ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun a => (a : ℂ) ^ y : ℝ → ℂ) x
proof:
:=
  (continuousAt_ofReal_cpow x y h).comp₂_of_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) rfl

name: continuous_ofReal_cpow_const
statement:
theorem continuous_ofReal_cpow_const {y : ℂ} (hs : 0 < y.re) :
    Continuous (fun x => (x : ℂ) ^ y : ℝ → ℂ)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => continuousAt_ofReal_cpow_const x y (Or.inl hs)

name: continuousAt_rpow
statement:
theorem continuousAt_rpow {x : ℝ≥0} {y : ℝ} (h : x ≠ 0 ∨ 0 < y) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ≥0 × ℝ => p.1 ^ p.2) (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  have :
    (fun p : ℝ≥0 × ℝ => p.1 ^ p.2) =
      Real.toNNReal ∘ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ p.2) ∘ fun p : ℝ≥0 × ℝ => (p.1.1, p.2) := by
    ext p
    simp only [coe_rpow, val_eq_coe, Function.comp_apply, coe_toNNReal', left_eq_sup]
    positivity
  rw [this]
  refine continuous_real_toNNReal.continuousAt.comp (ContinuousAt.comp ?_ ?_)
  · apply Real.continuousAt_rpow
    simpa using h
  · fun_prop

name: eventually_pow_one_div_le
statement:
theorem eventually_pow_one_div_le (x : ℝ≥0) {y : ℝ≥0} (hy : 1 < y) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, x ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := add_one_pow_unbounded_of_pos x (tsub_pos_of_lt hy)
  rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le hy.le] at hm
  refine eventually_atTop.2 ⟨m + 1, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  simp only [one_div]
  simpa only [NNReal.rpow_inv_le_iff (Nat.cast_pos.2 <| m.succ_pos.trans_le hn),
    NNReal.rpow_natCast] using hm.le.trans (pow_right_mono₀ hy.le (m.le_succ.trans hn))

name: Filter.Tendsto.nnrpow
continuousAt_rpow_const
statement:
theorem continuousAt_rpow_const {x : ℝ≥0} {y : ℝ} (h : x ≠ 0 ∨ 0 ≤ y) :
    ContinuousAt (fun z => z ^ y) x
proof:
:=
  h.elim (fun h => tendsto_id.nnrpow tendsto_const_nhds (Or.inl h)) fun h =>
    h.eq_or_lt.elim (fun h => h ▸ by simp only [rpow_zero, continuousAt_const]) fun h =>
      tendsto_id.nnrpow tendsto_const_nhds (Or.inr h)

name: continuous_rpow_const
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem continuous_rpow_const {y : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ y) : Continuous fun x : ℝ≥0 => x ^ y

name: continuousOn_rpow_const_compl_zero
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem continuousOn_rpow_const_compl_zero {r : ℝ} :
    ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ≥0 => z ^ r) {0}ᶜ

name: continuousOn_rpow_const
eventually_pow_one_div_le
statement:
theorem eventually_pow_one_div_le {x : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : x ≠ ∞) {y : ℝ≥0∞} (hy : 1 < y) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, x ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using hx
  by_cases h : y = ∞
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun n => h.symm ▸ le_top
  · lift y to ℝ≥0 using h
    have := NNReal.eventually_pow_one_div_le x (mod_cast hy : 1 < y)
    refine this.congr (Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
    rw [← coe_rpow_of_nonneg x (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1 / n : ℝ)), coe_le_coe]

name: continuousAt_rpow_const_of_pos
statement:
private theorem continuousAt_rpow_const_of_pos {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} (h : 0 < y) :
    ContinuousAt (fun a : ℝ≥0∞ => a ^ y) x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = ⊤
  · rw [hx, ContinuousAt]
    convert! ENNReal.tendsto_rpow_at_top h
    simp [h]
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using hx
  rw [continuousAt_coe_iff]
  convert! continuous_coe.continuousAt.comp (NNReal.continuousAt_rpow_const (Or.inr h.le)) using 1
  ext1 x
  simp [← coe_rpow_of_nonneg _ h.le]

name: continuous_rpow_const
statement:
@[continuity, fun_prop]
theorem continuous_rpow_const {y : ℝ} : Continuous fun a : ℝ≥0∞ => a ^ y
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => ?_
  rcases lt_trichotomy (0 : ℝ) y with (hy | rfl | hy)
  · exact continuousAt_rpow_const_of_pos hy
  · simp only [rpow_zero]
    exact continuousAt_const
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, y = -z := ⟨-y, (neg_neg _).symm⟩
    have z_pos : 0 < z := by simpa [hz] using hy
    simp_rw [hz, rpow_neg]
    exact continuous_inv.continuousAt.comp (continuousAt_rpow_const_of_pos z_pos)

name: tendsto_const_mul_rpow_nhds_zero_of_pos
statement:
theorem tendsto_const_mul_rpow_nhds_zero_of_pos {c : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : c ≠ ∞) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ≥0∞ => c * x ^ y) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  convert! ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul (ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.tendsto 0) _
  · simp [hy]
  · exact Or.inr hc

name: Filter.Tendsto.ennrpow_const
statement:
theorem Filter.Tendsto.ennrpow_const {α : Type*} {f : Filter α} {m : α → ℝ≥0∞} {a : ℝ≥0∞} (r : ℝ)

name: cpow_eq_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cpow_eq_pow (x y : ℂ) : cpow x y = x ^ y

name: cpow_def
statement: theorem cpow_def (x y : ℂ) : x ^ y = if x = 0 then if y = 0 then 1 else 0 else exp (log x * y)

name: cpow_def_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem cpow_def_of_ne_zero {x : ℂ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (y : ℂ) : x ^ y = exp (log x * y)

name: cpow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cpow_zero (x : ℂ) : x ^ (0 : ℂ) = 1

name: cpow_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cpow_eq_zero_iff (x y : ℂ) : x ^ y = 0 ↔ x = 0 ∧ y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cpow_def]
  split_ifs <;> simp [*, exp_ne_zero]

name: cpow_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem cpow_ne_zero_iff {x y : ℂ} :
    x ^ y ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0 ∨ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, cpow_eq_zero_iff, not_and_or, ne_eq, not_not]

name: cpow_ne_zero_iff_of_exponent_ne_zero
statement:
theorem cpow_ne_zero_iff_of_exponent_ne_zero {x y : ℂ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    x ^ y ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0

name: zero_cpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_cpow {x : ℂ} (h : x ≠ 0) : (0 : ℂ) ^ x = 0

name: zero_cpow_eq_iff
statement: theorem zero_cpow_eq_iff {x : ℂ} {a : ℂ} : (0 : ℂ) ^ x = a ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ a = 0 ∨ x = 0 ∧ a = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hyp
    simp only [cpow_def, ite_true] at hyp
    grind
  · rintro (⟨h, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact zero_cpow h
    · exact cpow_zero _

name: eq_zero_cpow_iff
statement: theorem eq_zero_cpow_iff {x : ℂ} {a : ℂ} : a = (0 : ℂ) ^ x ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ a = 0 ∨ x = 0 ∧ a = 1

name: cpow_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cpow_one (x : ℂ) : x ^ (1 : ℂ) = x
proof:
:=
  if hx : x = 0 then by simp [hx, cpow_def]
  else by
    rw [cpow_def, ite_eq_right (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℂ) ≠ 0), ite_eq_right hx, mul_one, exp_log hx]

name: one_cpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_cpow (x : ℂ) : (1 : ℂ) ^ x = 1

name: cpow_add
statement: theorem cpow_add {x : ℂ} (y z : ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) : x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cpow_def, ite_mul, mul_ite]
  simp_all [exp_add, mul_add]

name: cpow_mul
statement:
theorem cpow_mul {x y : ℂ} (z : ℂ) (h₁ : -π < (log x * y).im) (h₂ : (log x * y).im ≤ π) :
    x ^ (y * z) = (x ^ y) ^ z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cpow_def]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all [exp_ne_zero, log_exp h₁ h₂, mul_assoc]

name: cpow_neg
statement: theorem cpow_neg (x y : ℂ) : x ^ (-y) = (x ^ y)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cpow_def, neg_eq_zero, mul_neg]
  split_ifs <;> simp [exp_neg]

name: cpow_sub
statement: theorem cpow_sub {x : ℂ} (y z : ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) : x ^ (y - z) = x ^ y / x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, cpow_add _ _ hx, cpow_neg, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: cpow_neg_one
statement: theorem cpow_neg_one (x : ℂ) : x ^ (-1 : ℂ) = x⁻¹

name: cpow_int_mul
statement: lemma cpow_int_mul (x : ℂ) (n : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : x ^ (n * y) = (x ^ y) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
    · simp
    · rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with rfl | hy <;> simp [*, zero_zpow]
  · rw [cpow_def_of_ne_zero hx, cpow_def_of_ne_zero hx, mul_left_comm, exp_int_mul]

name: cpow_mul_int
statement: lemma cpow_mul_int (x y : ℂ) (n : ℤ) : x ^ (y * n) = (x ^ y) ^ n

statement:

theorem cpow_natCast (x : ℂ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (n : ℂ) = x ^ n
proof: := by simpa using cpow_nat_mul x n 1

name: cpow_ofNat
statement:

    x ^ (ofNat(n) : ℂ) = x ^ ofNat(n)

statement: theorem cpow_two (x : ℂ) : x ^ (2 : ℂ) = x ^ (2 : ℕ)

statement:

theorem cpow_intCast (x : ℂ) (n : ℤ) : x ^ (n : ℂ) = x ^ n
proof: := by simpa using cpow_int_mul x n 1

name: cpow_nat_inv_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cpow_nat_inv_pow (x : ℂ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : (x ^ (n⁻¹ : ℂ)) ^ n = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cpow_nat_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀, cpow_one]
  assumption_mod_cast

statement:

lemma cpow_ofNat_inv_pow (x : ℂ) (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :
    (x ^ ((ofNat(n) : ℂ)⁻¹)) ^ (ofNat(n) : ℕ) = x

name: cpow_int_mul'
statement:
lemma cpow_int_mul' {x : ℂ} {n : ℤ} (hlt : -π < n * x.arg) (hle : n * x.arg ≤ π) (y : ℂ) :
    x ^ (n * y) = (x ^ n) ^ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm] at hlt hle
  rw [cpow_mul, cpow_intCast] <;> simpa [log_im]

statement:

name: cpow_ofNat_mul'
statement:
lemma cpow_ofNat_mul' {x : ℂ} {n : ℕ} [n.AtLeastTwo] (hlt : -π < OfNat.ofNat n * x.arg)
    (hle : OfNat.ofNat n * x.arg ≤ π) (y : ℂ) :
    x ^ (OfNat.ofNat n * y) = (x ^ ofNat(n)) ^ y

name: pow_cpow_nat_inv
statement:
lemma pow_cpow_nat_inv {x : ℂ} {n : ℕ} (h₀ : n ≠ 0) (hlt : -(π / n) < x.arg) (hle : x.arg ≤ π / n) :
    (x ^ n) ^ (n⁻¹ : ℂ) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cpow_nat_mul', mul_inv_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 h₀), cpow_one]
  · rwa [← div_lt_iff₀' (Nat.cast_pos.2 h₀.bot_lt), neg_div]
  · rwa [← le_div_iff₀' (Nat.cast_pos.2 h₀.bot_lt)]

name: pow_cpow_ofNat_inv
statement:
lemma pow_cpow_ofNat_inv {x : ℂ} {n : ℕ} [n.AtLeastTwo] (hlt : -(π / OfNat.ofNat n) < x.arg)
    (hle : x.arg ≤ π / OfNat.ofNat n) :
    (x ^ ofNat(n)) ^ ((OfNat.ofNat n : ℂ)⁻¹) = x

name: sq_cpow_two_inv

name: isSquare
statement: @[simp] lemma isSquare (x : ℂ) : IsSquare x

name: mul_cpow_ofReal_nonneg
statement:
theorem mul_cpow_ofReal_nonneg {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (r : ℂ) :
    ((a : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) ^ r = (a : ℂ) ^ r * (b : ℂ) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne r 0 with (rfl | hr)
  · simp only [cpow_zero, mul_one]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with (rfl | ha')
  · rw [ofReal_zero, zero_mul, zero_cpow hr, zero_mul]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hb with (rfl | hb')
  · rw [ofReal_zero, mul_zero, zero_cpow hr, mul_zero]
  have ha'' : (a : ℂ) ≠ 0 := ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ha'.ne'
  have hb'' : (b : ℂ) ≠ 0 := ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hb'.ne'
  rw [cpow_def_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ha'' hb''), log_ofReal_mul ha' hb'', ofReal_log ha,
    add_mul, exp_add, ← cpow_def_of_ne_zero ha'', ← cpow_def_of_ne_zero hb'']

name: natCast_mul_natCast_cpow
statement: lemma natCast_mul_natCast_cpow (m n : ℕ) (s : ℂ) : (m * n : ℂ) ^ s = m ^ s * n ^ s
proof:
:=
  ofReal_natCast m ▸ ofReal_natCast n ▸ mul_cpow_ofReal_nonneg m.cast_nonneg n.cast_nonneg s

name: natCast_cpow_natCast_mul
statement: lemma natCast_cpow_natCast_mul (n m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : (n : ℂ) ^ (m * z) = ((n : ℂ) ^ m) ^ z
proof:
:= by
  refine cpow_nat_mul' (x := n) (n := m) ?_ ?_ z
  · simp only [natCast_arg, mul_zero, Left.neg_neg_iff, pi_pos]
  · simp only [natCast_arg, mul_zero, pi_pos.le]

name: inv_cpow_eq_ite
statement:
theorem inv_cpow_eq_ite (x : ℂ) (n : ℂ) :
    x⁻¹ ^ n = if x.arg = π then conj (x ^ conj n)⁻¹ else (x ^ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Complex.cpow_def, log_inv_eq_ite, inv_eq_zero, map_eq_zero, ite_mul, neg_mul,
    RCLike.conj_inv, apply_ite conj, apply_ite exp, apply_ite Inv.inv, map_zero, map_one, exp_neg,
    inv_one, inv_zero, ← exp_conj, map_mul, conj_conj]
  split_ifs with hx hn ha ha <;> rfl

name: inv_cpow
statement: theorem inv_cpow (x : ℂ) (n : ℂ) (hx : x.arg ≠ π) : x⁻¹ ^ n = (x ^ n)⁻¹

name: inv_cpow_ofReal_nonneg
statement:
lemma inv_cpow_ofReal_nonneg {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (r : ℂ) :
    ((a : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ r = (a ^ r : ℂ)⁻¹
proof:
:=

  split_ifs with hcx hn hx <;> rfl

name: rpow_pos
statement: theorem rpow_pos {p : ℝ} {x : ℝ≥0} (hx_pos : 0 < x) : 0 < x ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have rpow_pos_of_nonneg : ∀ {p : ℝ}, 0 < p → 0 < x ^ p := by
    intro p hp_pos
    rw [← zero_rpow hp_pos.ne']
    exact rpow_lt_rpow hx_pos hp_pos
  rcases lt_trichotomy (0 : ℝ) p with (hp_pos | rfl | hp_neg)
  · exact rpow_pos_of_nonneg hp_pos
  · simp only [zero_lt_one, rpow_zero]
  · rw [← neg_neg p, rpow_neg, inv_pos]
    exact rpow_pos_of_nonneg (neg_pos.mpr hp_neg)

name: rpow_right_inj
statement: lemma rpow_right_inj {y z : ℝ} (hx₀ : x ≠ 0) (hx₁ : x ≠ 1) : x ^ y = x ^ z ↔ y = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pos_iff_ne_zero] at hx₀
  rify at *
  grind [Real.rpow_right_inj]

name: rpow_eq_rpow_right_iff
statement:
lemma rpow_eq_rpow_right_iff {y z : ℝ} :
    x ^ y = x ^ z ↔ y = z ∨ x = 1 ∨ (x = 0 ∧ (y = 0 ↔ z = 0))
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx₀ := eq_or_ne x 0
  · obtain rfl | hz := eq_or_ne z 0
    · simp [zero_rpow_def]
    · simp +contextual [hz]
  obtain rfl | hx₁ := eq_or_ne x 1
  · simp
  simpa [hx₀, hx₁] using rpow_right_inj (y := y) (z := z) hx₀ hx₁

name: rpow_eq_left_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_eq_left_iff {y : ℝ} : x ^ y = x ↔ x = 1 ∨ y = 1 ∨ (x = 0 ∧ y ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [or_left_comm] using rpow_eq_rpow_right_iff (x := x) (y := y) (z := 1)

name: eq_rpow_inv_iff
statement: theorem eq_rpow_inv_iff {x y : ℝ≥0} {z : ℝ} (hz : z ≠ 0) : x = y ^ z⁻¹ ↔ x ^ z = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_eq_rpow_iff hz, ← one_div, rpow_self_rpow_inv hz]

name: rpow_inv_eq_iff
statement: theorem rpow_inv_eq_iff {x y : ℝ≥0} {z : ℝ} (hz : z ≠ 0) : x ^ z⁻¹ = y ↔ x = y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_eq_rpow_iff hz, ← one_div, rpow_self_rpow_inv hz]

name: rpow_rpow_inv
statement: @[simp] lemma rpow_rpow_inv {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x : ℝ≥0) : (x ^ y) ^ y⁻¹ = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hy, rpow_one]

name: rpow_inv_rpow
statement: @[simp] lemma rpow_inv_rpow {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x : ℝ≥0) : (x ^ y⁻¹) ^ y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hy, rpow_one]

name: rpow_rpow_inv_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_rpow_inv_eq_iff {y : ℝ} : (x ^ y) ^ y⁻¹ = x ↔ y ≠ 0 ∨ x = 1

name: rpow_inv_rpow_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_inv_rpow_eq_iff {y : ℝ} : (x ^ y⁻¹) ^ y = x ↔ y ≠ 0 ∨ x = 1

name: pow_rpow_inv_natCast
statement: theorem pow_rpow_inv_natCast (x : ℝ≥0) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : (x ^ n) ^ (n⁻¹ : ℝ) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← NNReal.coe_inj, coe_rpow, NNReal.coe_pow]
  exact Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast x.2 hn

name: rpow_inv_natCast_pow
statement: theorem rpow_inv_natCast_pow (x : ℝ≥0) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : (x ^ (n⁻¹ : ℝ)) ^ n = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← NNReal.coe_inj, NNReal.coe_pow, coe_rpow]
  exact Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow x.2 hn

name: _root_.Real.toNNReal_rpow_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem _root_.Real.toNNReal_rpow_of_nonneg {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Real.toNNReal (x ^ y) = Real.toNNReal x ^ y
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← Real.coe_toNNReal x hx]
  rw [← NNReal.coe_rpow, Real.toNNReal_coe]

name: strictMono_rpow_of_pos
statement: theorem strictMono_rpow_of_pos {z : ℝ} (h : 0 < z) : StrictMono fun x : ℝ≥0 => x ^ z
proof:
:=
  fun x y hxy => by simp only [NNReal.rpow_lt_rpow hxy h]

name: monotone_rpow_of_nonneg
statement: theorem monotone_rpow_of_nonneg {z : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ z) : Monotone fun x : ℝ≥0 => x ^ z
proof:
:=
  h.eq_or_lt.elim (fun h0 => h0 ▸ by simp only [rpow_zero, monotone_const]) fun h0 =>
    (strictMono_rpow_of_pos h0).monotone

name: orderIsoRpow_symm_eq
statement:
theorem orderIsoRpow_symm_eq (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    (orderIsoRpow y hy).symm = orderIsoRpow (1 / y) (one_div_pos.2 hy)

name: _root_.Real.nnnorm_rpow_of_nonneg
statement: theorem _root_.Real.nnnorm_rpow_of_nonneg {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : ‖x ^ y‖₊ = ‖x‖₊ ^ y

name: rpow_eq_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_eq_pow (x : ℝ≥0∞) (y : ℝ) : rpow x y = x ^ y

name: rpow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_zero {x : ℝ≥0∞} : x ^ (0 : ℝ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;>
    · dsimp only [(· ^ ·), Pow.pow, rpow]
      simp [← none_eq_top]

name: rpow_zero_pos
statement: theorem rpow_zero_pos (x : ℝ≥0∞) : 0 < x ^ (0 : ℝ)

name: top_rpow_def
statement: theorem top_rpow_def (y : ℝ) : (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y = if 0 < y then ⊤ else if y = 0 then 1 else 0

name: top_rpow_of_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem top_rpow_of_pos {y : ℝ} (h : 0 < y) : (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y = ⊤

name: top_rpow_of_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem top_rpow_of_neg {y : ℝ} (h : y < 0) : (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [top_rpow_def, asymm h, ne_of_lt h]

name: zero_rpow_of_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_rpow_of_pos {y : ℝ} (h : 0 < y) : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.coe_zero, ← ENNReal.some_eq_coe]
  dsimp only [(· ^ ·), rpow, Pow.pow]
  simp [asymm h, ne_of_gt h]

name: zero_rpow_of_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_rpow_of_neg {y : ℝ} (h : y < 0) : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.coe_zero, ← ENNReal.some_eq_coe]
  dsimp only [(· ^ ·), rpow, Pow.pow]
  simp [h]

name: zero_rpow_def
statement: theorem zero_rpow_def (y : ℝ) : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y = if 0 < y then 0 else if y = 0 then 1 else ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (0 : ℝ) y with (H | rfl | H)
  · simp [H, zero_rpow_of_pos]
  · simp
  · simp [H, asymm H, ne_of_lt, zero_rpow_of_neg]

name: zero_rpow_mul_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_rpow_mul_self (y : ℝ) : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y * (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y = (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_rpow_def]
  split_ifs
  exacts [zero_mul _, one_mul _, top_mul_top]

name: coe_rpow_of_ne_zero
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem coe_rpow_of_ne_zero {x : ℝ≥0} (h : x ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) : (↑(x ^ y) : ℝ≥0∞) = x ^ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.some_eq_coe]
  dsimp only [(· ^ ·), Pow.pow, rpow]
  simp [h]

name: coe_rpow_of_nonneg
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem coe_rpow_of_nonneg (x : ℝ≥0) {y : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ y) : ↑(x ^ y) = (x : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rcases le_iff_eq_or_lt.1 h with (H | H)
    · simp [hx, H.symm]
    · simp [hx, zero_rpow_of_pos H, NNReal.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt H)]
  · exact coe_rpow_of_ne_zero hx _

name: coe_rpow_def
statement:
theorem coe_rpow_def (x : ℝ≥0) (y : ℝ) :
    (x : ℝ≥0∞) ^ y = if x = 0 ∧ y < 0 then ⊤ else ↑(x ^ y)

name: rpow_ofNNReal
statement: theorem rpow_ofNNReal {M : ℝ≥0} {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 ≤ P) : (M : ℝ≥0∞) ^ P = ↑(M ^ P)

name: rpow_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_one (x : ℝ≥0∞) : x ^ (1 : ℝ) = x
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  · exact dite_eq_left zero_lt_one
  · change ite _ _ _ = _
    simp only [NNReal.rpow_one, ite_eq_right_iff, top_ne_coe, and_imp]
    exact fun _ => zero_le_one.not_gt

name: one_rpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_rpow (x : ℝ) : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_one, ← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero one_ne_zero]
  simp

name: rpow_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_eq_zero_iff {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} : x ^ y = 0 ↔ x = 0 ∧ 0 < y ∨ x = ⊤ ∧ y < 0
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | top =>
    rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (H | H | H) <;>
      simp [H, top_rpow_of_neg, top_rpow_of_pos, le_of_lt]
  | coe x =>
    by_cases h : x = 0
    · rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (H | H | H) <;>
        simp [h, H, zero_rpow_of_neg, zero_rpow_of_pos, le_of_lt]
    · simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero h, h]

name: rpow_eq_zero_iff_of_pos
statement: lemma rpow_eq_zero_iff_of_pos {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) : x ^ y = 0 ↔ x = 0

name: rpow_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_eq_top_iff {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} : x ^ y = ⊤ ↔ x = 0 ∧ y < 0 ∨ x = ⊤ ∧ 0 < y
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | top =>
    rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (H | H | H) <;>
      simp [H, top_rpow_of_neg, top_rpow_of_pos, le_of_lt]
  | coe x =>
    by_cases h : x = 0
    · rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (H | H | H) <;>
        simp [h, H, zero_rpow_of_neg, zero_rpow_of_pos, le_of_lt]
    · simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero h, h]

name: rpow_eq_top_iff_of_pos
statement: theorem rpow_eq_top_iff_of_pos {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) : x ^ y = ⊤ ↔ x = ⊤

name: rpow_lt_top_iff_of_pos
statement: lemma rpow_lt_top_iff_of_pos {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) : x ^ y < ∞ ↔ x < ∞
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lt_top_iff_ne_top, Ne, rpow_eq_top_iff_of_pos hy]

name: rpow_eq_top_of_nonneg
statement: theorem rpow_eq_top_of_nonneg (x : ℝ≥0∞) {y : ℝ} (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) : x ^ y = ⊤ → x = ⊤

name: rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg
statement: theorem rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (h : x ≠ ⊤) : x ^ y ≠ ⊤

name: rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg'
statement: theorem rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg' {y : ℝ} {x : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : 0 < x) (hx' : x ≠ ⊤) : x ^ y ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by simp [rpow_eq_top_iff, hx.ne', hx'] at h

name: rpow_lt_top_of_nonneg
statement: theorem rpow_lt_top_of_nonneg {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (h : x ≠ ⊤) : x ^ y < ⊤

name: rpow_ne_top_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem rpow_ne_top_of_ne_zero {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hx' : x ≠ ⊤) : x ^ y ≠ ⊤

name: rpow_add
statement: theorem rpow_add {x : ℝ≥0∞} (y z : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (h'x : x ≠ ⊤) : x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | top => exact (h'x rfl).elim
  | coe x =>
    have : x ≠ 0 := fun h => by simp [h] at hx
    simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero this, NNReal.rpow_add this]

name: rpow_add_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem rpow_add_of_nonneg {x : ℝ≥0∞} (y z : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  induction x using recTopCoe
  · rcases hy.eq_or_lt with rfl | hy
    · rw [rpow_zero, one_mul, zero_add]
    rcases hz.eq_or_lt with rfl | hz
    · rw [rpow_zero, mul_one, add_zero]
    simp [top_rpow_of_pos, hy, hz, add_pos hy hz]
  simp [← coe_rpow_of_nonneg, hy, hz, add_nonneg hy hz, NNReal.rpow_add_of_nonneg _ hy hz]

name: rpow_add_of_add_pos
statement:
lemma rpow_add_of_add_pos {x : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : x ≠ ⊤) (y z : ℝ) (hyz : 0 < y + z) :
    x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain (rfl | hx') := eq_or_ne x 0
  · by_cases hy' : 0 < y
    · simp [ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hyz, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hy']
    · have hz' : 0 < z := by linarith
      simp [ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hyz, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hz']
  · rw [ENNReal.rpow_add _ _ hx' hx]

name: rpow_neg
statement: theorem rpow_neg (x : ℝ≥0∞) (y : ℝ) : x ^ (-y) = (x ^ y)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | top =>
    rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (H | H | H) <;>
      simp [top_rpow_of_pos, top_rpow_of_neg, H, neg_pos.mpr]
  | coe x =>
    by_cases h : x = 0
    · rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (H | H | H) <;>
        simp [h, zero_rpow_of_pos, zero_rpow_of_neg, H, neg_pos.mpr]
    · have A : x ^ y ≠ 0 := by simp [h]
      simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero h, ← coe_inv A, NNReal.rpow_neg]

name: rpow_sub
statement: theorem rpow_sub {x : ℝ≥0∞} (y z : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (h'x : x ≠ ⊤) : x ^ (y - z) = x ^ y / x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, rpow_add _ _ hx h'x, rpow_neg, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: rpow_neg_one
statement: theorem rpow_neg_one (x : ℝ≥0∞) : x ^ (-1 : ℝ) = x⁻¹

name: rpow_mul
statement: theorem rpow_mul (x : ℝ≥0∞) (y z : ℝ) : x ^ (y * z) = (x ^ y) ^ z
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | top =>
    rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (Hy | Hy | Hy) <;>
        rcases lt_trichotomy z 0 with (Hz | Hz | Hz) <;>
      simp [Hy, Hz, zero_rpow_of_neg, zero_rpow_of_pos, top_rpow_of_neg, top_rpow_of_pos,
        mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg, mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos, mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg]
  | coe x =>
    by_cases h : x = 0
    · rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (Hy | Hy | Hy) <;>
          rcases lt_trichotomy z 0 with (Hz | Hz | Hz) <;>
        simp [h, Hy, Hz, zero_rpow_of_neg, zero_rpow_of_pos, top_rpow_of_neg, top_rpow_of_pos,
          mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg, mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos, mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg]
    · have : x ^ y ≠ 0 := by simp [h]
      simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero, h, this, NNReal.rpow_mul]

name: rpow_natCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem rpow_natCast (x : ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (n : ℝ) = x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  · cases n <;> simp [top_rpow_of_pos (Nat.cast_add_one_pos _), top_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)]
  · simp [← coe_rpow_of_nonneg _ (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]

name: rpow_ofNat
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_ofNat (x : ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :
    x ^ (ofNat(n) : ℝ) = x ^ (OfNat.ofNat n)

name: rpow_intCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma rpow_intCast (x : ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℤ) : x ^ (n : ℝ) = x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  cases n <;> simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, Int.cast_natCast, rpow_natCast, zpow_natCast,
    Int.cast_negSucc, rpow_neg, zpow_negSucc]

name: rpow_two
statement: theorem rpow_two (x : ℝ≥0∞) : x ^ (2 : ℝ) = x ^ 2

name: mul_rpow_eq_ite
statement:
theorem mul_rpow_eq_ite (x y : ℝ≥0∞) (z : ℝ) :
    (x * y) ^ z = if (x = 0 ∧ y = ⊤ ∨ x = ⊤ ∧ y = 0) ∧ z < 0 then ⊤ else x ^ z * y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne z 0 with (rfl | hz); · simp
  replace hz := hz.lt_or_gt
  wlog hxy : x ≤ y
  · convert! this y x z hz (le_of_not_ge hxy) using 2 <;> simp only [mul_comm, and_comm, or_comm]
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with (rfl | hx0)
  · induction y <;> rcases hz with hz | hz <;> simp [*, hz.not_gt]
  rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with (rfl | hy0)
  · exact (hx0 (bot_unique hxy)).elim
  induction x
  · rcases hz with hz | hz <;> simp [hz, top_unique hxy]
  induction y
  · rw [ne_eq, coe_eq_zero] at hx0
    rcases hz with hz | hz <;> simp [*]
  simp only [*]
  norm_cast at *
  rw [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hx0 hy0), NNReal.mul_rpow]
  norm_cast

name: mul_rpow_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem mul_rpow_of_ne_top {x y : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : x ≠ ⊤) (hy : y ≠ ⊤) (z : ℝ) :
    (x * y) ^ z = x ^ z * y ^ z

name: coe_mul_rpow
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem coe_mul_rpow (x y : ℝ≥0) (z : ℝ) : ((x : ℝ≥0∞) * y) ^ z = (x : ℝ≥0∞) ^ z * (y : ℝ≥0∞) ^ z

name: prod_coe_rpow
statement:
theorem prod_coe_rpow {ι} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ≥0) (r : ℝ) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (f i : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r = ((∏ i ∈ s, f i : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert _ _ hi ih => simp_rw [prod_insert hi, ih, ← coe_mul_rpow, coe_mul]

name: mul_rpow_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mul_rpow_of_ne_zero {x y : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (z : ℝ) :
    (x * y) ^ z = x ^ z * y ^ z

name: mul_rpow_of_nonneg
statement: theorem mul_rpow_of_nonneg (x y : ℝ≥0∞) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) : (x * y) ^ z = x ^ z * y ^ z

name: prod_rpow_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem prod_rpow_of_ne_top {ι} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ ∞) (r : ℝ) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i ^ r = (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    have h2f : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ ∞ := fun i hi ↦ hf i <| mem_insert_of_mem hi
    rw [prod_insert hi, prod_insert hi, ih h2f, ← mul_rpow_of_ne_top <| hf i <| mem_insert_self ..]
    apply prod_ne_top h2f

name: prod_rpow_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem prod_rpow_of_nonneg {ι} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → ℝ≥0∞} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i ^ r = (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert _ _ hi ih => simp_rw [prod_insert hi, ih, ← mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ hr]

name: inv_rpow
statement: theorem inv_rpow (x : ℝ≥0∞) (y : ℝ) : x⁻¹ ^ y = (x ^ y)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with (rfl | hy); · simp only [rpow_zero, inv_one]
  replace hy := hy.lt_or_gt
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with (rfl | h0); · cases hy <;> simp [*]
  rcases eq_or_ne x ⊤ with (rfl | h_top); · cases hy <;> simp [*]
  apply ENNReal.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
  rw [← mul_rpow_of_ne_zero (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.2 h_top) h0, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel h0 h_top,
    one_rpow]

name: div_rpow_of_nonneg
statement: theorem div_rpow_of_nonneg (x y : ℝ≥0∞) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) : (x / y) ^ z = x ^ z / y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ hz, inv_rpow, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: strictMono_rpow_of_pos
statement: theorem strictMono_rpow_of_pos {z : ℝ} (h : 0 < z) : StrictMono fun x : ℝ≥0∞ => x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using ne_top_of_lt hxy
  rcases eq_or_ne y ∞ with (rfl | hy)
  · simp only [top_rpow_of_pos h, ← coe_rpow_of_nonneg _ h.le, coe_lt_top]
  · lift y to ℝ≥0 using hy
    simp only [← coe_rpow_of_nonneg _ h.le, NNReal.rpow_lt_rpow (coe_lt_coe.1 hxy) h, coe_lt_coe]

name: monotone_rpow_of_nonneg
statement: theorem monotone_rpow_of_nonneg {z : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ z) : Monotone fun x : ℝ≥0∞ => x ^ z
proof:
:=
  h.eq_or_lt.elim (fun h0 => h0 ▸ by simp only [rpow_zero, monotone_const]) fun h0 =>
    (strictMono_rpow_of_pos h0).monotone

name: orderIsoRpow_symm_apply
statement:
theorem orderIsoRpow_symm_apply (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    (orderIsoRpow y hy).symm = orderIsoRpow (1 / y) (one_div_pos.2 hy)

name: rpow_le_rpow
statement: @[gcongr] theorem rpow_le_rpow {x y : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (h₁ : x ≤ y) (h₂ : 0 ≤ z) : x ^ z ≤ y ^ z

name: rpow_lt_rpow
statement: @[gcongr] theorem rpow_lt_rpow {x y : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (h₁ : x < y) (h₂ : 0 < z) : x ^ z < y ^ z

name: rpow_le_rpow_iff
statement: theorem rpow_le_rpow_iff {x y : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z ≤ y ^ z ↔ x ≤ y

name: rpow_lt_rpow_iff
statement: theorem rpow_lt_rpow_iff {x y : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z < y ^ z ↔ x < y

name: max_rpow
statement: lemma max_rpow {x y : ℝ≥0∞} {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) : max x y ^ p = max (x ^ p) (y ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total x y with hxy | hxy
  · rw [max_eq_right hxy, max_eq_right (rpow_le_rpow hxy hp)]
  · rw [max_eq_left hxy, max_eq_left (rpow_le_rpow hxy hp)]

name: le_rpow_inv_iff
statement: theorem le_rpow_inv_iff {x y : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) : x ≤ y ^ z⁻¹ ↔ x ^ z ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← rpow_one x]
  nth_rw 1 [← @mul_inv_cancel₀ _ _ z hz.ne']
  rw [rpow_mul, @rpow_le_rpow_iff _ _ z⁻¹ (by simp [hz])]

name: rpow_inv_lt_iff
statement: theorem rpow_inv_lt_iff {x y : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z⁻¹ < y ↔ x < y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← not_le, le_rpow_inv_iff hz]

name: lt_rpow_inv_iff
statement: theorem lt_rpow_inv_iff {x y : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) : x < y ^ z⁻¹ ↔ x ^ z < y
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← rpow_one x]
  nth_rw 1 [← @mul_inv_cancel₀ _ _ z (ne_of_lt hz).symm]
  rw [rpow_mul, @rpow_lt_rpow_iff _ _ z⁻¹ (by simp [hz])]

name: rpow_inv_le_iff
statement: theorem rpow_inv_le_iff {x y : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z⁻¹ ≤ y ↔ x ≤ y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← ENNReal.rpow_one y]
  nth_rw 1 [← @mul_inv_cancel₀ _ _ z hz.ne.symm]
  rw [ENNReal.rpow_mul, ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow_iff (inv_pos.2 hz)]

name: rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y z : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hx' : x ≠ ⊤) (hyz : y < z) :
    x ^ y < x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using hx'
  rw [one_lt_coe_iff] at hx
  simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero (lt_trans zero_lt_one hx).ne',
    NNReal.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hx hyz]

name: rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le
statement:
@[gcongr] theorem rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y z : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hyz : y ≤ z) :
    x ^ y ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  · rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (Hy | Hy | Hy) <;>
    rcases lt_trichotomy z 0 with (Hz | Hz | Hz) <;>
    simp [Hy, Hz, top_rpow_of_neg, top_rpow_of_pos] <;>
    linarith
  · simp only [one_le_coe_iff] at hx
    simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hx)),
      NNReal.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx hyz]

name: rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt
statement:
theorem rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y z : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (hyz : z < y) :
    x ^ y < x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hx1 le_top)
  simp only [coe_lt_one_iff, coe_pos] at hx0 hx1
  simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hx0), NNReal.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt hx0 hx1 hyz]

name: rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge
statement:
theorem rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y z : ℝ} (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hyz : z ≤ y) :
    x ^ y ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hx1 coe_lt_top)
  by_cases h : x = 0
  · rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (Hy | Hy | Hy) <;>
    rcases lt_trichotomy z 0 with (Hz | Hz | Hz) <;>
    simp [Hy, Hz, h, zero_rpow_of_neg, zero_rpow_of_pos] <;>
    linarith
  · rw [coe_le_one_iff] at hx1
    simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero h,
      NNReal.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr h) hx1 hyz]

name: rpow_le_self_of_le_one
statement: theorem rpow_le_self_of_le_one {x : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 1) (h_one_le : 1 ≤ z) : x ^ z ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← ENNReal.rpow_one x]
  exact ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hx h_one_le

name: le_rpow_self_of_one_le
statement: theorem le_rpow_self_of_one_le {x : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (h_one_le : 1 ≤ z) : x ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← ENNReal.rpow_one x]
  exact ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx h_one_le

name: rpow_pos_of_nonneg
statement: theorem rpow_pos_of_nonneg {p : ℝ} {x : ℝ≥0∞} (hx_pos : 0 < x) (hp_nonneg : 0 ≤ p) : 0 < x ^ p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp_zero : p = 0
  · simp [hp_zero, zero_lt_one]
  · rw [← Ne] at hp_zero
    have hp_pos := lt_of_le_of_ne hp_nonneg hp_zero.symm
    rw [← zero_rpow_of_pos hp_pos]
    exact rpow_lt_rpow hx_pos hp_pos

name: rpow_pos
statement: theorem rpow_pos {p : ℝ} {x : ℝ≥0∞} (hx_pos : 0 < x) (hx_ne_top : x ≠ ⊤) : 0 < x ^ p
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge 0 p with hp_pos | hp_nonpos
  · exact rpow_pos_of_nonneg hx_pos (le_of_lt hp_pos)
  · rw [← neg_neg p, rpow_neg, ENNReal.inv_pos]
    exact rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg (Right.nonneg_neg_iff.mpr hp_nonpos) hx_ne_top

name: rpow_lt_one
statement: theorem rpow_lt_one {x : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hx : x < 1) (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z < 1
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hx le_top)
  simp only [coe_lt_one_iff] at hx
  simp [← coe_rpow_of_nonneg _ (le_of_lt hz), NNReal.rpow_lt_one hx hz]

name: rpow_le_one
statement: theorem rpow_le_one {x : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 1) (hz : 0 ≤ z) : x ^ z ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hx coe_lt_top)
  simp only [coe_le_one_iff] at hx
  simp [← coe_rpow_of_nonneg _ hz, NNReal.rpow_le_one hx hz]

name: rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg
statement: theorem rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg {x : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hz : z < 0) : x ^ z < 1
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  · simp [top_rpow_of_neg hz, zero_lt_one]
  · simp only [one_lt_coe_iff] at hx
    simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (lt_trans zero_lt_one hx)),
      NNReal.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg hx hz]

name: rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_neg
statement: theorem rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_neg {x : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hz : z < 0) : x ^ z ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  · simp [top_rpow_of_neg hz]
  · simp only [one_le_coe_iff] at hx
    simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hx)),
      NNReal.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hx (le_of_lt hz)]

name: one_lt_rpow
statement: theorem one_lt_rpow {x : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hz : 0 < z) : 1 < x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  · simp [top_rpow_of_pos hz]
  · simp only [one_lt_coe_iff] at hx
    simp [← coe_rpow_of_nonneg _ (le_of_lt hz), NNReal.one_lt_rpow hx hz]

name: one_le_rpow
statement: theorem one_le_rpow {x : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hz : 0 < z) : 1 ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  · simp [top_rpow_of_pos hz]
  · simp only [one_le_coe_iff] at hx
    simp [← coe_rpow_of_nonneg _ (le_of_lt hz), NNReal.one_le_rpow hx (le_of_lt hz)]

name: one_lt_rpow_of_pos_of_lt_one_of_neg
statement:
theorem one_lt_rpow_of_pos_of_lt_one_of_neg {x : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hx1 : 0 < x) (hx2 : x < 1)
    (hz : z < 0) : 1 < x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hx2 le_top)
  simp only [coe_lt_one_iff, coe_pos] at hx1 hx2 ⊢
  simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hx1), NNReal.one_lt_rpow_of_pos_of_lt_one_of_neg hx1 hx2 hz]

name: one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_neg
statement:
theorem one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_neg {x : ℝ≥0∞} {z : ℝ} (hx1 : 0 < x) (hx2 : x ≤ 1)
    (hz : z < 0) : 1 ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hx2 coe_lt_top)
  simp only [coe_le_one_iff, coe_pos] at hx1 hx2 ⊢
  simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hx1),
    NNReal.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hx1 hx2 (le_of_lt hz)]

name: toNNReal_rpow
statement: @[simp] lemma toNNReal_rpow (x : ℝ≥0∞) (z : ℝ) : (x ^ z).toNNReal = x.toNNReal ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy z 0 with (H | H | H)
  · cases x with
    | top => simp [H, ne_of_lt]
    | coe x =>
      by_cases hx : x = 0
      · simp [hx, H, ne_of_lt]
      · simp [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero hx]
  · simp [H]
  · cases x
    · simp [H, ne_of_gt]
    simp [← coe_rpow_of_nonneg _ (le_of_lt H)]

name: toReal_rpow
statement: theorem toReal_rpow (x : ℝ≥0∞) (z : ℝ) : x.toReal ^ z = (x ^ z).toReal

name: ofReal_rpow_of_pos
statement:
theorem ofReal_rpow_of_pos {x p : ℝ} (hx_pos : 0 < x) :
    ENNReal.ofReal x ^ p = ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ENNReal.ofReal]
  rw [← coe_rpow_of_ne_zero, coe_inj, Real.toNNReal_rpow_of_nonneg hx_pos.le]
  simp [hx_pos]

name: ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg {x p : ℝ} (hx_nonneg : 0 ≤ x) (hp_nonneg : 0 ≤ p) :
    ENNReal.ofReal x ^ p = ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · simp [hp0]
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · rw [← Ne] at hp0
    have hp_pos : 0 < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hp_nonneg hp0.symm
    simp [hx0, hp_pos, hp_pos.ne.symm]
  rw [← Ne] at hx0
  exact ofReal_rpow_of_pos (hx_nonneg.lt_of_ne hx0.symm)

name: rpow_rpow_inv
statement: @[simp] lemma rpow_rpow_inv {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x : ℝ≥0∞) : (x ^ y) ^ y⁻¹ = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hy, rpow_one]

name: rpow_inv_rpow
statement: @[simp] lemma rpow_inv_rpow {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x : ℝ≥0∞) : (x ^ y⁻¹) ^ y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hy, rpow_one]

name: rpow_rpow_inv_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_rpow_inv_eq_iff {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} : (x ^ y) ^ y⁻¹ = x ↔ y ≠ 0 ∨ x = 1

name: rpow_inv_rpow_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_inv_rpow_eq_iff {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} : (x ^ y⁻¹) ^ y = x ↔ y ≠ 0 ∨ x = 1

name: pow_rpow_inv_natCast
statement: lemma pow_rpow_inv_natCast {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (x : ℝ≥0∞) : (x ^ n) ^ (n⁻¹ : ℝ) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_natCast, ← rpow_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity), rpow_one]

name: rpow_inv_natCast_pow
statement: lemma rpow_inv_natCast_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (x : ℝ≥0∞) : (x ^ (n⁻¹ : ℝ)) ^ n = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_natCast, ← rpow_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), rpow_one]

name: rpow_natCast_mul
statement: lemma rpow_natCast_mul (x : ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) : x ^ (n * z) = (x ^ n) ^ z

name: rpow_mul_natCast
statement: lemma rpow_mul_natCast (x : ℝ≥0∞) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (y * n) = (x ^ y) ^ n

name: rpow_intCast_mul
statement: lemma rpow_intCast_mul (x : ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℤ) (z : ℝ) : x ^ (n * z) = (x ^ n) ^ z

name: rpow_mul_intCast
statement: lemma rpow_mul_intCast (x : ℝ≥0∞) (y : ℝ) (n : ℤ) : x ^ (y * n) = (x ^ y) ^ n

name: rpow_left_injective
statement: lemma rpow_left_injective {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : Injective fun y : ℝ≥0∞ ↦ y ^ x
proof:
:=
  HasLeftInverse.injective ⟨fun y ↦ y ^ x⁻¹, rpow_rpow_inv hx⟩

name: rpow_left_surjective
statement: theorem rpow_left_surjective {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : Function.Surjective fun y : ℝ≥0∞ => y ^ x
proof:
:=
  HasRightInverse.surjective ⟨fun y ↦ y ^ x⁻¹, rpow_inv_rpow hx⟩

name: rpow_left_bijective
statement: theorem rpow_left_bijective {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : Function.Bijective fun y : ℝ≥0∞ => y ^ x

name: _root_.Real.enorm_rpow_of_nonneg
statement:
lemma _root_.Real.enorm_rpow_of_nonneg {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    ‖x ^ y‖ₑ = ‖x‖ₑ ^ y
proof: := by simp [enorm, nnnorm_rpow_of_nonneg hx, coe_rpow_of_nonneg _ hy]

name: add_rpow_le_two_rpow_mul_rpow_add_rpow
statement:
lemma add_rpow_le_two_rpow_mul_rpow_add_rpow {p : ℝ} (a b : ℝ≥0∞) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    (a + b) ^ p ≤ 2 ^ p * (a ^ p + b ^ p)
proof:
:= calc
  (a + b) ^ p ≤ (2 * max a b) ^ p := by rw [two_mul]; gcongr <;> simp
  _ = 2 ^ p * (max a b) ^ p := mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ hp
  _ = 2 ^ p * max (a ^ p) (b ^ p) := by rw [max_rpow hp]
  _ ≤ 2 ^ p * (a ^ p + b ^ p) := by gcongr; apply max_le_add_of_nonneg <;> simp

name: IsNat.nnreal_rpow_eq_nnreal_pow
statement:
theorem IsNat.nnreal_rpow_eq_nnreal_pow {b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (h : IsNat b n) (a : ℝ≥0) :
    a ^ b = a ^ n

name: IsInt.nnreal_rpow_eq_inv_nnreal_pow
statement:
theorem IsInt.nnreal_rpow_eq_inv_nnreal_pow {b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (h : IsInt b (.negOfNat n)) (a : ℝ≥0) :
    a ^ b = (a ^ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.1, NNReal.rpow_intCast, Int.negOfNat_eq, zpow_neg, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast]

name: IsNat.nnreal_rpow_isNNRat
statement:
theorem IsNat.nnreal_rpow_isNNRat {a : ℝ≥0} {b : ℝ} {m n d r : ℕ} (ha : IsNat a m)
    (hb : IsNNRat b n d) (k : ℕ) (hr : r ^ d = k) (l : ℕ) (hm : m ^ n = l) (hkl : k = l) :
    IsNat (a ^ b) r
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha with ⟨rfl⟩
  constructor
  have : d ≠ 0 := mod_cast hb.den_nz
  rw [hb.to_eq rfl rfl, div_eq_mul_inv, NNReal.rpow_natCast_mul, ← Nat.cast_pow, hm, ← hkl, ← hr,
    Nat.cast_pow, NNReal.pow_rpow_inv_natCast]
  positivity

name: IsNNRat.nnreal_rpow_isNNRat
statement:
theorem IsNNRat.nnreal_rpow_isNNRat (a : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ) (na da : ℕ) (ha : IsNNRat a na da)
    (nr dr : ℕ) (hnum : IsNat ((na : ℝ≥0) ^ b) nr) (hden : IsNat ((da : ℝ≥0) ^ b) dr) :
    IsNNRat (a ^ b) nr dr
proof:
:= by
  suffices IsNNRat (nr / dr : ℝ≥0) nr dr by
    simpa [ha.to_eq, NNReal.div_rpow, hnum.1, hden.1]
  apply IsNNRat.of_raw
  simp [← hden.1, ha.den_nz]

name: nnreal_rpow_isRat_eq_inv_nnreal_rpow
statement:
theorem nnreal_rpow_isRat_eq_inv_nnreal_rpow (a : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ) (n d : ℕ)
    (hb : IsRat b (Int.negOfNat n) d) : a ^ b = (a⁻¹) ^ (n / d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [NNReal.inv_rpow, ← NNReal.rpow_neg, hb.neg_to_eq rfl rfl]

name: rpow_eq_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_eq_pow (x y : ℝ) : rpow x y = x ^ y

name: rpow_def
statement: theorem rpow_def (x y : ℝ) : x ^ y = ((x : ℂ) ^ (y : ℂ)).re

name: rpow_def_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem rpow_def_of_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) :
    x ^ y = if x = 0 then if y = 0 then 1 else 0 else exp (log x * y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rpow_def, Complex.cpow_def]; split_ifs <;>
  simp_all [(Complex.ofReal_log hx).symm, -Complex.ofReal_mul,
      (Complex.ofReal_mul _ _).symm, Complex.exp_ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_eq_zero]

name: rpow_def_of_pos
statement: theorem rpow_def_of_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y : ℝ) : x ^ y = exp (log x * y)

name: exp_mul
statement: theorem exp_mul (x y : ℝ) : exp (x * y) = exp x ^ y

name: rpow_intCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem rpow_intCast (x : ℝ) (n : ℤ) : x ^ (n : ℝ) = x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rpow_def, ← Complex.ofReal_zpow, Complex.cpow_intCast, Complex.ofReal_intCast,
    Complex.ofReal_re]

name: rpow_natCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem rpow_natCast (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (n : ℝ) = x ^ n
proof: := by simpa using rpow_intCast x n

name: rpow_neg_natCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem rpow_neg_natCast (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (-n : ℝ) = x ^ (-n : ℤ)

lemma rpow_ofNat (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_neg_ofNat (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] : x ^ (-ofNat(n) : ℝ) = x ^ (-ofNat(n) : ℤ)
