statement:
@[simp]
theorem exp_one_rpow (x : ℝ) : exp 1 ^ x = exp x

name: exp_one_pow
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_one_pow (n : ℕ) : exp 1 ^ n = exp n

name: rpow_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
statement: theorem rpow_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (hx : 0 ≤ x) : x ^ y = 0 ↔ x = 0 ∧ y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rpow_def_of_nonneg hx]
  split_ifs <;> simp [*, exp_ne_zero]

name: rpow_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_eq_zero (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : y ≠ 0) : x ^ y = 0 ↔ x = 0

name: rpow_ne_zero
statement: lemma rpow_ne_zero (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : y ≠ 0) : x ^ y ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0

name: rpow_def_of_neg
statement: theorem rpow_def_of_neg {x : ℝ} (hx : x < 0) (y : ℝ) : x ^ y = exp (log x * y) * cos (y * π)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_def, Complex.cpow_def, ite_eq_right]
  · have : Complex.log x * y = ↑(log (-x) * y) + ↑(y * π) * Complex.I := by
      simp only [Complex.log, Complex.norm_real, norm_eq_abs, abs_of_neg hx, log_neg_eq_log,
        Complex.arg_ofReal_of_neg hx, Complex.ofReal_mul]
      ring
    rw [this, Complex.exp_add_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ←
      Complex.ofReal_sin, mul_add, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Real.log_neg_eq_log]
    ring
  · rw [Complex.ofReal_eq_zero]
    exact ne_of_lt hx

name: rpow_def_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem rpow_def_of_nonpos {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 0) (y : ℝ) :
    x ^ y = if x = 0 then if y = 0 then 1 else 0 else exp (log x * y) * cos (y * π)
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · simp_all [rpow_def]
  · simp_all
  · exact rpow_def_of_neg (hx.lt_of_ne h) _

name: rpow_pos_of_pos
statement:
@[bound]
theorem rpow_pos_of_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y : ℝ) : 0 < x ^ y

name: rpow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_zero (x : ℝ) : x ^ (0 : ℝ) = 1

name: rpow_zero_pos
statement: theorem rpow_zero_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < x ^ (0 : ℝ)

name: pi_rpow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_rpow_zero {α : Type*} (f : α → ℝ) : f ^ (0 : ℝ) = 1

name: zero_rpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_rpow {x : ℝ} (h : x ≠ 0) : (0 : ℝ) ^ x = 0

name: zero_rpow_eq_iff
statement: theorem zero_rpow_eq_iff {x : ℝ} {a : ℝ} : 0 ^ x = a ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ a = 0 ∨ x = 0 ∧ a = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hyp
    simp only [rpow_def, Complex.ofReal_zero] at hyp
    by_cases h : x = 0
    · subst h
      simp only [Complex.one_re, Complex.ofReal_zero, Complex.cpow_zero] at hyp
      exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, hyp.symm⟩
    · rw [Complex.zero_cpow (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h)] at hyp
      exact Or.inl ⟨h, hyp.symm⟩
  · rintro (⟨h, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact zero_rpow h
    · exact rpow_zero _

name: eq_zero_rpow_iff
statement: theorem eq_zero_rpow_iff {x : ℝ} {a : ℝ} : a = 0 ^ x ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ a = 0 ∨ x = 0 ∧ a = 1

name: rpow_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_one (x : ℝ) : x ^ (1 : ℝ) = x

name: pi_rpow_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_rpow_one {α : Type*} (f : α → ℝ) : f ^ (1 : ℝ) = f

name: one_rpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_rpow (x : ℝ) : (1 : ℝ) ^ x = 1

name: zero_rpow_le_one
statement: theorem zero_rpow_le_one (x : ℝ) : (0 : ℝ) ^ x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : x = 0 <;> simp [h, zero_le_one]

name: zero_rpow_nonneg
statement: theorem zero_rpow_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ (0 : ℝ) ^ x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : x = 0 <;> simp [h, zero_le_one]

name: rpow_nonneg
statement:
@[bound]
theorem rpow_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) : 0 ≤ x ^ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_def_of_nonneg hx]; split_ifs <;>
    simp only [zero_le_one, le_refl, le_of_lt (exp_pos _)]

name: abs_rpow_of_nonneg
statement: theorem abs_rpow_of_nonneg {x y : ℝ} (hx_nonneg : 0 ≤ x) : |x ^ y| = |x| ^ y
proof:
:= by
  have h_rpow_nonneg : 0 ≤ x ^ y := Real.rpow_nonneg hx_nonneg _
  rw [abs_eq_self.mpr hx_nonneg, abs_eq_self.mpr h_rpow_nonneg]

name: abs_rpow_le_abs_rpow
statement:
@[bound]
theorem abs_rpow_le_abs_rpow (x y : ℝ) : |x ^ y| ≤ |x| ^ y
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 x with hx | hx
  · rw [abs_rpow_of_nonneg hx]
  · rw [abs_of_neg hx, rpow_def_of_neg hx, rpow_def_of_pos (neg_pos.2 hx), log_neg_eq_log, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos (exp_pos _)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (exp_pos _).le (abs_cos_le_one _)

name: abs_rpow_le_exp_log_mul
statement: theorem abs_rpow_le_exp_log_mul (x y : ℝ) : |x ^ y| ≤ exp (log x * y)
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_rpow_le_abs_rpow x y).trans ?_
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · by_cases hy : y = 0 <;> simp [hx, hy, zero_le_one]
  · rw [rpow_def_of_pos (abs_pos.2 hx), log_abs]

name: rpow_inv_log
statement: lemma rpow_inv_log (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x ≠ 1) : x ^ (log x)⁻¹ = exp 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_def_of_pos hx₀, mul_inv_cancel₀]
  exact log_ne_zero.2 ⟨hx₀.ne', hx₁, by bound⟩

name: rpow_inv_log_le_exp_one
statement: lemma rpow_inv_log_le_exp_one : x ^ (log x)⁻¹ ≤ exp 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ |x ^ (log x)⁻¹| := le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ |x| ^ (log x)⁻¹ := abs_rpow_le_abs_rpow ..
  rw [← log_abs]
  obtain hx | hx := (abs_nonneg x).eq_or_lt'
  · simp [hx]
  · rw [rpow_def_of_pos hx]
    gcongr
    exact mul_inv_le_one

name: norm_rpow_of_nonneg
statement: theorem norm_rpow_of_nonneg {x y : ℝ} (hx_nonneg : 0 ≤ x) : ‖x ^ y‖ = ‖x‖ ^ y

name: rpow_add
statement: theorem rpow_add (hx : 0 < x) (y z : ℝ) : x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rpow_def_of_pos hx, mul_add, exp_add]

name: rpow_add'
statement: theorem rpow_add' (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : y + z ≠ 0) : x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.eq_or_lt with (rfl | pos)
  · rw [zero_rpow h, zero_eq_mul]
    have : y ≠ 0 ∨ z ≠ 0 := not_and_or.1 fun ⟨hy, hz⟩ => h <| hy.symm ▸ hz.symm ▸ zero_add 0
    exact this.imp zero_rpow zero_rpow
  · exact rpow_add pos _ _

name: rpow_of_add_eq
statement: lemma rpow_of_add_eq (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hw : w ≠ 0) (h : y + z = w) : x ^ w = x ^ y * x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h, rpow_add' hx]; rwa [h]

name: rpow_add_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem rpow_add_of_nonneg (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rcases hy.eq_or_lt with (rfl | hy)
  · rw [zero_add, rpow_zero, one_mul]
  exact rpow_add' hx (ne_of_gt <| add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hy hz)

name: le_rpow_add
statement: theorem le_rpow_add {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y z : ℝ) : x ^ y * x ^ z ≤ x ^ (y + z)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_iff_eq_or_lt.1 hx with (H | pos)
  · by_cases h : y + z = 0
    · simp only [H.symm, h, rpow_zero]
      calc
        (0 : ℝ) ^ y * 0 ^ z ≤ 1 * 1 := by
          gcongr
          exacts [zero_rpow_nonneg z, zero_rpow_le_one y, zero_rpow_le_one z]
        _ = 1 := by simp
    · simp [rpow_add', ← H, h]
  · simp [rpow_add pos]

name: rpow_sum_of_pos
statement:
theorem rpow_sum_of_pos {ι : Type*} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (f : ι → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) :
    (a ^ ∑ x ∈ s, f x) = ∏ x ∈ s, a ^ f x
proof:
:=
  map_sum (⟨⟨fun (x : ℝ) => (a ^ x : ℝ), rpow_zero a⟩, rpow_add ha⟩ : ℝ →+ (Additive ℝ)) f s

name: rpow_sum_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem rpow_sum_of_nonneg {ι : Type*} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ f x) : (a ^ ∑ x ∈ s, f x) = ∏ x ∈ s, a ^ f x
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => rw [sum_empty, Finset.prod_empty, rpow_zero]
  | cons i s hi ihs =>
    rw [forall_mem_cons] at h
    rw [sum_cons, prod_cons, ← ihs h.2, rpow_add_of_nonneg ha h.1 (sum_nonneg h.2)]

name: rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow
statement: theorem rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow (x y : ℝ) : x ^ (-y) = x⁻¹ ^ y

name: rpow_neg
statement: theorem rpow_neg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) : x ^ (-y) = (x ^ y)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rpow_def_of_nonneg hx]; split_ifs <;> simp_all [exp_neg]

name: rpow_sub
statement: theorem rpow_sub {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y z : ℝ) : x ^ (y - z) = x ^ y / x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, rpow_add hx, rpow_neg (le_of_lt hx), div_eq_mul_inv]

name: rpow_sub'
statement: theorem rpow_sub' {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) {y z : ℝ} (h : y - z ≠ 0) : x ^ (y - z) = x ^ y / x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg] at h ⊢
  simp only [rpow_add' hx h, rpow_neg hx, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: _root_.HasCompactSupport.rpow_const
statement:
protected theorem _root_.HasCompactSupport.rpow_const {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {f : α → ℝ}
    (hf : HasCompactSupport f) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) : HasCompactSupport (fun x ↦ f x ^ r)

name: ofReal_cpow
statement: theorem ofReal_cpow {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) : ((x ^ y : ℝ) : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) ^ (y : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Real.rpow_def_of_nonneg hx, Complex.cpow_def, ofReal_eq_zero]; split_ifs <;>
    simp [Complex.ofReal_log hx]

name: ofReal_cpow_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem ofReal_cpow_of_nonpos {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 0) (y : ℂ) :
    (x : ℂ) ^ y = (-x : ℂ) ^ y * exp (π * I * y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.eq_or_lt with (rfl | hlt)
  · rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with (rfl | hy) <;> simp [*]
  have hne : (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hlt.ne
  rw [cpow_def_of_ne_zero hne, cpow_def_of_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.2 hne), ← exp_add, ← add_mul, log,
    log, norm_neg, arg_ofReal_of_neg hlt, ← ofReal_neg, arg_ofReal_of_nonneg (neg_nonneg.2 hx),
    ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]

name: cpow_ofReal
statement:
lemma cpow_ofReal (x : ℂ) (y : ℝ) :
    x ^ (y : ℂ) = ↑(‖x‖ ^ y) * (Real.cos (arg x * y) + Real.sin (arg x * y) * I)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · simp [ofReal_cpow le_rfl]
  · rw [cpow_def_of_ne_zero hx, exp_eq_exp_re_mul_sin_add_cos, mul_comm (log x)]
    norm_cast
    rw [re_ofReal_mul, im_ofReal_mul, log_re, log_im, mul_comm y, mul_comm y, Real.exp_mul,
      Real.exp_log]
    rwa [norm_pos_iff]

name: cpow_ofReal_re
statement: lemma cpow_ofReal_re (x : ℂ) (y : ℝ) : (x ^ (y : ℂ)).re = ‖x‖ ^ y * Real.cos (arg x * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cpow_ofReal]; generalize arg x * y = z; simp [Real.cos]

name: cpow_ofReal_im
statement: lemma cpow_ofReal_im (x : ℂ) (y : ℝ) : (x ^ (y : ℂ)).im = ‖x‖ ^ y * Real.sin (arg x * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cpow_ofReal]; generalize arg x * y = z; simp [Real.sin]

name: norm_cpow_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem norm_cpow_of_ne_zero {z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 0) (w : ℂ) :
    ‖z ^ w‖ = ‖z‖ ^ w.re / Real.exp (arg z * im w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cpow_def_of_ne_zero hz, norm_exp, mul_re, log_re, log_im, Real.exp_sub,
    Real.rpow_def_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz)]

name: norm_cpow_of_imp
statement:
theorem norm_cpow_of_imp {z w : ℂ} (h : z = 0 → w.re = 0 → w = 0) :
    ‖z ^ w‖ = ‖z‖ ^ w.re / Real.exp (arg z * im w)
proof:
:= by
  rcases ne_or_eq z 0 with (hz | rfl) <;> [exact norm_cpow_of_ne_zero hz w; rw [norm_zero]]
  rcases eq_or_ne w.re 0 with hw | hw
  · simp [h rfl hw]
  · rw [Real.zero_rpow hw, zero_div, zero_cpow, norm_zero]
    exact ne_of_apply_ne re hw

name: norm_cpow_le
statement: theorem norm_cpow_le (z w : ℂ) : ‖z ^ w‖ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ w.re / Real.exp (arg z * im w)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : z = 0 → w.re = 0 → w = 0
  · exact (norm_cpow_of_imp h).le
  · simp [h]

name: norm_cpow_real
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_cpow_real (x : ℂ) (y : ℝ) : ‖x ^ (y : ℂ)‖ = ‖x‖ ^ y

name: norm_cpow_inv_nat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_cpow_inv_nat (x : ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ‖x ^ (n⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = ‖x‖ ^ (n⁻¹ : ℝ)

name: norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos
statement: theorem norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y : ℂ) : ‖(x : ℂ) ^ y‖ = x ^ y.re
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_cpow_of_ne_zero (ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hx.ne'), arg_ofReal_of_nonneg hx.le,
    zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, div_one, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hx.le]

name: norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) {y : ℂ} (hy : re y ≠ 0) :
    ‖(x : ℂ) ^ y‖ = x ^ re y

name: norm_ofReal_cpow_eventually_eq_atTop
statement:
lemma norm_ofReal_cpow_eventually_eq_atTop (c : ℂ) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ ‖(t : ℂ) ^ c‖) =ᶠ[atTop] fun t ↦ t ^ c.re
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with t ht
  rw [norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos ht]

name: norm_natCast_cpow_of_re_ne_zero
statement:
lemma norm_natCast_cpow_of_re_ne_zero (n : ℕ) {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re ≠ 0) :
    ‖(n : ℂ) ^ s‖ = (n : ℝ) ^ (s.re)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofReal_natCast, norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_nonneg n.cast_nonneg hs]

name: norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos
statement:
lemma norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (s : ℂ) :
    ‖(n : ℂ) ^ s‖ = (n : ℝ) ^ (s.re)

name: norm_natCast_cpow_pos_of_pos
statement: lemma norm_natCast_cpow_pos_of_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (s : ℂ) : 0 < ‖(n : ℂ) ^ s‖

name: cpow_mul_ofReal_nonneg
statement:
theorem cpow_mul_ofReal_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    (x : ℂ) ^ (↑y * z) = (↑(x ^ y) : ℂ) ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [cpow_mul, ofReal_cpow hx]
  · rw [← ofReal_log hx, ← ofReal_mul, ofReal_im, neg_lt_zero]; exact Real.pi_pos
  · rw [← ofReal_log hx, ← ofReal_mul, ofReal_im]; exact Real.pi_pos.le

name: rpow_mul
statement: theorem rpow_mul {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y z : ℝ) : x ^ (y * z) = (x ^ y) ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_inj, Complex.ofReal_cpow (rpow_nonneg hx _),
      Complex.ofReal_cpow hx, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.cpow_mul, Complex.ofReal_cpow hx] <;>
    simp only [(Complex.ofReal_mul _ _).symm, (Complex.ofReal_log hx).symm, Complex.ofReal_im,
      neg_lt_zero, pi_pos, le_of_lt pi_pos]

name: rpow_pow_comm
statement: lemma rpow_pow_comm {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (x ^ y) ^ n = (x ^ n) ^ y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← rpow_natCast, ← rpow_mul hx, mul_comm y]

name: rpow_zpow_comm
statement: lemma rpow_zpow_comm {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) (n : ℤ) : (x ^ y) ^ n = (x ^ n) ^ y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← rpow_intCast, ← rpow_mul hx, mul_comm y]

name: rpow_add_intCast
statement: lemma rpow_add_intCast {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) (n : ℤ) : x ^ (y + n) = x ^ y * x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_def, rpow_def, Complex.ofReal_add,
    Complex.cpow_add _ _ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hx), Complex.ofReal_intCast,
    Complex.cpow_intCast, ← Complex.ofReal_zpow, mul_comm, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, mul_comm]

name: rpow_add_natCast
statement: lemma rpow_add_natCast {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (y + n) = x ^ y * x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa using rpow_add_intCast hx y n

name: rpow_sub_intCast
statement: lemma rpow_sub_intCast {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) (n : ℤ) : x ^ (y - n) = x ^ y / x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! rpow_add_intCast hx y (-n)

name: rpow_sub_natCast
statement: lemma rpow_sub_natCast {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (y - n) = x ^ y / x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa using rpow_sub_intCast hx y n

name: rpow_add_intCast'
statement: lemma rpow_add_intCast' (hx : 0 ≤ x) {n : ℤ} (h : y + n ≠ 0) : x ^ (y + n) = x ^ y * x ^ n

name: rpow_add_natCast'
statement: lemma rpow_add_natCast' (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : y + n ≠ 0) : x ^ (y + n) = x ^ y * x ^ n

name: rpow_sub_intCast'
statement: lemma rpow_sub_intCast' (hx : 0 ≤ x) {n : ℤ} (h : y - n ≠ 0) : x ^ (y - n) = x ^ y / x ^ n

name: rpow_sub_natCast'
statement: lemma rpow_sub_natCast' (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : y - n ≠ 0) : x ^ (y - n) = x ^ y / x ^ n

name: rpow_add_one
statement: theorem rpow_add_one {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) : x ^ (y + 1) = x ^ y * x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using rpow_add_natCast hx y 1

name: rpow_sub_one
statement: theorem rpow_sub_one {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) : x ^ (y - 1) = x ^ y / x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using rpow_sub_natCast hx y 1

name: rpow_add_one'
statement: lemma rpow_add_one' (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : y + 1 ≠ 0) : x ^ (y + 1) = x ^ y * x

name: rpow_one_add'
statement: lemma rpow_one_add' (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : 1 + y ≠ 0) : x ^ (1 + y) = x * x ^ y

name: rpow_sub_one'
statement: lemma rpow_sub_one' (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : y - 1 ≠ 0) : x ^ (y - 1) = x ^ y / x

name: rpow_one_sub'
statement: lemma rpow_one_sub' (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : 1 - y ≠ 0) : x ^ (1 - y) = x / x ^ y

name: rpow_two
statement: theorem rpow_two (x : ℝ) : x ^ (2 : ℝ) = x ^ 2

name: rpow_neg_one
statement: theorem rpow_neg_one (x : ℝ) : x ^ (-1 : ℝ) = x⁻¹

name: mul_rpow
statement: theorem mul_rpow (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) : (x * y) ^ z = x ^ z * y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  iterate 2 rw [rpow_def_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; split_ifs with nz
  on_goal 4 =>
    rw [← Ne, mul_ne_zero_iff] at nz
    rw [log_mul nz.1 nz.2, add_mul, exp_add, rpow_def_of_pos (hx.lt_of_ne' nz.1),
      rpow_def_of_pos (hy.lt_of_ne' nz.2)]
  all_goals simp_all

name: inv_rpow
statement: theorem inv_rpow (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) : x⁻¹ ^ y = (x ^ y)⁻¹

name: div_rpow
statement: theorem div_rpow (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (z : ℝ) : (x / y) ^ z = x ^ z / y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_rpow hx (inv_nonneg.2 hy), inv_rpow hy]

name: log_rpow
statement: theorem log_rpow {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y : ℝ) : log (x ^ y) = y * log x
proof:
:= by
  apply exp_injective
  rw [exp_log (rpow_pos_of_pos hx y), ← exp_log hx, mul_comm, rpow_def_of_pos (exp_pos (log x)) y]

name: mul_log_eq_log_iff
statement:
theorem mul_log_eq_log_iff {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hz : 0 < z) :
    y * log x = log z ↔ x ^ y = z
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ log_injOn_pos (rpow_pos_of_pos hx _) hz <| log_rpow hx _ |>.trans h,
  by rintro rfl; rw [log_rpow hx]⟩

name: rpow_rpow_inv
statement: @[simp] lemma rpow_rpow_inv (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : y ≠ 0) : (x ^ y) ^ y⁻¹ = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_mul hx, mul_inv_cancel₀ hy, rpow_one]

name: rpow_inv_rpow
statement: @[simp] lemma rpow_inv_rpow (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : y ≠ 0) : (x ^ y⁻¹) ^ y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_mul hx, inv_mul_cancel₀ hy, rpow_one]

name: pow_rpow_inv_natCast
statement: theorem pow_rpow_inv_natCast (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hn : n ≠ 0) : (x ^ n) ^ (n⁻¹ : ℝ) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hn
  rw [← rpow_natCast, ← rpow_mul hx, mul_inv_cancel₀ hn0, rpow_one]

name: rpow_inv_natCast_pow
statement: theorem rpow_inv_natCast_pow (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hn : n ≠ 0) : (x ^ (n⁻¹ : ℝ)) ^ n = x
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hn
  rw [← rpow_natCast, ← rpow_mul hx, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn0, rpow_one]

name: rpow_natCast_mul
statement: lemma rpow_natCast_mul (hx : 0 ≤ x) (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) : x ^ (n * z) = (x ^ n) ^ z

name: rpow_mul_natCast
statement: lemma rpow_mul_natCast (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (y * n) = (x ^ y) ^ n

name: rpow_intCast_mul
statement: lemma rpow_intCast_mul (hx : 0 ≤ x) (n : ℤ) (z : ℝ) : x ^ (n * z) = (x ^ n) ^ z

name: rpow_mul_intCast
statement: lemma rpow_mul_intCast (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y : ℝ) (n : ℤ) : x ^ (y * n) = (x ^ y) ^ n

name: rpow_lt_rpow
statement:
@[gcongr, bound]
theorem rpow_lt_rpow (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxy : x < y) (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z < y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_eq_or_lt] at hx; rcases hx with hx | hx
  · rw [← hx, zero_rpow (ne_of_gt hz)]
    exact rpow_pos_of_pos (by rwa [← hx] at hxy) _
  · rw [rpow_def_of_pos hx, rpow_def_of_pos (lt_trans hx hxy), exp_lt_exp]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (log_lt_log hx hxy) hz

name: strictMonoOn_rpow_Ici_of_exponent_pos
statement:
theorem strictMonoOn_rpow_Ici_of_exponent_pos {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    StrictMonoOn (fun (x : ℝ) => x ^ r) (Set.Ici 0)
proof:
:=
  fun _ ha _ _ hab => rpow_lt_rpow ha hab hr

name: rpow_le_rpow
statement:
@[gcongr, bound]
theorem rpow_le_rpow {x y z : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ x) (h₁ : x ≤ y) (h₂ : 0 ≤ z) : x ^ z ≤ y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h₁ with (rfl | h₁'); · rfl
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h₂ with (rfl | h₂'); · simp
  exact le_of_lt (rpow_lt_rpow h h₁' h₂')

name: monotoneOn_rpow_Ici_of_exponent_nonneg
statement:
theorem monotoneOn_rpow_Ici_of_exponent_nonneg {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    MonotoneOn (fun (x : ℝ) => x ^ r) (Set.Ici 0)
proof:
:=
  fun _ ha _ _ hab => rpow_le_rpow ha hab hr

name: rpow_lt_rpow_of_neg
statement: lemma rpow_lt_rpow_of_neg (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x < y) (hz : z < 0) : y ^ z < x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  have := hx.trans hxy
  rw [← inv_lt_inv₀, ← rpow_neg, ← rpow_neg]
  on_goal 1 => refine rpow_lt_rpow ?_ hxy (neg_pos.2 hz)
  all_goals positivity

name: rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos
statement: lemma rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x ≤ y) (hz : z ≤ 0) : y ^ z ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  have := hx.trans_le hxy
  rw [← inv_le_inv₀, ← rpow_neg, ← rpow_neg]
  on_goal 1 => refine rpow_le_rpow ?_ hxy (neg_nonneg.2 hz)
  all_goals positivity

name: rpow_lt_rpow_iff
statement: theorem rpow_lt_rpow_iff (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z < y ^ z ↔ x < y
proof:
:=
  ⟨lt_imp_lt_of_le_imp_le fun h ↦ by gcongr, fun h ↦ by gcongr⟩

name: rpow_le_rpow_iff
statement: theorem rpow_le_rpow_iff (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z ≤ y ^ z ↔ x ≤ y

name: rpow_lt_rpow_iff_of_neg
statement: lemma rpow_lt_rpow_iff_of_neg (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : z < 0) : x ^ z < y ^ z ↔ y < x
proof:
:=
  ⟨lt_imp_lt_of_le_imp_le fun h ↦ rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hx h hz.le,
    fun h ↦ rpow_lt_rpow_of_neg hy h hz⟩

name: rpow_le_rpow_iff_of_neg
statement: lemma rpow_le_rpow_iff_of_neg (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : z < 0) : x ^ z ≤ y ^ z ↔ y ≤ x

name: le_rpow_inv_iff_of_pos
statement: lemma le_rpow_inv_iff_of_pos (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 < z) : x ≤ y ^ z⁻¹ ↔ x ^ z ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_le_rpow_iff hx _ hz, rpow_inv_rpow] <;> positivity

name: rpow_inv_le_iff_of_pos
statement: lemma rpow_inv_le_iff_of_pos (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z⁻¹ ≤ y ↔ x ≤ y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_le_rpow_iff _ hy hz, rpow_inv_rpow] <;> positivity

name: lt_rpow_inv_iff_of_pos
statement: lemma lt_rpow_inv_iff_of_pos (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 < z) : x < y ^ z⁻¹ ↔ x ^ z < y

name: rpow_inv_lt_iff_of_pos
statement: lemma rpow_inv_lt_iff_of_pos (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z⁻¹ < y ↔ x < y ^ z

name: le_rpow_inv_iff_of_neg
statement:
theorem le_rpow_inv_iff_of_neg (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : z < 0) :
    x ≤ y ^ z⁻¹ ↔ y ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_le_rpow_iff_of_neg _ hx hz, rpow_inv_rpow _ hz.ne] <;> positivity

name: lt_rpow_inv_iff_of_neg
statement:
theorem lt_rpow_inv_iff_of_neg (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : z < 0) :
    x < y ^ z⁻¹ ↔ y < x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_lt_rpow_iff_of_neg _ hx hz, rpow_inv_rpow _ hz.ne] <;> positivity

name: rpow_inv_lt_iff_of_neg
statement:
theorem rpow_inv_lt_iff_of_neg (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : z < 0) :
    x ^ z⁻¹ < y ↔ y ^ z < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_lt_rpow_iff_of_neg hy _ hz, rpow_inv_rpow _ hz.ne] <;> positivity

name: rpow_inv_le_iff_of_neg
statement:
theorem rpow_inv_le_iff_of_neg (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : z < 0) :
    x ^ z⁻¹ ≤ y ↔ y ^ z ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_le_rpow_iff_of_neg hy _ hz, rpow_inv_rpow _ hz.ne] <;> positivity

name: rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt
statement: theorem rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (hx : 1 < x) (hyz : y < z) : x ^ y < x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  repeat' rw [rpow_def_of_pos (lt_trans zero_lt_one hx)]
  rw [exp_lt_exp]; exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hyz (log_pos hx)

name: rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hyz : y ≤ z) : x ^ y ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  repeat' rw [rpow_def_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hx)]
  rw [exp_le_exp]; gcongr; exact log_nonneg hx

name: strictAntiOn_rpow_Ioi_of_exponent_neg
statement:
theorem strictAntiOn_rpow_Ioi_of_exponent_neg {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 0) :
    StrictAntiOn (fun (x : ℝ) => x ^ r) (Set.Ioi 0)
proof:
:=
  fun _ ha _ _ hab => rpow_lt_rpow_of_neg ha hab hr

name: antitoneOn_rpow_Ioi_of_exponent_nonpos
statement:
theorem antitoneOn_rpow_Ioi_of_exponent_nonpos {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≤ 0) :
    AntitoneOn (fun (x : ℝ) => x ^ r) (Set.Ioi 0)
proof:
:=
  fun _ ha _ _ hab => rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos ha hab hr

name: rpow_le_rpow_left_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_le_rpow_left_iff (hx : 1 < x) : x ^ y ≤ x ^ z ↔ y ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  have x_pos : 0 < x := lt_trans zero_lt_one hx
  rw [← log_le_log_iff (rpow_pos_of_pos x_pos y) (rpow_pos_of_pos x_pos z), log_rpow x_pos,
    log_rpow x_pos, mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (log_pos hx)]

name: rpow_lt_rpow_left_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_lt_rpow_left_iff (hx : 1 < x) : x ^ y < x ^ z ↔ y < z

name: rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt
statement: theorem rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (hyz : z < y) : x ^ y < x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  repeat' rw [rpow_def_of_pos hx0]
  rw [exp_lt_exp]; exact mul_lt_mul_of_neg_left hyz (log_neg hx0 hx1)

name: rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge
statement: theorem rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hyz : z ≤ y) : x ^ y ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  repeat' rw [rpow_def_of_pos hx0]
  rw [exp_le_exp]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hyz (log_nonpos (le_of_lt hx0) hx1)

name: rpow_le_rpow_left_iff_of_base_lt_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_le_rpow_left_iff_of_base_lt_one (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
    x ^ y ≤ x ^ z ↔ z ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← log_le_log_iff (rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 y) (rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 z), log_rpow hx0, log_rpow hx0,
    mul_le_mul_right_of_neg (log_neg hx0 hx1)]

name: rpow_lt_rpow_left_iff_of_base_lt_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_lt_rpow_left_iff_of_base_lt_one (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
    x ^ y < x ^ z ↔ z < y
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_not_ge, rpow_le_rpow_left_iff_of_base_lt_one hx0 hx1, lt_iff_not_ge]

name: rpow_lt_one
statement: theorem rpow_lt_one {x z : ℝ} (hx1 : 0 ≤ x) (hx2 : x < 1) (hz : 0 < z) : x ^ z < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_rpow z]
  exact rpow_lt_rpow hx1 hx2 hz

name: rpow_le_one
statement: theorem rpow_le_one {x z : ℝ} (hx1 : 0 ≤ x) (hx2 : x ≤ 1) (hz : 0 ≤ z) : x ^ z ≤ 1

name: rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg
statement: theorem rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg {x z : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hz : z < 0) : x ^ z < 1
proof:
:= by
  convert! rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hx hz
  exact (rpow_zero x).symm

name: rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos
statement: theorem rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos {x z : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hz : z ≤ 0) : x ^ z ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  convert! rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx hz
  exact (rpow_zero x).symm

name: one_lt_rpow
statement: theorem one_lt_rpow {x z : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hz : 0 < z) : 1 < x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_rpow z]
  exact rpow_lt_rpow zero_le_one hx hz

name: one_le_rpow
statement: theorem one_le_rpow {x z : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hz : 0 ≤ z) : 1 ≤ x ^ z

name: one_lt_rpow_of_pos_of_lt_one_of_neg
statement:
theorem one_lt_rpow_of_pos_of_lt_one_of_neg (hx1 : 0 < x) (hx2 : x < 1) (hz : z < 0) :
    1 < x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  convert! rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt hx1 hx2 hz
  exact (rpow_zero x).symm

name: one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos (hx1 : 0 < x) (hx2 : x ≤ 1) (hz : z ≤ 0) :
    1 ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  convert! rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hx1 hx2 hz
  exact (rpow_zero x).symm

name: rpow_lt_one_iff_of_pos
statement: theorem rpow_lt_one_iff_of_pos (hx : 0 < x) : x ^ y < 1 ↔ 1 < x ∧ y < 0 ∨ x < 1 ∧ 0 < y
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_def_of_pos hx, exp_lt_one_iff, mul_neg_iff, log_pos_iff hx.le, log_neg_iff hx]

name: rpow_lt_one_iff
statement:
theorem rpow_lt_one_iff (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    x ^ y < 1 ↔ x = 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∨ 1 < x ∧ y < 0 ∨ x < 1 ∧ 0 < y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.eq_or_lt with (rfl | hx)
  · rcases _root_.em (y = 0) with (rfl | hy) <;> simp [*, zero_lt_one]
  · simp [rpow_lt_one_iff_of_pos hx, hx.ne.symm]

name: rpow_lt_one_iff'
statement:
theorem rpow_lt_one_iff' {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    x ^ y < 1 ↔ x < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.rpow_lt_rpow_iff hx zero_le_one hy, Real.one_rpow]

name: one_lt_rpow_iff_of_pos
statement: theorem one_lt_rpow_iff_of_pos (hx : 0 < x) : 1 < x ^ y ↔ 1 < x ∧ 0 < y ∨ x < 1 ∧ y < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_def_of_pos hx, one_lt_exp_iff, mul_pos_iff, log_pos_iff hx.le, log_neg_iff hx]

name: one_lt_rpow_iff
statement: theorem one_lt_rpow_iff (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 1 < x ^ y ↔ 1 < x ∧ 0 < y ∨ 0 < x ∧ x < 1 ∧ y < 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.eq_or_lt with (rfl | hx)
  · rcases _root_.em (y = 0) with (rfl | hy) <;> simp [*, (zero_lt_one' ℝ).not_gt]
  · simp [one_lt_rpow_iff_of_pos hx, hx]

name: rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge_of_imp
statement:
theorem rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge_of_imp (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hyz : z ≤ y)
    (h : x = 0 → y = 0 → z = 0) :
    x ^ y ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx0 with (rfl | hx0')
  · rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with rfl | hy0
    · rw [h rfl rfl]
    · rw [zero_rpow hy0]
      apply zero_rpow_nonneg
  · exact rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hx0' hx1 hyz

name: rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge'
statement:
theorem rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hyz : z ≤ y) :
    x ^ y ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:=
  rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge_of_imp hx0 hx1 hyz fun _ hy ↦ le_antisymm (hyz.trans_eq hy) hz

name: rpow_max
statement:
lemma rpow_max {x y p : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    (max x y) ^ p = max (x ^ p) (y ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total x y with hxy | hxy
  · rw [max_eq_right hxy, max_eq_right (by gcongr)]
  · rw [max_eq_left hxy, max_eq_left (by gcongr)]

name: self_le_rpow_of_le_one
statement: theorem self_le_rpow_of_le_one (h₁ : 0 ≤ x) (h₂ : x ≤ 1) (h₃ : y ≤ 1) : x ≤ x ^ y

name: self_le_rpow_of_one_le
statement: theorem self_le_rpow_of_one_le (h₁ : 1 ≤ x) (h₂ : 1 ≤ y) : x ≤ x ^ y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rpow_one] using rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h₁ h₂

name: rpow_le_self_of_le_one
statement: theorem rpow_le_self_of_le_one (h₁ : 0 ≤ x) (h₂ : x ≤ 1) (h₃ : 1 ≤ y) : x ^ y ≤ x

name: rpow_le_self_of_one_le
statement: theorem rpow_le_self_of_one_le (h₁ : 1 ≤ x) (h₂ : y ≤ 1) : x ^ y ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rpow_one] using rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h₁ h₂

name: self_lt_rpow_of_lt_one
statement: theorem self_lt_rpow_of_lt_one (h₁ : 0 < x) (h₂ : x < 1) (h₃ : y < 1) : x < x ^ y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rpow_one] using rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt h₁ h₂ h₃

name: self_lt_rpow_of_one_lt
statement: theorem self_lt_rpow_of_one_lt (h₁ : 1 < x) (h₂ : 1 < y) : x < x ^ y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rpow_one] using rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt h₁ h₂

name: rpow_lt_self_of_lt_one
statement: theorem rpow_lt_self_of_lt_one (h₁ : 0 < x) (h₂ : x < 1) (h₃ : 1 < y) : x ^ y < x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rpow_one] using rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt h₁ h₂ h₃

name: rpow_lt_self_of_one_lt
statement: theorem rpow_lt_self_of_one_lt (h₁ : 1 < x) (h₂ : y < 1) : x ^ y < x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rpow_one] using rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt h₁ h₂

name: rpow_left_injOn
statement: theorem rpow_left_injOn {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : InjOn (fun y : ℝ => y ^ x) { y : ℝ | 0 ≤ y }
proof:
:= by
  rintro y hy z hz (hyz : y ^ x = z ^ x)
  rw [← rpow_one y, ← rpow_one z, ← mul_inv_cancel₀ hx, rpow_mul hy, rpow_mul hz, hyz]

:= by
  rw [← rpow_left_inj _ hy hz, rpow_inv_rpow hx hz]; positivity

statement: theorem rpow_le_one_iff_of_pos (hx : 0 < x) : x ^ y ≤ 1 ↔ 1 ≤ x ∧ y ≤ 0 ∨ x ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_def_of_pos hx, exp_le_one_iff, mul_nonpos_iff, log_nonneg_iff hx, log_nonpos_iff hx.le]

name: abs_log_mul_self_rpow_lt
statement:
theorem abs_log_mul_self_rpow_lt (x t : ℝ) (h1 : 0 < x) (h2 : x ≤ 1) (ht : 0 < t) :
    |log x * x ^ t| < 1 / t
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ ht]
  have := abs_log_mul_self_lt (x ^ t) (rpow_pos_of_pos h1 t) (rpow_le_one h1.le h2 ht.le)
  rwa [log_rpow h1, mul_assoc, abs_mul, abs_of_pos ht, mul_comm] at this

name: log_le_rpow_div
statement: lemma log_le_rpow_div {x ε : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hε : 0 < ε) : log x ≤ x ^ ε / ε
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.eq_or_lt with rfl | h
  · rw [log_zero, zero_rpow hε.ne', zero_div]
  rw [le_div_iff₀' hε]
  exact (log_rpow h ε).symm.trans_le <| (log_le_sub_one_of_pos <| rpow_pos_of_pos h ε).trans
    (sub_one_lt _).le

name: strictMono_rpow_of_base_gt_one
statement:
lemma strictMono_rpow_of_base_gt_one {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    StrictMono (b ^ · : ℝ → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (zero_lt_one.trans hb)]
  exact exp_strictMono.comp <| StrictMono.const_mul strictMono_id <| Real.log_pos hb

name: monotone_rpow_of_base_ge_one
statement:
lemma monotone_rpow_of_base_ge_one {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    Monotone (b ^ · : ℝ → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hb with hb | rfl
  case inl => exact (strictMono_rpow_of_base_gt_one hb).monotone
  case inr => intro _ _ _; simp

name: strictAnti_rpow_of_base_lt_one
statement:
lemma strictAnti_rpow_of_base_lt_one {b : ℝ} (hb₀ : 0 < b) (hb₁ : b < 1) :

proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hb₀]
  exact exp_strictMono.comp_strictAnti <| StrictMono.const_mul_of_neg strictMono_id
      <| Real.log_neg hb₀ hb₁

proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hb₁ with hb₁ | rfl
  case inl => exact (strictAnti_rpow_of_base_lt_one hb₀ hb₁).antitone
  case inr => intro _ _ _; simp

name: rpow_right_inj
statement: lemma rpow_right_inj (hx₀ : 0 < x) (hx₁ : x ≠ 1) : x ^ y = x ^ z ↔ y = z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun H ↦ by rw [H]⟩
  rcases hx₁.lt_or_gt with h | h
  · exact (strictAnti_rpow_of_base_lt_one hx₀ h).injective H
  · exact (strictMono_rpow_of_base_gt_one h).injective H

name: rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le_or_ge
statement:
@[bound] lemma rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le_or_ge {x y z : ℝ}
    (h : 1 ≤ x ∧ y ≤ z ∨ 0 < x ∧ x ≤ 1 ∧ z ≤ y) : x ^ y ≤ x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨x1, yz⟩ | ⟨x0, x1, zy⟩
  · exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le x1 yz
  · exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge x0 x1 zy

name: norm_prime_cpow_le_one_half
statement:
lemma norm_prime_cpow_le_one_half (p : Nat.Primes) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    ‖(p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_natCast_cpow_of_re_ne_zero p <| by rw [neg_re]; linarith only [hs]]
  refine (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos zero_lt_two (Nat.cast_le.mpr p.prop.two_le) <|
    by rw [neg_re]; linarith only [hs]).trans ?_
  rw [one_div, ← Real.rpow_neg_one]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le one_le_two <| (neg_lt_neg hs).le

name: one_sub_prime_cpow_ne_zero
statement:
lemma one_sub_prime_cpow_ne_zero {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    1 - (p : ℂ) ^ (-s) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine sub_ne_zero_of_ne fun H ↦ ?_
  have := norm_prime_cpow_le_one_half ⟨p, hp⟩ hs
  simp only at this
  rw [← H, norm_one] at this
  norm_num at this

name: norm_natCast_cpow_le_norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos hn]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by exact_mod_cast hn) h

statement:
lemma norm_natCast_cpow_le_norm_natCast_cpow_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) {w z : ℂ} :
    ‖(n : ℂ) ^ w‖ ≤ ‖(n : ℂ) ^ z‖ ↔ w.re ≤ z.re

name: norm_log_natCast_le_rpow_div
statement: lemma norm_log_natCast_le_rpow_div (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ‖log n‖ ≤ n ^ ε / ε
proof:
:= by
  rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | h
  · rw [Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_zero, log_zero, norm_zero, Real.zero_rpow hε.ne', zero_div]
  rw [← natCast_log, norm_real, norm_of_nonneg <| Real.log_nonneg <| by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_of_lt h.lt]
  exact Real.log_natCast_le_rpow_div n hε

name: sqrt_eq_rpow
statement: theorem sqrt_eq_rpow (x : ℝ) : √x = x ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := le_or_gt 0 x
  · rw [← mul_self_inj_of_nonneg (sqrt_nonneg _) (rpow_nonneg h _), mul_self_sqrt h, ← sq,
      ← rpow_natCast, ← rpow_mul h]
    simp
  · have : 1 / (2 : ℝ) * π = π / (2 : ℝ) := by ring
    rw [sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos h.le, rpow_def_of_neg h, this, cos_pi_div_two, mul_zero]

name: rpow_div_two_eq_sqrt
statement: theorem rpow_div_two_eq_sqrt {x : ℝ} (r : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : x ^ (r / 2) = √x ^ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqrt_eq_rpow, ← rpow_mul hx]
  congr
  ring

name: cpow_inv_two_re
statement: lemma cpow_inv_two_re (x : ℂ) : (x ^ (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).re = √((‖x‖ + x.re) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofReal_ofNat, ← ofReal_inv, cpow_ofReal_re, ← div_eq_mul_inv, ← one_div,
    ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, cos_half, ← sqrt_mul, ← mul_div_assoc, mul_add, mul_one, norm_mul_cos_arg]
  exacts [norm_nonneg _, (neg_pi_lt_arg _).le, arg_le_pi _]

name: cpow_inv_two_im_eq_sqrt
statement:
lemma cpow_inv_two_im_eq_sqrt {x : ℂ} (hx : 0 ≤ x.im) :
    (x ^ (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).im = √((‖x‖ - x.re) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofReal_ofNat, ← ofReal_inv, cpow_ofReal_im, ← div_eq_mul_inv, ← one_div,
    ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, sin_half_eq_sqrt, ← sqrt_mul (norm_nonneg _), ← mul_div_assoc, mul_sub,
    mul_one, norm_mul_cos_arg]
  · rwa [arg_nonneg_iff]
  · linarith [pi_pos, arg_le_pi x]

name: cpow_inv_two_im_eq_neg_sqrt
statement:
lemma cpow_inv_two_im_eq_neg_sqrt {x : ℂ} (hx : x.im < 0) :
    (x ^ (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).im = -√((‖x‖ - x.re) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofReal_ofNat, ← ofReal_inv, cpow_ofReal_im, ← div_eq_mul_inv, ← one_div,
    ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, sin_half_eq_neg_sqrt, mul_neg, ← sqrt_mul (norm_nonneg _),
    ← mul_div_assoc, mul_sub, mul_one, norm_mul_cos_arg]
  · linarith [pi_pos, neg_pi_lt_arg x]
  · exact (arg_neg_iff.2 hx).le

name: abs_cpow_inv_two_im
statement: lemma abs_cpow_inv_two_im (x : ℂ) : |(x ^ (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).im| = √((‖x‖ - x.re) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofReal_ofNat, ← ofReal_inv, cpow_ofReal_im, ← div_eq_mul_inv, ← one_div,
    ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sqrt_nonneg _), abs_sin_half,
    ← sqrt_mul (norm_nonneg _), ← mul_div_assoc, mul_sub, mul_one, norm_mul_cos_arg]

name: inv_natCast_cpow_ofReal_pos
statement:
lemma inv_natCast_cpow_ofReal_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    0 < ((n : ℂ) ^ (x : ℂ))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  refine RCLike.inv_pos_of_pos ?_
  rw [show (n : ℂ) ^ (x : ℂ) = (n : ℝ) ^ (x : ℂ) from rfl, ← ofReal_cpow n.cast_nonneg']
  positivity

statement: theorem IsNat.rpow_eq_pow {b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (h : IsNat b n) (a : ℝ) : a ^ b = a ^ n

statement:
theorem IsInt.rpow_eq_inv_pow {b : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (h : IsInt b (.negOfNat n)) (a : ℝ) :
    a ^ b = (a ^ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.1, Real.rpow_intCast, Int.negOfNat_eq, zpow_neg, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast]

name: IsNat.rpow_isNNRat
statement:
theorem IsNat.rpow_isNNRat {a b : ℝ} {m n d r : ℕ} (ha : IsNat a m) (hb : IsNNRat b n d)
    (k : ℕ) (hr : r ^ d = k) (l : ℕ) (hm : m ^ n = l) (hkl : k = l) : IsNat (a ^ b) r
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha with ⟨rfl⟩
  constructor
  have : d ≠ 0 := mod_cast hb.den_nz
  rw [hb.to_eq rfl rfl, div_eq_mul_inv, Real.rpow_natCast_mul, ← Nat.cast_pow, hm, ← hkl, ← hr,
    Nat.cast_pow, Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast] <;> positivity

name: IsNNRat.rpow_isNNRat
statement:
theorem IsNNRat.rpow_isNNRat (a b : ℝ) (na da : ℕ) (ha : IsNNRat a na da)
    (nr dr : ℕ) (hnum : IsNat ((na : ℝ) ^ b) nr) (hden : IsNat ((da : ℝ) ^ b) dr) :
    IsNNRat (a ^ b) nr dr
proof:
:= by
  suffices IsNNRat (nr / dr : ℝ) nr dr by
    simpa [ha.to_eq, Real.div_rpow, hnum.1, hden.1]
  apply IsNNRat.of_raw
  rw [← hden.1]
  apply (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos _ _).ne'
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne' da.cast_nonneg ha.den_nz

    a ^ b = (a⁻¹) ^ (n / d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow, hb.neg_to_eq rfl rfl]

name: mem_lattice
statement:
lemma mem_lattice {L : PeriodPair} {x : ℂ} :
    x ∈ L.lattice ↔ ∃ m n : ℤ, m * L.ω₁ + n * L.ω₂ = x

name: mul_
statement:
lemma mul_ω₁_add_mul_ω₂_mem_lattice {L : PeriodPair} {α β : ℚ} :
    α * L.ω₁ + β * L.ω₂ ∈ L.lattice ↔ α.den = 1 ∧ β.den = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨m, n, e⟩ := mem_lattice.mp H
    have := LinearIndependent.pair_iff.mp L.indep (m - α) (n - β)
      (by simp; linear_combination e)
    simp only [sub_eq_zero] at this
    norm_cast at this
    aesop
  · lift α to ℤ using h₁
    lift β to ℤ using h₂
    simp only [Rat.cast_intCast, ← zsmul_eq_mul]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ L.ω₁_mem_lattice)
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ L.ω₂_mem_lattice)

  rw [lattice, ← Set.image_univ, ← Finset.coe_univ, this]
  simp

  convert! Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range.symm using 1

name: hasSumLocallyUniformly_aux
statement:
lemma hasSumLocallyUniformly_aux (f : L.lattice → ℂ → ℂ)
    (u : ℝ → L.lattice → ℝ) (hu : ∀ r > 0, Summable (u r))
    (hf : ∀ r > 0, ∀ᶠ R in atTop, ∀ x, ‖x‖ < r → ∀ l : L.lattice, ‖l.1‖ = R → ‖f l x‖ ≤ u r l) :
    HasSumLocallyUniformly f (∑' j, f j ·)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasSumLocallyUniformly_iff_tendstoLocallyUniformly, tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff_filter]
  intro x
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩ : ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ 𝓝 x ≤ 𝓟 (Metric.ball 0 r) :=
    ⟨‖x‖ + 1, by positivity, Filter.le_principal_iff.mpr (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by simp))⟩
  refine .mono_right ?_ hr'
  rw [← tendstoUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformlyOnFilter]
  refine tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum_of_cofinite_eventually (hu r hr) ?_
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hf r hr)
  refine (isCompact_iff_finite.mp (isCompact_closedBall (0 : L.lattice) R)).subset ?_
  intros l hl
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ : ∃ x, ‖x‖ < r ∧ u r l < ‖f l x‖ := by simpa using hl
  simp only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  contrapose! hs'
  exact hR _ hs'.le _ hs _ rfl

name: weierstrassP_bound
statement:
lemma weierstrassP_bound (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (s : ℂ) (hs : ‖s‖ < r) (l : ℂ) (h : 2 * r ≤ ‖l‖) :
    ‖1 / (s - l) ^ 2 - 1 / l ^ 2‖ ≤ 10 * r * ‖l‖ ^ (-3 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have : s ≠ ↑l := by rintro rfl; linarith
  have : 0 < ‖l‖ := by linarith
  calc
    _ = ‖(↑l ^ 2 - (s - ↑l) ^ 2) / ((s - ↑l) ^ 2 * ↑l ^ 2)‖ := by
      rw [div_sub_div, one_mul, mul_one]
      · simpa [sub_eq_zero]
      · simpa
    _ = ‖l ^ 2 - (s - l) ^ 2‖ / (‖s - l‖ ^ 2 * ‖l‖ ^ 2) := by simp
    _ ≤ ‖l ^ 2 - (s - l) ^ 2‖ / ((‖l‖ / 2) ^ 2 * ‖l‖ ^ 2) := by
      gcongr
      rw [norm_sub_rev]
      exact .trans (by linarith) (norm_sub_norm_le l s)
    _ = ‖s * (2 * l - s)‖ / (‖l‖ ^ 4 / 4) := by
      congr 1
      · rw [sq_sub_sq]; simp [← sub_add, two_mul, sub_add_eq_add_sub]
      · ring
    _ = (‖s‖ * ‖2 * l - s‖) / (‖l‖ ^ 4 / 4) := by simp
    _ = (4 * ‖s‖ * ‖2 * l - s‖) / ‖l‖ ^ 4 := by field
    _ ≤ (4 * r * (2.5 * ‖l‖)) / ‖l‖ ^ 4 := by
      gcongr (4 * ?_ * ?_) / ‖l‖ ^ 4
      refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
      simp only [Complex.norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat]
      linarith
    _ = 10 * r / ‖l‖ ^ 3 := by field
    _ = _ := by norm_cast

name: hasSumLocallyUniformly_weierstrassPExcept
statement:
lemma hasSumLocallyUniformly_weierstrassPExcept (l₀ : ℂ) :
    HasSumLocallyUniformly
      (fun (l : L.lattice) (z : ℂ) ↦ if l.1 = l₀ then 0 else (1 / (z - l) ^ 2 - 1 / l ^ 2))
      ℘[L - l₀]
proof:
:= by
  refine L.hasSumLocallyUniformly_aux (u := (10 * · * ‖·‖ ^ (-3 : ℝ))) _
    (fun _ _ ↦ (ZLattice.summable_norm_rpow _ _ (by simp; norm_num)).mul_left _) fun r hr ↦
    Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨2 * r, ?_⟩
  rintro _ h s hs l rfl
  split_ifs
  · simpa using! show 0 ≤ 10 * r * (‖↑l‖ ^ 3)⁻¹ by positivity
  · exact weierstrassP_bound r hr s hs l h

name: weierstrassPExcept_add

    ℘[L - l₀] z + (1 / (z - l₀.1) ^ 2 - 1 / l₀.1 ^ 2) = ℘[L] z
proof:
:= by
  trans ℘[L - l₀] z + ∑' i : L.lattice, if i = l₀.1 then (1 / (z - l₀.1) ^ 2 - 1 / l₀.1 ^ 2) else 0
  · simp
  rw [weierstrassPExcept, ← Summable.tsum_add]
  · congr with w; split_ifs <;> simp only [zero_add, add_zero, *]
  · exact ⟨_, L.hasSum_weierstrassPExcept _ _⟩
  · exact summable_of_hasFiniteSupport ((Set.finite_singleton l₀).subset (by simp))

name: not_continuousAt_weierstrassP
statement: lemma not_continuousAt_weierstrassP (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ L.lattice) : ¬ ContinuousAt ℘[L] x
proof:
:= by
  eta_expand
  simp_rw [← L.weierstrassPExcept_add ⟨x, hx⟩]
  intro H
  apply (NormedField.continuousAt_zpow (n := -2) (x := (0 : ℂ))).not.mpr (by simp)
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using!
    (((H.sub ((L.differentiableOn_weierstrassPExcept x).differentiableAt
      (L.compl_lattice_sdiff_singleton_mem_nhds x)).continuousAt).add
      (continuous_const (y := 1 / x ^ 2)).continuousAt).comp_of_eq
      (continuous_const_add x).continuousAt (add_zero _) :)

name: hasSumLocallyUniformly_derivWeierstrassPExcept
statement:
lemma hasSumLocallyUniformly_derivWeierstrassPExcept (l₀ : ℂ) :
    HasSumLocallyUniformly (fun (l : L.lattice) (z : ℂ) ↦ if l.1 = l₀ then 0 else -2 / (z - l) ^ 3)
      ℘'[L - l₀]
proof:
:= by
  refine L.hasSumLocallyUniformly_aux (u := fun _ ↦ (16 * ‖·‖ ^ (-3 : ℝ))) _
    (fun _ _ ↦ (ZLattice.summable_norm_rpow _ _ (by simp; norm_num)).mul_left _) fun r hr ↦
    Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨2 * r, ?_⟩
  rintro _ h s hs l rfl
  split_ifs
  · simp
  have : s ≠ ↑l := by rintro rfl; exfalso; linarith
  have : l ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp_all; linarith
  simp only [Complex.norm_div, norm_neg, Complex.norm_ofNat, norm_pow]
  rw [Real.rpow_neg (by positivity), ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_div_iff₀, norm_sub_rev]
  · refine LE.le.trans_eq (b := 2 * (2 * ‖l - s‖) ^ 3) ?_ (by ring)
    norm_cast
    gcongr
    refine le_trans ?_ (mul_le_mul le_rfl (norm_sub_norm_le _ _) (by linarith) (by linarith))
    norm_cast at *
    linarith
  · exact pow_pos (by simpa [sub_eq_zero]) _
  · exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by simpa) _

name: differentiableOn_derivWeierstrassPExcept
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_derivWeierstrassPExcept (l₀ : ℂ) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ ℘'[L - l₀] (L.lattice \ {l₀})ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  refine L.hasSumLocallyUniformly_derivWeierstrassPExcept l₀
    |>.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn.differentiableOn
      (.of_forall fun s ↦ .fun_sum fun i hi ↦ ?_) L.isOpen_compl_lattice_sdiff
  split_ifs
  · simp
  refine .div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) fun x hx ↦ ?_
  have : x ≠ i := by rintro rfl; simp_all
  simpa [sub_eq_zero]

name: eqOn_deriv_weierstrassPExcept_derivWeierstrassPExcept
statement:
lemma eqOn_deriv_weierstrassPExcept_derivWeierstrassPExcept (l₀ : ℂ) :
    Set.EqOn (deriv ℘[L - l₀]) ℘'[L - l₀] (L.lattice \ {l₀})ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  refine ((L.hasSumLocallyUniformly_weierstrassPExcept l₀).tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn.deriv
    (.of_forall fun s ↦ ?_) L.isOpen_compl_lattice_sdiff).unique ?_
  · refine .fun_sum fun i hi ↦ ?_
    split_ifs
    · simp
    refine .sub (.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) fun x hx ↦ ?_) (by fun_prop)
    have : x ≠ i := by rintro rfl; simp_all
    simpa [sub_eq_zero]
  · refine (L.hasSumLocallyUniformly_derivWeierstrassPExcept l₀).tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn.congr ?_
    intro s l hl
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [deriv_fun_sum]
    · congr with x
      split_ifs with hl₁
      · simp
      have hl₁ : l - x ≠ 0 := fun e ↦ hl₁ (by
        obtain rfl := sub_eq_zero.mp e
        simpa using hl)
      rw [deriv_fun_sub (.fun_div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by simpa)) (by fun_prop),
        deriv_const]
      simp_rw [← zpow_natCast, one_div, ← zpow_neg, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      rw [deriv_comp_sub_const (f := (· ^ (-2 : ℤ))), deriv_zpow]
      simp
      field_simp
    · intros x hxs
      split_ifs with hl₁
      · simp
      have hl₁ : l - x ≠ 0 := fun e ↦ hl₁ (by
        obtain rfl := sub_eq_zero.mp e
        simpa using hl)
      exact .sub (.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by simpa)) (by fun_prop)

statement:
lemma derivWeierstrassPExcept_add_coe (l₀ : ℂ) (z : ℂ) (l : L.lattice) :
    ℘'[L - l₀] (z + l) = ℘'[L - (l₀ - l)] z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [derivWeierstrassPExcept]

name: weierstrassPExcept_add_coe_aux
statement:
private lemma weierstrassPExcept_add_coe_aux
    (l₀ : ℂ) (hl₀ : l₀ ∈ L.lattice) (l : L.lattice) (hl : l.1 / 2 ∉ L.lattice) :
    Set.EqOn (℘[L - l₀] <| · + l) (℘[L - (l₀ - l)] · + (1 / l₀ ^ 2 - 1 / (l₀ - ↑l) ^ 2))
      (L.lattice \ {l₀ - l})ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpen.eqOn_of_deriv_eq (𝕜 := ℂ) L.isOpen_compl_lattice_sdiff
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (x := -(l / 2)) ?_ ?_
  · refine (Set.Countable.isConnected_compl_of_one_lt_rank (by simp) ?_).2
    exact .mono sdiff_le (countable_of_Lindelof_of_discrete (X := L.lattice))
  · refine (L.differentiableOn_weierstrassPExcept l₀).comp (f := (· + l.1)) (by fun_prop) ?_
    rintro x h₁ ⟨h₂ : x + l ∈ _, h₃ : x + l ≠ l₀⟩
    exact h₁ ⟨by simpa using sub_mem h₂ l.2, by rintro rfl; simp at h₃⟩
  · refine .add (L.differentiableOn_weierstrassPExcept _) (by simp)
  · intro x hx
    simp only [deriv_add_const', deriv_comp_add_const]
    rw [L.eqOn_deriv_weierstrassPExcept_derivWeierstrassPExcept,
      L.eqOn_deriv_weierstrassPExcept_derivWeierstrassPExcept, L.derivWeierstrassPExcept_add_coe]
    · simpa using hx
    · simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_sdiff, SetLike.mem_coe, Set.mem_singleton_iff, not_and,
        Decidable.not_not, eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at hx ⊢
      exact fun H ↦ hx (by simpa using sub_mem H l.2)
  · simp [hl]
  · rw [L.weierstrassPExcept_neg, L.weierstrassPExcept_def ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩,
      L.weierstrassPExcept_def ⟨_, neg_mem (sub_mem hl₀ l.2)⟩, add_assoc]
    congr 2 <;> ring

name: weierstrassP_add_coe_aux
statement:
private lemma weierstrassP_add_coe_aux (z : ℂ) (l : L.lattice) (hl : l.1 / 2 ∉ L.lattice) :
    ℘[L] (z + l) = ℘[L] z
proof:
:= by
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hl
  by_cases hz : z ∈ L.lattice
  · have := L.weierstrassPExcept_add_coe_aux (z + l) (add_mem hz l.2) l hl (x := z) (by simp)
    dsimp at this
    rw [← L.weierstrassPExcept_add ⟨z + l, add_mem hz l.2⟩, this,
      ← L.weierstrassPExcept_add ⟨z, hz⟩]
    simp
    ring
  · have := L.weierstrassPExcept_add_coe_aux 0 (zero_mem _) l hl (x := z) (by simp [hz])
    simp only [zero_sub, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, div_zero,
      even_two, Even.neg_pow, one_div] at this
    rw [← L.weierstrassPExcept_add 0, Submodule.coe_zero, this, ← L.weierstrassPExcept_add (-l)]
    simp
    ring

name: weierstrassP_add_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weierstrassP_add_coe (z : ℂ) (l : L.lattice) : ℘[L] (z + l) = ℘[L] z
proof:
:= by
  let G : AddSubgroup ℂ :=
    { carrier := { z | (℘[L] <| · + z) = ℘[L] }
      add_mem' := by simp_all [funext_iff, ← add_assoc]
      zero_mem' := by simp
      neg_mem' {z} hz := funext fun i ↦ by conv_lhs => rw [← hz]; simp }
  have : L.lattice ≤ G.toIntSubmodule := by
    rw [lattice, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
    · ext i
      exact L.weierstrassP_add_coe_aux _ ⟨_, L.ω₁_mem_lattice⟩ L.ω₁_div_two_notMem_lattice
    · ext i
      exact L.weierstrassP_add_coe_aux _ ⟨_, L.ω₂_mem_lattice⟩ L.ω₂_div_two_notMem_lattice
  exact congr_fun (this l.2) _

name: differentiableOn_derivWeierstrassP
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_derivWeierstrassP :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ ℘'[L] L.latticeᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← L.derivWeierstrassPExcept_of_notMem _ L.ω₁_div_two_notMem_lattice]

name: hasSum_sumInvPow
statement:
lemma hasSum_sumInvPow (x : ℂ) {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 < r) :
    HasSum (fun l : L.lattice ↦ ((l - x) ^ r)⁻¹) (L.sumInvPow x r)
proof:
:= by
  refine Summable.hasSum (.of_norm_bounded (ZLattice.summable_norm_sub_zpow _
    (-r) (by simpa) x) fun l ↦ ?_)
  rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg, ← norm_zpow]

name: coeff_weierstrassPExceptSeries
statement:
lemma coeff_weierstrassPExceptSeries (l₀ x : ℂ) (i : ℕ) :
    (L.weierstrassPExceptSeries l₀ x).coeff i =
      ∑' l : L.lattice, L.weierstrassPExceptSummand l₀ x i l
proof:
:= by
  delta weierstrassPExceptSummand weierstrassPExceptSeries
  cases i with
  | zero => simp [weierstrassPExcept, sub_sq_comm x, zpow_ofNat]
  | succ i =>
    split_ifs with hl₀
    · trans (i + 2) * (L.sumInvPow x (i + 3) -
        ∑' l : L.lattice, if l = ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩ then (l₀ - x) ^ (-↑(i + 3) : ℤ) else 0)
      · rw [FormalMultilinearSeries.coeff_ofScalars, tsum_ite_eq, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
        simp [add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two]
      · rw [sumInvPow, ← (hasSum_sumInvPow _ _ (by linarith)).summable.tsum_sub, ← tsum_mul_left]
        · simp_rw [Subtype.ext_iff, zpow_neg]
          congr with l
          split_ifs with e
          · simp only [e, zpow_natCast, sub_self, mul_zero]
          · dsimp; norm_cast; ring
        · exact summable_of_hasFiniteSupport ((Set.finite_singleton ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩).subset (by simp))
    · have h₁ (l : L.lattice) : l.1 ≠ l₀ := fun e ↦ hl₀ (e ▸ l.2)
      simp [h₁, tsum_mul_left, sumInvPow, add_assoc,
        one_add_one_eq_two, ← zpow_natCast, -neg_add_rev]

name: summable_weierstrassPExceptSummand
statement:
lemma summable_weierstrassPExceptSummand (l₀ z x : ℂ)
    (hx : ∀ l : L.lattice, l.1 ≠ l₀ → ‖z - x‖ < ‖l - x‖) :
    Summable (Function.uncurry fun b c ↦ L.weierstrassPExceptSummand l₀ x b c * (z - x) ^ b)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hκ'⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ, 1 < κ ∧ ∀ l : L.lattice, l.1 ≠ l₀ → ‖z - x‖ * κ < ‖l - x‖ := by
    obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hκ'⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp ((continuous_mul_const ‖z - x‖).isOpen_preimage _
      (isClosedMap_dist x _
      (L.isClosed_of_subset_lattice (Set.sdiff_subset (t := {l₀})))).upperClosure.isOpen_compl) 1
      (by simpa [Complex.dist_eq, @forall_comm ℝ, norm_sub_rev x] using hx)
    refine ⟨κ / 2 + 1, by simpa, fun l hl ↦ ?_⟩
    have : ∀ l ∈ L.lattice, l ≠ l₀ → (κ / 2 + 1) * ‖z - x‖ < dist x l := by
      simpa using @hκ' (κ / 2 + 1) (by simp [div_lt_iff₀, abs_eq_self.mpr hκ.le, hκ])
    simpa only [Complex.dist_eq, norm_sub_rev x, mul_comm] using this _ l.2 hl
  
  let e : ℕ × L.lattice ≃ L.lattice ⊕ (ℕ × L.lattice) :=
    (Equiv.prodCongrLeft fun _ ↦ (Denumerable.eqv (Option ℕ)).symm).trans optionProdEquiv
  rw [← e.symm.summable_iff]
  apply Summable.sum
  · 
    simpa [weierstrassPExceptSummand, e, Function.comp_def, Function.uncurry, sub_sq_comm x,
      Denumerable.eqv] using! (L.hasSum_weierstrassPExcept l₀ x).summable
  · 
    dsimp [e, Function.comp_def, Function.uncurry_def, Denumerable.eqv, weierstrassPExceptSummand]
    have H₁ : Summable fun i : ℕ ↦ ((i + 2) * κ ^ (-i : ℤ)) := by
      have : |κ⁻¹| < 1 := by grind [abs_inv, inv_lt_one_iff₀]
      simpa [mul_comm] using ((Real.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_ofScalars_mul_add_zero 1 2).hasSum
        (y := κ⁻¹) (by simpa [enorm_eq_nnnorm])).summable
    have H₂ : Summable fun l : L.lattice ↦ ‖l - x‖ ^ (-3 : ℤ) * ‖z - x‖ :=
      (ZLattice.summable_norm_sub_zpow _ _ (by simp) _).mul_right _
    refine (H₁.mul_of_nonneg H₂ (by intro; positivity) (by intro; positivity)).of_norm_bounded ?_
    intro p
    split_ifs with hp
    · simp only [zero_mul, norm_zero, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, Int.reduceNeg]; positivity
    have hpx : ‖p.2 - x‖ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by
      obtain rfl : p.2 = x := by simpa [sub_eq_zero] using h
      simpa [(norm_nonneg _).not_gt] using hx p.2 hp
    obtain rfl | hxz := eq_or_ne z x
    · simp
    calc
      _ = ‖(p.1 + 2 : ℂ)‖ * ‖p.2 - x‖ ^ (-3 - p.1 : ℤ) * ‖z - x‖ ^ (p.1 + 1) := by
        norm_num; ring_nf; simp
      _ = ‖(p.1 + 2 : ℂ)‖ * ((‖↑p.2 - x‖ / ‖z - x‖) ^ p.1)⁻¹ * ((‖p.2 - x‖ ^ 3)⁻¹ * ‖z - x‖) := by
        simp [hpx, zpow_sub₀, div_pow]; field
      _ ≤ (p.1 + 2) * (κ ^ p.1)⁻¹ * ((‖p.2 - x‖ ^ 3)⁻¹ * ‖z - x‖) := by
        gcongr
        · norm_cast
        · exact (le_div_iff₀ (by simpa [sub_eq_zero])).mpr ((mul_comm _ _).trans_le (hκ' p.2 hp).le)
      _ = _ := by simp [zpow_ofNat]

name: weierstrassPExcept_eq_tsum
statement:
lemma weierstrassPExcept_eq_tsum (l₀ z x : ℂ)
    (hx : ∀ l : L.lattice, l.1 ≠ l₀ → ‖z - x‖ < ‖l - x‖) :
    ℘[L - l₀] z = ∑' i : ℕ, (L.weierstrassPExceptSeries l₀ x).coeff i * (z - x) ^ i
proof:
:= by
  trans ∑' (l : L.lattice) (i : ℕ), if l.1 = l₀ then 0 else
      ((i + 1) * (l.1 - x) ^ (- ↑(i + 2) : ℤ) - i.casesOn (l.1 ^ (-2 : ℤ)) 0) * (z - x) ^ i
  · delta weierstrassPExcept
    congr 1 with l
    split_ifs with h
    · simp
    simpa [mul_comm] using ((Complex.one_div_sub_sq_sub_one_div_sq_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_zero l x
      (by simpa [sub_eq_zero] using (norm_nonneg _).trans_lt (hx l h))).hasSum (y := z - x)
      (by simpa [enorm_eq_nnnorm] using hx _ h)).tsum_eq.symm
  trans ∑' (l : ↥L.lattice) (i : ℕ), L.weierstrassPExceptSummand l₀ x i l * (z - x) ^ i
  · simp only [weierstrassPExceptSummand, ite_mul, zero_mul]
  · simp_rw [coeff_weierstrassPExceptSeries, ← tsum_mul_right]
    apply Summable.tsum_comm
    exact L.summable_weierstrassPExceptSummand l₀ z x hx

name: weierstrassPExceptSeries_hasSum
statement:
lemma weierstrassPExceptSeries_hasSum (l₀ z x : ℂ)
    (hx : ∀ l : L.lattice, l.1 ≠ l₀ → ‖z - x‖ < ‖l - x‖) :
    HasSum (fun i ↦ (L.weierstrassPExceptSeries l₀ x).coeff i * (z - x) ^ i) (℘[L - l₀] z)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Summable.hasSum_iff ?_).mpr (L.weierstrassPExcept_eq_tsum l₀ z x hx).symm
  simp_rw [coeff_weierstrassPExceptSeries, ← tsum_mul_right]
  exact (L.summable_weierstrassPExceptSummand l₀ z x hx).prod

name: hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_weierstrassPExcept
statement:
lemma hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_weierstrassPExcept (l₀ x : ℂ) (r : NNReal) (hr0 : 0 < r)
    (hr : Metric.closedBall x r ⊆ (L.lattice \ {l₀})ᶜ) :
    HasFPowerSeriesOnBall ℘[L - l₀] (L.weierstrassPExceptSeries l₀ x) x r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply FormalMultilinearSeries.le_radius_of_tendsto (l := 0)
    convert!
      tendsto_norm.comp
        (L.weierstrassPExceptSeries_hasSum l₀ (x + r) x ?_).summable.tendsto_atTop_zero using
      2 with i
    · simp
    · simp
    · intro l hl
      simpa [-Metric.mem_closedBall, mem_closedBall_iff_norm]
        using Set.subset_compl_comm.mp hr ⟨l.2, hl⟩
  · exact ENNReal.coe_pos.mpr hr0
  · intro z hz
    replace hz : ‖z‖ < r := by simpa using hz
    have := L.weierstrassPExceptSeries_hasSum l₀ (x + z) x
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left] at this
    have A (l : ↥L.lattice) (hl : ↑l ≠ l₀) : r < ‖↑l - x‖ := by
      simpa [-Metric.mem_closedBall, mem_closedBall_iff_norm] using
        Set.subset_compl_comm.mp hr ⟨l.2, hl⟩
    convert! this (fun l hl ↦ hz.trans (A l hl)) with i
    rw [weierstrassPExceptSeries, FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq,
      FormalMultilinearSeries.coeff_ofScalars, smul_eq_mul]

name: hasFPowerSeriesAt_weierstrassPExcept
statement:
lemma hasFPowerSeriesAt_weierstrassPExcept (l : ℂ) :
    HasFPowerSeriesAt ℘[L - l] (.ofScalars (𝕜 := ℂ) ℂ fun i : ℕ ↦
      if i = 0 then ℘[L - l] l else (i + 1) * L.sumInvPow l (i + 2)) l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, h₁, h₂⟩ := Metric.nhds_basis_closedBall.mem_iff.mp
    (L.compl_lattice_sdiff_singleton_mem_nhds l)
  lift r to NNReal using h₁.le
  simpa [weierstrassPExceptSeries] using
    (L.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_weierstrassPExcept l l r h₁ h₂).hasFPowerSeriesAt

name: iteratedDeriv_weierstrassPExcept_self
proof:
:= by
  rw [← div_mul_cancel₀ (a := iteratedDeriv _ _ _) (b := ↑n !) (by simp),
    ← eq_div_iff_mul_eq (by simp)]
  trans if n = 0 then ℘[L - l] l else (n + 1) * L.sumInvPow l (n + 2)
  · simpa using congr($((L.analyticAt_weierstrassPExcept l).hasFPowerSeriesAt

lemma hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_derivWeierstrassPExcept (l₀ x : ℂ) (r : NNReal) (hr0 : 0 < r)

  · have := (L.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_weierstrassPExcept l₀ x r hr0 hr).fderiv
    convert! (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ ℂ (1 : ℂ)).comp_hasFPowerSeriesOnBall this
    ext n

    refine ⟨fun z ↦ (z - l₀) ^ 2 * ℘[L - l₀] z + 1 - (z - l₀) ^ 2 / l₀ ^ 2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : AnalyticAt ℂ ℘[L - l₀] l₀ := L.analyticOnNhd_weierstrassPExcept l₀ l₀ (by simp)
      suffices AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z ↦ (z - l₀) ^ 2 / l₀ ^ 2) l₀ by fun_prop
      by_cases hl₀ : l₀ = 0

      have : (z - l₀) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by simpa [sub_eq_zero]

@[local fun_prop]
private lemma meromorphic_relation : Meromorphic L.relation
proof:
:= by
  have : Meromorphic fun z ↦ ℘'[L] z ^ 2 - 4 * ℘[L] z ^ 3 + L.g₂ * ℘[L] z + L.g₃ := by fun_prop
  refine fun z ↦ (this _).congr ?_
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds
    (L.compl_lattice_sdiff_singleton_mem_nhds _)] with w hw hw'
  rw [relation, ite_eq_right (by simp_all)]

name: relation_mul_id_pow_six_eventuallyEq
statement:
private lemma relation_mul_id_pow_six_eventuallyEq :
    (L.relation * id ^ 6) =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun z ↦
      (℘'[L - (0 : ℂ)] z * z ^ 3 - 2) ^ 2 - 4 *
      (℘[L - (0 : ℂ)] z * z ^ 2 + 1) ^ 3 + L.g₂ *
      (℘[L - (0 : ℂ)] z * z ^ 6 + z ^ 4) + L.g₃ * z ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [L.compl_lattice_sdiff_singleton_mem_nhds _] with z hz
  by_cases hz0 : z = 0
  · simp [hz0, relation]; norm_num
  replace hz : z ∉ L.lattice := by simp_all
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, relation, ↓reduceIte, hz,
    ← ZeroMemClass.coe_zero L.lattice, L.derivWeierstrassPExcept_def, L.weierstrassPExcept_def]
  simp
  field

name: analyticAt_relation_mul_id_pow_six
relation_neg
statement:
@[local simp]
private lemma relation_neg (x) : L.relation (-x) = L.relation x

name: iteratedDeriv_six_relation_mul_id_pow_six
statement:
private lemma iteratedDeriv_six_relation_mul_id_pow_six :
    iteratedDeriv 6 (L.relation * id ^ 6) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.relation_mul_id_pow_six_eventuallyEq.iteratedDeriv_eq]
  simp_rw [pow_succ (_ + _), pow_succ (_ - _), pow_zero, one_mul]
  simp (discharger := fun_prop) only [iteratedDeriv_fun_add, iteratedDeriv_fun_sub,
    iteratedDeriv_fun_mul, iteratedDeriv_const, iteratedDeriv_fun_pow_zero,
    iteratedDeriv_derivWeierstrassPExcept_self, iteratedDeriv_weierstrassPExcept_self]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, L.G_eq_zero_of_odd 3 (by decide), g₃,
    show Nat.choose 6 4 = 15 by rfl, show Nat.choose 6 3 = 20 by rfl]
  ring

name: analyticAt_relation_zero
statement: private lemma analyticAt_relation_zero : AnalyticAt ℂ L.relation 0
proof:
:= by
  refine .of_meromorphicOrderAt_pos (one_pos.trans_le ?_) (by simp [relation])
  suffices 7 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt (L.relation * id ^ 6) 0 by
    rw [meromorphicOrderAt_mul (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
      meromorphicOrderAt_pow (by fun_prop)] at this
    rw [← WithTop.add_le_add_iff_right (z := 6) (by simp)]
    simpa [-add_le_add_iff_left_of_ne_top] using! this
  rw [AnalyticAt.meromorphicOrderAt_eq (by fun_prop)]
  refine ENat.monotone_map_iff.mpr Nat.mono_cast
    ((natCast_le_analyticOrderAt_iff_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero (by fun_prop)).mpr fun i hi₁ ↦ ?_)
  by_cases hi₂ : Odd i
  · simpa [← CharZero.eq_neg_self_iff, hi₂, (show Even 6 by decide).neg_pow] using!
      (iteratedDeriv_comp_neg i (L.relation * id ^ 6) 0 :)
  by_cases hi₃ : i = 0
  · simp [hi₃]
  by_cases hi₄ : i = 6
  · exact hi₄ ▸ L.iteratedDeriv_six_relation_mul_id_pow_six
  rw [L.relation_mul_id_pow_six_eventuallyEq.iteratedDeriv_eq]
  simp_rw [pow_succ (_ + _), pow_succ (_ - _), pow_zero, one_mul]
  simp (discharger := fun_prop) only [iteratedDeriv_fun_add, iteratedDeriv_fun_sub,
    iteratedDeriv_fun_mul, iteratedDeriv_const, iteratedDeriv_fun_pow_zero,
    iteratedDeriv_derivWeierstrassPExcept_self, iteratedDeriv_weierstrassPExcept_self]
  obtain rfl | rfl : i = 2 ∨ i = 4 := by grind
  · simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]
  · simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, show Nat.choose 4 2 = 6 by rfl, g₂]; ring

name: relation_add_coe
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relation, derivWeierstrassP_add_coe, weierstrassP_add_coe]
  congr 1
  simpa using (L.lattice.toAddSubgroup.add_mem_cancel_right (y := x) l.2)

name: relation_sub_coe
analyticAt_relation
statement: private lemma analyticAt_relation (x : ℂ) : AnalyticAt ℂ L.relation x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ L.lattice
  · lift x to L.lattice using hx
    have := L.analyticAt_relation_zero
    rw [← sub_self x.1] at this
    convert! this.comp (f := (· - x.1)) (by fun_prop)
    ext a
    simp
  · have : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z ↦ ℘'[L] z ^ 2 - 4 * ℘[L] z ^ 3 + L.g₂ * ℘[L] z + L.g₃) x := by
      have := L.analyticOnNhd_derivWeierstrassP _ hx
      have := L.analyticOnNhd_weierstrassP _ hx
      fun_prop
    apply this.congr
    filter_upwards [L.isClosed_lattice.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hx] with x hx
    simp_all [relation]

name: relation_eq_zero
statement: private lemma relation_eq_zero : L.relation = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have : Differentiable ℂ L.relation := fun x ↦ (L.analyticAt_relation x).differentiableAt
  exact (this.apply_eq_apply_of_bounded (IsZLattice.isCompact_range_of_periodic L.lattice _
    this.continuous fun z w hw ↦ by lift w to L.lattice using hw; simp).isBounded x 0).trans
    (ite_eq_left (by simp))

name: derivWeierstrassP_sq
statement:
lemma derivWeierstrassP_sq (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∉ L.lattice) :
    ℘'[L] z ^ 2 = 4 * ℘[L] z ^ 3 - L.g₂ * ℘[L] z - L.g₃
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_zero, relation, hz, sub_add] using congr($L.relation_eq_zero z)

name: norm_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_mul_I
statement:
theorem norm_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_mul_I (b : ℂ) (c T : ℝ) :
    ‖cexp (-b * (T + c * I) ^ 2)‖ = exp (-(b.re * T ^ 2 - 2 * b.im * c * T - b.re * c ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.norm_exp, neg_mul, neg_re, ← re_add_im b]
  simp only [sq, re_add_im, mul_re, mul_im, add_re, add_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, I_re, I_im]
  ring_nf

name: norm_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_mul_I'
statement:
theorem norm_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_mul_I' (hb : b.re ≠ 0) (c T : ℝ) :
    ‖cexp (-b * (T + c * I) ^ 2)‖ =
      exp (-(b.re * (T - b.im * c / b.re) ^ 2 - c ^ 2 * (b.im ^ 2 / b.re + b.re)))
proof:
:= by
  have :
    b.re * T ^ 2 - 2 * b.im * c * T - b.re * c ^ 2 =
      b.re * (T - b.im * c / b.re) ^ 2 - c ^ 2 * (b.im ^ 2 / b.re + b.re) := by
    field
  rw [norm_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_mul_I, this]

name: verticalIntegral_norm_le
statement:
theorem verticalIntegral_norm_le (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ℝ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ‖verticalIntegral b c T‖ ≤
      (2 : ℝ) * |c| * exp (-(b.re * T ^ 2 - (2 : ℝ) * |b.im| * |c| * T - b.re * c ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  
  have vert_norm_bound :
    ∀ {T : ℝ},
      0 ≤ T →
        ∀ {c y : ℝ},
          |y| ≤ |c| →
            ‖cexp (-b * (T + y * I) ^ 2)‖ ≤
              exp (-(b.re * T ^ 2 - (2 : ℝ) * |b.im| * |c| * T - b.re * c ^ 2)) := by
    intro T hT c y hy
    rw [norm_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_mul_I b]
    gcongr exp (-(_ - ?_ * _ - _ * ?_))
    · (conv_lhs => rw [mul_assoc]); (conv_rhs => rw [mul_assoc])
      gcongr _ * ?_
      refine (le_abs_self _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_mul]
      gcongr
    · rwa [sq_le_sq]
  
  apply (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const _).trans
  · rw [sub_zero]
    conv_lhs => simp only [mul_comm _ |c|]
    conv_rhs =>
      conv =>
        congr
        rw [mul_comm]
      rw [mul_assoc]
  · intro y hy
    have absy : |y| ≤ |c| := by
      simpa using abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc (uIoc_subset_uIcc hy)
    rw [norm_mul, norm_I, one_mul, two_mul]
    refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (vert_norm_bound hT absy) ?_)
    rw [← abs_neg y] at absy
    simpa only [neg_mul, ofReal_neg] using! vert_norm_bound hT absy

name: tendsto_verticalIntegral
statement:
theorem tendsto_verticalIntegral (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (verticalIntegral b c) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
  refine
    tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds ?_
      (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
      ((eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)).mp
        (Eventually.of_forall fun T hT => verticalIntegral_norm_le hb c hT))
  rw [(by ring : 0 = 2 * |c| * 0)]
  refine (tendsto_exp_atBot.comp (tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp ?_)).const_mul _
  apply tendsto_atTop_add_const_right
  simp_rw [sq, ← mul_assoc, ← sub_mul]
  refine Tendsto.atTop_mul_atTop₀ (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ _ ?_) tendsto_id
  exact (tendsto_const_mul_atTop_of_pos hb).mpr tendsto_id

name: integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_real_mul_I
statement:
theorem integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_real_mul_I (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ℝ) :
    Integrable fun x : ℝ => cexp (-b * (x + c * I) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by fun_prop, ?_⟩
  rw [← hasFiniteIntegral_norm_iff]
  simp_rw [norm_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_mul_I' hb.ne', neg_sub _ (c ^ 2 * _),
    sub_eq_add_neg _ (b.re * _), Real.exp_add]
  suffices Integrable fun x : ℝ => exp (-(b.re * x ^ 2)) by
    exact (Integrable.comp_sub_right this (b.im * c / b.re)).hasFiniteIntegral.const_mul _
  simp_rw [← neg_mul]
  apply integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq hb

name: integral_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_real_mul_I
statement:
theorem integral_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_real_mul_I (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ℝ) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, cexp (-b * (x + c * I) ^ 2) = (π / b) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  refine
    tendsto_nhds_unique
      (intervalIntegral_tendsto_integral (integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_real_mul_I hb c)
        tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot tendsto_id)
      ?_
  set I₁ := fun T => ∫ x : ℝ in -T..T, cexp (-b * (x + c * I) ^ 2) with HI₁
  let I₂ := fun T : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ in -T..T, cexp (-b * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)
  let I₄ := fun T : ℝ => ∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..c, cexp (-b * (T + y * I) ^ 2)
  let I₅ := fun T : ℝ => ∫ y : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..c, cexp (-b * (-T + y * I) ^ 2)
  have C : ∀ T : ℝ, I₂ T - I₁ T + I * I₄ T - I * I₅ T = 0 := by
    intro T
    have :=
      integral_boundary_rect_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn (fun z => cexp (-b * z ^ 2)) (-T)
        (T + c * I)
        (by
          refine Differentiable.differentiableOn (Differentiable.const_mul ?_ _).cexp
          exact differentiable_pow 2)
    simpa only [neg_im, ofReal_im, neg_zero, ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, neg_re,
      ofReal_re, add_re, mul_re, I_re, mul_zero, I_im, tsub_zero, add_im, mul_im,
      mul_one, zero_add, smul_eq_mul, ofReal_neg] using this
  simp_rw [id, ← HI₁]
  have : I₁ = fun T : ℝ => I₂ T + verticalIntegral b c T := by
    ext1 T
    specialize C T
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at C
    unfold verticalIntegral
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_sub]
    · simp_rw [(fun a b => by rw [sq]; ring_nf : ∀ a b : ℂ, (a - b * I) ^ 2 = (-a + b * I) ^ 2)]
      change I₁ T = I₂ T + I * (I₄ T - I₅ T)
      rw [mul_sub, ← C]
      abel
    all_goals apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop
  rw [this, ← add_zero ((π / b : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)), ← integral_gaussian_complex hb]
  refine Tendsto.add ?_ (tendsto_verticalIntegral hb c)
  exact
    intervalIntegral_tendsto_integral (integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq hb) tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot
      tendsto_id

name: _root_.integral_cexp_quadratic
statement:
theorem _root_.integral_cexp_quadratic (hb : b.re < 0) (c d : ℂ) :
    ∫ x : ℝ,
      cexp (b * x ^ 2 + c * x + d) = (π / -b) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * cexp (d - c ^ 2 / (4 * b))
proof:
:= by
  have hb' : b ≠ 0 := by contrapose! hb; rw [hb, zero_re]
  have h (x : ℝ) : cexp (b * x ^ 2 + c * x + d) =
      cexp (- -b * (x + c / (2 * b)) ^ 2) * cexp (d - c ^ 2 / (4 * b)) := by
    simp_rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    field
  simp_rw [h, MeasureTheory.integral_mul_const]
  rw [← re_add_im (c / (2 * b))]
  simp_rw [← add_assoc, ← ofReal_add]
  rw [integral_add_right_eq_self fun a : ℝ ↦ cexp (- -b * (↑a + ↑(c / (2 * b)).im * I) ^ 2),
    integral_cexp_neg_mul_sq_add_real_mul_I ((neg_re b).symm ▸ (neg_pos.mpr hb))]

name: _root_.integrable_cexp_quadratic'
statement:
lemma _root_.integrable_cexp_quadratic' (hb : b.re < 0) (c d : ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun (x : ℝ) ↦ cexp (b * x ^ 2 + c * x + d))
proof:
:= by
  have hb' : b ≠ 0 := by contrapose! hb; rw [hb, zero_re]
  by_contra H
  simpa [hb', pi_ne_zero, Complex.exp_ne_zero, integral_undef H]
    using integral_cexp_quadratic hb c d

name: _root_.integrable_cexp_quadratic
statement:
lemma _root_.integrable_cexp_quadratic (hb : 0 < b.re) (c d : ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun (x : ℝ) ↦ cexp (-b * x ^ 2 + c * x + d))
proof:
:= by
  have : (-b).re < 0 := by simpa using hb
  exact integrable_cexp_quadratic' this c d

name: _root_.fourierIntegral_gaussian
statement:
theorem _root_.fourierIntegral_gaussian (hb : 0 < b.re) (t : ℂ) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, cexp (I * t * x) * cexp (-b * x ^ 2) =
    (π / b) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * cexp (-t ^ 2 / (4 * b))
proof:
:= by
  conv => enter [1, 2, x]; rw [← Complex.exp_add, add_comm, ← add_zero (-b * x ^ 2 + I * t * x)]
  rw [integral_cexp_quadratic (show (-b).re < 0 by rwa [neg_re, neg_lt_zero]), neg_neg, zero_sub,
    mul_neg, div_neg, neg_neg, mul_pow, I_sq, neg_one_mul, mul_comm]

name: _root_.fourier_gaussian_pi'
statement:
theorem _root_.fourier_gaussian_pi' (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ℂ) :
    (𝓕 fun x : ℝ => cexp (-π * b * x ^ 2 + 2 * π * c * x)) = fun t : ℝ =>
    1 / b ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * cexp (-π / b * (t + I * c) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have : b ≠ 0 := by contrapose! hb; rw [hb, zero_re]
  have h : (-↑π * b).re < 0 := by
    simpa only [neg_mul, neg_re, re_ofReal_mul, neg_lt_zero] using mul_pos pi_pos hb
  ext1 t
  simp_rw [fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← Complex.exp_add, ← add_assoc]
  have (x : ℝ) : ↑(-2 * π * x * t) * I + -π * b * x ^ 2 + 2 * π * c * x =
    -π * b * x ^ 2 + (-2 * π * I * t + 2 * π * c) * x + 0 := by push_cast; ring
  simp_rw [this, integral_cexp_quadratic h, neg_mul, neg_neg]
  congr 2
  · rw [← div_div, div_self <| ofReal_ne_zero.mpr pi_ne_zero, one_div, inv_cpow, ← one_div]
    rw [Ne, arg_eq_pi_iff, not_and_or, not_lt]
    exact Or.inl hb.le
  · field_simp
    ring_nf
    simp only [I_sq]
    ring

name: _root_.fourier_gaussian_pi
statement:
theorem _root_.fourier_gaussian_pi (hb : 0 < b.re) :
    (𝓕 fun (x : ℝ) ↦ cexp (-π * b * x ^ 2)) =
    fun t : ℝ ↦ 1 / b ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * cexp (-π / b * t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using fourier_gaussian_pi' hb 0

name: integrable_cexp_neg_sum_mul_add
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Complex.exp_sum, ← neg_mul]
  apply Integrable.fintype_prod (f := fun i (v : ℝ) ↦ cexp (-b i * v ^ 2 + c i * v)) (fun i ↦ ?_)
  convert! integrable_cexp_quadratic (hb i) (c i) 0 using 3 with x
  simp only [add_zero]

name: integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sum_add
statement:
theorem integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sum_add {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ι → ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun (v : ι → ℝ) ↦ cexp (-b * ∑ i, (v i : ℂ) ^ 2 + ∑ i, c i * v i))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [neg_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact integrable_cexp_neg_sum_mul_add (fun _ ↦ hb) c

name: integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add_of_euclideanSpace
statement:
theorem integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add_of_euclideanSpace
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ℂ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    Integrable (fun (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) ↦ cexp (- b * ‖v‖ ^ 2 + c * ⟪w, v⟫))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp ι).integrable_comp_emb
    (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 _).measurableEmbedding]
  simp only [neg_mul, Function.comp_def]
  convert! integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sum_add hb (fun i ↦ c * w i) using 3 with v
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply,
    conj_trivial, ofReal_sum, ofReal_mul, Finset.mul_sum, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
    mul_assoc]
  norm_cast
  rw [sq_sqrt]
  · simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _hi ↦ by positivity)

name: integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add
statement:
theorem integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ℂ) (w : V) :
    Integrable (fun (v : V) ↦ cexp (-b * ‖v‖ ^ 2 + c * ⟪w, v⟫))
proof:
:= by
  let e := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ V).repr.symm
  rw [← e.measurePreserving.integrable_comp_emb e.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding]
  convert! integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add_of_euclideanSpace hb c (e.symm w) with v
  simp only [neg_mul, Function.comp_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map,
    LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_symm,
    LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_eq_flip]

name: integral_cexp_neg_sum_mul_add
statement:
theorem integral_cexp_neg_sum_mul_add {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {b : ι → ℂ}
    (hb : ∀ i, 0 < (b i).re) (c : ι → ℂ) :
    ∫ v : ι → ℝ, cexp (-∑ i, b i * (v i : ℂ) ^ 2 + ∑ i, c i * v i)
      = ∏ i, (π / b i) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * cexp (c i ^ 2 / (4 * b i))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Complex.exp_sum, ← neg_mul]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_volume_eq_prod (f := fun i (v : ℝ) ↦ cexp (-b i * v ^ 2 + c i * v))]
  congr with i
  have : (-b i).re < 0 := by simpa using hb i
  convert! integral_cexp_quadratic this (c i) 0 using 1 <;> simp [div_neg]

name: integral_cexp_neg_mul_sum_add
statement:
theorem integral_cexp_neg_mul_sum_add {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ι → ℂ) :
    ∫ v : ι → ℝ, cexp (-b * ∑ i, (v i : ℂ) ^ 2 + ∑ i, c i * v i)
      = (π / b) ^ (Fintype.card ι / 2 : ℂ) * cexp ((∑ i, c i ^ 2) / (4 * b))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [neg_mul, Finset.mul_sum, integral_cexp_neg_sum_mul_add (fun _ ↦ hb) c, one_div,
    Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, ← cpow_nat_mul, ← Complex.exp_sum, Fintype.card,
    Finset.sum_div, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: integral_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add_of_euclideanSpace
statement:
theorem integral_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add_of_euclideanSpace
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (hb : 0 < b.re) (c : ℂ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ∫ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, cexp (- b * ‖v‖ ^ 2 + c * ⟪w, v⟫) =
      (π / b) ^ (Fintype.card ι / 2 : ℂ) * cexp (c ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 / (4 * b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp ι).integral_comp

proof:

    ext1 x; ring_nf

    tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop (neg_pos.mpr ha)

name: Complex.tsum_exp_neg_quadratic
statement:
theorem Complex.tsum_exp_neg_quadratic {a : ℂ} (ha : 0 < a.re) (b : ℂ) :
    (∑' n : ℤ, cexp (-π * a * n ^ 2 + 2 * π * b * n)) =
      1 / a ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∑' n : ℤ, cexp (-π / a * (n + I * b) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun x ↦ cexp (-π * a * x ^ 2 + 2 * π * b * x)
  have hFf : 𝓕 f = fun x : ℝ ↦ 1 / a ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * cexp (-π / a * (x + I * b) ^ 2) :=
    fourier_gaussian_pi' ha b
  have h1 : 0 < (π * a).re := by
    rw [re_ofReal_mul]
    exact mul_pos pi_pos ha
  have h2 : 0 < (π / a).re := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, re_ofReal_mul, inv_re]
    refine mul_pos pi_pos (div_pos ha <| normSq_pos.mpr ?_)
    contrapose! ha
    rw [ha, zero_re]
  have f_bd : f =O[cocompact ℝ] (fun x => |x| ^ (-2 : ℝ)) := by
    convert! (cexp_neg_quadratic_isLittleO_abs_rpow_cocompact ?_ _ (-2)).isBigO
    rwa [neg_mul, neg_re, neg_lt_zero]
  have Ff_bd : (𝓕 f) =O[cocompact ℝ] (fun x => |x| ^ (-2 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hFf]
    have : ∀ (x : ℝ), -π / a * (x + I * b) ^ 2 =
        -π / a * x ^ 2 + (-2 * π * I * b) / a * x + π * b ^ 2 / a := by
      intro x; ring_nf; rw [I_sq]; ring
    simp_rw [this]
    conv => enter [2, x]; rw [Complex.exp_add, ← mul_assoc _ _ (Complex.exp _), mul_comm]
    refine ((cexp_neg_quadratic_isLittleO_abs_rpow_cocompact
      ?_ (-2 * π * I * b / a) (-2)).isBigO.const_mul_left _).const_mul_left _
    rwa [neg_div, neg_re, neg_lt_zero]
  convert! Real.tsum_eq_tsum_fourier_of_rpow_decay (by fun_prop) one_lt_two f_bd Ff_bd 0 using 1
  · simp only [f, zero_add, ofReal_intCast]
  · simp [← tsum_mul_left, hFf]

    rw [show 0 = b ^ (-p⁻¹) * 0 by rw [mul_zero], ← integrableOn_Ioi_comp_mul_left_iff _ _ hib]
    refine this.congr_fun (fun _ hx => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi

      rpow_neg_one, mul_inv_cancel_left₀]

    atTop (𝓝 (-(2 * b)⁻¹ * 0)) := by

  convert!
    integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto' (fun x _ => (A ↑x).comp_ofReal)
      (integrable_mul_cexp_neg_mul_sq hb).integrableOn B using 1
