    (∫ x : ℝ, cexp (-b * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)) ^ 2 = π / b
proof:
:= by
  /- We compute `(∫ exp (-b x^2))^2` as an integral over `ℝ^2`, and then make a polar change
  of coordinates. We are left with `∫ r * exp (-b r^2)`, which has been computed in
  `integral_mul_cexp_neg_mul_sq` using the fact that this function has an obvious primitive. -/
  calc
    (∫ x : ℝ, cexp (-b * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)) ^ 2 =
        ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, cexp (-b * (p.1 : ℂ) ^ 2) * cexp (-b * (p.2 : ℂ) ^ 2) := by
      rw [pow_two, ← integral_prod_mul]; rfl
    _ = ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, cexp (-b * ((p.1 : ℂ) ^ 2 + (p.2 : ℂ) ^ 2)) := by
      congr
      ext1 p
      rw [← Complex.exp_add, mul_add]
    _ = ∫ p in polarCoord.target, p.1 •
        cexp (-b * ((p.1 * Complex.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (p.1 * Complex.sin p.2) ^ 2)) := by
      rw [← integral_comp_polarCoord_symm]
      simp only [polarCoord_symm_apply, ofReal_mul, ofReal_cos, ofReal_sin]
    _ = (∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), r * cexp (-b * (r : ℂ) ^ 2)) * ∫ θ in Ioo (-π) π, 1 := by
      rw [← setIntegral_prod_mul]
      congr with p : 1
      rw [mul_one]
      congr
      conv_rhs => rw [← one_mul ((p.1 : ℂ) ^ 2), ← sin_sq_add_cos_sq (p.2 : ℂ)]
      ring
    _ = ↑π / b := by
      simp only [integral_const, MeasurableSet.univ, measureReal_restrict_apply,
        univ_inter, real_smul, mul_one, integral_mul_cexp_neg_mul_sq hb]
      rw [volume_real_Ioo_of_le (by linarith [pi_nonneg])]
      simp
      ring

name: integral_gaussian
statement: theorem integral_gaussian (b : ℝ) : ∫ x : ℝ, exp (-b * x ^ 2) = √(π / b)
proof:
:= by
  
  rcases le_or_gt b 0 with (hb | hb)
  · rw [integral_undef, sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos]
    · exact div_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos pi_pos.le hb
    · simpa only [not_lt, integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq_iff] using hb
  
  refine (sq_eq_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).1 ?_
  rw [← ofReal_inj, ofReal_pow, ← coe_algebraMap, RCLike.algebraMap_eq_ofReal, ← integral_ofReal,
    sq_sqrt (div_pos pi_pos hb).le, ← RCLike.algebraMap_eq_ofReal, coe_algebraMap, ofReal_div]
  convert! integral_gaussian_sq_complex (by rwa [ofReal_re] : 0 < (b : ℂ).re) with _ x
  rw [ofReal_exp, ofReal_mul, ofReal_pow, ofReal_neg]

name: continuousAt_gaussian_integral
statement:
theorem continuousAt_gaussian_integral (b : ℂ) (hb : 0 < re b) :
    ContinuousAt (fun c : ℂ => ∫ x : ℝ, cexp (-c * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)) b
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun (c : ℂ) (x : ℝ) => cexp (-c * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hd'⟩ := exists_between hb
  have f_le_bd : ∀ᶠ c : ℂ in 𝓝 b, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ, ‖f c x‖ ≤ exp (-d * x ^ 2) := by
    refine eventually_of_mem ((continuous_re.isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds hd') ?_
    intro c hc; filter_upwards with x
    rw [norm_cexp_neg_mul_sq]
    gcongr
    exact le_of_lt hc
  exact continuousAt_of_dominated (Eventually.of_forall (by fun_prop)) f_le_bd
    (integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq hd) (ae_of_all _ (by fun_prop))

name: integral_gaussian_complex
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian_complex {b : ℂ} (hb : 0 < re b) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, cexp (-b * (x : ℂ) ^ 2) = (π / b) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have nv : ∀ {b : ℂ}, 0 < re b → b ≠ 0 := by intro b hb; contrapose! hb; rw [hb]; simp
  apply
    (convex_halfSpace_re_gt 0).isPreconnected.eq_of_sq_eq ?_ ?_ (fun c hc => ?_) (fun {c} hc => ?_)
      (by simp : 0 < re (1 : ℂ)) ?_ hb
  · 
    exact continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt continuousAt_gaussian_integral
  · 
    refine
      continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt fun b hb =>
        (continuousAt_cpow_const (Or.inl ?_)).comp (continuousAt_const.div continuousAt_id (nv hb))
    rw [div_re, ofReal_im, ofReal_re, zero_mul, zero_div, add_zero]
    exact div_pos (mul_pos pi_pos hb) (normSq_pos.mpr (nv hb))
  · 
    have : ∀ x : ℝ, cexp (-(1 : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) ^ 2) = exp (-(1 : ℝ) * x ^ 2) := by
      intro x
      simp only [ofReal_exp, neg_mul, one_mul, ofReal_neg, ofReal_pow]
    simp_rw [this, ← coe_algebraMap, RCLike.algebraMap_eq_ofReal, integral_ofReal,
      ← RCLike.algebraMap_eq_ofReal, coe_algebraMap]
    conv_rhs =>
      congr
      · rw [← ofReal_one, ← ofReal_div]
      · rw [← ofReal_one, ← ofReal_ofNat, ← ofReal_div]
    rw [← ofReal_cpow, ofReal_inj]
    · convert! integral_gaussian (1 : ℝ) using 1
      rw [sqrt_eq_rpow]
    · rw [div_one]; exact pi_pos.le
  · 
    dsimp only [Pi.pow_apply]
    rw [integral_gaussian_sq_complex hc, sq]
    conv_lhs => rw [← cpow_one (↑π / c)]
    rw [← cpow_add _ _ (div_ne_zero (ofReal_ne_zero.mpr pi_ne_zero) (nv hc))]
    norm_num
  · 
    rw [Ne, cpow_eq_zero_iff, not_and_or]
    exact Or.inl (div_ne_zero (ofReal_ne_zero.mpr pi_ne_zero) (nv hc))

name: integral_gaussian_complex_Ioi
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian_complex_Ioi {b : ℂ} (hb : 0 < re b) :
    ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, cexp (-b * (x : ℂ) ^ 2) = (π / b) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => cexp (-b * (x : ℂ) ^ 2)
  have full_integral := integral_gaussian_complex hb
  have h_eq := calc
    ∫ x : ℝ in Iic 0, f x = ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, f (-x) := by
      simpa [f] using (integral_comp_neg_Ioi 0 f).symm
    _ = ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, f x :=
      setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun _ _ ↦ (by simp [f])
  rw [← integral_add_compl (s := Ioi 0) (by simp) (integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq hb), compl_Ioi, h_eq,
    ← mul_two] at full_integral
  exact (eq_div_iff two_ne_zero).2 (by simpa using full_integral)

name: integral_gaussian_Ioi
statement:
theorem integral_gaussian_Ioi (b : ℝ) :
    ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), exp (-b * x ^ 2) = √(π / b) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt b 0 with (hb | hb)
  · rw [integral_undef, sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos, zero_div]
    · exact div_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos pi_pos.le hb
    · rwa [← IntegrableOn, integrableOn_Ioi_exp_neg_mul_sq_iff, not_lt]
  rw [← RCLike.ofReal_inj (K := ℂ), ← integral_ofReal, ← RCLike.algebraMap_eq_ofReal,
    coe_algebraMap]
  convert! integral_gaussian_complex_Ioi (by rwa [ofReal_re] : 0 < (b : ℂ).re)
  · simp
  · rw [sqrt_eq_rpow, ← ofReal_div, ofReal_div, ofReal_cpow]
    · simp
    · exact (div_pos pi_pos hb).le

name: Real.Gamma_one_half_eq
statement: theorem Real.Gamma_one_half_eq : Real.Gamma (1 / 2) = √π
proof:
:= by
  rw [Gamma_eq_integral one_half_pos, ← integral_comp_rpow_Ioi_of_pos zero_lt_two]
  convert! congr_arg (fun x : ℝ => 2 * x) (integral_gaussian_Ioi 1) using 1
  · rw [← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun x hx => ?_
    have : (x ^ (2 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ) - 1) = x⁻¹ := by
      rw [← rpow_mul (le_of_lt hx)]
      norm_num
      rw [rpow_neg (le_of_lt hx), rpow_one]
    rw [smul_eq_mul, this]
    simp [field, (ne_of_lt (show 0 < x from hx)).symm]
    norm_num
  · rw [div_one, ← mul_div_assoc, mul_comm, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (two_ne_zero' ℝ)]

name: Complex.Gamma_one_half_eq
statement: theorem Complex.Gamma_one_half_eq : Complex.Gamma (1 / 2) = (π : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  convert! congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) Real.Gamma_one_half_eq
  · simpa only [one_div, ofReal_inv, ofReal_ofNat] using Gamma_ofReal (1 / 2)
  · rw [sqrt_eq_rpow, ofReal_cpow pi_pos.le, ofReal_div, ofReal_ofNat, ofReal_one]

name: Real.Gamma_nat_add_one_add_half
statement:
lemma Real.Gamma_nat_add_one_add_half (k : ℕ) :
    Gamma (k + 1 + 1 / 2) = (2 * k + 1 : ℕ)‼ * √π / (2 ^ (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [-one_div, add_comm (1 : ℝ), Gamma_add_one, Gamma_one_half_eq]; ring
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [add_right_comm, Gamma_add_one (by positivity), Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, ih, Nat.mul_add]
    simp
    ring

name: Real.Gamma_nat_add_half
statement:
lemma Real.Gamma_nat_add_half (k : ℕ) :
    Gamma (k + 1 / 2) = (2 * k - 1 : ℕ)‼ * √π / (2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => simp [-one_div, Gamma_one_half_eq]
  | succ k => simpa [-one_div, mul_add] using Gamma_nat_add_one_add_half k

theorem arcsin_neg (x : ℝ) : arcsin (-x) = -arcsin x
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total x (-1) with hx₁ | hx₁
  · rw [arcsin_of_le_neg_one hx₁, neg_neg, arcsin_of_one_le (le_neg.2 hx₁)]
  rcases le_total 1 x with hx₂ | hx₂
  · rw [arcsin_of_one_le hx₂, arcsin_of_le_neg_one (neg_le_neg hx₂)]
  refine arcsin_eq_of_sin_eq ?_ ?_
  · rw [sin_neg, sin_arcsin hx₁ hx₂]
  · exact ⟨neg_le_neg (arcsin_le_pi_div_two _), neg_le.2 (neg_pi_div_two_le_arcsin _)⟩

  rw [← arcsin_sin' hy, strictMonoOn_arcsin.le_iff_le hx (sin_mem_Icc _), arcsin_sin' hy]

name: arcsin_le_iff_le_sin'

proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total x (-1) with hx₁ | hx₁
  · simp [arcsin_of_le_neg_one hx₁, hy.1, hx₁.trans (neg_one_le_sin _)]
  rcases lt_or_ge 1 x with hx₂ | hx₂
  · simp [arcsin_of_one_le hx₂.le, hy.2.not_ge, (sin_le_one y).trans_lt hx₂]
  exact arcsin_le_iff_le_sin ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ (mem_Icc_of_Ico hy)

proof:

    arcsin_le_iff_le_sin ⟨neg_le_neg hy.2, neg_le.2 hy.1⟩ ⟨neg_le_neg hx.2, neg_le.2 hx.1⟩, sin_neg,

name: cos_arcsin
statement: theorem cos_arcsin (x : ℝ) : cos (arcsin x) = √(1 - x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx₁ : -1 ≤ x; swap
  · rw [not_le] at hx₁
    rw [arcsin_of_le_neg_one hx₁.le, cos_neg, cos_pi_div_two, sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos]
    nlinarith
  by_cases hx₂ : x ≤ 1; swap
  · rw [not_le] at hx₂
    rw [arcsin_of_one_le hx₂.le, cos_pi_div_two, sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos]
    nlinarith
  have : sin (arcsin x) ^ 2 + cos (arcsin x) ^ 2 = 1 := sin_sq_add_cos_sq (arcsin x)
  rw [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq', ← sqrt_inj (sq_nonneg _) (sub_nonneg.2 (sin_sq_le_one (arcsin x))), sq,
    sqrt_mul_self (cos_arcsin_nonneg _)] at this
  rw [this, sin_arcsin hx₁ hx₂]

  by_cases hx₁ : -1 ≤ x; swap
  · have h : √(1 - x ^ 2) = 0 := sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos (by nlinarith)
    rw [h]
    simp
  by_cases hx₂ : x ≤ 1; swap
  · have h : √(1 - x ^ 2) = 0 := sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos (by nlinarith)
    rw [h]
    simp
  rw [sin_arcsin hx₁ hx₂]

statement:
theorem tan_add
    (h : ((∀ k : ℤ, x ≠ (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧ ∀ l : ℤ, y ≠ (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) ∨
      (∃ k : ℤ, x = (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧ ∃ l : ℤ, y = (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) :
    tan (x + y) = (tan x + tan y) / (1 - tan x * tan y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← Complex.ofReal_inj, Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_div,
    Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_tan] using!
    @Complex.tan_add (x : ℂ) (y : ℂ) (by convert h <;> norm_cast)

      (∃ k : ℤ, x = (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧ ∃ l : ℤ, y = (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) :
    tan (x - y) = (tan x - tan y) / (1 + tan x * tan y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← Complex.ofReal_inj, Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_div,

statement: theorem continuousOn_tan_Ioo : ContinuousOn tan (Ioo (-(π / 2)) (π / 2))
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousOn.mono continuousOn_tan fun x => ?_
  simp only [and_imp, mem_Ioo, mem_ofPred_eq, Ne]
  rw [cos_eq_zero_iff]
  rintro hx_gt hx_lt ⟨r, hxr_eq⟩
  rcases le_or_gt 0 r with h | h
  · rw [lt_iff_not_ge] at hx_lt
    refine hx_lt ?_
    rw [hxr_eq, ← one_mul (π / 2), mul_div_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (half_pos pi_pos)]
    simp [h]
  · rw [lt_iff_not_ge] at hx_gt
    refine hx_gt ?_
    rw [hxr_eq, ← one_mul (π / 2), mul_div_assoc, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul,
      mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (half_pos pi_pos)]
    have hr_le : r ≤ -1 := by rwa [Int.lt_iff_add_one_le, ← le_neg_iff_add_nonpos_right] at h
    rw [← le_sub_iff_add_le, mul_comm, ← le_div_iff₀]
    · norm_num
      assumption_mod_cast
    · exact zero_lt_two

  · rw_mod_cast [tan_pi_div_two_sub, tan_arcsin, inv_div]

  · linarith only [arcsin_pos.2 h]

  · simpa using (arctan_lt_pi_div_two x).trans (half_lt_self_iff.mpr pi_pos)
  · rw [sub_lt_self_iff, ← arctan_zero]
    exact tanOrderIso.symm.strictMono h

  rwa [inv_neg, arctan_neg, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, neg_sub', arctan_neg, neg_neg] at this

name: arctan_ne_mul_pi_div_two
statement: lemma arctan_ne_mul_pi_div_two : ∀ (k : ℤ), arctan x ≠ (2 * k + 1) * π / 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! ⟨k, h⟩
  obtain ⟨lb, ub⟩ := arctan_mem_Ioo x
  rw [h, neg_eq_neg_one_mul, mul_div_assoc, mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ (by positivity)] at lb
  rw [h, ← one_mul (π / 2), mul_div_assoc, mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ (by positivity)] at ub
  norm_cast at lb ub; change -1 < _ at lb; lia

name: arctan_add_arctan_lt_pi_div_two

proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt y 0 with hy | hy
  · rw [← add_zero (π / 2), ← arctan_zero]
    exact add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (arctan_lt_pi_div_two _) (tanOrderIso.symm.monotone hy)
  · rw [← lt_div_iff₀ hy, ← inv_eq_one_div] at h
    replace h : arctan x < arctan y⁻¹ := tanOrderIso.symm.strictMono h
    rwa [arctan_inv_of_pos hy, lt_tsub_iff_right] at h

name: arctan_add
statement:
theorem arctan_add (h : x * y < 1) :
    arctan x + arctan y = arctan ((x + y) / (1 - x * y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← arctan_tan (x := _ + _)]
  · congr
    conv_rhs => rw [← tan_arctan x, ← tan_arctan y]
    exact tan_add' ⟨arctan_ne_mul_pi_div_two, arctan_ne_mul_pi_div_two⟩
  · rw [neg_lt, neg_add, ← arctan_neg, ← arctan_neg]
    rw [← neg_mul_neg] at h
    exact arctan_add_arctan_lt_pi_div_two h
  · exact arctan_add_arctan_lt_pi_div_two h

name: arctan_add_eq_add_pi
statement:
theorem arctan_add_eq_add_pi (h : 1 < x * y) (hx : 0 < x) :
    arctan x + arctan y = arctan ((x + y) / (1 - x * y)) + π
proof:
:= by
  have hy : 0 < y := by
    have := mul_pos_iff.mp (zero_lt_one.trans h)
    simpa [hx, hx.asymm]
  have k := arctan_add (mul_inv x y ▸ inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ h)
  rw [arctan_inv_of_pos hx, arctan_inv_of_pos hy, show _ + _ = π - (arctan x + arctan y) by ring,
    sub_eq_iff_eq_add, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', sub_eq_add_neg, ← arctan_neg, add_comm] at k
  grind

name: arctan_add_eq_sub_pi
statement:
theorem arctan_add_eq_sub_pi (h : 1 < x * y) (hx : x < 0) :
    arctan x + arctan y = arctan ((x + y) / (1 - x * y)) - π
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_mul_neg] at h
  have k := arctan_add_eq_add_pi h (neg_pos.mpr hx)
  rw [show _ / _ = -((x + y) / (1 - x * y)) by ring, ← neg_inj] at k
  simp only [arctan_neg, neg_add, neg_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg _ π] at k
  exact k

name: Complex.hasSum_cos'
statement:
theorem Complex.hasSum_cos' (z : ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (z * Complex.I) ^ (2 * n) / ↑(2 * n)!) (Complex.cos z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.cos, Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ]
  have := ((expSeries_div_hasSum_exp (z * Complex.I)).add
    (expSeries_div_hasSum_exp (-z * Complex.I))).div_const 2
  replace := (Nat.divModEquiv 2).symm.hasSum_iff.mpr this
  dsimp [Function.comp_def] at this
  simp_rw [← mul_comm 2 _] at this
  refine this.prod_fiberwise fun k => ?_
  dsimp only
  convert! hasSum_fintype (_ : Fin 2 → ℂ) using 1
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp_rw [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, add_zero, pow_succ, pow_mul, mul_pow, neg_sq, ← two_mul,
    neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_div, add_neg_cancel, zero_div, add_zero,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0)]

name: Complex.hasSum_sin'
statement:
theorem Complex.hasSum_sin' (z : ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (z * Complex.I) ^ (2 * n + 1) / ↑(2 * n + 1)! / Complex.I)
      (Complex.sin z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.sin, Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ]
  have := (((expSeries_div_hasSum_exp (-z * Complex.I)).sub
    (expSeries_div_hasSum_exp (z * Complex.I))).mul_right Complex.I).div_const 2
  replace := (Nat.divModEquiv 2).symm.hasSum_iff.mpr this
  dsimp [Function.comp_def] at this
  simp_rw [← mul_comm 2 _] at this
  refine this.prod_fiberwise fun k => ?_
  dsimp only
  convert! hasSum_fintype (_ : Fin 2 → ℂ) using 1
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp_rw [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, add_zero, pow_succ, pow_mul, mul_pow, neg_sq, sub_self,
    zero_mul, zero_div, zero_add, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_div, ← neg_add', ← two_mul,
    neg_mul, neg_div, mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0), Complex.div_I]

  apply iff_of_eq 
  congr

name: cos_eq_iff_coe_eq_or_eq_neg
statement:
theorem cos_eq_iff_coe_eq_or_eq_neg {θ ψ : ℝ} :
    cos θ = cos ψ ↔ (θ : Angle) = ψ ∨ (θ : Angle) = -ψ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro Hcos
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, cos_sub_cos, mul_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero, neg_eq_zero,
      eq_false (two_ne_zero' ℝ), false_or, sin_eq_zero_iff, sin_eq_zero_iff] at Hcos
    rcases Hcos with (⟨n, hn⟩ | ⟨n, hn⟩)
    · right
      rw [eq_div_iff_mul_eq (two_ne_zero' ℝ), ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hn
      rw [← hn, coe_sub, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, sub_add_cancel, mul_assoc, intCast_mul_eq_zsmul,
        mul_comm, coe_two_pi, zsmul_zero]
    · left
      rw [eq_div_iff_mul_eq (two_ne_zero' ℝ), eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at hn
      rw [← hn, coe_add, mul_assoc, intCast_mul_eq_zsmul, mul_comm, coe_two_pi, zsmul_zero,
        zero_add]
  · rw [angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub, ← coe_neg, angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub]
    rintro (⟨k, H⟩ | ⟨k, H⟩)
    · rw [← sub_eq_zero, cos_sub_cos, H, mul_assoc 2 π k, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (two_ne_zero' ℝ),
        mul_comm π _, sin_int_mul_pi, mul_zero]
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, cos_sub_cos, ← sub_neg_eq_add, H, mul_assoc 2 π k,
      mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (two_ne_zero' ℝ), mul_comm π _, sin_int_mul_pi, mul_zero,
      zero_mul]

name: sin_eq_iff_coe_eq_or_add_eq_pi
statement:
theorem sin_eq_iff_coe_eq_or_add_eq_pi {θ ψ : ℝ} :
    sin θ = sin ψ ↔ (θ : Angle) = ψ ∨ (θ : Angle) + ψ = π
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro Hsin
    rw [← cos_pi_div_two_sub, ← cos_pi_div_two_sub] at Hsin
    rcases cos_eq_iff_coe_eq_or_eq_neg.mp Hsin with h | h
    · left
      rw [coe_sub, coe_sub] at h
      exact sub_right_inj.1 h
    right
    rw [coe_sub, coe_sub, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_sub, sub_add_eq_add_sub, ← coe_add,
      add_halves, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  · rw [angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← coe_sub, angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub]
    rintro (⟨k, H⟩ | ⟨k, H⟩)
    · rw [← sub_eq_zero, sin_sub_sin, H, mul_assoc 2 π k, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (two_ne_zero' ℝ),
        mul_comm π _, sin_int_mul_pi, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    have H' : θ + ψ = 2 * k * π + π := by
      rwa [← sub_add, sub_add_eq_add_sub, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, mul_assoc, mul_comm π _, ←
        mul_assoc] at H
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, sin_sub_sin, H', add_div, mul_assoc 2 _ π,
      mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (two_ne_zero' ℝ), cos_add_pi_div_two, sin_int_mul_pi, neg_zero,
      mul_zero]

name: cos_sin_inj
statement: theorem cos_sin_inj {θ ψ : ℝ} (Hcos : cos θ = cos ψ) (Hsin : sin θ = sin ψ) : (θ : Angle) = ψ
proof:
:= by
  rcases cos_eq_iff_coe_eq_or_eq_neg.mp Hcos with hc | hc; · exact hc
  rcases sin_eq_iff_coe_eq_or_add_eq_pi.mp Hsin with hs | hs; · exact hs
  rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, hs] at hc
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, n • _ = _ := QuotientAddGroup.leftRel_apply.mp (Quotient.exact' hc)
  rw [← neg_one_mul, add_zero, ← sub_eq_zero, zsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← sub_mul, mul_eq_zero,
    eq_false (ne_of_gt pi_pos), or_false, sub_neg_eq_add, ← Int.cast_zero, ← Int.cast_one,
    ← Int.cast_ofNat, ← Int.cast_mul, ← Int.cast_add, Int.cast_inj] at hn
  have : (n * 2 + 1) % (2 : ℤ) = 0 % (2 : ℤ) := congr_arg (· % (2 : ℤ)) hn
  rw [add_comm, Int.add_mul_emod_self_right] at this
  exact absurd this one_ne_zero

  by_cases hnegpi : θ = π; · simp [hnegpi, Real.pi_pos.le]
  rw [← coe_neg,
    toReal_coe_eq_self_iff.2
      ⟨neg_lt_neg (lt_of_le_of_ne h.2 hnegpi), (neg_nonpos.2 h.1).trans Real.pi_pos.le⟩,

name: nsmul_toReal_eq_mul
statement:
theorem nsmul_toReal_eq_mul {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) {θ : Angle} :
    (n • θ).toReal = n * θ.toReal ↔ θ.toReal ∈ Set.Ioc (-π / n) (π / n)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← coe_toReal θ]
  have h' : 0 < (n : ℝ) := mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h
  rw [← coe_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, toReal_coe_eq_self_iff, Set.mem_Ioc, div_lt_iff₀' h',
    le_div_iff₀' h']

name: two_nsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul
statement:
theorem two_nsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul {θ : Angle} :
    ((2 : ℕ) • θ).toReal = 2 * θ.toReal ↔ θ.toReal ∈ Set.Ioc (-π / 2) (π / 2)

name: two_zsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul
statement:
theorem two_zsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul {θ : Angle} :
    ((2 : ℤ) • θ).toReal = 2 * θ.toReal ↔ θ.toReal ∈ Set.Ioc (-π / 2) (π / 2)

name: toReal_coe_eq_self_sub_two_mul_int_mul_pi_iff
statement:
theorem toReal_coe_eq_self_sub_two_mul_int_mul_pi_iff {θ : ℝ} {k : ℤ} :
    (θ : Angle).toReal = θ - 2 * k * π ↔ θ ∈ Set.Ioc ((2 * k - 1 : ℝ) * π) ((2 * k + 1) * π)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_zero (θ : Angle), ← zsmul_zero k, ← coe_two_pi, ← coe_zsmul, ← coe_sub, zsmul_eq_mul, ←
    mul_assoc, mul_comm (k : ℝ), toReal_coe_eq_self_iff, Set.mem_Ioc]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, fun h => ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩

name: toReal_coe_eq_self_sub_two_pi_iff
statement:
theorem toReal_coe_eq_self_sub_two_pi_iff {θ : ℝ} :
    (θ : Angle).toReal = θ - 2 * π ↔ θ ∈ Set.Ioc π (3 * π)

name: toReal_coe_eq_self_add_two_pi_iff
statement:
theorem toReal_coe_eq_self_add_two_pi_iff {θ : ℝ} :
    (θ : Angle).toReal = θ + 2 * π ↔ θ ∈ Set.Ioc (-3 * π) (-π)

name: two_nsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul_sub_two_pi
statement:
theorem two_nsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul_sub_two_pi {θ : Angle} :
    ((2 : ℕ) • θ).toReal = 2 * θ.toReal - 2 * π ↔ π / 2 < θ.toReal
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← coe_toReal θ]
  rw [← coe_nsmul, two_nsmul, ← two_mul, toReal_coe_eq_self_sub_two_pi_iff, Set.mem_Ioc]
  exact
    ⟨fun h => by linarith, fun h =>
      ⟨(div_lt_iff₀' (zero_lt_two' ℝ)).1 h, by linarith [pi_pos, toReal_le_pi θ]⟩⟩

name: two_zsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul_sub_two_pi
statement:
theorem two_zsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul_sub_two_pi {θ : Angle} :
    ((2 : ℤ) • θ).toReal = 2 * θ.toReal - 2 * π ↔ π / 2 < θ.toReal

name: two_nsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul_add_two_pi
statement:
theorem two_nsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul_add_two_pi {θ : Angle} :
    ((2 : ℕ) • θ).toReal = 2 * θ.toReal + 2 * π ↔ θ.toReal ≤ -π / 2
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← coe_toReal θ]
  rw [← coe_nsmul, two_nsmul, ← two_mul, toReal_coe_eq_self_add_two_pi_iff, Set.mem_Ioc]
  refine
    ⟨fun h => by linarith, fun h =>
      ⟨by linarith [pi_pos, neg_pi_lt_toReal θ], (le_div_iff₀' (zero_lt_two' ℝ)).1 h⟩⟩

name: two_zsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul_add_two_pi
statement:
theorem two_zsmul_toReal_eq_two_mul_add_two_pi {θ : Angle} :
    ((2 : ℤ) • θ).toReal = 2 * θ.toReal + 2 * π ↔ θ.toReal ≤ -π / 2

statement: theorem cos_nonneg_iff_abs_toReal_le_pi_div_two {θ : Angle} : 0 ≤ cos θ ↔ |θ.toReal| ≤ π / 2
proof:

  have : 0 < π / 2 := by positivity
  have := toReal_mem_Ioc θ
  rw [← cos_toReal, ← cos_abs]
  grind [cos_neg_of_pi_div_two_lt_of_lt, cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc]

    and_congr_right]
  rintro -
  contrapose
  rw [@eq_comm ℝ 0, abs_toReal_eq_pi_div_two_iff, cos_eq_zero_iff]

name: two_nsmul_eq_iff_eq_of_abs_toReal_lt_pi_div_two
statement:
lemma two_nsmul_eq_iff_eq_of_abs_toReal_lt_pi_div_two {θ ψ : Angle} (hθ : |θ.toReal| < π / 2)
    (hψ : |ψ.toReal| < π / 2) : (2 : ℕ) • θ = (2 : ℕ) • ψ ↔ θ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  suffices θ ≠ ψ + π by simp [this, two_nsmul_eq_iff]
  rintro rfl
  simp only [← cos_pos_iff_abs_toReal_lt_pi_div_two, cos_add_pi] at hθ hψ
  grind

name: abs_cos_eq_abs_sin_of_two_nsmul_add_two_nsmul_eq_pi
statement:
theorem abs_cos_eq_abs_sin_of_two_nsmul_add_two_nsmul_eq_pi {θ ψ : Angle}
    (h : (2 : ℕ) • θ + (2 : ℕ) • ψ = π) : |cos θ| = |sin ψ|
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← two_nsmul_coe_div_two, ← nsmul_sub, two_nsmul_eq_iff] at h
  rcases h with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp [cos_pi_div_two_sub]

name: abs_cos_eq_abs_sin_of_two_zsmul_add_two_zsmul_eq_pi

theorem abs_cos_eq_abs_sin_of_two_zsmul_add_two_zsmul_eq_pi {θ ψ : Angle}

proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [two_zsmul, ← two_nsmul] at h
  exact abs_cos_eq_abs_sin_of_two_nsmul_add_two_nsmul_eq_pi h

name: tan_eq_of_two_nsmul_eq
statement: theorem tan_eq_of_two_nsmul_eq {θ ψ : Angle} (h : (2 : ℕ) • θ = (2 : ℕ) • ψ) : tan θ = tan ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_nsmul_eq_iff] at h

  · rfl
  · exact tan_add_pi _

name: tan_eq_of_two_zsmul_eq

name: tan_eq_inv_of_two_nsmul_add_two_nsmul_eq_pi
statement:
theorem tan_eq_inv_of_two_nsmul_add_two_nsmul_eq_pi {θ ψ : Angle}
    (h : (2 : ℕ) • θ + (2 : ℕ) • ψ = π) : tan ψ = (tan θ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction θ using Real.Angle.induction_on
  induction ψ using Real.Angle.induction_on
  rw [← smul_add, ← coe_add, ← coe_nsmul, two_nsmul, ← two_mul, angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub] at h
  rcases h with ⟨k, h⟩
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add, ← mul_inv_cancel_left₀ two_ne_zero π, mul_assoc, ← mul_add,
    mul_right_inj' (two_ne_zero' ℝ), ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq', mul_inv_cancel_left₀ two_ne_zero π,
    inv_mul_eq_div, mul_comm] at h
  rw [tan_coe, tan_coe, ← tan_pi_div_two_sub, h, add_sub_assoc, add_comm]
  exact Real.tan_periodic.int_mul _ _

name: tan_eq_inv_of_two_zsmul_add_two_zsmul_eq_pi
statement:
theorem tan_eq_inv_of_two_zsmul_add_two_zsmul_eq_pi {θ ψ : Angle}
    (h : (2 : ℤ) • θ + (2 : ℤ) • ψ = π) : tan ψ = (tan θ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [two_zsmul, ← two_nsmul] at h
  exact tan_eq_inv_of_two_nsmul_add_two_nsmul_eq_pi h

name: toReal_neg_iff_sign_neg

proof:
:= by
  rw [sign, ← sin_toReal, sign_eq_neg_one_iff]
  grind [sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi, sin_neg_of_neg_of_neg_pi_lt, toReal_mem_Ioc]

name: sign_toReal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sign_toReal {θ : Angle} (h : θ ≠ π) : SignType.sign θ.toReal = θ.sign
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy θ.toReal 0 with (ht | ht | ht)
  · simp [ht, toReal_neg_iff_sign_neg.1 ht]
  · simp [sign, ht, ← sin_toReal]
  · rw [sign, ← sin_toReal, sign_pos ht,
      sign_pos
        (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi ht ((toReal_le_pi θ).lt_of_ne (toReal_eq_pi_iff.not.2 h)))]

name: toReal_mem_Ioo_iff_sign_pos
statement:
lemma toReal_mem_Ioo_iff_sign_pos {θ : Angle} :
    θ.toReal ∈ Set.Ioo 0 π ↔ θ.sign = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne θ π with rfl | h
  · simp
  · simp only [Set.mem_Ioo, ← sign_toReal h, sign_eq_one_iff, and_iff_left_iff_imp]
    exact fun _ ↦ (toReal_le_pi θ).lt_of_ne (toReal_eq_pi_iff.not.2 h)

name: coe_abs_toReal_of_sign_nonneg

name: neg_coe_abs_toReal_of_sign_nonpos
statement: theorem neg_coe_abs_toReal_of_sign_nonpos {θ : Angle} (h : θ.sign ≤ 0) : -↑|θ.toReal| = θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [SignType.nonpos_iff] at h
  rcases h with (h | h)
  · rw [abs_of_neg (toReal_neg_iff_sign_neg.2 h), coe_neg, neg_neg, coe_toReal]
  · rw [sign_eq_zero_iff] at h
    rcases h with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp [abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]

name: sign_two_nsmul_eq_sign_iff
statement:
theorem sign_two_nsmul_eq_sign_iff {θ : Angle} :
    ((2 : ℕ) • θ).sign = θ.sign ↔ θ = π ∨ |θ.toReal| < π / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sign, sin_two_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, sign_mul, Nat.ofNat_pos, sign_pos,
    one_mul, mul_right_eq_self₀, _root_.sign_eq_zero_iff, sign_eq_one_iff, sin_eq_zero_iff,
    cos_pos_iff_abs_toReal_lt_pi_div_two]

theorem sign_two_zsmul_eq_sign_iff {θ : Angle} :

lemma sign_two_nsmul_eq_neg_sign_iff {θ : Angle} :

lemma sign_two_zsmul_eq_neg_sign_iff {θ : Angle} :

name: eq_add_pi_of_two_zsmul_eq_of_sign_eq_neg
statement:
theorem eq_add_pi_of_two_zsmul_eq_of_sign_eq_neg (a b : Real.Angle) (h : (2 : ℤ) • a = (2 : ℤ) • b)
    (h_sign : a.sign = -b.sign) (h_ne : b.sign ≠ 0) : a = b + π
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Real.Angle.two_zsmul_eq_iff.mp h
  refine h1.resolve_left ?_
  rintro rfl
  simp only [SignType.self_eq_neg_iff] at h_sign
  rw [h_sign] at h_ne
  contradiction

name: sub_ne_pi_of_sign_eq_of_sign_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sub_ne_pi_of_sign_eq_of_sign_ne_zero (a b : Real.Angle) (h_sign : a.sign = b.sign)
    (h_ne : b.sign ≠ 0) : a - b ≠ π
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : a = b + π := by
    simp [← h]
  have h_sign' := h_sign
  rw [h', Real.Angle.sign_add_pi] at h_sign'
  simp only [SignType.neg_eq_self_iff] at h_sign'
  contradiction

name: two_zsmul_eq_iff_eq
statement:
theorem two_zsmul_eq_iff_eq {a b : Real.Angle} (ha : a.sign ≠ 0) (h : a.sign = b.sign) :
    (2 : ℤ) • a = (2 : ℤ) • b ↔ a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.Angle.two_zsmul_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with h1 | h2
    · exact h1
    · have : a.sign = (b + π).sign := by aesop
      rw [Real.Angle.sign_add_pi] at this
      have := congr_arg (· = b.sign) this
      aesop
  · intro h
    aesop

name: abs_toReal_add_abs_toReal_eq_pi_of_two_nsmul_add_eq_zero_of_sign_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases two_nsmul_eq_zero_iff.mp h with h | h
  · simp_all [add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.mp h]
  rw [← coe_toReal θ, ← coe_toReal ψ, ← coe_add] at h
  suffices |θ.toReal + ψ.toReal| = π by grind [toReal_neg_iff_sign_neg, abs_add_eq_add_abs_iff]
  rw [abs_eq pi_nonneg]
  rcases angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub.mp h with ⟨k, hk⟩
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hk
  have : k ∈ Finset.Icc (-1) 0 :=
    IsStrictOrderedRing.int_mem_Icc_of_mul_mem_Ioo two_pi_pos <| by grind [toReal_mem_Ioc]
  fin_cases this
  all_goals simp at hk; grind

name: abs_toReal_add_abs_toReal_eq_pi_of_two_zsmul_add_eq_zero_of_sign_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_zsmul, ← two_nsmul] at h
  exact abs_toReal_add_abs_toReal_eq_pi_of_two_nsmul_add_eq_zero_of_sign_eq h hs h0

name: toReal_add_of_sign_pos_sign_neg
statement:
lemma toReal_add_of_sign_pos_sign_neg {θ ψ : Angle}
    (hθ : θ.sign = 1) (hψ : ψ.sign = -1) : (θ + ψ).toReal = θ.toReal + ψ.toReal
proof:
:= by
  suffices ((θ.toReal + ψ.toReal : ℝ) : Angle).toReal = θ.toReal + ψ.toReal by simpa using this
  rw [toReal_coe_eq_self_iff]
  grind [toReal_mem_Ioc, toReal_neg_iff_sign_neg, toReal_mem_Ioo_iff_sign_pos]

name: toReal_add_of_sign_eq_neg_sign
statement:
lemma toReal_add_of_sign_eq_neg_sign {θ ψ : Angle} (hψ : θ ≠ π ∨ ψ ≠ π)
    (hs : θ.sign = -ψ.sign) : (θ + ψ).toReal = θ.toReal + ψ.toReal
proof:
:= by
  obtain (h | h | h) := ψ.sign.trichotomy
  all_goals grind [neg_neg, add_comm, toReal_add_of_sign_pos_sign_neg]

name: toReal_add_eq_toReal_add_toReal
statement:
lemma toReal_add_eq_toReal_add_toReal {θ ψ : Angle} (hθ : θ ≠ π) (hψ : ψ ≠ π)
    (hs : θ.sign ≠ ψ.sign ∨ θ.sign = (θ + ψ).sign) : (θ + ψ).toReal = θ.toReal + ψ.toReal
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hs | hs) := hs
  · obtain (h | h | h) := ψ.sign.trichotomy <;> obtain (h | h | h) := θ.sign.trichotomy
    all_goals grind [add_comm, toReal_add_of_sign_pos_sign_neg, sign_eq_zero_iff]
  · rw [← neg_neg θ.sign, ← sign_neg] at hs
    have := toReal_add_of_sign_eq_neg_sign (.inr <| by simpa [neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]) hs.symm
    simpa [toReal_neg_eq_neg_toReal_iff.mpr, hθ, ← sub_eq_add_neg, eq_sub_iff_add_eq', eq_comm]

name: abs_toReal_add_eq_two_pi_sub_abs_toReal_add_abs_toReal_aux
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toReal_mem_Ioo_iff_sign_pos] at hθs hψs
  have : ((θ + ψ).toReal : Angle) = ↑(θ.toReal + ψ.toReal) := by simp
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub.mp this
  obtain (h | h) : (θ + ψ).toReal ≤ 0 ∨ θ + ψ = π := by
    have := (θ + ψ).sign.trichotomy
    grind [sign_eq_zero_iff, toReal_eq_zero_iff, toReal_neg_iff_sign_neg]
  · obtain rfl : k = -1 := IsStrictOrderedRing.int_eq_of_mul_mem_Ioo two_pi_pos <| by
      grind [toReal_mem_Ioc]
    grind [abs_of_nonpos]
  · simp_all only [sign_coe_pi, ne_eq, zero_ne_one, not_false_eq_true, toReal_pi, coe_add,
      coe_toReal, pi_pos, abs_of_pos]
    obtain rfl : k = 0 := IsStrictOrderedRing.int_eq_of_mul_mem_Ioo two_pi_pos (by grind)
    grind

name: abs_toReal_add_eq_two_pi_sub_abs_toReal_add_abs_toReal
statement:
lemma abs_toReal_add_eq_two_pi_sub_abs_toReal_add_abs_toReal {θ ψ : Angle} (hs : θ.sign = ψ.sign)
    (hsa : θ.sign ≠ (θ + ψ).sign) : |(θ + ψ).toReal| = 2 * π - (|θ.toReal| + |ψ.toReal|)
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h | h := θ.sign.trichotomy
  · obtain ⟨hθ', hψ'⟩ : (-θ).sign = 1 ∧ (-ψ).sign = 1 := by grind [sign_neg, neg_neg]
    have hsa' : (-θ + -ψ).sign ≠ 1 := by
      rwa [← hθ', ne_comm, ← neg_add, sign_neg, sign_neg, neg_injective.ne_iff]
    convert! abs_toReal_add_eq_two_pi_sub_abs_toReal_add_abs_toReal_aux hθ' hψ' hsa' using 1
    all_goals simp [-neg_add_rev, ← neg_add, abs_toReal_neg]
  · grind [sign_eq_zero_iff, coe_pi_add_coe_pi]
  · exact abs_toReal_add_eq_two_pi_sub_abs_toReal_add_abs_toReal_aux h (hs ▸ h) (h ▸ hsa.symm)

name: deriv_arcsin_aux
statement:
theorem deriv_arcsin_aux {x : ℝ} (h₁ : x ≠ -1) (h₂ : x ≠ 1) :
    HasStrictDerivAt arcsin (1 / √(1 - x ^ 2)) x ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ω arcsin x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h₁.lt_or_gt with h₁ | h₁
  · have : 1 - x ^ 2 < 0 := by nlinarith [h₁]
    rw [sqrt_eq_zero'.2 this.le, div_zero]
    have : arcsin =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => -(π / 2) :=
      (gt_mem_nhds h₁).mono fun y hy => arcsin_of_le_neg_one hy.le
    exact ⟨(hasStrictDerivAt_const x _).congr_of_eventuallyEq this.symm,
      contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq this⟩
  rcases h₂.lt_or_gt with h₂ | h₂
  · have : 0 < √(1 - x ^ 2) := sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith [h₁, h₂])
    simp only [← cos_arcsin, one_div] at this ⊢
    exact ⟨sinPartialHomeomorph.hasStrictDerivAt_symm ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ this.ne' (hasStrictDerivAt_sin _),
      sinPartialHomeomorph.contDiffAt_symm_deriv this.ne' ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ (hasDerivAt_sin _)
        contDiff_sin.contDiffAt⟩
  · have : 1 - x ^ 2 < 0 := by nlinarith [h₂]
    rw [sqrt_eq_zero'.2 this.le, div_zero]
    have : arcsin =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => π / 2 := (lt_mem_nhds h₂).mono fun y hy => arcsin_of_one_le hy.le
    exact ⟨(hasStrictDerivAt_const x _).congr_of_eventuallyEq this.symm,
      contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq this⟩

name: differentiableWithinAt_arcsin_Ici
statement:
theorem differentiableWithinAt_arcsin_Ici {x : ℝ} :
    DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ arcsin (Ici x) x ↔ x ≠ -1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => (hasDerivWithinAt_arcsin_Ici h).differentiableWithinAt⟩
  rintro h rfl
  have : sin ∘ arcsin =ᶠ[𝓝[≥] (-1 : ℝ)] id := by
    filter_upwards [Icc_mem_nhdsGE (neg_lt_self zero_lt_one)] with x using sin_arcsin'
  have := h.hasDerivWithinAt.sin.congr_of_eventuallyEq this.symm (by simp)
  simpa using (uniqueDiffOn_Ici _ _ self_mem_Ici).eq_deriv _ this (hasDerivWithinAt_id _ _)

:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => (hasDerivWithinAt_arcsin_Iic h).differentiableWithinAt⟩
  rw [← neg_neg x, ← image_neg_Ici] at h
  have := (h.comp (-x) differentiableWithinAt_id.fun_neg (mapsTo_image _ _)).fun_neg
  simpa [(· ∘ ·), differentiableWithinAt_arcsin_Ici] using this

    | inl h0 => exact (sin_neg_of_neg_of_neg_pi_lt h0 hx₁).ne

name: sin_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem sin_eq_zero_iff {x : ℝ} : sin x = 0 ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, (n : ℝ) * π = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    ⟨⌊x / π⌋,
      le_antisymm (sub_nonneg.1 (Int.sub_floor_div_mul_nonneg _ pi_pos))
        (sub_nonpos.1 <|
          le_of_not_gt fun h₃ =>
            (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi h₃ (Int.sub_floor_div_mul_lt _ pi_pos)).ne
              (by simp [sub_eq_add_neg, sin_add, h, sin_int_mul_pi]))⟩,
    fun ⟨_, hn⟩ => hn ▸ sin_int_mul_pi _⟩

name: cos_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem cos_eq_one_iff (x : ℝ) : cos x = 1 ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, (n : ℝ) * (2 * π) = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    let ⟨n, hn⟩ := sin_eq_zero_iff.1 (sin_eq_zero_iff_cos_eq.2 (Or.inl h))
    ⟨n / 2,
      (Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one n).elim
        (fun hn0 => by
          rwa [← mul_assoc, ← @Int.cast_two ℝ, ← Int.cast_mul,
            Int.ediv_mul_cancel (Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero.2 hn0)])
        fun hn1 => by
        rw [← Int.emod_add_mul_ediv n 2, hn1, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, add_mul, one_mul,
          add_comm, mul_comm (2 : ℤ), Int.cast_mul, mul_assoc, Int.cast_two] at hn
        rw [← hn, cos_int_mul_two_pi_add_pi] at h
        exact absurd h (by norm_num)⟩,
    fun ⟨_, hn⟩ => hn ▸ cos_int_mul_two_pi _⟩

name: cos_eq_one_iff_of_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem cos_eq_one_iff_of_lt_of_lt {x : ℝ} (hx₁ : -(2 * π) < x) (hx₂ : x < 2 * π) :
    cos x = 1 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rcases (cos_eq_one_iff _).1 h with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rw [mul_lt_iff_lt_one_left two_pi_pos] at hx₂
    rw [neg_lt, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul, mul_lt_iff_lt_one_left two_pi_pos] at hx₁
    norm_cast at hx₁ hx₂
    obtain rfl : n = 0 := le_antisymm (by lia) (by lia)
    simp, fun h => by simp [h]⟩

name: sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two

    (hxy : x < y) : sin x < sin y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_pos, sin_sub_sin]
  have : 0 < sin ((y - x) / 2) := by apply sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi <;> linarith
  have : 0 < cos ((y + x) / 2) := by refine cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  positivity

theorem sqrtTwoAddSeries_lt_two : ∀ n : ℕ, sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 n < 2

    rw [sqrtTwoAddSeries, sqrt_lt_sqrt_iff, ← lt_sub_iff_add_lt']
    · refine (sqrtTwoAddSeries_lt_two n).trans_le ?_
      norm_num
    · exact add_nonneg zero_le_two (sqrtTwoAddSeries_zero_nonneg n)

name: cos_pi_over_two_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cos_pi_over_two_pow : ∀ n : ℕ, cos (π / 2 ^ (n + 1)) = sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 n / 2
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
    have A : (1 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= one_lt_pow₀ one_lt_two n.succ_ne_zero
    have B : π / 2 ^ (n + 1) < π := div_lt_self pi_pos A
    have C : 0 < π / 2 ^ (n + 1) := by positivity
    rw [pow_succ, div_mul_eq_div_div, cos_half, cos_pi_over_two_pow n, sqrtTwoAddSeries,
      add_div_eq_mul_add_div, one_mul, ← div_mul_eq_div_div, sqrt_div, sqrt_mul_self] <;>
      linarith [sqrtTwoAddSeries_nonneg le_rfl n]

  · congr
    · norm_num

  · exact add_nonneg two_pos.le (sqrtTwoAddSeries_zero_nonneg _)

  rw [eq_div_iff_mul_eq two_ne_zero, eq_comm, sqrt_eq_iff_eq_sq, mul_pow,
    sin_sq_pi_over_two_pow_succ, sub_mul]
  · congr <;> norm_num
  · rw [sub_nonneg]
    exact (sqrtTwoAddSeries_lt_two _).le
  refine mul_nonneg (sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ?_ ?_) zero_le_two
  · positivity
  · exact div_le_self pi_pos.le <| one_le_pow₀ one_le_two

name: quadratic_root_cos_pi_div_five
statement:
theorem quadratic_root_cos_pi_div_five :
    letI c
proof:
:= cos (π / 5)
    4 * c ^ 2 - 2 * c - 1 = 0 := by
  set θ := π / 5 with hθ
  set c := cos θ
  set s := sin θ
  suffices 2 * c = 4 * c ^ 2 - 1 by simp [this]
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, sin_eq_zero_iff, hθ]
    push Not
    intro n hn
    replace hn : n * 5 = 1 := by field_simp at hn; norm_cast at hn
    lia
  suffices s * (2 * c) = s * (4 * c ^ 2 - 1) from mul_left_cancel₀ hs this
  calc s * (2 * c) = 2 * s * c := by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm 2]
                 _ = sin (2 * θ) := by rw [sin_two_mul]
                 _ = sin (π - 2 * θ) := by rw [sin_pi_sub]
                 _ = sin (2 * θ + θ) := by congr; linarith
                 _ = sin (2 * θ) * c + cos (2 * θ) * s := sin_add (2 * θ) θ
                 _ = 2 * s * c * c + cos (2 * θ) * s := by rw [sin_two_mul]
                 _ = 2 * s * c * c + (2 * c ^ 2 - 1) * s := by rw [cos_two_mul]
                 _ = s * (2 * c * c) + s * (2 * c ^ 2 - 1) := by linarith
                 _ = s * (4 * c ^ 2 - 1) := by linarith

theorem cos_pi_div_five : cos (π / 5) = (1 + √5) / 4
proof:
:= by
  set c := cos (π / 5)
  have : 4 * (c * c) + (-2) * c + (-1) = 0 := by
    rw [← sq, neg_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact quadratic_root_cos_pi_div_five
  have hd : discrim 4 (-2) (-1) = (2 * √5) * (2 * √5) := by norm_num [discrim, mul_mul_mul_comm]
  rcases (quadratic_eq_zero_iff (by simp) hd c).mp this with h | h
  · simp [h]; linarith
  · absurd (show 0 ≤ c from cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc <| by constructor <;> linarith [pi_pos.le])
    rw [not_le, h]
    exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num [lt_sqrt]) (by positivity)

  · exact

  · refine Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨?_, hb⟩

name: cos_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem cos_eq_zero_iff {θ : ℂ} : cos θ = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, θ = (2 * k + 1) * π / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : (exp (θ * I) + exp (-θ * I)) / 2 = 0 ↔ exp (2 * θ * I) = -1 := by
    rw [@div_eq_iff _ _ (exp (θ * I) + exp (-θ * I)) 2 0 two_ne_zero, zero_mul,
      add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg, neg_eq_neg_one_mul, ← div_eq_iff (exp_ne_zero _), ← exp_sub]
    ring_nf
  rw [cos, h, ← exp_pi_mul_I, exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int, mul_right_comm]
  refine exists_congr fun x => ?_
  refine (iff_of_eq <| congr_arg _ ?_).trans (mul_right_inj' <| mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero I_ne_zero)
  ring

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    use k + 1
    simp [eq_add_of_sub_eq hk]
    ring
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    use k - 1

    ring

name: cos_eq_cos_iff
statement: theorem cos_eq_cos_iff {x y : ℂ} : cos x = cos y ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, y = 2 * k * π + x ∨ y = 2 * k * π - x
proof:
:=
  calc
    cos x = cos y ↔ cos x - cos y = 0 := sub_eq_zero.symm
    _ ↔ -2 * sin ((x + y) / 2) * sin ((x - y) / 2) = 0 := by rw [cos_sub_cos]
    _ ↔ sin ((x + y) / 2) = 0 ∨ sin ((x - y) / 2) = 0 := by simp [(by simp : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0)]
    _ ↔ sin ((x - y) / 2) = 0 ∨ sin ((x + y) / 2) = 0 := or_comm
    _ ↔ (∃ k : ℤ, y = 2 * k * π + x) ∨ ∃ k : ℤ, y = 2 * k * π - x := by
      apply or_congr <;>
        simp only [field, sin_eq_zero_iff, eq_sub_iff_add_eq',
          sub_eq_iff_eq_add, mul_comm (2 : ℂ), mul_right_comm _ (2 : ℂ)]
      constructor <;> · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; use -k; simp
    _ ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, y = 2 * k * π + x ∨ y = 2 * k * π - x := exists_or.symm

name: tan_add
statement:
theorem tan_add {x y : ℂ}
    (h : ((∀ k : ℤ, x ≠ (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧ ∀ l : ℤ, y ≠ (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) ∨
      (∃ k : ℤ, x = (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧ ∃ l : ℤ, y = (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) :
    tan (x + y) = (tan x + tan y) / (1 - tan x * tan y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with (⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨⟨k, rfl⟩, ⟨l, rfl⟩⟩)
  · rw [tan, sin_add, cos_add, ←
      div_div_div_cancel_right₀ (mul_ne_zero (cos_ne_zero_iff.mpr h1) (cos_ne_zero_iff.mpr h2)),
      add_div, sub_div]
    simp only [← div_mul_div_comm, tan, mul_one, one_mul, div_self (cos_ne_zero_iff.mpr h1),
      div_self (cos_ne_zero_iff.mpr h2)]
  · have t := tan_int_mul_pi_div_two
    obtain ⟨hx, hy, hxy⟩ := t (2 * k + 1), t (2 * l + 1), t (2 * k + 1 + (2 * l + 1))
    simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_two, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_one] at hx hy hxy
    rw [hx, hy, add_zero, zero_div, mul_div_assoc, mul_div_assoc, ←
      add_mul (2 * (k : ℂ) + 1) (2 * l + 1) (π / 2), ← mul_div_assoc, hxy]

name: tan_add'
tan_sub
statement:
theorem tan_sub {x y : ℂ}
    (h : ((∀ k : ℤ, x ≠ (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧ ∀ l : ℤ, y ≠ (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) ∨
      (∃ k : ℤ, x = (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧ ∃ l : ℤ, y = (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) :
    tan (x - y) = (tan x - tan y) / (1 + tan x * tan y)
proof:
:= by
  have := tan_add (x := x) (y := -y) <| by
    rcases h with ⟨x_ne, minus_y_ne⟩ | ⟨x_eq, minus_y_eq⟩
    · refine .inl ⟨x_ne, fun l => ?_⟩
      rw [Ne, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]
      convert! minus_y_ne (-l - 1) using 2
      push_cast
      ring
    · refine .inr ⟨x_eq, ?_⟩
      rcases minus_y_eq with ⟨l, rfl⟩
      use -l - 1
      push_cast
      ring
  rw [tan_neg] at this
  convert! this using 2
  ring

name: tan_sub'
tan_two_mul
statement: theorem tan_two_mul {z : ℂ} : tan (2 * z) = (2 : ℂ) * tan z / ((1 : ℂ) - tan z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : ∀ k : ℤ, z ≠ (2 * k + 1) * π / 2
  · rw [two_mul, two_mul, sq, tan_add (Or.inl ⟨h, h⟩)]
  · rw [two_mul, two_mul, sq, tan_add (Or.inr ⟨h, h⟩)]

name: tan_add_mul_I
statement:
theorem tan_add_mul_I {x y : ℂ}
    (h :
      ((∀ k : ℤ, x ≠ (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧ ∀ l : ℤ, y * I ≠ (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) ∨
        (∃ k : ℤ, x = (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧ ∃ l : ℤ, y * I = (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) :
    tan (x + y * I) = (tan x + tanh y * I) / (1 - tan x * tanh y * I)

name: tan_eq
statement:
theorem tan_eq {z : ℂ}
    (h :
      ((∀ k : ℤ, (z.re : ℂ) ≠ (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧
          ∀ l : ℤ, (z.im : ℂ) * I ≠ (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) ∨
        (∃ k : ℤ, (z.re : ℂ) = (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧
          ∃ l : ℤ, (z.im : ℂ) * I = (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) :
    tan z = (tan z.re + tanh z.im * I) / (1 - tan z.re * tanh z.im * I)
proof:
:= by
  convert! tan_add_mul_I h; exact (re_add_im z).symm

name: tan_eq_zero_of_cos_eq_zero

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hxk⟩ := cos_eq_zero_iff.mp h
  exact tan_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨2 * k + 1, by simp [hxk]⟩

name: cos_eq_two_mul_tan_half_div_one_sub_tan_half_sq
statement:
theorem cos_eq_two_mul_tan_half_div_one_sub_tan_half_sq (x : ℂ) (h : cos x ≠ -1) :
    cos x = (1 - tan (x / 2) ^ 2) / (1 + tan (x / 2) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← mul_div_cancel₀ x two_ne_zero, cos_two_mul']
  have : cos (x / 2) ≠ 0 := by grind [cos_ne_zero_iff, cos_eq_neg_one_iff]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv (1 - tan (x / 2) ^ 2) (1 + tan (x / 2) ^ 2), inv_one_add_tan_sq this,
    ← tan_mul_cos this]
  ring

name: sin_eq_two_mul_tan_half_div_one_add_tan_half_sq
statement:
theorem sin_eq_two_mul_tan_half_div_one_add_tan_half_sq (x : ℂ) :
    sin x = (2 * tan (x / 2)) / (1 + tan (x / 2) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← mul_div_cancel₀ x two_ne_zero, sin_two_mul]
  by_cases h : cos (x / 2) = 0
  · simp [h, tan_eq_zero_of_cos_eq_zero]
  · rw [div_eq_mul_inv (2 * tan (x / 2)) (1 + tan (x / 2) ^ 2), inv_one_add_tan_sq h,
      ← tan_mul_cos h]
    ring

statement:

    cos z = w ↔ exp (z * I) ^ 2 - 2 * w * exp (z * I) + 1 = 0
proof:

  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  simpa [field, cos, exp_neg] using Eq.congr (by ring) rfl

name: cos_surjective
statement: theorem cos_surjective : Function.Surjective cos
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨w, w₀, hw⟩ : ∃ w ≠ 0, 1 * (w * w) + -2 * x * w + 1 = 0 := by
    rcases exists_quadratic_eq_zero one_ne_zero
        ⟨_, (cpow_nat_inv_pow _ two_ne_zero).symm.trans <| pow_two _⟩ with
      ⟨w, hw⟩
    refine ⟨w, ?_, hw⟩
    rintro rfl
    simp only [zero_add, one_ne_zero, mul_zero] at hw
  refine ⟨log w / I, cos_eq_iff_quadratic.2 ?_⟩
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ I_ne_zero, exp_log w₀]
  convert! hw using 1
  ring

name: sin_mul_sum_sin
statement:
theorem sin_mul_sum_sin (n : ℕ) (a b : ℂ) :
    sin (a / 2) * ∑ i ∈ range n, sin (a * i + b) = sin (n * a / 2) * sin ((n - 1) * a / 2 + b)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (-2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 by simp)
  simp_rw [← mul_assoc, mul_sum]
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ range n, -2 * sin (a / 2) * sin (a * i + b)
      = ∑ x ∈ range n, (cos (a * (↑(x + 1) - 1 / 2) + b) - cos (-(a * (x - 1 / 2) + b))) := by
      congr! 1 with x hx
      rw [cos_sub_cos]
      push_cast
      ring_nf
    _ = -2 * sin (n * a / 2) * sin ((n - 1) * a / 2 + b) := by
      simp_rw [cos_neg, sum_range_sub (fun i ↦ cos (a * (i - 1 / 2) + b)), cos_sub_cos]
      ring_nf

name: sin_mul_sum_cos
statement:
theorem sin_mul_sum_cos (n : ℕ) (a b : ℂ) :
    sin (a / 2) * ∑ i ∈ range n, cos (a * i + b) = sin (n * a / 2) * cos ((n - 1) * a / 2 + b)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 by simp)
  simp_rw [← mul_assoc, mul_sum]
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ range n, 2 * sin (a / 2) * cos (a * i + b)
      = ∑ x ∈ range n, (sin (a * (↑(x + 1) - 1 / 2) + b) - sin (a * (x - 1 / 2) + b)) := by
      congr! 1 with x hx
      rw [sin_sub_sin]
      push_cast
      ring_nf
    _ = 2 * sin (n * a / 2) * cos ((n - 1) * a / 2 + b) := by
      simp_rw [sum_range_sub (fun i ↦ sin (a * (i - 1 / 2) + b)), sin_sub_sin]
      ring_nf

lemma abs_cos_eq_one_iff {x : ℝ} :

  rw [← abs_one, abs_eq_abs, cos_eq_one_iff, cos_eq_neg_one_iff]

name: Complex.cot_eq_exp_ratio
statement:
lemma Complex.cot_eq_exp_ratio (z : ℂ) :
    cot z = (Complex.exp (2 * I * z) + 1) / (I * (1 - Complex.exp (2 * I * z)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.cot, Complex.sin, Complex.cos]
  have h1 : exp (z * I) + exp (-z * I) = exp (-(z * I)) * (exp (2 * I * z) + 1) := by
    rw [mul_add, ← Complex.exp_add]
    ring_nf
  have h2 : (exp (-z * I) - exp (z * I)) = exp (-(z * I)) * ((1 - exp (2 * I * z))) := by
    ring_nf
    rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
    ring_nf
  rw [h1, h2]
  field

name: Complex.cot_pi_eq_exp_ratio
statement:
lemma Complex.cot_pi_eq_exp_ratio (z : ℂ) :
    cot (π * z) = (Complex.exp (2 * π * I * z) + 1) / (I * (1 - Complex.exp (2 * π * I * z)))

name: pi_mul_cot_pi_q_exp
statement:
theorem pi_mul_cot_pi_q_exp (z : ℍ) :
    π * cot (π * z) = π * I - 2 * π * I * ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.exp (2 * π * I * z) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : π * ((exp (2 * π * I * z) + 1) / (I * (1 - exp (2 * π * I * z)))) =
      -π * I * ((exp (2 * π * I * z) + 1) * (1 / (1 - exp (2 * π * I * z)))) := by
    simp only [div_mul_eq_div_mul_one_div, div_I, one_div, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_inj]
    ring
  rw [cot_pi_eq_exp_ratio, h1, one_div, (tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one
    (UpperHalfPlane.norm_exp_two_pi_I_lt_one z)).symm, add_comm, geom_series_mul_one_add
      (Complex.exp (2 * π * I * (z : ℂ))) (UpperHalfPlane.norm_exp_two_pi_I_lt_one _)]
  ring

name: sineTerm_ne_zero

  rw [add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg, neg_div', eq_div_iff]

proof:
:= by
  rw [show (sin (π * x) / (π * x)) = sin (π * x) * (1 / (π * x)) by ring]
  apply (Filter.Tendsto.mul_const (b := 1 / (π * x)) (tendsto_euler_sin_prod x)).congr
  exact fun n ↦ by field_simp; rfl
