name: integral_cos_mul_complex
statement:
theorem integral_cos_mul_complex {z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 0) (a b : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in a..b, Complex.cos (z * x)) = Complex.sin (z * b) / z - Complex.sin (z * a) / z
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
  swap
  · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable <| by fun_prop
  intro x _
  have a := Complex.hasDerivAt_sin (↑x * z)
  have b : HasDerivAt (fun y => y * z : ℂ → ℂ) z ↑x := hasDerivAt_mul_const _
  have c : HasDerivAt (Complex.sin ∘ fun y : ℂ => (y * z)) _ ↑x := HasDerivAt.comp (𝕜 := ℂ) x a b
  have d := HasDerivAt.comp_ofReal (c.div_const z)
  grind

theorem integral_inv_sq_add_sq {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :

name: integral_inv_div_log
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_inv_div_log (ha : 1 < a) (hb : 1 < b) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun _ _ ↦ deriv_log_log_apply)]
  refine integral_deriv_eq_sub (fun _ _ ↦ ?_) ?_
  · exact differentiableOn_log_log.differentiableAt (Ioi_mem_nhds (by grind [Set.uIcc]))
  refine (?_ : ContinuousOn _ _).congr (fun _ _ ↦ deriv_log_log_apply) |>.intervalIntegrable

name: integral_inv_div_log_sq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_inv_div_log_sq (ha : 1 < a) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ∫ t in a..b, t⁻¹ / log t ^ 2 = (log a)⁻¹ - (log b)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∫ t in a..b, deriv (fun t ↦ (log t)⁻¹) t = (log b)⁻¹ - (log a)⁻¹ by
    simp_rw [deriv_inv_log, neg_div, intervalIntegral.integral_neg] at this
    linarith
  refine integral_deriv_eq_sub (fun _ _ ↦ ?_) (ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable ?_)
  · exact differentiableOn_inv_log.differentiableAt (Ioi_mem_nhds (by grind [Set.uIcc]))
  suffices ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ (-x⁻¹) * ((log x)⁻¹) ^ 2) (.uIcc a b) by
    convert this using 2 with x
    simp [field]
  fun_prop (disch := grind [log_pos, Set.uIcc])

name: integral_mul_cpow_one_add_sq
proof:
:= by
  have : t + 1 ≠ 0 := by contrapose ht; rwa [add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at ht
  apply integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
  · intro x _
    have f : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℂ => 1 + y ^ 2) (2 * x : ℂ) x := by
      convert! (hasDerivAt_pow 2 (x : ℂ)).const_add 1
      simp
    have g :
      ∀ {z : ℂ}, 0 < z.re → HasDerivAt (fun z => z ^ (t + 1) / (2 * (t + 1))) (z ^ t / 2) z := by
      intro z hz
      convert!
        (HasDerivAt.cpow_const (c := t + 1) (hasDerivAt_id _) (Or.inl hz)).div_const
          (2 * (t + 1)) using 1
      simp [field]
    convert! (HasDerivAt.comp (↑x) (g _) f).comp_ofReal using 1
    · ring
    · exact mod_cast add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg zero_lt_one (sq_nonneg x)
  · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    refine continuous_ofReal.mul ?_
    apply Continuous.cpow (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    intro a
    norm_cast
    exact ofReal_mem_slitPlane.2 <| add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg one_pos <| sq_nonneg a

name: integral_mul_rpow_one_add_sq
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ x s : ℝ, (((↑1 + x ^ 2) ^ s : ℝ) : ℂ) = (1 + (x : ℂ) ^ 2) ^ (s : ℂ) := by
    intro x s
    norm_cast
    rw [ofReal_cpow, ofReal_add, ofReal_pow, ofReal_one]
    exact add_nonneg zero_le_one (sq_nonneg x)
  rw [← ofReal_inj]
  convert! integral_mul_cpow_one_add_sq (_ : (t : ℂ) ≠ -1)
  · rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
    congr with x : 1
    rw [ofReal_mul, this x t]
  · simp_rw [ofReal_sub, ofReal_div, this a (t + 1), this b (t + 1)]
    push_cast; rfl
  · rw [← ofReal_one, ← ofReal_neg, Ne, ofReal_inj]
    exact ht

name: integral_sin_pow_aux
statement:
theorem integral_sin_pow_aux :
    (∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ (n + 2)) =
      (sin a ^ (n + 1) * cos a - sin b ^ (n + 1) * cos b + (↑n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ n) -
        (↑n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  let C := sin a ^ (n + 1) * cos a - sin b ^ (n + 1) * cos b
  have h : ∀ α β γ : ℝ, β * α * γ * α = β * (α * α * γ) := fun α β γ => by ring
  have hu : ∀ x ∈ [[a, b]],
      HasDerivAt (fun y => sin y ^ (n + 1)) ((n + 1 : ℕ) * cos x * sin x ^ n) x :=
    fun x _ => by simpa only [mul_right_comm] using! (hasDerivAt_sin x).pow (n + 1)
  have hv : ∀ x ∈ [[a, b]], HasDerivAt (-cos) (sin x) x := fun x _ => by
    simpa only [neg_neg] using! (hasDerivAt_cos x).neg
  have H := integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul hu hv ?_ ?_
  · calc
      (∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ (n + 2)) = ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ (n + 1) * sin x := by
        simp only [_root_.pow_succ]
      _ = C + (↑n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ 2 * sin x ^ n := by simp [H, h, sq]; ring
      _ = C + (↑n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ n - sin x ^ (n + 2) := by
        simp [cos_sq', sub_mul, ← pow_add, add_comm]
      _ = (C + (↑n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ n) - (↑n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ (n + 2) := by
        rw [integral_sub, mul_sub, add_sub_assoc] <;>
          apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable <;> fun_prop
  all_goals apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop

name: integral_sin_pow
statement:
theorem integral_sin_pow :
    (∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ (n + 2)) =
      (sin a ^ (n + 1) * cos a - sin b ^ (n + 1) * cos b) / (n + 2) +
        (n + 1) / (n + 2) * ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  field_simp
  convert! eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp (integral_sin_pow_aux n) using 1
  ring

name: integral_sin_sq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_sin_sq : ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ 2 = (sin a * cos a - sin b * cos b + b - a) / 2

name: integral_sin_pow_odd
statement:
theorem integral_sin_pow_odd :
    (∫ x in 0..π, sin x ^ (2 * n + 1)) = 2 * ∏ i ∈ range n, (2 * (i : ℝ) + 2) / (2 * i + 3)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [prod_range_succ_comm, mul_left_comm, ← ih, mul_succ, integral_sin_pow]
    norm_cast

name: integral_sin_pow_even

  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>

    simp

name: integral_sin_pow_pos
statement: theorem integral_sin_pow_pos : 0 < ∫ x in 0..π, sin x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases even_or_odd' n with ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩ <;>
  simp only [integral_sin_pow_even, integral_sin_pow_odd] <;>
  refine mul_pos (by simp [pi_pos]) (prod_pos fun n _ => div_pos ?_ ?_) <;>
  norm_cast <;>
  lia

name: integral_sin_pow_succ_le
statement: theorem integral_sin_pow_succ_le : (∫ x in 0..π, sin x ^ (n + 1)) ≤ ∫ x in 0..π, sin x ^ n

name: integral_sin_pow_antitone
statement: theorem integral_sin_pow_antitone : Antitone fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in 0..π, sin x ^ n

name: integral_cos_pow_aux
statement:
theorem integral_cos_pow_aux :
    (∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ (n + 2)) =
      (cos b ^ (n + 1) * sin b - cos a ^ (n + 1) * sin a + (n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ n) -
        (n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  let C := cos b ^ (n + 1) * sin b - cos a ^ (n + 1) * sin a
  have h : ∀ α β γ : ℝ, β * α * γ * α = β * (α * α * γ) := fun α β γ => by ring
  have hu : ∀ x ∈ [[a, b]],
      HasDerivAt (fun y => cos y ^ (n + 1)) (-(n + 1 : ℕ) * sin x * cos x ^ n) x :=
    fun x _ => by
      simpa only [mul_right_comm, neg_mul, mul_neg] using! (hasDerivAt_cos x).pow (n + 1)
  have hv : ∀ x ∈ [[a, b]], HasDerivAt sin (cos x) x := fun x _ => hasDerivAt_sin x
  have H := integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul hu hv ?_ ?_
  · calc
      (∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ (n + 2)) = ∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ (n + 1) * cos x := by
        simp only [_root_.pow_succ]
      _ = C + (n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ 2 * cos x ^ n := by simp [C, H, h, sq, -neg_add_rev]
      _ = C + (n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ n - cos x ^ (n + 2) := by
        simp [sin_sq, sub_mul, ← pow_add, add_comm]
      _ = (C + (n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ n) - (n + 1) * ∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ (n + 2) := by
        rw [integral_sub, mul_sub, add_sub_assoc] <;>
          apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable <;> fun_prop
  all_goals apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop

name: integral_cos_pow
statement:
theorem integral_cos_pow :
    (∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ (n + 2)) =
      (cos b ^ (n + 1) * sin b - cos a ^ (n + 1) * sin a) / (n + 2) +
        (n + 1) / (n + 2) * ∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  field_simp
  convert! eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp (integral_cos_pow_aux n) using 1
  ring

name: integral_cos_sq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_cos_sq : ∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ 2 = (cos b * sin b - cos a * sin a + b - a) / 2

name: integral_sin_pow_mul_cos_pow_odd
statement:
theorem integral_sin_pow_mul_cos_pow_odd (m n : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ m * cos x ^ (2 * n + 1)) = ∫ u in sin a..sin b, u ^ m * (1 - u ^ 2) ^ n
proof:
:=
  have hc : Continuous fun u : ℝ => u ^ m * (↑1 - u ^ 2) ^ n := by fun_prop
  calc
    (∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ m * cos x ^ (2 * n + 1)) =
        ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ m * (↑1 - sin x ^ 2) ^ n * cos x := by
      simp only [_root_.pow_zero, _root_.pow_succ, mul_assoc, pow_mul, one_mul]
      congr! 5
      rw [← sq, ← sq, cos_sq']
    _ = ∫ u in sin a..sin b, u ^ m * (1 - u ^ 2) ^ n :=
      integral_comp_mul_deriv (fun x _ => hasDerivAt_sin x) continuousOn_cos hc

name: integral_sin_mul_cos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_sin_mul_cos₁ : ∫ x in a..b, sin x * cos x = (sin b ^ 2 - sin a ^ 2) / 2

name: integral_sin_sq_mul_cos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_sin_sq_mul_cos :
    ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ 2 * cos x = (sin b ^ 3 - sin a ^ 3) / 3
proof:
:= by
  have := @integral_sin_pow_mul_cos_pow_odd a b 2 0
  norm_num at this; exact this

name: integral_cos_pow_three
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_cos_pow_three :
    ∫ x in a..b, cos x ^ 3 = sin b - sin a - (sin b ^ 3 - sin a ^ 3) / 3
proof:
:= by
  have := @integral_sin_pow_mul_cos_pow_odd a b 0 1
  norm_num at this; exact this

name: integral_sin_pow_odd_mul_cos_pow
statement:
theorem integral_sin_pow_odd_mul_cos_pow (m n : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ (2 * m + 1) * cos x ^ n) = ∫ u in cos b..cos a, u ^ n * (1 - u ^ 2) ^ m
proof:
:=
  have hc : Continuous fun u : ℝ => u ^ n * (↑1 - u ^ 2) ^ m := by fun_prop
  calc
    (∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ (2 * m + 1) * cos x ^ n) =
        -∫ x in b..a, sin x ^ (2 * m + 1) * cos x ^ n := by rw [integral_symm]
    _ = ∫ x in b..a, (↑1 - cos x ^ 2) ^ m * -sin x * cos x ^ n := by
      simp only [_root_.pow_succ, pow_mul, _root_.pow_zero, one_mul, mul_neg, neg_mul,
        integral_neg, neg_inj]
      congr! 5
      rw [← sq, ← sq, sin_sq]
    _ = ∫ x in b..a, cos x ^ n * (↑1 - cos x ^ 2) ^ m * -sin x := by congr; ext; ring
    _ = ∫ u in cos b..cos a, u ^ n * (↑1 - u ^ 2) ^ m :=
      integral_comp_mul_deriv (fun x _ => hasDerivAt_cos x) continuousOn_sin.neg hc

name: integral_sin_pow_even_mul_cos_pow_even
statement:
theorem integral_sin_pow_even_mul_cos_pow_even (m n : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ (2 * m) * cos x ^ (2 * n)) =
      ∫ x in a..b, ((1 - cos (2 * x)) / 2) ^ m * ((1 + cos (2 * x)) / 2) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [pow_mul, sin_sq, cos_sq, ← sub_sub]
  field_simp
  norm_num

name: integral_sin_sq_mul_cos_sq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_sin_sq_mul_cos_sq :
    ∫ x in a..b, sin x ^ 2 * cos x ^ 2 = (b - a) / 8 - (sin (4 * b) - sin (4 * a)) / 32
proof:
:= by
  convert! integral_sin_pow_even_mul_cos_pow_even 1 1 using 1
  have h1 : ∀ c : ℝ, (↑1 - c) / ↑2 * ((↑1 + c) / ↑2) = (↑1 - c ^ 2) / 4 := fun c => by ring
  have h2 : Continuous fun x => cos (2 * x) ^ 2 := by fun_prop
  have h3 : ∀ x, cos x * sin x = sin (2 * x) / 2 := by intro; rw [sin_two_mul]; ring
  have h4 : ∀ d : ℝ, 2 * (2 * d) = 4 * d := fun d => by ring
  simp [h1, h2.intervalIntegrable, integral_comp_mul_left fun x => cos x ^ 2, h3, h4]
  ring

name: integral_sqrt_one_sub_sq
statement: theorem integral_sqrt_one_sub_sq : ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, √(1 - x ^ 2 : ℝ) = π / 2
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ = ∫ x in sin (-(π / 2))..sin (π / 2), √(1 - x ^ 2 : ℝ) := by rw [sin_neg, sin_pi_div_two]
    _ = ∫ x in (-(π / 2))..(π / 2), √(1 - sin x ^ 2 : ℝ) * cos x :=
          (integral_comp_mul_deriv (fun x _ => hasDerivAt_sin x) continuousOn_cos
            (by fun_prop)).symm
    _ = ∫ x in (-(π / 2))..(π / 2), cos x ^ 2 := by
          refine integral_congr_ae (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun _ h => ?_)
          rw [uIoc_of_le (neg_le_self (le_of_lt (half_pos Real.pi_pos))), Set.mem_Ioc] at h
          rw [← Real.cos_eq_sqrt_one_sub_sin_sq (le_of_lt h.1) h.2, pow_two]
    _ = π / 2 := by simp

name: integral_log_sin_zero_pi_eq_two_mul_integral_log_sin_zero_pi_div_two
statement:
private lemma integral_log_sin_zero_pi_eq_two_mul_integral_log_sin_zero_pi_div_two :
    ∫ x in 0..π, log (sin x) = 2 * ∫ x in 0..(π / 2), log (sin x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (a := 0) (b := π / 2) (c := π)
    (by apply intervalIntegrable_log_sin) (by apply intervalIntegrable_log_sin)]
  conv =>
    left; right; arg 1
    intro x
    rw [← sin_pi_sub]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left (fun x ↦ log (sin x)), sub_self,
    (by linarith : π - π / 2 = π / 2)]
  ring!

name: integral_log_sin_zero_pi_div_two
statement: theorem integral_log_sin_zero_pi_div_two : ∫ x in 0..(π / 2), log (sin x) = -log 2 * π / 2
proof:
:= by
  calc ∫ x in 0..(π / 2), log (sin x)
    _ = ∫ x in 0..(π / 2), (log (sin (2 * x)) - log 2 - log (cos x)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_codiscreteWithin
      apply Filter.codiscreteWithin_mono (by tauto : Ι 0 (π / 2) ⊆ Set.univ)
      have t₀ : sin ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ ∈ Filter.codiscrete ℝ := by
        apply analyticOnNhd_sin.preimage_zero_mem_codiscrete (x := π / 2)
        simp
      have t₁ : cos ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ ∈ Filter.codiscrete ℝ := by
        apply analyticOnNhd_cos.preimage_zero_mem_codiscrete (x := 0)
        simp
      filter_upwards [t₀, t₁] with y h₁y h₂y
      simp_all only [Set.preimage_compl, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
        sin_two_mul, ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, or_self, not_false_eq_true, log_mul]
      ring
    _ = (∫ x in 0..(π / 2), log (sin (2 * x))) - π / 2 * log 2
        - ∫ x in 0..(π / 2), log (cos x) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub _ _,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub _ intervalIntegrable_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      · simp
      · simpa using (intervalIntegrable_log_sin (a := 0) (b := π)).comp_mul_left
      · apply IntervalIntegrable.sub _ intervalIntegrable_const
        simpa using (intervalIntegrable_log_sin (a := 0) (b := π)).comp_mul_left
      · exact intervalIntegrable_log_cos
    _ = (∫ x in 0..(π / 2), log (sin (2 * x)))
        - π / 2 * log 2 - ∫ x in 0..(π / 2), log (sin x) := by
      simp [← sin_pi_div_two_sub,
        intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left (fun x ↦ log (sin x)) (π / 2)]
    _ = -log 2 * π / 2 := by
      simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (f := fun x ↦ log (sin x)) two_ne_zero,
        mul_zero, (by linarith : 2 * (π / 2) = π),
        integral_log_sin_zero_pi_eq_two_mul_integral_log_sin_zero_pi_div_two, smul_eq_mul, ne_eq,
        OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, inv_mul_cancel_left₀, sub_sub_cancel_left, neg_mul]
      linarith

name: integral_log_sin_zero_pi
statement: theorem integral_log_sin_zero_pi : ∫ x in 0..π, log (sin x) = -log 2 * π

lemma abs_smul_nonneg {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [SMulWithZero R ℝ≥0] [SMul R A]

  · simp only [abs, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, star_smul, ← smul_assoc,
      RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜)]
    simp [-algebraMap_smul, ← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_comm (starRingEnd _ _), RCLike.conj_mul, sq]

name: summable_finsetProd_of_summable_nonneg
statement:
lemma summable_finsetProd_of_summable_nonneg {f : ι → ℝ} (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i)
    (hfs : Summable f) : Summable (fun s : Finset ι ↦ ∏ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine summable_of_sum_le (c := Real.exp (∑' i, f i))
    (fun s ↦ Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hf i) fun T ↦ ?_
  calc ∑ s ∈ T, ∏ i ∈ s, f i
      ≤ ∑ s ∈ (T.biUnion id).powerset, ∏ i ∈ s, f i :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (fun s hs ↦ Finset.mem_powerset.mpr
          (Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem id hs)) (fun s _ _ ↦ Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hf i)
    _ = ∏ i ∈ T.biUnion id, (1 + f i) := (Finset.prod_one_add _).symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp (∑ i ∈ T.biUnion id, f i) := Real.prod_one_add_le_exp_sum _ hf
    _ ≤ Real.exp (∑' i, f i) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hfs.sum_le_tsum _ fun _ _ ↦ hf _)

name: Multipliable.eventually_bounded_finsetProd
statement:
lemma Multipliable.eventually_bounded_finsetProd {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : Multipliable v) :

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁⟩ := exists_gt (max 0 <| ∏' i, v i)
  rw [max_lt_iff] at hr₁
  have := hv.hasProd.eventually_le_const hr₁.2
  rw [unconditional, eventually_atTop] at this
  exact ⟨r₁, hr₁.1, this⟩

proof:
:= by
  conv => enter [1, i]; rw [← sub_add_cancel ‖1 + f i‖ 1, add_comm]
  refine Real.multipliable_one_add_of_summable <| hf.of_norm_bounded (fun i ↦ ?_)
  simpa using abs_norm_sub_norm_le (1 + f i) 1

name: Finset.norm_prod_one_add_sub_one_le
statement:
lemma Finset.norm_prod_one_add_sub_one_le (t : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) :
    ‖∏ i ∈ t, (1 + f i) - 1‖ ≤ Real.exp (∑ i ∈ t, ‖f i‖) - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert x t hx IH =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hx, Finset.sum_insert hx, Real.exp_add,
      show (1 + f x) * ∏ i ∈ t, (1 + f i) - 1 =
        (∏ i ∈ t, (1 + f i) - 1) + f x * ∏ x ∈ t, (1 + f x) by ring]
    refine (norm_add_le_of_le IH (norm_mul_le _ _)).trans ?_
    generalize h : Real.exp (∑ i ∈ t, ‖f i‖) = A at ⊢ IH
    rw [sub_add_eq_add_sub, sub_le_sub_iff_right]
    transitivity A + ‖f x‖ * A
    · grw [norm_le_norm_sub_add (∏ x ∈ t, (1 + f x)) 1, IH, norm_one, sub_add_cancel]
    rw [← one_add_mul, add_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.add_one_le_exp _) (h ▸ Real.exp_nonneg _)

name: prod_vanishing_of_summable_norm
statement:
lemma prod_vanishing_of_summable_norm (hf : Summable fun i ↦ ‖f i‖) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ s₂, ∀ t, Disjoint t s₂ → ‖∏ i ∈ t, (1 + f i) - 1‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ s, ∀ t, Disjoint t s → Real.exp (∑ i ∈ t, ‖f i‖) - 1 < ε from
    this.imp fun s hs t ht ↦ (t.norm_prod_one_add_sub_one_le _).trans_lt (hs t ht)
  suffices {x | Real.exp x - 1 < ε} ∈ 𝓝 0 from hf.vanishing this
  let f (x) := Real.exp x - 1
  have : Set.Iio ε ∈ nhds (f 0) := by simpa [f] using Iio_mem_nhds hε
  exact ContinuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (by fun_prop) this

name: multipliable_one_add_of_summable
statement:
lemma multipliable_one_add_of_summable [CompleteSpace R]
    (hf : Summable fun i ↦ ‖f i‖) : Multipliable fun i ↦ (1 + f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine CompleteSpace.complete <| Metric.cauchy_iff.mpr ⟨by infer_instance, fun ε hε ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, s₁, hs₁⟩ :=
    (multipliable_norm_one_add_of_summable_norm hf).eventually_bounded_finsetProd
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂⟩ := prod_vanishing_of_summable_norm hf (show 0 < ε / (2 * r₁) by positivity)
  simp only [unconditional, Filter.mem_map, mem_atTop_sets, Set.mem_preimage]
  let s := s₁ ∪ s₂
  
  
  
  
  
  
  refine ⟨Metric.ball (∏ i ∈ s, (1 + f i)) (ε / 2), ⟨s, fun b hb ↦ ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [← union_sdiff_of_subset hb, prod_union sdiff_disjoint.symm,
      Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm_sub, ← mul_sub_one,
      show ε / 2 = r₁ * (ε / (2 * r₁)) by field]
    apply (norm_mul_le _ _).trans_lt
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (b := r₁ * ‖∏ x ∈ b \ s, (1 + f x) - 1‖) ?_ ?_
    · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
      exact (Finset.norm_prod_le _ _).trans (hs₁ _ subset_union_left)
    · refine mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hs₂ _ ?_) hr₁
      simp [s, sdiff_union_distrib, disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
  · intro x hx y hy
    exact (dist_triangle_right _ _ (∏ i ∈ s, (1 + f i))).trans_lt (add_halves ε ▸ add_lt_add hx hy)

statement:
lemma Summable.summable_log_norm_one_add (hu : Summable fun n ↦ ‖f n‖) :
    Summable fun i ↦ Real.log ‖1 + f i‖
proof:
:= by
  suffices Summable (‖1 + f ·‖ - 1) from
    (Real.summable_log_one_add_of_summable this).congr (by simp)
  refine .of_norm (hu.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i ↦ by positivity) fun i ↦ ?_)
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
  constructor
  · simpa using norm_add_le (1 + f i) (-f i)
  · simpa [add_comm] using norm_add_le (f i) 1

  · rw [← Real.rexp_tsum_eq_tprod (fun i ↦ norm_pos_iff.mpr <| hf i) hu.summable_log_norm_one_add]

name: not_differentiableAt_inv_log_zero
statement: lemma not_differentiableAt_inv_log_zero : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x ↦ (log x)⁻¹) 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← hasDerivAt_deriv_iff, hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero, zero_add, log_zero,
    inv_zero, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_inv, mul_comm _ (log _)]
  refine fun H ↦ (tendsto_nhdsWithin_mono_left (by grind : Set.Iio (0 : ℝ) ⊆ _) H).not_tendsto
    (by simp) (tendsto_inv_nhdsGT_zero.comp ?_)
  refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _
    tendsto_log_mul_self_nhdsLT_zero ?_
  simp only [← nhdsWithin_Ioo_eq_nhdsLT neg_one_lt_zero, Set.mem_Ioi]
  refine eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun x ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ ↦ mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg ?_ hx₂
  apply log_neg_eq_log x ▸ log_neg <;> grind

    not_continuousAt_of_tendsto this nhdsWithin_le_nhds (disjoint_nhds_cobounded _)
  exact tendsto_inv₀_nhdsNE_zero.comp <| log_one ▸
    HasDerivAt.tendsto_nhdsNE (by simpa using hasDerivAt_log one_ne_zero) one_ne_zero

name: deriv_inv_log_apply
statement: theorem deriv_inv_log_apply {x : ℝ} : deriv (fun x ↦ (log x)⁻¹) x = -x⁻¹ / log x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have := mt (continuousAt (𝕜 := ℝ)) not_continuousAt_inv_log_neg_one
  have := mt (continuousAt (𝕜 := ℝ)) not_continuousAt_inv_log_one
  have := not_differentiableAt_inv_log_zero
  obtain (⟨_, _, _⟩ | rfl | rfl | rfl) :
      (x ≠ -1 ∧ x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1) ∨ x = -1 ∨ x = 0 ∨ x = 1 := by tauto
  · simp_all
  all_goals rw [deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt ‹_›]; simp

statement: theorem contDiffAt_log {n : ℕ∞ω} {x : ℝ} : ContDiffAt ℝ n log x ↔ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ continuousAt_log_iff.1 h.continuousAt, fun hx ↦ ?_⟩
  have A y (hy : 0 < y) : ContDiffAt ℝ n log y := by
    apply expPartialHomeomorph.contDiffAt_symm_deriv (f₀' := y) hy.ne' (by simpa)
    · convert! hasDerivAt_exp (log y)
      rw [exp_log hy]
    · exact analyticAt_rexp.contDiffAt
  rcases hx.lt_or_gt with hx | hx
  · have : ContDiffAt ℝ n (log ∘ (fun y ↦ -y)) x := by
      apply ContDiffAt.comp
      · apply A _ (Left.neg_pos_iff.mpr hx)
      apply contDiffAt_id.neg
    convert! this
    ext x
    simp
  · exact A x hx

name: abs_log_sub_add_sum_range_le
statement:
theorem abs_log_sub_add_sum_range_le {x : ℝ} (h : |x| < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    |(∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1)) + log (1 - x)| ≤ |x| ^ (n + 1) / (1 - |x|)
proof:
:= by
  /- For the proof, we show that the derivative of the function to be estimated is small,
    and then apply the mean value inequality. -/
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1)) + log (1 - x)
  let F' : ℝ → ℝ := fun x ↦ -x ^ n / (1 - x)
  
  
  
  have A : ∀ y ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt F (F' y) y := fun y hy ↦ by
    have : HasDerivAt F ((∑ i ∈ range n, ↑(i + 1) * y ^ i / (↑i + 1)) + (-1) / (1 - y)) y :=
      .add (.fun_sum fun i _ ↦ (hasDerivAt_pow (i + 1) y).div_const ((i : ℝ) + 1))
        (((hasDerivAt_id y).const_sub _).log <| sub_ne_zero.2 hy.2.ne')
    convert! this using 1
    calc
      -y ^ n / (1 - y) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, y ^ i + -1 / (1 - y) := by
        simp [field, geom_sum_eq hy.2.ne, sub_ne_zero.2 hy.2.ne, sub_ne_zero.2 hy.2.ne']
        ring
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ↑(i + 1) * y ^ i / (↑i + 1) + -1 / (1 - y) := by
        congr with i
        rw [Nat.cast_succ, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (Nat.cast_add_one_pos i).ne']
  
  have B : ∀ y ∈ Icc (-|x|) |x|, |F' y| ≤ |x| ^ n / (1 - |x|) := fun y hy ↦
    calc
      |F' y| = |y| ^ n / |1 - y| := by simp [F', abs_div]
      _ ≤ |x| ^ n / (1 - |x|) := by
        have : |y| ≤ |x| := abs_le.2 hy
        have : 1 - |x| ≤ |1 - y| := le_trans (by linarith [hy.2]) (le_abs_self _)
        gcongr
  
  have C : ‖F x - F 0‖ ≤ |x| ^ n / (1 - |x|) * ‖x - 0‖ := by
    refine Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (fun y hy ↦ (A _ ?_).hasDerivWithinAt) B (convex_Icc _ _) ?_ ?_
    · exact Icc_subset_Ioo (neg_lt_neg h) h hy
    · simp
    · simp [le_abs_self x, neg_le.mp (neg_le_abs x)]
  
  simpa [F, div_mul_eq_mul_div, pow_succ] using C

name: hasDerivAt_half_log_one_add_div_one_sub_sub_sum_range
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_half_log_one_add_div_one_sub_sub_sum_range
    {y : ℝ} (n : ℕ) (hy₁ : -1 < y) (hy₂ : y < 1) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun x ↦ 1 / 2 * log ((1 + x) / (1 - x)) - (∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1)))
      ((y ^ 2) ^ n / (1 - y ^ 2)) y
proof:
:= by
  refine ((((((hasDerivAt_id _).const_add _).div ((hasDerivAt_id _).const_sub _) (by grind)).log
          ?_).const_mul _).sub (HasDerivAt.fun_sum fun i hi ↦ (hasDerivAt_pow _ _).div_const _))
        |>.congr_deriv ?_
  · simp only [div_ne_zero_iff, Pi.div_apply]; grind
  have : (∑ i ∈ range n, (2 * i + 1) * y ^ (2 * i) / (2 * i + 1)) =
      (∑ i ∈ range n, (y ^ 2) ^ i) := by
    congr with i
    simp [field, mul_comm, ← pow_mul]
  have hy₃ : y ^ 2 ≠ 1 := by simp [hy₁.ne', hy₂.ne]
  have hy₄ : (1 - y) * (1 + y) = 1 - y ^ 2 := by ring
  simp [this, field, geom_sum_eq hy₃, hy₄]
  ring

name: sum_range_sub_log_div_le
statement:
lemma sum_range_sub_log_div_le {x : ℝ} (h : |x| < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    |1 / 2 * log ((1 + x) / (1 - x)) - ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1)| ≤
      |x| ^ (2 * n + 1) / (1 - x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    1 / 2 * log ((1 + x) / (1 - x)) - (∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1))
  let F' (y : ℝ) : ℝ := (y ^ 2) ^ n / (1 - y ^ 2)
  have hI : Icc (-|x|) |x| ⊆ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 := Icc_subset_Ioo (by simp [h]) h
  
  have A : ∀ y ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt F (F' y) y := by
    intro y hy
    exact hasDerivAt_half_log_one_add_div_one_sub_sub_sum_range _ (by grind) (by grind)
  
  have B : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-|x|) |x|, ‖F' y‖ ≤ |x| ^ (2 * n) / (1 - x ^ 2) := fun y hy ↦ by
    have : y ^ 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := sq_le_sq.2 (abs_le.2 hy)
    calc
      ‖F' y‖ = (y ^ 2) ^ n / |1 - y ^ 2| := by simp [F']
      _ = (y ^ 2) ^ n / (1 - y ^ 2) := by rw [abs_of_pos (by simpa [abs_lt] using hI hy)]
      _ ≤ (x ^ 2) ^ n / (1 - x ^ 2) := by gcongr ?_ ^ n / (1 - ?_); simpa [abs_lt] using h
      _ ≤ |x| ^ (2 * n) / (1 - x ^ 2) := by simp [pow_mul]
  
  have C : ‖F x - F 0‖ ≤ |x| ^ (2 * n) / (1 - x ^ 2) * ‖x - 0‖ :=
    (convex_Icc (-|x|) |x|).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (fun y hy ↦ (A _ (hI hy)).hasDerivWithinAt) B
      (by simp) (by simp [le_abs_self, neg_le, neg_le_abs x])
  
  simpa [F, pow_succ, div_mul_eq_mul_div] using C

name: sum_range_le_log_div
statement:
lemma sum_range_le_log_div {x : ℝ} (h₀ : 0 ≤ x) (h : x < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1) ≤ 1 / 2 * log ((1 + x) / (1 - x))
proof:
:= by
  let F (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    1 / 2 * log ((1 + x) / (1 - x)) - (∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1))
  let F' (y : ℝ) : ℝ := (y ^ 2) ^ n / (1 - y ^ 2)
  
  have A : ∀ y ∈ Icc 0 x, HasDerivAt F (F' y) y := by
    intro y hy
    exact hasDerivAt_half_log_one_add_div_one_sub_sub_sum_range _ (by grind) (by grind)
  
  suffices MonotoneOn F (Icc 0 x) by simpa [F] using this ⟨le_rfl, h₀⟩ ⟨h₀, le_rfl⟩ h₀
  
  refine monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 x)
    (fun y hy ↦ (A y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun y hy ↦ (A y (interior_subset hy)).hasDerivWithinAt) ?_
  intro y hy
  simp only [interior_Icc, Set.mem_Ioo] at hy
  have : 0 ≤ 1 - y ^ 2 := by calc
    0 ≤ 1 - x ^ 2 := by simp [abs_of_nonneg h₀, h.le]
    _ ≤ 1 - y ^ 2 := sub_le_sub_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hy.1.le hy.2.le 2) 1
  positivity

name: log_div_le_sum_range_add
statement:
lemma log_div_le_sum_range_add {x : ℝ} (h₀ : 0 ≤ x) (h : x < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    1 / 2 * log ((1 + x) / (1 - x)) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (2 * i + 1) / (2 * i + 1)) + x ^ (2 * n + 1) / (1 - x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := sum_range_sub_log_div_le (by rwa [abs_of_nonneg h₀]) n
  rwa [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg_of_le (sum_range_le_log_div h₀ h n)), abs_of_nonneg h₀,
    sub_le_iff_le_add'] at h₁

name: hasSum_pow_div_log_of_abs_lt_one
statement:
theorem hasSum_pow_div_log_of_abs_lt_one {x : ℝ} (h : |x| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => x ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)) (-log (1 - x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Summable.hasSum_iff_tendsto_nat]
  · show Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ range n, x ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (-log (1 - x)))
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    simp only [norm_eq_abs, sub_neg_eq_add]
    refine squeeze_zero (fun n => abs_nonneg _) (abs_log_sub_add_sum_range_le h) ?_
    suffices Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => |x| ^ (t + 1) / (1 - |x|)) atTop (𝓝 (|x| * 0 / (1 - |x|))) by
      simpa
    simp only [pow_succ']
    refine (tendsto_const_nhds.mul ?_).div_const _
    exact tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg _) h
  show Summable fun n : ℕ => x ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)
  refine .of_norm_bounded (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg _) h) fun i => ?_
  calc
    ‖x ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1)‖ = |x| ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1) := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ i + 1 := le_of_lt (Nat.cast_add_one_pos i)
      rw [norm_eq_abs, abs_div, ← pow_abs, abs_of_nonneg this]
    _ ≤ |x| ^ (i + 1) / (0 + 1) := by
      gcongr
      positivity
    _ ≤ |x| ^ i := by
      simpa [pow_succ] using mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) h.le

name: hasSum_log_sub_log_of_abs_lt_one
statement:
theorem hasSum_log_sub_log_of_abs_lt_one {x : ℝ} (h : |x| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * k + 1)) * x ^ (2 * k + 1))
      (log (1 + x) - log (1 - x))
proof:
:= by
  set term := fun n : ℕ => -1 * ((-x) ^ (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) + x ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)
  have h_term_eq_goal :
      term ∘ (2 * ·) = fun k : ℕ => 2 * (1 / (2 * k + 1)) * x ^ (2 * k + 1) := by
    ext n
    dsimp only [term, (· ∘ ·)]
    rw [Odd.neg_pow (⟨n, rfl⟩ : Odd (2 * n + 1)) x]
    push_cast
    ring_nf
  rw [← h_term_eq_goal, (mul_right_injective₀ (two_ne_zero' ℕ)).hasSum_iff]
  · have h₁ := (hasSum_pow_div_log_of_abs_lt_one (Eq.trans_lt (abs_neg x) h)).mul_left (-1)
    convert! h₁.add (hasSum_pow_div_log_of_abs_lt_one h) using 1
    ring_nf
  · intro m hm
    rw [range_two_mul, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ← Nat.even_add_one] at hm
    dsimp [term]
    rw [Even.neg_pow hm, neg_one_mul, neg_add_cancel]

name: hasSum_log_one_add_inv
statement:
theorem hasSum_log_one_add_inv {a : ℝ} (h : 0 < a) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * k + 1)) * (1 / (2 * a + 1)) ^ (2 * k + 1))
      (log (1 + a⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : |1 / (2 * a + 1)| < 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_pos, div_lt_one]
    · linarith
    · linarith
    · exact div_pos one_pos (by linarith)
  convert! hasSum_log_sub_log_of_abs_lt_one h₁ using 1
  have h₂ : (2 : ℝ) * a + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h₃ := h.ne'
  rw [← log_div]
  · congr
    simp [field]
    ring
  · field_simp
    positivity
  · simp [field, h₃]

name: hasSum_log_one_add
statement:
theorem hasSum_log_one_add {a : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ a) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * k + 1)) * (a / (a + 2)) ^ (2 * k + 1))
      (log (1 + a))
proof:
:= by
  obtain (rfl | ha0) := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp [hasSum_zero]
  · convert! hasSum_log_one_add_inv (inv_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne h ha0.symm)) using 4
    all_goals simp [field, add_comm]

name: mul_logb
statement:
theorem mul_logb {a b c : ℝ} (h₁ : b ≠ 0) (h₂ : b ≠ 1) (h₃ : b ≠ -1) :
    logb a b * logb b c = logb a c
proof:
:= by
  unfold logb
  rw [mul_comm, div_mul_div_cancel₀ (log_ne_zero.mpr ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩)]

name: div_logb
statement:
theorem div_logb {a b c : ℝ} (h₁ : c ≠ 0) (h₂ : c ≠ 1) (h₃ : c ≠ -1) :
    logb a c / logb b c = logb a b

name: logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos
statement: theorem logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos (hx : 0 < x) : logb b (x ^ y) = y * logb b x
proof:
:= by
  rw [logb, log_rpow hx, logb, mul_div_assoc]

name: logb_pow
statement: theorem logb_pow (b x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : logb b (x ^ k) = k * logb b x

name: logb_rpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem logb_rpow : logb b (b ^ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [logb, div_eq_iff, log_rpow b_pos]
  exact log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one b_pos b_ne_one

name: rpow_logb_eq_abs
statement: theorem rpow_logb_eq_abs (hx : x ≠ 0) : b ^ logb b x = |x|
proof:
:= by
  apply log_injOn_pos
  · simp only [Set.mem_Ioi]
    apply rpow_pos_of_pos b_pos
  · simp only [abs_pos, mem_Ioi, Ne, hx, not_false_iff]
  rw [log_rpow b_pos, logb, log_abs]
  field [log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one b_pos b_ne_one]

name: rpow_logb
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rpow_logb (hx : 0 < x) : b ^ logb b x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_logb_eq_abs b_pos b_ne_one hx.ne']
  exact abs_of_pos hx

name: rpow_logb_of_neg
statement: theorem rpow_logb_of_neg (hx : x < 0) : b ^ logb b x = -x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_logb_eq_abs b_pos b_ne_one (ne_of_lt hx)]
  exact abs_of_neg hx

name: logb_eq_iff_rpow_eq
statement: theorem logb_eq_iff_rpow_eq (hy : 0 < y) : logb b y = x ↔ b ^ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro rfl
  · exact rpow_logb b_pos b_ne_one hy
  · exact logb_rpow b_pos b_ne_one

name: surjOn_logb
statement: theorem surjOn_logb : SurjOn (logb b) (Ioi 0) univ
proof:
:= fun x _ =>
  ⟨b ^ x, rpow_pos_of_pos b_pos x, logb_rpow b_pos b_ne_one⟩

name: logb_surjective
statement: theorem logb_surjective : Surjective (logb b)
proof: := fun x => ⟨b ^ x, logb_rpow b_pos b_ne_one⟩

name: range_logb
statement:
@[simp]
theorem range_logb : range (logb b) = univ

name: surjOn_logb'
statement: theorem surjOn_logb' : SurjOn (logb b) (Iio 0) univ
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  use -b ^ x
  constructor
  · simp only [Right.neg_neg_iff, Set.mem_Iio]
    apply rpow_pos_of_pos b_pos
  · rw [logb_neg_eq_logb, logb_rpow b_pos b_ne_one]

statement: theorem logb_le_iff_le_rpow (hx : 0 < x) : logb b x ≤ y ↔ x ≤ b ^ y
proof:

name: logb_pos_iff
statement: theorem logb_pos_iff (hx : 0 < x) : 0 < logb b x ↔ 1 < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← @logb_one b]
  rw [logb_lt_logb_iff hb zero_lt_one hx]

name: logb_pos
statement: theorem logb_pos (hx : 1 < x) : 0 < logb b x
proof:
:= by
  rw [logb_pos_iff hb (lt_trans zero_lt_one hx)]
  exact hx

name: logb_neg_iff
statement: theorem logb_neg_iff (h : 0 < x) : logb b x < 0 ↔ x < 1
proof:

  rw [← logb_one]
  exact logb_lt_logb_iff hb h zero_lt_one

name: logb_nonneg_iff

name: logb_nonpos_iff'
statement: theorem logb_nonpos_iff' (hx : 0 ≤ x) : logb b x ≤ 0 ↔ x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by

  · simp [zero_le_one]

name: strictMonoOn_logb
statement: theorem strictMonoOn_logb : StrictMonoOn (logb b) (Set.Ioi 0)

statement: theorem strictAntiOn_logb : StrictAntiOn (logb b) (Set.Iio 0)
proof:

  rw [← logb_abs b y, ← logb_abs b x]
  refine logb_lt_logb hb (abs_pos.2 hy.ne) ?_

name: logb_pos_of_base_lt_one

proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_atTop_atBot]

  use 1 ⊔ b ^ e
  intro a
  simp only [and_imp, sup_le_iff]
  intro ha
  rw [logb_le_iff_le_rpow_of_base_lt_one b_pos b_lt_one]
  · tauto
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one ha

name: floor_logb_natCast
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem floor_logb_natCast {b : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ⌊logb b r⌋ = Int.log b r
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hr := hr.eq_or_lt
  · rw [logb_zero, Int.log_zero_right, Int.floor_zero]
  by_cases hb : 1 < b
  · have hb1' : 1 < (b : ℝ) := Nat.one_lt_cast.mpr hb
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log hb hr, ← rpow_intCast b]
      refine le_of_le_of_eq ?_ (rpow_logb (zero_lt_one.trans hb1') hb1'.ne' hr)
      exact rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hb1'.le (Int.floor_le _)
    · rw [Int.le_floor, le_logb_iff_rpow_le hb1' hr, rpow_intCast]
      exact Int.zpow_log_le_self hb hr
  · rw [Nat.one_lt_iff_ne_zero_and_ne_one, ← or_iff_not_and_not] at hb
    cases hb
    · simp_all only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, logb_zero_left, Int.floor_zero, Int.log_zero_left]
    · simp_all only [Nat.cast_one, logb_one_left, Int.floor_zero, Int.log_one_left]

name: ceil_logb_natCast
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem ceil_logb_natCast {b : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ⌈logb b r⌉ = Int.clog b r
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hr := hr.eq_or_lt
  · rw [logb_zero, Int.clog_zero_right, Int.ceil_zero]
  by_cases hb : 1 < b
  · have hb1' : 1 < (b : ℝ) := Nat.one_lt_cast.mpr hb
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Int.ceil_le, logb_le_iff_le_rpow hb1' hr, rpow_intCast]
      exact Int.self_le_zpow_clog hb r
    · rw [← Int.le_zpow_iff_clog_le hb hr, ← rpow_intCast b]
      refine (rpow_logb (zero_lt_one.trans hb1') hb1'.ne' hr).symm.trans_le ?_
      exact rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hb1'.le (Int.le_ceil _)
  · rw [Nat.one_lt_iff_ne_zero_and_ne_one, ← or_iff_not_and_not] at hb
    cases hb
    · simp_all only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, logb_zero_left, Int.ceil_zero, Int.clog_zero_left]
    · simp_all only [Nat.cast_one, logb_one_left, Int.ceil_zero, Int.clog_one_left]

name: natFloor_logb_natCast
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem natFloor_logb_natCast (b : ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ⌊logb b n⌋₊ = Nat.log b n
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ | b := b
  · simp [Real.logb]
  · simp [Real.logb]
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp
  rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := ℤ), Int.natCast_floor_eq_floor, floor_logb_natCast (by simp),
    Int.log_natCast]
  exact logb_nonneg (by simp [Nat.cast_add_one_pos]) (Nat.one_le_cast.2 (by lia))

name: natCeil_logb_natCast
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem natCeil_logb_natCast (b : ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ⌈logb b n⌉₊ = Nat.clog b n
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ | b := b
  · simp [Real.logb]
  · simp [Real.logb]
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp
  rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := ℤ), Int.natCast_ceil_eq_ceil, ceil_logb_natCast (by simp),
    Int.clog_natCast]
  exact logb_nonneg (by simp [Nat.cast_add_one_pos]) (Nat.one_le_cast.2 (by lia))

name: natLog_le_logb
statement: lemma natLog_le_logb (a b : ℕ) : Nat.log b a ≤ Real.logb b a
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans _ (Int.floor_le ((b : ℝ).logb a))
  rw [Real.floor_logb_natCast (Nat.cast_nonneg a), Int.log_natCast, Int.cast_natCast]

name: log2_le_logb
statement: lemma log2_le_logb (n : ℕ) : Nat.log2 n ≤ Real.logb 2 n
proof:
:= by
  calc (Nat.log2 n : ℝ) = Nat.log 2 n := mod_cast Nat.log2_eq_log_two
  _ ≤ Real.logb 2 n := natLog_le_logb _ _

name: tendsto_abs_logb_atTop
statement:
lemma tendsto_abs_logb_atTop (hb : b ≠ -1 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 1) :
    Tendsto (|logb b ·|) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  wlog hb₀ : 0 < b generalizing b
  · exact (this (b := -b) (by simp [hb, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]) (by linarith +splitNe)).congr (by simp)
  wlog hb₁ : 1 < b generalizing b
  · exact (this (b := b⁻¹) (by simp [hb, inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, inv_neg]) (by simpa)
      ((one_lt_inv₀ hb₀).2 (by linarith +splitNe))).congr (by simp)
  refine (tendsto_logb_atTop hb₁).congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hx₁
  rw [abs_of_nonneg]
  exact logb_nonneg hb₁ hx₁

name: continuousAt_logb_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem continuousAt_logb_iff (hb₀ : 0 < b) (hb : b ≠ 1) : ContinuousAt (logb b) x ↔ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, continuousAt_logb⟩
  rintro h rfl
  cases lt_or_gt_of_ne hb with
  | inl hb₁ =>
      exact not_tendsto_nhds_of_tendsto_atTop (tendsto_logb_nhdsNE_zero_of_base_lt_one hb₀ hb₁)
        _ (h.tendsto.mono_left inf_le_left)
  | inr hb₁ =>
      exact not_tendsto_nhds_of_tendsto_atBot (tendsto_logb_nhdsNE_zero hb₁)
        _ (h.tendsto.mono_left inf_le_left)

name: logb_prod
statement:
theorem logb_prod {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0) :

name: _root_.Finsupp.logb_prod

name: tendsto_pow_logb_div_mul_add_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_pow_logb_div_mul_add_atTop (a c : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun x => logb b x ^ n / (a * x + c)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases eq_or_ne (log b) 0 with
  | inl h => simpa [logb, h] using! ((tendsto_mul_add_inv_atTop_nhds_zero _ _ ha).const_mul _)
  | inr h => apply (tendsto_pow_log_div_mul_add_atTop (a * (log b) ^ n) (c * (log b) ^ n) n
                (by positivity)).congr fun x ↦ by simp [field, div_pow, logb]

name: isLittleO_pow_logb_id_atTop
statement: theorem isLittleO_pow_logb_id_atTop {n : ℕ} : (fun x => logb b x ^ n) =o[atTop] id
proof:
:= by
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff_tendsto']
  · simpa using tendsto_pow_logb_div_mul_add_atTop 1 0 n one_ne_zero
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ne_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x h₁ h₂ using (h₁ h₂).elim

proof:
:= by

  intro hc

name: isBigO_logb_log
statement: theorem isBigO_logb_log : logb b =O[⊤] log
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : b = -1 ∨ b = 0 ∨ b = 1
  · obtain rfl | rfl | rfl := h
    all_goals simpa [-Asymptotics.isBigO_top] using! Asymptotics.isBigO_zero log ⊤
  · simpa [logb, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
      using! (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl log ⊤).const_mul_left (log b)⁻¹

name: isBigO_log_const_mul_log_atTop
statement: theorem isBigO_log_const_mul_log_atTop (c : ℝ) : (fun x ↦ log (c * x)) =O[atTop] log
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hc := eq_or_ne c 0
  · simpa using isLittleO_const_log_atTop.isBigO
  · calc (fun x ↦ log (c * x))
      =ᶠ[atTop] (fun x => log c + log x) := by
          filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with a ha using log_mul hc ha.ne'
      _ =O[atTop] log :=
          isLittleO_const_log_atTop.isBigO.add (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl ..)

proof:
:= by

name: Real.induction_Ico_mul
statement:
lemma Real.induction_Ico_mul {P : ℝ → Prop} (x₀ r : ℝ) (hr : 1 < r) (hx₀ : 0 < x₀)
    (base : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico x₀ (r * x₀), P x)
    (step : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 1 → (∀ z ∈ Set.Ico x₀ (r ^ n * x₀), P z) →
      (∀ z ∈ Set.Ico (r ^ n * x₀) (r ^ (n + 1) * x₀), P z)) :
    ∀ x ≥ x₀, P x
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico x₀ (r ^ (n + 1) * x₀), P x by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : 0 < x / x₀ := div_pos (hx₀.trans_le hx) hx₀
    refine this ⌊logb r (x / x₀)⌋₊ x ?_
    rw [mem_Ico, ← div_lt_iff₀ hx₀, ← rpow_natCast, ← logb_lt_iff_lt_rpow hr hx', Nat.cast_add,
      Nat.cast_one]
    exact ⟨hx, Nat.lt_floor_add_one _⟩
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using base
  | succ n ih =>
    exact fun x hx => (Ico_subset_Ico_union_Ico hx).elim (ih x) (step (n + 1) (by simp) ih _)

name: log_mul_add
statement: theorem log_mul_add {x y : ℝ≥0∞} : log (x * y) = log x + log y
proof:
:= by
  rcases ENNReal.trichotomy x with (rfl | rfl | x_real)
  · simp
  · rw [log_top]
    rcases ENNReal.trichotomy y with (rfl | rfl | y_real)
    · rw [mul_zero, log_zero, EReal.add_bot]
    · simp
    · rw [log_pos_real' y_real, ENNReal.top_mul', EReal.top_add_coe, log_eq_top_iff]
      simp only [ite_eq_right_iff, zero_ne_top, imp_false]
      exact (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.1 y_real).1.ne'
  · rw [log_pos_real' x_real]
    rcases ENNReal.trichotomy y with (rfl | rfl | y_real)
    · simp
    · simp [(ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.1 x_real).1.ne']
    · rw_mod_cast [log_pos_real', log_pos_real' y_real, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
      · exact Real.log_mul x_real.ne' y_real.ne'
      rw [toReal_mul]
      positivity

name: log_rpow
statement: theorem log_rpow {x : ℝ≥0∞} {y : ℝ} : log (x ^ y) = y * log x
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy y 0 with (y_neg | rfl | y_pos)
  · rcases ENNReal.trichotomy x with (rfl | rfl | x_real)
    · simp only [ENNReal.zero_rpow_def y, not_lt_of_gt y_neg, y_neg.ne, ite_false, log_top,
        log_zero, EReal.coe_mul_bot_of_neg y_neg]
    · rw [ENNReal.top_rpow_of_neg y_neg, log_zero, log_top, EReal.coe_mul_top_of_neg y_neg]
    · have x_ne_zero := (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.1 x_real).1.ne'
      have x_ne_top := (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.1 x_real).2.ne
      simp only [log, rpow_eq_zero_iff, x_ne_zero, false_and, x_ne_top, or_self, ↓reduceIte,
        rpow_eq_top_iff]
      norm_cast
      exact ENNReal.toReal_rpow x y ▸ Real.log_rpow x_real y
  · simp
  · rcases ENNReal.trichotomy x with (rfl | rfl | x_real)
    · rw [ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos y_pos, log_zero, EReal.mul_bot_of_pos]; norm_cast
    · rw [ENNReal.top_rpow_of_pos y_pos, log_top, EReal.mul_top_of_pos]; norm_cast
    · have x_ne_zero := (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.1 x_real).1.ne'
      have x_ne_top := (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.1 x_real).2.ne
      simp only [log, rpow_eq_zero_iff, x_ne_zero, false_and, x_ne_top, or_self, ↓reduceIte,
        rpow_eq_top_iff]
      norm_cast
      exact ENNReal.toReal_rpow x y ▸ Real.log_rpow x_real y

name: log_neg_of_lt_zero
statement: theorem log_neg_of_lt_zero (h0 : x < 0) (h1 : -1 < x) : log x < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_neg x, log_neg_eq_log]
  have h0' : 0 < -x := by linarith
  have h1' : -x < 1 := by linarith
  exact log_neg h0' h1'

name: log_nonneg_iff
statement: theorem log_nonneg_iff (hx : 0 < x) : 0 ≤ log x ↔ 1 ≤ x
proof: := by rw [← not_lt, log_neg_iff hx, not_lt]

name: log_nonneg
statement:
@[bound]
theorem log_nonneg (hx : 1 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ log x

name: log_nonpos_iff
statement: theorem log_nonpos_iff (hx : 0 ≤ x) : log x ≤ 0 ↔ x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.eq_or_lt with (rfl | hx)
  · simp [zero_le_one]
  rw [← not_lt, log_pos_iff hx.le, not_lt]

name: log_nonpos
statement:
@[bound]
theorem log_nonpos (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h'x : x ≤ 1) : log x ≤ 0

name: log_natCast_nonneg
statement: theorem log_natCast_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ log n
proof:
:= by
  if hn : n = 0 then
    simp [hn]
  else
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := mod_cast Nat.one_le_of_lt <| Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    exact log_nonneg this

name: log_neg_natCast_nonneg
statement: theorem log_neg_natCast_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ log (-n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← log_neg_eq_log, neg_neg]
  exact log_natCast_nonneg _

name: log_intCast_nonneg
statement: theorem log_intCast_nonneg (n : ℤ) : 0 ≤ log n
proof:
:= by
  cases lt_trichotomy 0 n with
  | inl hn =>
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := mod_cast hn
      exact log_nonneg this
  | inr hn =>
      cases hn with
      | inl hn => simp [hn.symm]
      | inr hn =>
          have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ -n := by rw [← neg_zero, ← lt_neg] at hn; exact mod_cast hn
          rw [← log_neg_eq_log]
          exact log_nonneg this

name: strictMonoOn_log
statement: theorem strictMonoOn_log : StrictMonoOn log (Set.Ioi 0)
proof: := fun _ hx _ _ hxy => log_lt_log hx hxy

name: strictAntiOn_log
statement: theorem strictAntiOn_log : StrictAntiOn log (Set.Iio 0)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x (hx : x < 0) y (hy : y < 0) hxy
  rw [← log_abs y, ← log_abs x]
  refine log_lt_log (abs_pos.2 hy.ne) ?_
  rwa [abs_of_neg hy, abs_of_neg hx, neg_lt_neg_iff]

name: log_injOn_pos
statement: theorem log_injOn_pos : Set.InjOn log (Set.Ioi 0)

name: log_lt_sub_one_of_pos
statement: theorem log_lt_sub_one_of_pos (hx1 : 0 < x) (hx2 : x ≠ 1) : log x < x - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : log x ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [← log_one, log_injOn_pos.ne_iff hx1]
    exact mem_Ioi.mpr zero_lt_one
  linarith [add_one_lt_exp h, exp_log hx1]

name: eq_one_of_pos_of_log_eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_one_of_pos_of_log_eq_zero {x : ℝ} (h₁ : 0 < x) (h₂ : log x = 0) : x = 1

name: log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one
statement: theorem log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one {x : ℝ} (hx_pos : 0 < x) (hx : x ≠ 1) : log x ≠ 0

name: log_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_eq_zero {x : ℝ} : log x = 0 ↔ x = 0 ∨ x = 1 ∨ x = -1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with (x_lt_zero | rfl | x_gt_zero)
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inr (neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp ?_))
      rw [← log_neg_eq_log x] at h
      exact eq_one_of_pos_of_log_eq_zero (neg_pos.mpr x_lt_zero) h
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (eq_one_of_pos_of_log_eq_zero x_gt_zero h))
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;> simp only [log_one, log_zero, log_neg_eq_log]

name: log_ne_zero
statement: theorem log_ne_zero {x : ℝ} : log x ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ 1 ∧ x ≠ -1

name: log_pow
statement:
@[simp, push]
theorem log_pow (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : log (x ^ n) = n * log x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with (rfl | hx)
    · simp
    · rw [pow_succ, log_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hx) hx, ih, Nat.cast_succ, add_mul, one_mul]

name: log_zpow
statement:
@[simp, push]
theorem log_zpow (x : ℝ) (n : ℤ) : log (x ^ n) = n * log x
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · rw [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast, log_pow, Int.cast_natCast]
  · rw [zpow_negSucc, log_inv, log_pow, Int.cast_negSucc, Nat.cast_add_one, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul]

name: log_sqrt
statement:
@[push]
theorem log_sqrt {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : log (√x) = log x / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_div_iff, mul_comm, ← Nat.cast_two, ← log_pow, sq_sqrt hx]
  exact two_ne_zero

name: log_le_sub_one_of_pos
statement: theorem log_le_sub_one_of_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : log x ≤ x - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_sub_iff_add_le]
  convert! add_one_le_exp (log x)
  rw [exp_log hx]

name: one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos
statement: lemma one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (hx : 0 < x) : 1 - x⁻¹ ≤ log x

name: log_le_self
statement: lemma log_le_self (hx : 0 ≤ x) : log x ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := hx.eq_or_lt
  · simp
  · exact (log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx).trans (by linarith)

name: neg_inv_le_log
statement: lemma neg_inv_le_log (hx : 0 ≤ x) : -x⁻¹ ≤ log x
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_le, ← log_inv]; exact log_le_self <| inv_nonneg.2 hx

name: abs_log_mul_self_lt
statement: theorem abs_log_mul_self_lt (x : ℝ) (h1 : 0 < x) (h2 : x ≤ 1) : |log x * x| < 1
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 < 1 / x := by simpa only [one_div, inv_pos] using h1
  replace := log_le_sub_one_of_pos this
  replace : log (1 / x) < 1 / x := by linarith
  rw [log_div one_ne_zero h1.ne', log_one, zero_sub, lt_div_iff₀ h1] at this
  have aux : 0 ≤ -log x * x := by
    refine mul_nonneg ?_ h1.le
    rw [← log_inv]
    apply log_nonneg
    rw [← le_inv_comm₀ h1 zero_lt_one, inv_one]
    exact h2
  rw [← abs_of_nonneg aux, neg_mul, abs_neg] at this
  exact this

name: le_log_one_add_of_nonneg
statement: lemma le_log_one_add_of_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 2 * x / (x + 2) ≤ log (1 + x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_log_iff_exp_le (by grind)]
  convert exp_le_two_add_div_two_sub (x := 2 * x / (x + 2)) (by positivity) _ using 1
  all_goals field_simp; grind

name: lt_log_one_add_of_pos
statement: lemma lt_log_one_add_of_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : 2 * x / (x + 2) < log (1 + x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by grind)]
  convert exp_lt_two_add_div_two_sub (x := 2 * x / (x + 2)) (by positivity) _ using 1
  all_goals field_simp; grind

name: tendsto_log_atTop
statement: theorem tendsto_log_atTop : Tendsto log atTop atTop
proof:
:=
  tendsto_comp_exp_atTop.1 <| by simpa only [log_exp] using! tendsto_id

name: tendsto_log_nhdsGT_zero
statement: lemma tendsto_log_nhdsGT_zero : Tendsto log (𝓝[>] 0) atBot

name: tendsto_log_nhdsNE_zero
statement: theorem tendsto_log_nhdsNE_zero : Tendsto log (𝓝[≠] 0) atBot

name: tendsto_log_nhdsLT_zero
statement: lemma tendsto_log_nhdsLT_zero : Tendsto log (𝓝[<] 0) atBot
proof:
:=
  tendsto_log_nhdsNE_zero.mono_left <| nhdsWithin_mono _ fun _ h ↦ ne_of_lt h

name: continuousOn_log
statement: theorem continuousOn_log : ContinuousOn log {0}ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  simp +unfoldPartialApp only [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict,
    domRestrict]
  conv in log _ => rw [log_of_ne_zero (show (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 from x.2)]
  exact expOrderIso.symm.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.norm.subtype_mk _)

name: continuous_log
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem continuous_log : Continuous fun x : { x : ℝ // x ≠ 0 } => log x

name: continuous_log'
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem continuous_log' : Continuous fun x : { x : ℝ // 0 < x } => log x
proof:
:=
  continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.1 <| continuousOn_log.mono fun _ hx => ne_of_gt hx

name: continuousAt_log
statement: theorem continuousAt_log (hx : x ≠ 0) : ContinuousAt log x

name: continuousAt_log_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem continuousAt_log_iff : ContinuousAt log x ↔ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, continuousAt_log⟩
  rintro h rfl
  exact not_tendsto_nhds_of_tendsto_atBot tendsto_log_nhdsNE_zero _ <|
    h.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds

name: log_list_prod
statement:
lemma log_list_prod {l : List ℝ} (h : ∀ x ∈ l, x ≠ 0) :
    log l.prod = (l.map (fun x ↦ log x)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp_all only [ne_eq, mem_cons, or_true, not_false_eq_true, forall_const, forall_eq_or_imp,
      prod_cons, map_cons, sum_cons]
    have : l.prod ≠ 0 := by grind [prod_ne_zero]
    rw [log_mul h.1 this, add_right_inj, ih]

name: log_multiset_prod
statement:
lemma log_multiset_prod {s : Multiset ℝ} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≠ 0) :
    log s.prod = (s.map (fun x ↦ log x)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_toList, log_list_prod (by simp_all), sum_map_toList]

name: log_prod
statement:
@[push]
theorem log_prod {α : Type*} {s : Finset α} {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0) :
    log (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, log (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_map_toList, log_list_prod (by simp_all)]
  simp

name: _root_.Finsupp.log_prod
statement:
@[push]
protected theorem _root_.Finsupp.log_prod {α β : Type*} [Zero β] (f : α →₀ β) (g : α → β → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ a, g a (f a) = 0 → f a = 0) : log (f.prod g) = f.sum fun a b ↦ log (g a b)
proof:
:=
  log_prod fun _x hx h₀ ↦ Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hx <| hg _ h₀

name: log_finprod
statement:
lemma log_finprod {α : Type*} {f : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ a, 0 < f a) :
    log (∏ᶠ a, f a) = ∑ᶠ a, log (f a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have H : (fun i ↦ log (f i)).support = f.mulSupport := by
    grind [mem_mulSupport, mem_support, log_eq_zero]
  have H' : HasFiniteMulSupport f ↔ HasFiniteSupport fun a ↦ log (f a) := by
    simp [HasFiniteMulSupport, HasFiniteSupport, H]
  simp only [finprod_def, finsum_def]
  by_cases h' : HasFiniteMulSupport f
  · simp [h', log_prod (fun a _ ↦ (h a).ne'), H'.mp h', H]
  · simp [h', mt H'.mpr h']

name: log_nat_eq_sum_factorization
statement:
theorem log_nat_eq_sum_factorization (n : ℕ) :
    log n = n.factorization.sum fun p t => t * log p
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp 
  · simp only [← log_pow, ← Nat.cast_pow]
    rw [← Finsupp.log_prod, ← Nat.cast_finsuppProd, Nat.prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn]
    intro p hp
    rw [eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero (Nat.cast_eq_zero.1 hp), Nat.factorization_zero_right]

name: tendsto_pow_log_div_mul_add_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_pow_log_div_mul_add_atTop (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun x => log x ^ n / (a * x + b)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:=
  ((tendsto_div_pow_mul_exp_add_atTop a b n ha.symm).comp tendsto_log_atTop).congr' <| by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x hx using by simp [exp_log hx]

name: isLittleO_pow_log_id_atTop
statement: theorem isLittleO_pow_log_id_atTop {n : ℕ} : (fun x => log x ^ n) =o[atTop] id
proof:
:= by
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff_tendsto']
  · simpa using tendsto_pow_log_div_mul_add_atTop 1 0 n one_ne_zero
  filter_upwards [eventually_ne_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x h₁ h₂ using (h₁ h₂).elim

name: isLittleO_log_id_atTop
statement: theorem isLittleO_log_id_atTop : log =o[atTop] id

name: isLittleO_const_log_atTop
statement: theorem isLittleO_const_log_atTop {c : ℝ} : (fun _ => c) =o[atTop] log
proof:
:= by
  refine Asymptotics.isLittleO_of_tendsto' ?_
    <| Tendsto.div_atTop (a := c) (by simp) tendsto_log_atTop
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 1] with x hx
  aesop (add safe forward log_pos)

name: image_log_Ioi
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_log_Ioi {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : log '' Ioi a = Ioi (log a)
proof:
:=
  (continuousOn_log.mono fun _ hx ↦ (ha.trans_le hx).ne').image_Ioi_of_strictMonoOn
    (strictMonoOn_log.mono fun _ hx ↦ ha.trans_le hx) tendsto_log_atTop

theorem image_log_Ici {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : log '' Ici a = Ici (log a)

  (continuousOn_log.mono fun _ hx ↦ (ha.trans_le hx).ne').image_Ici_of_monotoneOn
    (strictMonoOn_log.monotoneOn.mono fun _ hx ↦ ha.trans_le hx) tendsto_log_atTop

theorem image_log_Icc {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) : log '' Icc a b = Icc (log a) (log b)
proof:
:=
  (continuousOn_log.mono fun _ hx ↦ (ha.trans_le hx.1).ne').image_Icc_of_monotoneOn hab
    (strictMonoOn_log.monotoneOn.mono fun _ hx ↦ ha.trans_le hx.1)

name: image_log_Ico
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_log_Ico {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) : log '' Ico a b = Ico (log a) (log b)
proof:
:=
  (continuousOn_log.mono fun _ hx ↦ (ha.trans_le hx.1).ne').image_Ico_of_strictMonoOn hab
    (strictMonoOn_log.mono fun _ hx ↦ ha.trans_le hx.1)

name: image_log_Ioc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_log_Ioc {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) : log '' Ioc a b = Ioc (log a) (log b)

:=
  (continuousOn_log.mono fun _ hx ↦ (ha.trans_le hx.1).ne').image_Ioc_of_strictMonoOn hab

name: image_log_Ioo
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_log_Ioo {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) : log '' Ioo a b = Ioo (log a) (log b)

  (continuousOn_log.mono fun _ hx ↦ (ha.trans_le hx.1).ne').image_Ioo_of_strictMonoOn hab

name: image_log_uIcc
statement:

theorem image_log_uIcc {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :

    (strictMonoOn_log.monotoneOn.mono fun _ hx ↦ (lt_min ha hb).trans_le hx.1)

name: image_log_Ioo_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_log_Ioo_zero {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : log '' Ioo 0 a = Iio (log a)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← exp_log ha, ← image_exp_Iio, ← image_comp, log_comp_exp, image_id]

proof: := fun x hx => (hf x hx).log (h₀ x hx)

name: tendsto_log_comp_add_sub_log
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_comp_add_sub_log (y : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => log (x + y) - log x) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : Tendsto (fun x ↦ 1 + y / x) atTop (𝓝 (1 + 0)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.add (tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_id)
  rw [← comap_exp_nhds_exp, exp_zero, tendsto_comap_iff, ← add_zero (1 : ℝ)]
  refine this.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ), eventually_gt_atTop (-y)] with x hx₀ hxy
  rw [comp_apply, exp_sub, exp_log, exp_log, one_add_div] <;> linarith

name: tendsto_log_nat_add_one_sub_log
statement: theorem tendsto_log_nat_add_one_sub_log : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => log (k + 1) - log k) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: log_nonneg_of_isNat
statement: lemma log_nonneg_of_isNat {n : ℕ} (h : NormNum.IsNat e n) : 0 ≤ Real.log (e : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [NormNum.IsNat.to_eq h rfl]
  exact Real.log_natCast_nonneg _

name: log_pos_of_isNat
statement:
lemma log_pos_of_isNat {n : ℕ} (h : NormNum.IsNat e n) (w : Nat.blt 1 n = true) :
    0 < Real.log (e : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [NormNum.IsNat.to_eq h rfl]
  apply Real.log_pos
  simpa using w

statement:
lemma log_nonneg_of_isNegNat {n : ℕ} (h : NormNum.IsInt e (.negOfNat n)) :
    0 ≤ Real.log (e : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [NormNum.IsInt.neg_to_eq h rfl]
  exact Real.log_neg_natCast_nonneg _

name: log_pos_of_isNegNat
statement:
lemma log_pos_of_isNegNat {n : ℕ} (h : NormNum.IsInt e (.negOfNat n)) (w : Nat.blt 1 n = true) :
    0 < Real.log (e : ℝ)
proof:

  rw [NormNum.IsInt.neg_to_eq h rfl]

name: log_pos_of_isNNRat
statement:
lemma log_pos_of_isNNRat {n : ℕ} :
    (NormNum.IsNNRat e n d) → (decide ((1 : ℚ) < n / d)) → (0 < Real.log (e : ℝ))
  | ⟨inv, eq⟩, h => by
    rw [eq, invOf_eq_inv, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
    have : 1 < (n : ℝ) / d
proof:
:= by
      simpa using (Rat.cast_lt (K := ℝ)).2 (of_decide_eq_true h)
    exact Real.log_pos this

name: log_pos_of_isRat_neg
statement:
lemma log_pos_of_isRat_neg {n : ℤ} :
    (NormNum.IsRat e n d) → (decide (n / d < (-1 : ℚ))) → (0 < Real.log (e : ℝ))
  | ⟨inv, eq⟩, h => by
    rw [eq, invOf_eq_inv, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
    have : (n : ℝ) / d < -1
proof:
:= by exact_mod_cast of_decide_eq_true h
    exact Real.log_pos_of_lt_neg_one this

name: log_nz_of_isNNRat
statement:
lemma log_nz_of_isNNRat {n : ℕ} : (NormNum.IsNNRat e n d) → (decide ((0 : ℚ) < n / d))
    → (decide (n / d < (1 : ℚ))) → (Real.log (e : ℝ) ≠ 0)
  | ⟨inv, eq⟩, h₁, h₂ => by
    rw [eq, invOf_eq_inv, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
    have h₁' : 0 < (n : ℝ) / d
proof:
:= by
      simpa using (Rat.cast_pos (K := ℝ)).2 (of_decide_eq_true h₁)
    have h₂' : (n : ℝ) / d < 1 := by
      simpa using (Rat.cast_lt (K := ℝ)).2 (of_decide_eq_true h₂)

name: log_nz_of_isRat_neg

lemma log_nz_of_isRat_neg {n : ℤ} : (NormNum.IsRat e n d) → (decide (n / d < (0 : ℚ)))

  | ⟨inv, eq⟩, h₁, h₂ => by
    rw [eq, invOf_eq_inv, ← div_eq_mul_inv]

proof:
:= by exact_mod_cast of_decide_eq_true h₁
    have h₂' : -1 < (n : ℝ) / d := by exact_mod_cast of_decide_eq_true h₂
    exact ne_of_lt <| Real.log_neg_of_lt_zero h₁' h₂'

name: posLog_apply
statement: theorem posLog_apply : log⁺ x = max 0 (log x)

name: posLog_def
statement: theorem posLog_def : log⁺ = max 0 (log ·)

name: posLog_sub_posLog_inv
statement: theorem posLog_sub_posLog_inv : log⁺ x - log⁺ x⁻¹ = log x
proof:
:= by
  rw [posLog_apply, posLog_apply, log_inv]
  by_cases! h : 0 ≤ log x
  · simp [h]
  · simp [neg_nonneg.1 (Left.nonneg_neg_iff.2 h.le)]

name: half_mul_log_add_log_abs
statement: theorem half_mul_log_add_log_abs : 2⁻¹ * (log x + |log x|) = log⁺ x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hr : 0 ≤ log x
  · simp [posLog, hr, abs_of_nonneg]
    ring
  · simp [posLog, hr.le, abs_of_nonpos]

name: posLog_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma posLog_zero : log⁺ 0 = 0

name: posLog_one
statement: @[simp] lemma posLog_one : log⁺ 1 = 0

name: posLog_nonneg
statement: theorem posLog_nonneg : 0 ≤ log⁺ x

name: posLog_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem posLog_neg (x : ℝ) : log⁺ (-x) = log⁺ x

name: posLog_abs
statement: @[simp] theorem posLog_abs (x : ℝ) : log⁺ |x| = log⁺ x

name: posLog_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem posLog_eq_zero_iff (x : ℝ) : log⁺ x = 0 ↔ |x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← posLog_abs, ← log_nonpos_iff (abs_nonneg x)]
  simp [posLog]

name: posLog_eq_log
statement: theorem posLog_eq_log (hx : 1 ≤ |x|) : log⁺ x = log x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [posLog, sup_eq_right]
  rw [← log_abs]
  apply log_nonneg hx

name: monotoneOn_posLog
statement: theorem monotoneOn_posLog : MonotoneOn log⁺ (Set.Ici (-1))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y _ hxy
  grind [posLog_eq_zero_iff, posLog_nonneg, posLog_eq_log, log_le_log]

name: antitoneOn_posLog
statement: theorem antitoneOn_posLog : AntitoneOn log⁺ (Set.Iic 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  rw [← posLog_neg x, ← posLog_neg y]
  exact monotoneOn_posLog (by grind) (by grind) (neg_le_neg hxy)

name: log_of_nat_eq_posLog
statement: theorem log_of_nat_eq_posLog {n : ℕ} : log⁺ n = log n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn, posLog]
  · simp [posLog_eq_log, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hn]

name: abs_log_eq_posLog_add_posLog_inv
statement: theorem abs_log_eq_posLog_add_posLog_inv (x : ℝ) : |log x| = log⁺ x + log⁺ x⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  grind [half_mul_log_add_log_abs (x := x), log_inv x ▸ half_mul_log_add_log_abs (x := x⁻¹)]

name: posLog_eq_log_max_one
statement: theorem posLog_eq_log_max_one (hx : 0 ≤ x) : log⁺ x = log (max 1 x)
proof:
:= by
  grind [le_abs, posLog_eq_log, log_one, max_eq_left, log_nonpos, posLog_apply]

name: posLog_le_posLog
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma posLog_le_posLog (hx : -1 ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) : log⁺ x ≤ log⁺ y

name: posLog_pow
statement: @[simp] lemma posLog_pow (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : log⁺ (x ^ n) = n * log⁺ x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp_all
  by_cases hx : |x| ≤ 1
  · simp_all [pow_le_one₀, (posLog_eq_zero_iff _).2]
  rw [not_le] at hx
  have : 1 ≤ |x ^ n| := by simp_all [one_le_pow₀, hx.le]
  simp [posLog_eq_log this, posLog_eq_log hx.le]

name: posLog_rpow
statement: @[simp] theorem posLog_rpow {x α : ℝ} (hx : -1 ≤ x) (hα : 0 ≤ α) : log⁺ (x ^ α) = α * log⁺ x
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt x 0 with h | h
  · have h₁ : |x| ≤ 1 := abs_le.2 ⟨hx, h.trans zero_le_one⟩
    rw [(posLog_eq_zero_iff x).2 h₁, mul_zero, (posLog_eq_zero_iff _).2]
    exact (abs_rpow_le_abs_rpow x α).trans (rpow_le_one (abs_nonneg x) h₁ hα)
  · rw [posLog_apply, posLog_apply, log_rpow h, mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ hα, mul_zero]

name: continuous_posLog
statement: @[fun_prop] theorem continuous_posLog : Continuous log⁺
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · apply ContinuousAt.congr (f := fun _ ↦ 0) (by fun_prop)
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ zero_lt_one] with y hy
    rw [eq_comm, posLog_eq_zero_iff y]
    simp_all [le_of_lt]
  rw [posLog_def]
  fun_prop

name: posLog_le_log_one_add
statement: lemma posLog_le_log_one_add {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : log⁺ x ≤ log (1 + x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [posLog_eq_log_max_one hx]
  exact log_le_log (by positivity) (max_le (by linarith) (by linarith))

name: log_one_add_le_posLog
statement: lemma log_one_add_le_posLog {x : ℝ} : log (1 + x) ≤ log⁺ x + log 2
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 |x| := le_max_left ..
  have h₂ : |1 + x| ≤ max 1 |x| * 2 := by
    linarith [abs_add_le 1 x, le_max_right 1 |x|, abs_one (α := ℝ)]
  calc log (1 + x)
  _ ≤ log⁺ (1 + x) := le_max_right ..
  _ = log⁺ |1 + x| := (posLog_abs _).symm
  _ ≤ log⁺ (max 1 |x| * 2) := posLog_le_posLog (neg_one_lt_zero.le.trans (abs_nonneg _)) h₂
  _ = log⁺ x + log 2 := by
    rw [posLog_eq_log (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; linarith),
      log_mul (by positivity) two_ne_zero, ← posLog_eq_log_max_one (abs_nonneg x), posLog_abs]

name: posLog_le_abs
statement: lemma posLog_le_abs (x : ℝ) : log⁺ x ≤ |x|
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt |x| 1 with h | h
  · rw [(posLog_eq_zero_iff x).2 h]
    exact abs_nonneg x
  · rw [← posLog_abs, posLog_eq_log (by rw [abs_abs]; exact h.le)]
    linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (lt_trans one_pos h)]

name: posLog_mul
statement: theorem posLog_mul : log⁺ (x * y) ≤ log⁺ x + log⁺ y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : x = 0
  · simp [ha, posLog]
  by_cases hb : y = 0
  · simp [hb, posLog]
  unfold posLog
  nth_rw 1 [← add_zero 0, log_mul ha hb]
  exact max_add_add_le_max_add_max

name: posLog_nat_mul
statement: theorem posLog_nat_mul {n : ℕ} : log⁺ (n * x) ≤ log n + log⁺ x

name: posLog_prod
statement:
theorem posLog_prod {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    log⁺ (∏ t ∈ s, f t) ≤ ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ (f t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [posLog]
  | insert a s ha hs =>
    calc log⁺ (∏ t ∈ insert a s, f t)
    _ = log⁺ (f a * ∏ t ∈ s, f t) := by rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
    _ ≤ log⁺ (f a) + log⁺ (∏ t ∈ s, f t) := posLog_mul
    _ ≤ log⁺ (f a) + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ (f t) := add_le_add (by rfl) hs
    _ = ∑ t ∈ insert a s, log⁺ (f t) := by rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: posLog_sum
statement:
theorem posLog_sum {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    log⁺ (∑ t ∈ s, f t) ≤ log (s.card) + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ (f t)
proof:
:= by
  
  by_cases! hs : s = ∅
  · simp [hs, posLog]
  
  obtain ⟨t_max, ht_max⟩ := s.exists_max_image (fun t ↦ |f t|) hs
  
  calc log⁺ (∑ t ∈ s, f t)
  _ = log⁺ |∑ t ∈ s, f t| := by
    rw [Real.posLog_abs]
  _ ≤ log⁺ (∑ t ∈ s, |f t|) := by
    apply posLog_le_posLog (neg_one_lt_zero.le.trans (abs_nonneg _))
    simp [Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs]
  _ ≤ log⁺ (∑ t ∈ s, |f t_max|) := by
    apply posLog_le_posLog (neg_one_lt_zero.le.trans (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _))
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i ih ↦ ht_max.2 i ih)
  _ = log⁺ (s.card * |f t_max|) := by
    simp [Finset.sum_const]
  _ ≤ log s.card + log⁺ |f t_max| := posLog_nat_mul
  _ ≤ log s.card + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ (f t) := by
    gcongr
    rw [posLog_abs]
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ posLog_nonneg) ht_max.1

name: posLog_norm_sum_le
statement:
lemma posLog_norm_sum_le {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] {α : Type*} (s : Finset α)
    (f : α → E) :
    log⁺ ‖∑ t ∈ s, f t‖ ≤ log s.card + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ ‖f t‖

name: posLog_add
statement: theorem posLog_add : log⁺ (x + y) ≤ log 2 + log⁺ x + log⁺ y
proof:
:= by
  convert! posLog_sum Finset.univ ![x, y] using 1 <;> simp [add_assoc]

name: posLog_norm_add_le
statement:
lemma posLog_norm_add_le {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (a b : E) :
    log⁺ ‖a + b‖ ≤ log⁺ ‖a‖ + log⁺ ‖b‖ + log 2
proof:
:= by
  grw [norm_add_le, posLog_add, add_rotate]
  exact neg_one_lt_zero.le.trans (norm_nonneg _)

name: mul_log_strictMonoOn
statement: theorem mul_log_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn (fun x ↦ x * log x) <| .Ici <| exp (-1)
proof:
:= by
  refine strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Ici _) continuous_mul_log.continuousOn fun x hx ↦ ?_
  have hlt : rexp (-1) < x := by simpa using hx
  have hpos : 0 < x := by grind [Real.exp_pos]
  grind [deriv_mul_log, Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hpos |>.mpr hlt]

name: log_mul_self_monotoneOn
statement:
@[deprecated Real.mul_log_strictMonoOn (since := "2026-04-07")]
theorem log_mul_self_monotoneOn : MonotoneOn (fun x : ℝ => log x * x) { x | 1 ≤ x }
proof:

name: mul_log_strictAntiOn
statement:
theorem mul_log_strictAntiOn :
    StrictAntiOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ x * log x) <| .Icc 0 (exp (-1))
proof:
:= by
  refine strictAntiOn_of_deriv_neg (convex_Icc ..) continuous_mul_log.continuousOn fun x hx ↦ ?_
  have hgt : x < rexp (-1) := by simp_all [interior_Icc, mem_Ioo]
  have hpos : 0 < x := by simp_all [interior_Icc, mem_Ioo]
  grind [deriv_mul_log, Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp hpos |>.mpr hgt]

name: log_div_self_antitoneOn
statement: theorem log_div_self_antitoneOn : AntitoneOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ log x / x) <| .Ici (exp 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hex y hey hxy
  have x_pos : 0 < x := (exp_pos 1).trans_le hex
  have y_pos : 0 < y := (exp_pos 1).trans_le hey
  have hlogx : 1 ≤ log x := by rwa [le_log_iff_exp_le x_pos]
  have hyx : 0 ≤ y / x - 1 := by rwa [le_sub_iff_add_le, le_div_iff₀ x_pos, zero_add, one_mul]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ y_pos, ← sub_le_sub_iff_right (log x)]
  calc
    log y - log x = log (y / x) := by rw [log_div y_pos.ne' x_pos.ne']
    _ ≤ y / x - 1 := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos y_pos x_pos)
    _ ≤ log x * (y / x - 1) := le_mul_of_one_le_left hyx hlogx
    _ = log x / x * y - log x := by ring

name: log_div_self_rpow_antitoneOn
statement:
theorem log_div_self_rpow_antitoneOn {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    AntitoneOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ log x / x ^ a) <| .Ici (exp a⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hex y _ hxy
  simp only
  have x_pos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (exp_pos a⁻¹) (le_of_le_of_eq hex rfl)
  have y_pos : 0 < y := by linarith
  nth_rw 1 [← rpow_one y, ← rpow_one x]
  rw [← div_self (ne_of_lt ha).symm, div_eq_mul_one_div a a, rpow_mul y_pos.le, rpow_mul x_pos.le,
    log_rpow (rpow_pos_of_pos y_pos a), log_rpow (rpow_pos_of_pos x_pos a), mul_div_assoc,
    mul_div_assoc, mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (one_div_pos.mpr ha)]
  have hbound {z : ℝ} (hz : z ∈ Ici (rexp a⁻¹)) : z ^ a ∈ {b | rexp 1 ≤ b} := by
    rw [mem_ofPred_eq]
    convert! rpow_le_rpow _ hz (le_of_lt ha) using 1
    · simp only [← exp_mul, Real.exp_eq_exp, field]
    positivity
  refine log_div_self_antitoneOn (hbound hex) (hbound (hex.trans hxy)) ?_
  gcongr

name: log_div_sqrt_antitoneOn
statement: theorem log_div_sqrt_antitoneOn : AntitoneOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ log x / √x) <| .Ici (exp 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sqrt_eq_rpow]
  convert! log_div_self_rpow_antitoneOn one_half_pos
  norm_num

name: Real.norm_inv_mul_rpow_sub_one_sub_log_le
statement:
lemma Real.norm_inv_mul_rpow_sub_one_sub_log_le {p x : ℝ} (p_pos : 0 < p) (x_pos : 0 < x)
    (hx : ‖p * log x‖ ≤ 1) : ‖p⁻¹ * (x ^ p - 1) - log x‖ ≤ p * ‖log x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have pinv_nonneg : 0 ≤ p⁻¹ := by grind [_root_.inv_nonneg]
  calc
    _ = ‖p⁻¹ * ((x ^ p - 1) - p * log x)‖ := by grind
    _ = p⁻¹ * ‖(rexp (p * log x) - 1) - p * log x‖ := by
          simp only [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (r := p⁻¹) pinv_nonneg]
          congr
          rw [mul_comm, Real.exp_mul, Real.exp_log (by grind)]
    _ ≤ p⁻¹ * ‖p * log x‖ ^ 2 := by
          gcongr
          refine Real.norm_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le ?_
          simp only [hx]
    _ = p * ‖log x‖ ^ 2 := by
          simp only [norm_mul]
          grind [Real.norm_of_nonneg]

name: Real.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_rpow_sub_one_log
statement:
lemma Real.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_rpow_sub_one_log :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun (p : ℝ) (x : ℝ) => p⁻¹ * (x ^ p - 1)) log (𝓝[>] 0) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact isOpen_Ioi).mpr ?_
  intro s hs hs'
  rw [Metric.uniformity_basis_dist_le.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff_of_uniformity]
  intro ε hε
  let pbound : ℝ := ε / (sSup ((fun x => ‖log x‖ ^ 2) '' s) + 1)
  have hxs : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≠ 0 := by grind
  have sSup_nonneg : 0 ≤ sSup ((fun x => ‖log x‖ ^ 2) '' s) := by
    refine Real.sSup_nonneg ?_
    grind [← sq_nonneg]
  have sSup_nonneg' : 0 ≤ sSup ((fun x => ‖log x‖) '' s) := by
    refine Real.sSup_nonneg ?_
    grind [← sq_nonneg]
  have pbound_pos : 0 < pbound := by positivity
  have h₁ : ∀ᶠ p : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, 0 < p ∧ p < pbound := nhdsGT_basis 0 |>.mem_of_mem pbound_pos
  have h₂ : ∀ᶠ p : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, p ≤ 1 / (sSup ((fun x => ‖log x‖) '' s) + 1) :=
    Eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds <| eventually_le_nhds (by positivity)
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => ‖log x‖ ^ 2) s := by fun_prop
  have hcont' : ContinuousOn (fun x => ‖log x‖) s := by fun_prop
  filter_upwards [h₁, h₂] with p ⟨hp₁,hp₂⟩ hp₃
  intro x hx
  have hx' : ‖p * log x‖ ≤ 1 := calc
    _ = p * ‖log x‖ := by grind [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg]
    _ ≤ 1 / (sSup ((fun y => ‖log y‖) '' s) + 1) * ‖log x‖ := by gcongr
    _ ≤ 1 / (‖log x‖ + 1) * ‖log x‖ := by
        gcongr
        refine le_csSup ?_ (by grind)
        grind [IsCompact.bddAbove, ← IsCompact.image_of_continuousOn]
    _ = ‖log x‖ / (‖log x‖ + 1) := by grind
    _ ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one₀] <;> grind [norm_nonneg]
  have pinv_nonneg : 0 ≤ p⁻¹ := by grind [_root_.inv_nonneg]
  rw [dist_eq_norm']
  calc
    _ ≤ p * ‖log x‖ ^ 2 := Real.norm_inv_mul_rpow_sub_one_sub_log_le hp₁ (hs hx) hx'
    _ ≤ p * sSup ((fun x => ‖log x‖ ^ 2) '' s) := by
          gcongr
          refine le_csSup ?_ (by grind)
          grind [IsCompact.bddAbove, ← IsCompact.image_of_continuousOn]
    _ ≤ pbound * (sSup ((fun x => ‖log x‖ ^ 2) '' s) + 1) := by gcongr; grind
    _ = ε := by grind

name: self_sub_one_lt_mul_log
statement: lemma self_sub_one_lt_mul_log {x : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≠ 1) : x - 1 < x * x.log
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx_pos : 0 < x
  · nlinarith [Real.log_inv x, Real.log_lt_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hx_pos) (by aesop),
      mul_inv_cancel₀ hx_pos.ne']
  · cases lt_or_eq_of_le h0 <;> aesop

name: continuous_mul_log
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma continuous_mul_log : Continuous fun x ↦ x * log x
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  obtain hx | rfl := ne_or_eq x 0
  · exact (continuous_id'.continuousAt).mul (continuousAt_log hx)
  rw [ContinuousAt, zero_mul]
  simp_rw [mul_comm _ (log _)]
  nth_rewrite 1 [← nhdsWithin_univ]
  have : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) = Set.Iio 0 ∪ Set.Ioi 0 ∪ {0} := by ext; simp [em]
  rw [this, nhdsWithin_union, nhdsWithin_union]
  simp only [nhdsWithin_singleton, Filter.tendsto_sup]
  refine ⟨⟨tendsto_log_mul_self_nhdsLT_zero, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [rpow_one] using tendsto_log_mul_rpow_nhdsGT_zero zero_lt_one
  · convert! tendsto_pure_nhds (fun x ↦ log x * x) 0
    simp

private lemma tendsto_deriv_mul_log_nhdsWithin_zero :

proof:
:= fun h ↦
  (not_differentiableWithinAt_of_deriv_tendsto_atBot_Ioi (fun x : ℝ ↦ x * log x) (a := 0))
    tendsto_deriv_mul_log_nhdsWithin_zero
    (h.differentiableWithinAt (s := Set.Ioi 0))

name: deriv2_mul_log
statement: lemma deriv2_mul_log (x : ℝ) : deriv^[2] (fun x ↦ x * log x) x = x⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Function.iterate_succ, Function.iterate_zero, Function.id_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [hx, inv_zero]
    exact deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt
      (fun h ↦ not_continuousAt_deriv_mul_log_zero h.continuousAt)
  · suffices ∀ᶠ y in (𝓝 x), deriv (fun x ↦ x * log x) y = log y + 1 by
      refine (Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq this).trans ?_
      rw [deriv_add_const, deriv_log x]
    filter_upwards [eventually_ne_nhds hx] with y hy using deriv_mul_log hy

statement: lemma differentiableAt_negMulLog_iff {x : ℝ} : DifferentiableAt ℝ negMulLog x ↔ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · unfold negMulLog
    intro h eq0
    simp only [neg_mul, differentiableAt_fun_neg_iff, eq0] at h
    exact not_DifferentiableAt_log_mul_zero h
  · intro hx
    have : x ∈ ({0} : Set ℝ)ᶜ := by
      simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, not_false_eq_true]
    have := differentiableOn_negMulLog x this
    apply DifferentiableWithinAt.differentiableAt (s := {0}ᶜ) <;>
    simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, not_false_eq_true,
      compl_singleton_mem_nhds_iff]
