name: CFC.tendsto_cfc_rpow_sub_one_log
statement:
lemma CFC.tendsto_cfc_rpow_sub_one_log {a : A} (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => cfc (fun x => p⁻¹ * (x ^ p - 1)) a) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (CFC.log a))
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_cfc_fun ?tendsto ?cont
  case cont =>
    exact .of_forall fun p ↦ by fun_prop (disch := grind -abstractProof)
  case tendsto =>
    let s := {a : A | IsStrictlyPositive a}
    let f (p : ℝ) (x : ℝ) := if p > 0 then p⁻¹ * (x ^ p - 1) else Real.log x
    have hmain := Real.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_rpow_sub_one_log
    rw [tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact isOpen_Ioi] at hmain
    exact hmain (spectrum ℝ a) (by grind) (by grind)

name: CFC.tendsto_ite_cfc_rpow_sub_one_ite_log
statement:
lemma CFC.tendsto_ite_cfc_rpow_sub_one_ite_log :
    Tendsto (fun (p : ℝ) (a : A) =>
      if a ∈ {b : A | IsStrictlyPositive b} then cfc (fun x => p⁻¹ * (x ^ p - 1)) a else 0) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 (fun a => if a ∈ {b : A | IsStrictlyPositive b} then CFC.log a else 0))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_pi_nhds]
  intro a
  by_cases ha : IsStrictlyPositive a
  · simpa [ha] using CFC.tendsto_cfc_rpow_sub_one_log ha
  · simp_all

name: CFC.cfc_rpow_sub_one_eqOn
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  simp only [ha, ↓reduceIte, ← smul_eq_mul]
  rw [cfc_smul _ (hf := by fun_prop (disch := grind)),
    cfc_sub _ _ (hf := by fun_prop (disch := grind)),
    cfc_const_one .., rpow_eq_cfc_real ..]

name: CFC.log_monotoneOn
statement: lemma CFC.log_monotoneOn : MonotoneOn log {a : A | IsStrictlyPositive a}
proof:
:= by
  /- We have that `log x = lim_{p → 0} p⁻¹ * (x ^ p - 1)` with uniform convergence on the spectrum
  of any positive definite operator, which means that `CFC.log a = lim_{p → 0} p⁻¹ * (a ^ p - 1)`
  by the continuity of the continuous functional calculus (`tendsto_cfc_fun`). Then, we use the
  fact that `x^p` is monotone for `p ∈ [0,1]` (`CFC.monotone_nnrpow`) and that the set of
  monotone functions is closed (`isClosed_monotoneOn`) to conclude the proof. -/
  let s := {a : A | IsStrictlyPositive a}
  let f (p : ℝ) := fun a => if a ∈ s then cfc (A := A) (fun x => p⁻¹ * (x ^ p - 1)) a else 0
  let g := fun a => if a ∈ s then log (A := A) a else 0
  have hg : s.EqOn g (log (A := A)) := by simp +contextual [g, Set.EqOn]
  refine MonotoneOn.congr ?_ hg
  refine isClosed_monotoneOn.mem_of_tendsto (f := f) (b := (𝓝[>] 0))
    tendsto_ite_cfc_rpow_sub_one_ite_log ?_
  have h₁ : ∀ᶠ (p : ℝ) in 𝓝[>] 0, 0 < p ∧ p < 1 := nhdsGT_basis 0 |>.mem_of_mem zero_lt_one
  filter_upwards [h₁] with p ⟨hp, hp'⟩
  refine MonotoneOn.congr (fun a ha b hb hab ↦ ?_) CFC.cfc_rpow_sub_one_eqOn.symm
  gcongr
  grind

name: CFC.log_le_log
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma CFC.log_le_log {a b : A} (hab : a ≤ b) (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    log a ≤ log b

name: CFC.concaveOn_log
statement: lemma CFC.concaveOn_log : ConcaveOn ℝ {a : A | IsStrictlyPositive a} log
proof:
:= by
  /- We have that `log x = lim_{p → 0} p⁻¹ * (x ^ p - 1)` with uniform convergence on the spectrum
  of any positive definite operator, which means that `CFC.log a = lim_{p → 0} p⁻¹ * (a ^ p - 1)`
  by the continuity of the continuous functional calculus (`tendsto_cfc_fun`). Then, we use the
  fact that `x^p` is concave for `p ∈ [0,1]` (`CFC.concaveOn_rpow`) and that the set of
  concave functions is closed (`isClosed_setOfPred_concaveOn`) to conclude the proof. -/
  set s := {a : A | IsStrictlyPositive a}
  let f (p : ℝ) := fun a => if a ∈ s then cfc (A := A) (fun x => p⁻¹ * (x ^ p - 1)) a else 0
  let g := fun a => if a ∈ s then log (A := A) a else 0
  have hg : s.EqOn g (log (A := A)) := by simp +contextual [g, Set.EqOn]
  refine ConcaveOn.congr ?_ hg
  apply isClosed_setOfPred_concaveOn.mem_of_tendsto (f := f) (b := (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)))
    tendsto_ite_cfc_rpow_sub_one_ite_log ?_
  have h₁ : ∀ᶠ (p : ℝ) in 𝓝[>] 0, 0 < p ∧ p < 1 := nhdsGT_basis 0 |>.mem_of_mem zero_lt_one
  filter_upwards [h₁] with p ⟨hp, hp'⟩
  refine ConcaveOn.congr ?_ CFC.cfc_rpow_sub_one_eqOn.symm
  refine ConcaveOn.smul (by positivity) ?_
  have h_convex : Convex ℝ s := by grind [convex_iff_forall_pos]
  refine ConcaveOn.sub ?_ (convexOn_const _ h_convex)
  refine ConcaveOn.subset (t := Ici 0) ?_ (by grind) h_convex
  exact CFC.concaveOn_rpow (by grind)

name: NormedSpace.exp_continuousMap_eq
statement:
lemma NormedSpace.exp_continuousMap_eq (f : C(α, 𝕜)) :
    exp f = (⟨exp ∘ f, exp_continuous.comp f.continuous⟩ : C(α, 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp_rw [NormedSpace.exp_eq_expSeries_sum (𝔸 := C(α, 𝕜)) 𝕜, FormalMultilinearSeries.sum]
  have h_sum := NormedSpace.expSeries_summable (𝕂 := 𝕜) f
  simp_rw [← ContinuousMap.tsum_apply h_sum a, NormedSpace.expSeries_apply_eq]
  simp [NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum 𝕜]

name: exp_eq_normedSpace_exp
statement:
lemma exp_eq_normedSpace_exp {a : A} (ha : p a := by cfc_tac) :
    cfc (exp : 𝕜 → 𝕜) a = exp a
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← cfc_id 𝕜 a ha, cfc_apply id a ha]
  have h := cfcHom_continuous (R := 𝕜) ha
  have _ : ContinuousOn exp (spectrum 𝕜 a) := exp_continuous.continuousOn
  let +nondep : Algebra ℚ A := .restrictScalars ℚ 𝕜 A
  simp_rw [← map_exp _ h, cfc_apply exp a ha]
  congr 1
  ext
  simp [exp_continuousMap_eq]

name: log_smul
statement:
lemma log_smul {r : ℝ} (a : A) (ha₂ : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ a, x ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (ha₁ : IsSelfAdjoint a := by cfc_tac) :
    log (r • a) = algebraMap ℝ A (Real.log r) + log a
proof:
:= by
  rw [log, ← cfc_smul_id (R := ℝ) r a, ← cfc_comp Real.log (r • ·) a, log]
  calc
    _ = cfc (fun z => Real.log r + Real.log z) a :=
      cfc_congr (Real.log_mul hr <| ha₂ · ·)
    _ = _ := by rw [cfc_const_add _ _ _]

name: log_smul'
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma log_smul' [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [NonnegSpectrumClass ℝ A] {r : ℝ} (a : A)
    (hr : 0 < r) (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    log (r • a) = algebraMap ℝ A (Real.log r) + log a

name: log_pow
statement:
lemma log_pow (n : ℕ) (a : A) (ha₂ : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ a, x ≠ 0)
    (ha₁ : IsSelfAdjoint a := by cfc_tac) : log (a ^ n) = n • log a
proof:
:= by
  have ha₂' : ContinuousOn Real.log (spectrum ℝ a) := by fun_prop
  have ha₂'' : ContinuousOn Real.log ((· ^ n) '' spectrum ℝ a) := by fun_prop (disch := aesop)
  rw [log, ← cfc_pow_id (R := ℝ) a n ha₁, ← cfc_comp' Real.log (· ^ n) a ha₂'', log]
  simp_rw [Real.log_pow, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ n, cfc_const_mul (n : ℝ) Real.log a ha₂']

name: log_pow'
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma log_pow' [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [NonnegSpectrumClass ℝ A] (n : ℕ) (a : A)
    (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    log (a ^ n) = n • log a

name: log_exp
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma log_exp (a : A) (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := by cfc_tac) : log (exp a) = a
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : ContinuousOn Real.log (Real.exp '' spectrum ℝ a) := by fun_prop (disch := simp)
  rw [log, ← real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp, ← cfc_comp' Real.log Real.exp a hcont]
  simp [cfc_id' (R := ℝ) a]

name: exp_log
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma exp_log [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [NonnegSpectrumClass ℝ A] (a : A)
    (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) : exp (log a) = a
proof:
:= by
  have ha₂ : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ a, x ≠ 0 := by grind
  rw [← real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp .log, log, ← cfc_comp' Real.exp Real.log a (by fun_prop)]
  conv_rhs => rw [← cfc_id (R := ℝ) a]
  congr! 1 with x hx
  grind [Real.exp_log]

name: continuousOn_log
proof:
:=
  continuousOn_id.cfc_of_mem_nhdsSet _ (s := {0}ᶜ) <| by
    simpa using fun _ _ ↦ spectrum.zero_notMem ℝ

name: CStarAlgebra.norm_posPart_le
statement:
@[simp]
lemma CStarAlgebra.norm_posPart_le (a : A) : ‖a⁺‖ ≤ ‖a‖
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : IsSelfAdjoint a
  case neg => simp [CFC.posPart_def, cfcₙ_apply_of_not_predicate a ha]
  refine norm_cfcₙ_le fun x hx ↦ ?_
  obtain (h | h) := le_or_gt x 0
  · simp [posPart_def, max_eq_right h]
  · simp only [posPart_def, max_eq_left h.le]
    exact NonUnitalIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus.norm_quasispectrum_le a hx ha

name: CStarAlgebra.norm_negPart_le
statement:
@[simp]
lemma CStarAlgebra.norm_negPart_le (a : A) : ‖a⁻‖ ≤ ‖a‖

name: IsSelfAdjoint.norm_eq_max_norm_posPart_negPart
statement:
lemma IsSelfAdjoint.norm_eq_max_norm_posPart_negPart (a : A) (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := by cfc_tac) :
    ‖a‖ = max ‖a⁺‖ ‖a⁻‖
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ <| max_le (norm_posPart_le a) (norm_negPart_le a)
  conv_lhs => rw [← cfcₙ_id' ℝ a]
  rw [norm_cfcₙ_le_iff ..]
  intro x hx
  obtain (hx' | hx') := le_total 0 x
  · apply le_max_of_le_left
    refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ <| norm_apply_le_norm_cfcₙ _ a hx
    rw [posPart_eq_self.mpr hx']
  · apply le_max_of_le_right
    refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ <| norm_apply_le_norm_cfcₙ _ a hx
    rw [negPart_eq_neg.mpr hx', norm_neg]

name: posPart_mul_negPart
statement:
@[simp]
lemma posPart_mul_negPart (a : A) : a⁺ * a⁻ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [posPart_def, negPart_def]
  by_cases ha : IsSelfAdjoint a
  · rw [← cfcₙ_mul _ _, ← cfcₙ_zero ℝ a]
    congr! 1 with x _
    simp only [_root_.posPart_def, _root_.negPart_def]
    simpa using le_total x 0
  · simp [cfcₙ_apply_of_not_predicate a ha]

name: negPart_mul_posPart
statement:

lemma negPart_mul_posPart (a : A) : a⁻ * a⁺ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [posPart_def, negPart_def]
  by_cases ha : IsSelfAdjoint a
  · rw [← cfcₙ_mul _ _, ← cfcₙ_zero ℝ a]
    congr! 1 with x _
    simp only [_root_.posPart_def, _root_.negPart_def]
    simpa using le_total 0 x
  · simp [cfcₙ_apply_of_not_predicate a ha]

name: posPart_sub_negPart
statement: lemma posPart_sub_negPart (a : A) (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := by cfc_tac) : a⁺ - a⁻ = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [posPart_def, negPart_def]
  rw [← cfcₙ_sub _ _]
  conv_rhs => rw [← cfcₙ_id ℝ a]
  congr! 1 with x hx
  exact _root_.posPart_sub_negPart x

name: posPart_neg
statement:
@[simp]
lemma posPart_neg (a : A) : (-a)⁺ = a⁻
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : IsSelfAdjoint a
  · rw [posPart_def, negPart_def, ← cfcₙ_comp_neg _ _]
    congr! 1
  · have ha' : ¬ IsSelfAdjoint (-a) := fun h ↦ ha (by simpa using h.neg)
    rw [posPart_def, negPart_def, cfcₙ_apply_of_not_predicate a ha,
      cfcₙ_apply_of_not_predicate _ ha']

name: negPart_neg
statement:
@[simp]
lemma negPart_neg (a : A) : (-a)⁻ = a⁺
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero, ← posPart_neg, neg_neg, sub_self]

name: posPart_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma posPart_smul {r : ℝ≥0} {a : A} : (r • a)⁺ = r • a⁺
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : IsSelfAdjoint a
  · simp only [CFC.posPart_def, NNReal.smul_def]
    rw [← cfcₙ_comp_smul .., ← cfcₙ_smul ..]
    congr! 1 with x hx
    simp [_root_.posPart_def, mul_max_of_nonneg]
  · obtain (rfl | hr) := eq_or_ne r 0
    · simp
    · have := (not_iff_not.mpr <| (IsSelfAdjoint.all r).smul_iff hr.isUnit (x := a)) |>.mpr ha
      simp [CFC.posPart_def, cfcₙ_apply_of_not_predicate a ha,
        cfcₙ_apply_of_not_predicate _ this]

name: negPart_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma negPart_smul {r : ℝ≥0} {a : A} : (r • a)⁻ = r • a⁻

name: posPart_smul_of_nonpos
statement: lemma posPart_smul_of_nonpos {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≤ 0) {a : A} : (r • a)⁺ = -r • a⁻
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← neg_neg r]
  rw [neg_smul, ← smul_neg, posPart_smul_of_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hr), posPart_neg]

name: negPart_smul_of_nonneg
statement: lemma negPart_smul_of_nonneg {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) {a : A} : (r • a)⁻ = r • a⁻
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← neg_neg r, neg_smul, negPart_neg, posPart_smul_of_nonpos (by simpa), neg_neg]

name: negPart_smul_of_nonpos
statement: lemma negPart_smul_of_nonpos {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≤ 0) {a : A} : (r • a)⁻ = -r • a⁺
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← neg_neg r, neg_smul, negPart_neg, posPart_smul_of_nonneg (by simpa)]

statement:
lemma posPart_nonneg (a : A) :
    0 ≤ a⁺

statement:
lemma negPart_nonneg (a : A) :

name: posPart_eq_of_eq_sub_negPart
statement:
lemma posPart_eq_of_eq_sub_negPart {a b : A} (hab : a = b - a⁻) (hb : 0 ≤ b := by cfc_tac) :
    a⁺ = b
proof:
:= by
  have ha := hab.symm ▸ hb.isSelfAdjoint.sub (negPart_nonneg a).isSelfAdjoint
  nth_rw 1 [← posPart_sub_negPart a] at hab
  simpa using hab

name: negPart_eq_of_eq_PosPart_sub
statement:
lemma negPart_eq_of_eq_PosPart_sub {a c : A} (hac : a = a⁺ - c) (hc : 0 ≤ c := by cfc_tac) :
    a⁻ = c
proof:
:= by
  have ha := hac.symm ▸ (posPart_nonneg a).isSelfAdjoint.sub hc.isSelfAdjoint
  nth_rw 1 [← posPart_sub_negPart a] at hac
  simpa using hac

name: le_posPart
statement: lemma le_posPart {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := by cfc_tac) : a ≤ a⁺
proof:
:= by
  simpa [posPart_sub_negPart a] using sub_le_self a⁺ (negPart_nonneg a)

name: neg_negPart_le
statement: lemma neg_negPart_le {a : A} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := by cfc_tac) : -a⁻ ≤ a

name: posPart_eq_self
statement: lemma posPart_eq_self (a : A) : a⁺ = a ↔ 0 ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ha ↦ ha ▸ posPart_nonneg a, fun ha ↦ ?_⟩
  conv_rhs => rw [← cfcₙ_id ℝ a]
  rw [posPart_def]
  congr! 1 with x hx
  simpa [_root_.posPart_def] using quasispectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg a ha x hx

name: negPart_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma negPart_eq_zero_iff (a : A) (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := by cfc_tac) :
    a⁻ = 0 ↔ 0 ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← posPart_eq_self, eq_comm (b := a)]
  nth_rw 2 [← posPart_sub_negPart a]
  simp

name: negPart_eq_neg
statement: lemma negPart_eq_neg (a : A) : a⁻ = -a ↔ a ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_inj, neg_neg, eq_comm]
  refine ⟨fun ha ↦ by rw [ha, neg_nonpos]; exact negPart_nonneg a, fun ha ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← neg_nonneg] at ha
  rw [negPart_def, ← cfcₙ_neg]
  have _ : IsSelfAdjoint a := neg_neg a ▸ (IsSelfAdjoint.neg <| .of_nonneg ha)
  conv_lhs => rw [← cfcₙ_id ℝ a]
  congr! 1 with x hx
  rw [Unitization.quasispectrum_eq_spectrum_inr ℝ, ← neg_neg x, ← Set.mem_neg,
    spectrum.neg_eq, ← Unitization.inr_neg, ← Unitization.quasispectrum_eq_spectrum_inr ℝ] at hx
  rw [← neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, eq_comm]
  simpa using quasispectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg _ ha _ hx

name: posPart_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma posPart_eq_zero_iff (a : A) (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := by cfc_tac) :
    a⁺ = 0 ↔ a ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← negPart_eq_neg, eq_comm (b := -a)]
  nth_rw 2 [← posPart_sub_negPart a]
  simp

name: posPart_negPart_unique
statement:
lemma posPart_negPart_unique {a b c : A} (habc : a = b - c) (hbc : b * c = 0)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b := by cfc_tac) (hc : 0 ≤ c := by cfc_tac) :
    a⁺ = b ∧ a⁻ = c
proof:
:= by
  /- The key idea is to show that `cfcₙ f a = cfcₙ f b + cfcₙ f (-c)` for all real-valued `f`
  continuous on the union of the spectra of `a`, `b`, and `-c`. Then apply this to `f = (·⁺)`.
  The equality holds because both sides constitute star homomorphisms which agree on `f = id` since
  `a = b - c`. -/
  /- `a`, `b`, `-c` are selfadjoint. -/
  have hb' : IsSelfAdjoint b := .of_nonneg hb
  have hc' : IsSelfAdjoint (-c) := .neg <| .of_nonneg hc
  have ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := habc ▸ hb'.sub <| .of_nonneg hc
  /- It suffices to show `b = a⁺` since `a⁺ - a⁻ = a = b - c` -/
  rw [and_iff_left_of_imp ?of_b_eq]
  case of_b_eq =>
    rintro rfl
    exact negPart_eq_of_eq_PosPart_sub habc hc
  /- `s := σₙ ℝ a ∪ σₙ ℝ b ∪ σₙ ℝ (-c)` is compact and each of these sets are subsets of `s`.
  Moreover, `0 ∈ s`. -/
  let s := σₙ ℝ a ∪ σₙ ℝ b ∪ σₙ ℝ (-c)
  have hs : CompactSpace s := by
    refine isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp <| (IsCompact.union ?_ ?_).union ?_
    all_goals exact isCompact_quasispectrum _
  obtain ⟨has, hbs, hcs⟩ : σₙ ℝ a ⊆ s ∧ σₙ ℝ b ⊆ s ∧ σₙ ℝ (-c) ⊆ s := by grind
  have : Fact (0 ∈ s) := ⟨by aesop⟩
  /- The continuous functional calculi for functions `f g : C(s, ℝ)₀` applied to `b` and `(-c)`
  are orthogonal (i.e., the product is always zero). -/
  have mul₁ (f g : C(s, ℝ)₀) :
      (cfcₙHomSuperset hb' hbs f) * (cfcₙHomSuperset hc' hcs g) = 0 := by
    refine f.nonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply_mul_eq_zero _ _ ?id ?star_id
      (cfcₙHomSuperset_continuous hb' hbs)
    case' star_id => rw [star_trivial]
    all_goals
      refine g.mul_nonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply_eq_zero _ _ ?_ ?_
        (cfcₙHomSuperset_continuous hc' hcs)
      all_goals simp only [star_trivial, cfcₙHomSuperset_id hb' hbs,
        cfcₙHomSuperset_id hc' hcs, mul_neg, hbc, neg_zero]
  have mul₂ (f g : C(s, ℝ)₀) : (cfcₙHomSuperset hc' hcs f) * (cfcₙHomSuperset hb' hbs g) = 0 := by
    simpa only [star_mul, star_zero, ← map_star, star_trivial] using congr(star $(mul₁ g f))
  /- `fun f ↦ cfcₙ f b + cfcₙ f (-c)` defines a star homomorphism `ψ : C(s, ℝ)₀ →⋆ₙₐ[ℝ] A` which
  agrees with the star homomorphism `cfcₙ · a : C(s, ℝ)₀ →⋆ₙₐ[ℝ] A` since
  `cfcₙ id a = a = b - c = cfcₙ id b + cfcₙ id (-c)`. -/
  let ψ : C(s, ℝ)₀ →⋆ₙₐ[ℝ] A :=
    { (cfcₙHomSuperset hb' hbs : C(s, ℝ)₀ →ₗ[ℝ] A) + (cfcₙHomSuperset hc' hcs : C(s, ℝ)₀ →ₗ[ℝ] A)
        with
      toFun := cfcₙHomSuperset hb' hbs + cfcₙHomSuperset hc' hcs
      map_zero' := by simp [-cfcₙHomSuperset_apply]
      map_mul' := fun f g ↦ by
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, map_mul, mul_add, add_mul, mul₂, add_zero, mul₁,
          zero_add]
      map_star' := fun f ↦ by simp [← map_star] }
  have key : (cfcₙHomSuperset ha has) = ψ :=
    have : ContinuousMapZero.UniqueHom ℝ A := inferInstance
    ContinuousMapZero.UniqueHom.eq_of_continuous_of_map_id s
    (cfcₙHomSuperset ha has) ψ (cfcₙHomSuperset_continuous ha has)
    ((cfcₙHomSuperset_continuous hb' hbs).add (cfcₙHomSuperset_continuous hc' hcs))
    (by simpa [ψ, -cfcₙHomSuperset_apply, cfcₙHomSuperset_id, sub_eq_add_neg] using habc)
  /- Applying the equality of star homomorphisms to the function `(·⁺ : ℝ → ℝ)` we find that
  `b = cfcₙ id b + cfcₙ 0 (-c) = cfcₙ (·⁺) b - cfcₙ (·⁺) (-c) = cfcₙ (·⁺) a = a⁺`, where the
  second equality follows because these functions are equal on the spectra of `b` and `-c`,
  respectively, since `0 ≤ b` and `-c ≤ 0`. -/
  let f : C(s, ℝ)₀ := ⟨⟨(·⁺), by fun_prop⟩, by simp; norm_cast⟩
  replace key := congr($key f)
  simp only [cfcₙHomSuperset_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.coe_mk', NonUnitalAlgHom.coe_mk, ψ,
    Pi.add_apply, cfcₙHom_eq_cfcₙ_extend (·⁺)] at key
  symm
  calc
    b = cfcₙ (id : ℝ → ℝ) b + cfcₙ (0 : ℝ → ℝ) (-c) := by simp [cfcₙ_id' ℝ b]
    _ = _ := by
      congr! 1
      all_goals
        congr! 1 with x hx
        symm
        lift x to σₙ ℝ _ using hx
        simp only [Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply, comp_apply, coe_mk,
          ContinuousMap.coe_mk, Subtype.map_coe, id_eq, _root_.posPart_eq_self, f, Pi.zero_apply,
          posPart_eq_zero]
      · exact quasispectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg b hb x.val x.property
      · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
        simp only [← neg_nonneg]
        rw [Unitization.quasispectrum_eq_spectrum_inr ℝ (-c), Unitization.inr_neg,
          ← spectrum.neg_eq, Set.mem_neg, ← Unitization.quasispectrum_eq_spectrum_inr ℝ c]
          at hx
        exact quasispectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg c hc _ hx
    _ = _ := key.symm
    _ = a⁺ := by
      refine cfcₙ_congr fun x hx ↦ ?_
      lift x to σₙ ℝ a using hx
      simp [f]

name: CStarAlgebra.linear_combination_nonneg

lemma CStarAlgebra.linear_combination_nonneg (x : A) :
    ((ℜ x : A)⁺ - (ℜ x : A)⁻) + (I • (ℑ x : A)⁺ - I • (ℑ x : A)⁻) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [CFC.posPart_sub_negPart _ (ℜ x).2, ← smul_sub, CFC.posPart_sub_negPart _ (ℑ x).2,

name: CStarAlgebra.span_nonneg
statement: lemma CStarAlgebra.span_nonneg : Submodule.span ℂ {a : A | 0 ≤ a} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => ?_
  rw [← CStarAlgebra.linear_combination_nonneg x]
  apply_rules [sub_mem, Submodule.smul_mem, add_mem]
  all_goals
    refine subset_span ?_
    first | apply CFC.negPart_nonneg | apply CFC.posPart_nonneg

name: nnnorm_rpow
statement:
lemma nnnorm_rpow (a : A) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) :
    ‖a ^ r‖₊ = ‖a‖₊ ^ r
proof:
:= by
  lift r to ℝ≥0 using hr.le

    fun a ha => (hμ a ha).2

lemma monotone_nnrpow {p : ℝ≥0} (hp : p ∈ Icc 0 1) :

  intro a b hab
  by_cases ha : 0 ≤ a
  · have hb : 0 ≤ b := ha.trans hab
    have hIcc : Icc (0 : ℝ≥0) 1 = Ioo 0 1 ∪ {0} ∪ {1} := by ext; simp
    rw [hIcc] at hp
    obtain (hp | hp) | hp := hp
    · exact monotoneOn_nnrpow_Ioo hp ha hb hab
    · simp_all [mem_singleton_iff]
    · simp_all [mem_singleton_iff, nnrpow_one a, nnrpow_one b]

    simp [this]

name: _root_.CStarAlgebra.nonneg_TFAE
statement:
theorem _root_.CStarAlgebra.nonneg_TFAE {a : A} :
    [ 0 ≤ a,
      a = sqrt a * sqrt a,
      ∃ b : A, 0 ≤ b ∧ a = b * b,
      ∃ b : A, IsSelfAdjoint b ∧ a = b * b,
      ∃ b : A, a = star b * b,
      ∃ b : A, a = b * star b,
      a = a⁺,
      IsSelfAdjoint a ∧ a⁻ = 0,
      IsSelfAdjoint a ∧ QuasispectrumRestricts a ContinuousMap.realToNNReal ].TFAE
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 9 := nonneg_iff_isSelfAdjoint_and_quasispectrumRestricts
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 7 := eq_comm.eq ▸ (CFC.posPart_eq_self a).symm
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 8 := ⟨fun h => ⟨h.isSelfAdjoint, negPart_eq_zero_iff a |>.mpr h⟩,
    fun h => negPart_eq_zero_iff a |>.mp h.2⟩
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := fun h => sqrt_mul_sqrt_self a |>.symm
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := fun h => ⟨sqrt a, sqrt_nonneg a, h⟩
  tfae_have 3 → 4 := fun ⟨b, hb⟩ => ⟨b, hb.1.isSelfAdjoint, hb.2⟩
  tfae_have 4 → 5 := fun ⟨b, hb⟩ => ⟨b, hb.1.symm ▸ hb.2⟩
  tfae_have 5 → 6 := fun ⟨b, hb⟩ => ⟨star b, star_star b |>.symm ▸ hb⟩
  tfae_have 6 → 1 := fun ⟨b, hb⟩ => hb ▸ mul_star_self_nonneg _
  tfae_finish

statement: lemma rpow_zero (a : A) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) : a ^ (0 : ℝ) = 1

name: rpow_zero_eqOn
statement: lemma rpow_zero_eqOn : (Set.Ici (0 : A)).EqOn (fun a => a ^ (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  simp [rpow_zero a ha]

name: zero_rpow
statement: lemma zero_rpow {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : rpow (0 : A) x = 0

name: rpow_natCast
statement: lemma rpow_natCast (a : A) (n : ℕ) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) : a ^ (n : ℝ) = a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_pow_id (R := ℝ≥0) a n, rpow_def]
  congr
  simp

name: rpow_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rpow_algebraMap {x : ℝ≥0} {y : ℝ} :
    (algebraMap ℝ≥0 A x) ^ y = algebraMap ℝ≥0 A (x ^ y)

name: rpow_add
statement:
lemma rpow_add {a : A} {x y : ℝ} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    a ^ (x + y) = a ^ x * a ^ y
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : 0 ∉ spectrum ℝ≥0 a := spectrum.zero_notMem _ ha
  simp only [rpow_def]
  rw [← cfc_mul _ _ a]
  congr! 1 with z hz
  have : z ≠ 0 := by aesop
  simp [NNReal.rpow_add this _ _]

name: rpow_rpow
statement:
lemma rpow_rpow [IsSemitopologicalRing A] [T2Space A]
    (a : A) (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    (a ^ x) ^ y = a ^ (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  have ha₁' : 0 ∉ spectrum ℝ≥0 a := spectrum.zero_notMem _ ha.isUnit
  simp only [rpow_def]
  rw [← cfc_comp _ _ a ha.nonneg]
  congr! 1 with _ _
  simp [NNReal.rpow_mul]

name: rpow_rpow_inv
statement:
lemma rpow_rpow_inv [IsSemitopologicalRing A] [T2Space A]
    (a : A) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    (a ^ x) ^ x⁻¹ = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [rpow_rpow a x x⁻¹ hx, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx, rpow_one a ha.nonneg]

name: rpow_inv_rpow
statement:
lemma rpow_inv_rpow [IsSemitopologicalRing A] [T2Space A]
    (a : A) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    (a ^ x⁻¹) ^ x = a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using rpow_rpow_inv a x⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hx)

name: rpow_rpow_of_exponent_nonneg
statement:
lemma rpow_rpow_of_exponent_nonneg [IsSemitopologicalRing A] [T2Space A] (a : A) (x y : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) : (a ^ x) ^ y = a ^ (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rpow_def]
  rw [← cfc_comp _ _ a]
  congr! 1 with _ _
  simp [NNReal.rpow_mul]

name: rpow_mul_rpow_neg
statement:
lemma rpow_mul_rpow_neg {a : A} (x : ℝ) (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    a ^ x * a ^ (-x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_add ha.isUnit, add_neg_cancel, rpow_zero a]

name: rpow_neg_mul_rpow
statement:
lemma rpow_neg_mul_rpow {a : A} (x : ℝ) (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    a ^ (-x) * a ^ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rpow_add ha.isUnit, neg_add_cancel, rpow_zero a]

name: rpow_neg_one_eq_inv
statement:
lemma rpow_neg_one_eq_inv (a : Aˣ) (ha : (0 : A) ≤ a := by cfc_tac) :
    a ^ (-1 : ℝ) = (↑a⁻¹ : A)
proof:
:= by
  refine a.inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left ?_ |>.symm
  simpa [rpow_one (a : A)] using rpow_neg_mul_rpow 1 (a.isStrictlyPositive_iff.mpr ha)

name: rpow_neg_one_eq_cfc_inv
statement:
lemma rpow_neg_one_eq_cfc_inv {A : Type*} [PartialOrder A] [NormedRing A] [StarRing A]
    [StarOrderedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℝ A] [NonnegSpectrumClass ℝ A]
    [ContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ A IsSelfAdjoint] (a : A) :
    a ^ (-1 : ℝ) = cfc (·⁻¹ : ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0) a

name: inverse_eq_rpow_neg_one
statement:
lemma inverse_eq_rpow_neg_one {a : A} (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    Ring.inverse a = a ^ (-1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ax, hax⟩ := ha.isUnit
  simp only [← hax, Ring.inverse_invertible, invOf_units, CFC.rpow_neg_one_eq_inv ax]

name: rpow_neg
statement:
lemma rpow_neg [IsSemitopologicalRing A] [T2Space A] (a : Aˣ) (x : ℝ)
    (ha' : (0 : A) ≤ a := by cfc_tac) : (a : A) ^ (-x) = (↑a⁻¹ : A) ^ x
proof:
:= by
  suffices h₁ : ContinuousOn (fun z ↦ z ^ x) (Inv.inv '' (spectrum ℝ≥0 (a : A))) by
    rw [← cfc_inv_id (R := ℝ≥0) a, rpow_def, rpow_def,
        ← cfc_comp' (fun z => z ^ x) (Inv.inv : ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0) (a : A) h₁]
    congr! 1 with _ _
    simp [NNReal.rpow_neg, NNReal.inv_rpow]
  refine NNReal.continuousOn_rpow_const (.inl ?_)
  rintro ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩
  exact spectrum.zero_notMem ℝ≥0 a.isUnit <| inv_eq_zero.mp hz' ▸ hz

name: rpow_intCast
statement:
lemma rpow_intCast (a : Aˣ) (n : ℤ) (ha : (0 : A) ≤ a := by cfc_tac) :
    (a : A) ^ (n : ℝ) = (↑(a ^ n) : A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_zpow (R := ℝ≥0) a n, rpow_def]
  congr! 1 with _ _
  simp

name: _root_.IsUnit.cfcRpow
statement:
@[aesop safe apply, grind ←]
lemma _root_.IsUnit.cfcRpow {a : A} (ha : IsUnit a) (x : ℝ) (ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) :
    IsUnit (a ^ x)

name: spectrum_rpow
statement:
lemma spectrum_rpow (a : A) (x : ℝ)
    (h : ContinuousOn (· ^ x) (spectrum ℝ≥0 a) := by cfc_cont_tac)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) :
    spectrum ℝ≥0 (a ^ x) = (· ^ x) '' spectrum ℝ≥0 a
proof:
:=
  cfc_map_spectrum (· ^ x : ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0) a ha h

name: isUnit_rpow_iff
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma isUnit_rpow_iff (a : A) (y : ℝ) (hy : y ≠ 0) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) :
    IsUnit (a ^ y) ↔ IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.cfcRpow y ha⟩
  rw [rpow_def] at h
  by_cases hf : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ≥0 => x ^ y) (spectrum ℝ≥0 a)
  · rw [isUnit_cfc_iff _ a hf] at h
    refine spectrum.isUnit_of_zero_notMem ℝ≥0 ?_
    intro h0
    specialize h 0 h0
    simp only [ne_eq, NNReal.rpow_eq_zero_iff, true_and, Decidable.not_not] at h
    exact hy h
  · rw [cfc_apply_of_not_continuousOn a hf] at h
    exact False.elim <| not_isUnit_zero h

name: rpow_map_prod
statement:
lemma rpow_map_prod {a : A} {b : B} {x : ℝ} (ha : IsUnit a) (hb : IsUnit b)
    (ha' : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) (hb' : 0 ≤ b := by cfc_tac) :
    rpow (a, b) x = (a ^ x, b ^ x)
proof:
:= by
  have ha'' : 0 ∉ spectrum ℝ≥0 a := spectrum.zero_notMem _ ha
  have hb'' : 0 ∉ spectrum ℝ≥0 b := spectrum.zero_notMem _ hb
  simp only [rpow_def]
  unfold rpow
  refine cfc_map_prod (R := ℝ≥0) (S := ℝ) _ a b (by cfc_cont_tac) ?_
  rw [Prod.le_def]
  constructor <;> simp [ha', hb']

name: rpow_eq_rpow_prod
statement:
lemma rpow_eq_rpow_prod {a : A} {b : B} {x : ℝ} (ha : IsUnit a) (hb : IsUnit b)
    (ha' : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) (hb' : 0 ≤ b := by cfc_tac) :
    rpow (a, b) x = (a, b) ^ x

name: rpow_map_pi
statement:
lemma rpow_map_pi {c : ∀ i, C i} {x : ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, IsUnit (c i))
    (hc' : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i := by cfc_tac) :
    rpow c x = fun i => (c i) ^ x
proof:
:= by
  have hc'' : ∀ i, 0 ∉ spectrum ℝ≥0 (c i) := fun i => spectrum.zero_notMem _ (hc i)
  simp only [rpow_def]
  unfold rpow
  exact cfc_map_pi (S := ℝ) _ c

name: rpow_eq_rpow_pi
statement:
lemma rpow_eq_rpow_pi {c : ∀ i, C i} {x : ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, IsUnit (c i))
    (hc' : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i := by cfc_tac) :
    rpow c x = c ^ x

statement: lemma nnrpow_eq_rpow {a : A} {x : ℝ≥0} (hx : 0 < x) : a ^ x = a ^ (x : ℝ)

name: sqrt_eq_rpow
statement: lemma sqrt_eq_rpow {a : A} : sqrt a = a ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have : a ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = a ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := rfl
  rw [this, ← nnrpow_eq_rpow (by simp), sqrt_eq_nnrpow a]

name: sqrt_eq_cfc
statement: lemma sqrt_eq_cfc {a : A} : sqrt a = cfc NNReal.sqrt a

name: sqrt_sq
statement: lemma sqrt_sq (a : A) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) : sqrt (a ^ 2) = a

statement: lemma sq_sqrt (a : A) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) : (sqrt a) ^ 2 = a

statement:
lemma sq_eq_sq_iff (a b : A) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) (hb : 0 ≤ b := by cfc_tac) :
    a ^ 2 = b ^ 2 ↔ a = b

name: sqrt_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sqrt_algebraMap {r : ℝ≥0} : sqrt (algebraMap ℝ≥0 A r) = algebraMap ℝ≥0 A (NNReal.sqrt r)

name: sqrt_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sqrt_one : sqrt (1 : A) = 1

name: sqrt_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma sqrt_eq_one_iff (a : A) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) :
    sqrt a = 1 ↔ a = 1

name: sqrt_eq_one_iff'
statement:
lemma sqrt_eq_one_iff' [Nontrivial A] (a : A) :
    sqrt a = 1 ↔ a = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ sqrt_eq_one_iff a ?_ |>.mp h, fun h ↦ by subst h; exact sqrt_one⟩
  rw [sqrt, cfcₙ] at h
  cfc_tac

name: sqrt_rpow
statement:
lemma sqrt_rpow {a : A} {x : ℝ} (h : IsUnit a)
    (hx : x ≠ 0) : sqrt (a ^ x) = a ^ (x / 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnonneg : 0 ≤ a
  case pos =>
    have : IsStrictlyPositive a := by grind
    simp [sqrt_eq_rpow, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, rpow_rpow _ _ _ hx]
  case neg =>
    simp [sqrt_eq_cfc, rpow_def, cfc_apply_of_not_predicate a hnonneg]

name: rpow_sqrt
statement:
lemma rpow_sqrt (a : A) (x : ℝ) (h : IsUnit a)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) : (sqrt a) ^ x = a ^ (x / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsStrictlyPositive a := by grind
  rw [sqrt_eq_rpow, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul,
      rpow_rpow _ _ _ (by simp), inv_mul_eq_div]

name: sqrt_rpow_nnreal
statement: lemma sqrt_rpow_nnreal {a : A} {x : ℝ≥0} : sqrt (a ^ (x : ℝ)) = a ^ (x / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases htriv : 0 ≤ a
  case neg => simp [sqrt_eq_cfc, rpow_def, cfc_apply_of_not_predicate a htriv]
  case pos =>
    cases eq_zero_or_pos x with
    | inl hx => simp [hx, rpow_zero _ htriv]
    | inr h₁ =>
      have h₂ : (x : ℝ) / 2 = NNReal.toReal (x / 2) := by simp
      have h₃ : 0 < x / 2 := by positivity
      rw [← nnrpow_eq_rpow h₁, h₂, ← nnrpow_eq_rpow h₃, sqrt_nnrpow (A := A)]

name: rpow_sqrt_nnreal
statement:
lemma rpow_sqrt_nnreal {a : A} {x : ℝ≥0}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) : (sqrt a) ^ (x : ℝ) = a ^ (x / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  case pos =>
    have ha' : 0 ≤ sqrt a := sqrt_nonneg _
    simp [hx, rpow_zero _ ha', rpow_zero _ ha]
  case neg =>
    have h₁ : 0 ≤ (x : ℝ) := NNReal.zero_le_coe
    rw [sqrt_eq_rpow, rpow_rpow_of_exponent_nonneg _ _ _ (by simp) h₁, one_div_mul_eq_div]

name: isUnit_nnrpow_iff
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma isUnit_nnrpow_iff (a : A) (y : ℝ≥0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) :
    IsUnit (a ^ y) ↔ IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  rw [nnrpow_eq_rpow (pos_of_ne_zero hy)]
  refine isUnit_rpow_iff a y ?_ ha
  exact_mod_cast hy

name: _root_.IsUnit.cfcNNRpow

lemma _root_.IsUnit.cfcNNRpow (a : A) (y : ℝ≥0) (ha_unit : IsUnit a) (hy : y ≠ 0)

statement: lemma isUnit_sqrt_iff (a : A) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) : IsUnit (sqrt a) ↔ IsUnit a

name: isUnit_sqrt_iff_isStrictlyPositive
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma isUnit_sqrt_iff_isStrictlyPositive {a : A} : IsUnit (sqrt a) ↔ IsStrictlyPositive a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, by grind [isUnit_sqrt_iff]⟩
  rw [IsStrictlyPositive.iff_of_unital]
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by
    nontriviality
    by_contra H
    rw [CFC.sqrt_of_not_nonneg H] at h
    exact not_isUnit_zero h
  refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
  rwa [isUnit_sqrt_iff _ ha] at h

lemma _root_.IsStrictlyPositive.isUnit_cfcSqrt (a : A) (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :

name: inverse_rpow
statement:
lemma inverse_rpow (a : A) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a := by cfc_tac) :
    Ring.inverse (a ^ x) = a ^ (-x)
proof:
:= by
  have : a ^ (-x) = (a ^ x) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [rpow_rpow (hx := hx) (ha := by grind)]
    simp
  rw [← inverse_eq_rpow_neg_one (by grind)] at this
  rw [this]

name: _root_.IsStrictlyPositive.ringInverse
statement:
@[aesop safe apply]
lemma _root_.IsStrictlyPositive.ringInverse {a : A} (ha : IsStrictlyPositive a) :
    IsStrictlyPositive a⁻¹ʳ

name: _root_.isStrictlyPositive_ringInverse_iff
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma _root_.isStrictlyPositive_ringInverse_iff {a : A} :
    IsStrictlyPositive a⁻¹ʳ ↔ IsStrictlyPositive a
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, IsStrictlyPositive.ringInverse⟩
  have ha : IsUnit a := by
    by_contra H
    rw [Ring.inverse_non_unit _ H, IsStrictlyPositive.iff_of_unital] at h
    exact not_isUnit_zero h.2
  rw [← Ring.inverse_inverse ha]
  exact h.ringInverse

name: ringInverse_nonneg_iff_nonneg_of_isUnit
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma ringInverse_nonneg_iff_nonneg_of_isUnit {a : A} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    0 ≤ a⁻¹ʳ ↔ 0 ≤ a

name: sqrt_ringInverse
statement:
@[grind _=_]
lemma sqrt_ringInverse {a : A} : sqrt a⁻¹ʳ = (sqrt a)⁻¹ʳ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : IsStrictlyPositive a
  · rw [sqrt_eq_rpow, sqrt_eq_rpow, inverse_rpow _ _ (by grind),
        inverse_eq_rpow_neg_one, rpow_rpow _ _ _ (by grind)]
    grind only
  · have ha' : ¬IsUnit (sqrt a) := by rwa [CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff_isStrictlyPositive]
    obtain (H | H) : ¬0 ≤ a ∨ ¬IsUnit a := by grind
    · rw [sqrt_of_not_nonneg H, inverse_zero]
      by_cases hunit : IsUnit a
      · have h₂ : ¬0 ≤ inverse a := by grind [CFC.ringInverse_nonneg_iff_nonneg_of_isUnit]
        rw [sqrt_of_not_nonneg h₂]
      · simp [inverse_non_unit _ hunit]
    · simp [inverse_non_unit _ ha', inverse_non_unit _ H]

name: _root_.CStarAlgebra.isStrictlyPositive_TFAE
statement:
theorem _root_.CStarAlgebra.isStrictlyPositive_TFAE {a : A} :
    [IsStrictlyPositive a,
     IsStrictlyPositive (sqrt a) ∧ a = sqrt a * sqrt a,
     IsUnit (sqrt a) ∧ a = sqrt a * sqrt a,
     ∃ b, IsStrictlyPositive b ∧ a = b * b,
     ∃ b, IsUnit b ∧ IsSelfAdjoint b ∧ a = b * b,
     ∃ b, IsUnit b ∧ a = star b * b,
     ∃ b, IsUnit b ∧ a = b * star b,
     0 ≤ a ∧ IsUnit a,
     IsSelfAdjoint a ∧ ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ a, 0 < x].TFAE
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 8 := IsStrictlyPositive.iff_of_unital
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 9 := ⟨fun h => ⟨h.isSelfAdjoint,
      StarOrderedRing.isStrictlyPositive_iff_spectrum_pos a |>.mp h⟩,
    fun h => (StarOrderedRing.isStrictlyPositive_iff_spectrum_pos a).mpr h.2⟩
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := fun h => ⟨h.sqrt, sqrt_mul_sqrt_self a |>.symm⟩
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := fun h => ⟨h.1.isUnit, h.2⟩
  tfae_have 3 → 4 := fun h => ⟨sqrt a, h.1.isStrictlyPositive (sqrt_nonneg _), h.2⟩
  tfae_have 4 → 5 := fun ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ => ⟨b, hb.isUnit, hb.isSelfAdjoint, hab⟩
  tfae_have 5 → 6 := fun ⟨b, hb, hbsa, hab⟩ => ⟨b, hb, hbsa.symm ▸ hab⟩
  tfae_have 6 → 7 := fun ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ => ⟨star b, hb.star, star_star b |>.symm ▸ hab⟩
  tfae_have 7 → 8 := fun ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ => ⟨hab ▸ mul_star_self_nonneg _, hab ▸ hb.mul hb.star⟩
  tfae_finish

name: _root_.CStarAlgebra.isStrictlyPositive_iff_isStrictlyPositive_sqrt_and_eq_sqrt_mul_sqrt

name: measurable_sqrt
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_sqrt : Measurable (sqrt : A → A)
proof:
:= by
  have h_measurable : MeasurableSet {S : A | 0 ≤ S} :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_id).measurableSet
  classical
  convert continuousOn_sqrt.measurable_piecewise (continuousOn_const (c := 0)) h_measurable
  ext S
  by_cases hS : 0 ≤ S
  · simp [hS]
  · simp [hS, sqrt_of_not_nonneg]

@[simp]
lemma rpowIntegrand₀₁_zero_right : rpowIntegrand₀₁ p t 0 = 0

name: rpowIntegrand
statement: lemma rpowIntegrand₀₁_zero_left (hp : 0 < p) : rpowIntegrand₀₁ p 0 x = 0

name: rpowIntegrand
statement:
lemma rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq_sub {p t : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 1) (ht : 0 < t) :
    rpowIntegrand₀₁ p t = fun x => t ^ (p - 1) - t ^ p * (t + x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold rpowIntegrand₀₁
  ext x
  rw [mul_sub, ← rpow_neg_one, ← rpow_add' (by grind) (by grind)]
  grind only

name: rpowIntegrand
statement:
lemma rpowIntegrand₀₁_nonneg (hp : 0 < p) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ rpowIntegrand₀₁ p t x
proof:
:= by
  unfold rpowIntegrand₀₁
  cases eq_or_lt_of_le' ht with
  | inl ht_zero => simp [ht_zero, Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt hp)]
  | inr ht_pos =>
    refine mul_nonneg (by positivity) ?_
    rw [sub_nonneg]
    gcongr
    linarith

name: rpowIntegrand
statement:
lemma rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq_pow_div (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    rpowIntegrand₀₁ p t x = t ^ (p - 1) * x / (t + x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht' : t = 0
  case neg =>
    have hxt : t + x ≠ 0 := by positivity
    calc _ = (t : ℝ) ^ p * (t⁻¹ - (t + x)⁻¹) := rfl
      _ = (t : ℝ) ^ p * ((t + x - t) / (t * (t + x))) := by
          simp only [inv_eq_one_div]
          rw [div_sub_div _ _ (by lia) (by lia)]
          simp
      _ = t ^ p / t * x / (t + x) := by simp [field]
      _ = t ^ (p - 1) * x / (t + x) := by congr; exact (Real.rpow_sub_one ht' p).symm
  case pos =>
    push _ ∈ _ at hp
    have hp₂ : p - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    simp [rpowIntegrand₀₁, ht', hp.1.ne', hp₂]

name: rpowIntegrand
statement:
lemma rpowIntegrand₀₁_eqOn_pow_div (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Set.EqOn (rpowIntegrand₀₁ p · x) (fun t => t ^ (p - 1) * x / (t + x)) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  simp [rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq_pow_div hp (le_of_lt ht) hx]

name: rpowIntegrand
statement:
lemma rpowIntegrand₀₁_apply_mul (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    rpowIntegrand₀₁ p (x * t) x = (rpowIntegrand₀₁ p t 1) * x ^ (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hxt : 0 ≤ x * t := by positivity
  rw [rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq_pow_div hp hxt hx, rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq_pow_div hp ht zero_le_one]
  by_cases hx_zero : x = 0
  case neg =>
    calc _ = x ^ (p - 1) * (t ^ (p - 1) * (x / (x * t + x))) := by
              rw [← mul_assoc, mul_div_assoc, Real.mul_rpow hx ht]
      _ = x ^ (p - 1) * (t ^ (p - 1) * 1 / (t + 1)) := by
              have : x * t + x = x * (t + 1) := by ring
              rw [mul_div_assoc, this, div_mul_eq_div_mul_one_div, div_self hx_zero, one_mul]
      _ = t ^ (p - 1) * 1 / (t + 1) * x ^ (p - 1) := by rw [mul_comm]
  case pos =>
    rw [mem_Ioo] at hp
    simp [hx_zero, Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : p - 1 ≠ 0)]

name: rpowIntegrand
statement:
lemma rpowIntegrand₀₁_apply_mul' (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    rpowIntegrand₀₁ p (x * t) x * x = (rpowIntegrand₀₁ p t 1) * x ^ p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rpowIntegrand₀₁_apply_mul hp ht hx, mul_assoc]
  congr
  simpa using Eq.symm <| Real.rpow_add' hx (by aesop : (p - 1) + 1 ≠ 0)

name: rpowIntegrand
statement:
lemma rpowIntegrand₀₁_apply_mul_eqOn_Ici (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (Ici 0).EqOn (fun t => rpowIntegrand₀₁ p (x * t) x * x)
      (fun t => (rpowIntegrand₀₁ p t 1) * x ^ p)
proof:
:=
  fun _ ht => rpowIntegrand₀₁_apply_mul' hp ht hx

name: continuousOn_rpowIntegrand
statement:
lemma continuousOn_rpowIntegrand₀₁ (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    ContinuousOn (rpowIntegrand₀₁ p · x) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousOn.congr ?_ <| rpowIntegrand₀₁_eqOn_pow_div hp hx
  have h₀ : ContinuousOn (· ^ (p - 1) : ℝ → ℝ) (Ioi 0) := .rpow_const (by fun_prop) <|
    fun t ht => .inl ht.ne'
  fun_prop (disch := grind -abstractProof)

lemma aestronglyMeasurable_rpowIntegrand₀₁ (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :

statement:
lemma rpowIntegrand₀₁_monotoneOn (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    MonotoneOn (rpowIntegrand₀₁ p t) (Ici 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  by_cases h : x = 0
  case pos => simpa [h, rpowIntegrand₀₁] using rpowIntegrand₀₁_nonneg hp.1 ht hy
  case neg =>
    simp only [rpowIntegrand₀₁, mem_Ici] at hx h ⊢
    gcongr

name: continuousOn_rpowIntegrand
statement:
lemma continuousOn_rpowIntegrand₀₁_uncurry (hp : p ∈ Ioo 0 1) (s : Set ℝ) (hs : s ⊆ Ici 0) :
    ContinuousOn (rpowIntegrand₀₁ p).uncurry (Ioi 0 ×ˢ s)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun q => q.1 ^ (p - 1) * q.2 / (q.1 + q.2)
  refine ContinuousOn.congr (f := g) ?_ fun q => ?_
  · simp only [g]
    refine ContinuousOn.mul ?_ ?_
    · refine ContinuousOn.mul ?_ (by fun_prop)
      exact ContinuousOn.rpow_const (by fun_prop) (by grind)
    · exact ContinuousOn.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (by grind)
  · intro hq
    simp [Function.uncurry, g, rpowIntegrand₀₁_eq_pow_div hp (le_of_lt hq.1) (hs hq.2)]
